public function boolean wf_setghmx ();Long ll_rowcount ,ll_cur , ll_find, ll_insert
String ls_brbm,ls_brxm,ls_sfzh,ls_ghdate,ls_zlf,ls_ghf,ls_ksbm,ls_ksmc,ls_tsb,ls_mz,ls_brlx,ls_yblx,ls_ztbz,ls_zxlsh,ls_zhbz
Dec{2} ld_zlf,ld_zje,ld_fyze,ld_zlje
DateTime ldt_ghrq
IF is_dzr = '' Or IsNull(is_dzr) THEN
	MessageBox('提示','请先统计汇总!')
	RETURN False
END IF
IF is_dzr <> String(idt_begin,'yyyymmdd') THEN
	MessageBox('提示','对账日与实际统计的时间不一致，请重新统计!')
	RETURN False
END IF
//sb_ghmx表中查找到当天记录，则直接检索进行判断
IF tab_1.tab_ghmx.dw_ghmx.Retrieve( idt_begin,idt_end) > 0 THEN
	ld_zje = tab_1.tab_ghmx.dw_ghmx.Object.jzje_total[1]
	IF IsNull(ld_zje) THEN ld_zje = 0
	IF dw_1.Object.mzgh[1] <> ld_zje THEN
		dw_1.Object.mzgh[1] = ld_zje
		gf_begin_transaction(sqlca)
		IF dw_1.Update( ) <> 1 THEN
			gf_rollback_transaction(sqlca)
			RETURN False
		ELSE
			gf_commit_transaction(sqlca)
			dw_1.Retrieve(is_dzr)
			RETURN True
		END IF
	ELSE
		RETURN True
	END IF
END IF
//没有挂号明细则生成
IF IsValid(iuds_ghmx) THEN Destroy iuds_ghmx
iuds_ghmx = Create u_datastore
iuds_ghmx.DataObject = 'd_sbghmx'
iuds_ghmx.SetTransObject( sqlca)
ll_rowcount = iuds_ghmx.Retrieve( idt_begin,idt_end)
IF ll_rowcount > 0 THEN
	gf_waiting("正在生成挂号明细......",0)
	FOR ll_cur = 1 To ll_rowcount
		gf_waiting("正在生成挂号明细......",ll_cur / ll_rowcount * 100)
		ls_brbm = Trim(iuds_ghmx.Object.brbm[ll_cur])
		ls_brxm = Trim(iuds_ghmx.Object.brxm[ll_cur])
		ls_sfzh = Trim(iuds_ghmx.Object.sfzh[ll_cur])
		ldt_ghrq = iuds_ghmx.Object.jssj[ll_cur]
		ls_ghdate = String(ldt_ghrq,'yyyymmdd')
		//誅AT*

		ld_fyze = iuds_ghmx.Object.fyze[ll_cur]
		ld_zlje = iuds_ghmx.Object.zlje[ll_cur]
		IF IsNull(ld_fyze) THEN ld_fyze = 0
		IF IsNull(ld_zlje) THEN ld_zlje = 0
//		ld_zlf = ld_fyze + ld_zlje
		ld_zlf = ld_fyze
		IF ld_zlf < 0 THEN
			ls_zlf = '-' +Right('0000000000'+String(Abs(ld_zlf),'#####.00'),9)
		ELSE
			ls_zlf = Right('0000000000'+String(Abs(ld_zlf),'#####.00'),10)
		END IF
		//挂号费
		ls_ghf = Right('00000000000.00',10)
		//社保科室编码
		ls_ksbm = String(iuds_ghmx.Describe("Evaluate('LookUpDisplay(ksbm) ', "+ String(ll_cur) + ")"))
		IF IsNull(ls_ksbm) Or ls_ksbm = '' THEN ls_ksbm = '1'
		//获取对应科室名称
		IF IsValid (gu_ybjk) = False THEN //创建医保接口
			gu_ybjk = Create u_ybjk_his
		END IF
		IF gu_ybjk.of_get_ybksbm( ls_ksbm, ls_ksmc) < 0 THEN
			ls_ksbm = '1'
			ls_ksmc = '内    科'
		END IF
		
		ls_tsb = iuds_ghmx.Object.tsb[ll_cur]
		ls_mz = iuds_ghmx.Object.mjz[ll_cur]
		ls_brlx = iuds_ghmx.Object.brlx[ll_cur]
		ls_zxlsh = iuds_ghmx.Object.zxlsh[ll_cur]
		ls_zhbz = iuds_ghmx.Object.yblx[ll_cur]
		ls_yblx = Upper(Mid(ls_zhbz,1,1))
		ls_ztbz = Mid(ls_zhbz,2,1)
		IF ls_ztbz = '2' THEN ls_ztbz = '4'
		
		IF IsNull(ls_brbm) Or ls_brbm = '' THEN ls_brbm = '1'
		IF IsNull(ls_brxm) Or ls_brxm = '' THEN ls_brxm = '1'
		IF IsNull(ls_sfzh) Or ls_sfzh = '' THEN ls_sfzh = '1'
		
		IF Len(ls_ksmc) > 10 THEN ls_ksmc = gf_midstring(ls_ksmc,10)
		IF Len(ls_ksbm) > 5  THEN ls_ksbm = gf_midstring(ls_ksbm, 5)
		IF Len(ls_brxm) > 30 THEN ls_brxm = gf_midstring(ls_brxm,30)
		IF Len(ls_brbm) > 8 THEN ls_brbm = gf_midstring(ls_brbm,8)
		
		ll_insert = tab_1.tab_ghmx.dw_ghmx_save.InsertRow(0)
		tab_1.tab_ghmx.dw_ghmx_save.Object.id[ll_insert] = ls_brbm
		tab_1.tab_ghmx.dw_ghmx_save.Object.xm[ll_insert] = ls_brxm
		tab_1.tab_ghmx.dw_ghmx_save.Object.sfzh[ll_insert] = ls_sfzh
		tab_1.tab_ghmx.dw_ghmx_save.Object.gh_date[ll_insert] = ls_ghdate
		tab_1.tab_ghmx.dw_ghmx_save.Object.ks_bm[ll_insert] = ls_ksbm
		tab_1.tab_ghmx.dw_ghmx_save.Object.ks_na[ll_insert] = ls_ksmc
		tab_1.tab_ghmx.dw_ghmx_save.Object.ghf[ll_insert] = ls_ghf
		tab_1.tab_ghmx.dw_ghmx_save.Object.zlf[ll_insert] = ls_zlf
		tab_1.tab_ghmx.dw_ghmx_save.Object.db_bz[ll_insert] = ls_tsb
		tab_1.tab_ghmx.dw_ghmx_save.Object.mz_bz[ll_insert] = ls_mz
		tab_1.tab_ghmx.dw_ghmx_save.Object.p_type[ll_insert] = ls_brlx
		tab_1.tab_ghmx.dw_ghmx_save.Object.yb_bz[ll_insert] = ls_yblx
		tab_1.tab_ghmx.dw_ghmx_save.Object.zt_bz[ll_insert] = ls_ztbz
		tab_1.tab_ghmx.dw_ghmx_save.Object.cen_lsh[ll_insert] = ls_zxlsh
		tab_1.tab_ghmx.dw_ghmx_save.Object.jssj[ll_insert] = ldt_ghrq
	NEXT
	
	gf_waiting("挂号明细生成完成......",-1)
ELSE
	MessageBox('提示','没有可生成的挂号明细')
	destroy iuds_ghmx
	RETURN False
END IF
destroy iuds_ghmx
//更新
gf_begin_transaction(sqlca)
IF tab_1.tab_ghmx.dw_ghmx_save.Update() = 1 THEN
	gf_commit_transaction(sqlca)
	IF tab_1.tab_ghmx.dw_ghmx.Retrieve( idt_begin,idt_end) > 0 THEN
		ld_zje = tab_1.tab_ghmx.dw_ghmx.Object.jzje_total[1]
		IF IsNull(ld_zje) THEN ld_zje = 0
		IF dw_1.Object.mzgh[1] <> ld_zje THEN
			dw_1.Object.mzgh[1] = ld_zje
			gf_begin_transaction(sqlca)
			IF dw_1.Update( ) <> 1 THEN
				gf_rollback_transaction(sqlca)
				MessageBox('提示','更新对账信息失败，门诊挂号总费用：' + String(ld_zje))
				RETURN False
			ELSE
				gf_commit_transaction(sqlca)
				dw_1.Retrieve(is_dzr)
				RETURN True
			END IF
		ELSE
			RETURN True
		END IF
	END IF
ELSE
	gf_rollback_transaction(sqlca)
	MessageBox('提示','生成挂号明细失败')
	RETURN False
END IF
RETURN True



end function

public function boolean wf_setypmx ();String ls_brbm,ls_brxm,ls_sfzh,ls_cfdate,ls_fylb,ls_xmbm,ls_xmmc,ls_jx,ls_dw,ls_gg,ls_num,ls_price,ls_jylx
String ls_kbbl,ls_brlx,ls_ztbz,ls_tsb,ls_mzbz,ls_ysgh,ls_ksbm,ls_ksmc,ls_zxlsh,ls_fyze,ls_zlje,ls_ybbz,ls_zhbz,ls_fplsh
Long ll_cfs,ll_cur,ll_rowcount,ll_insert,ll_bfrow
Dec{2} ld_szfbl,ld_fyze,ld_zlje,ld_num,ld_ypzje,ld_cyzje,ld_kbbl,ld_szfbl2
Dec{4} ld_price,ld_zjje,ld_zfje
Dec ld_ywlsh,ld_jllsh
DateTime ldt_cfsj
Boolean lb_bf
ld_szfbl2 = -1
IF is_dzr = '' Or IsNull(is_dzr) THEN
	MessageBox('提示','请先统计汇总!')
	RETURN False
END IF
IF is_dzr <> String(idt_begin,'yyyymmdd') THEN
	MessageBox('提示','对账日与实际统计的时间不一致，请重新统计!')
	RETURN False
END IF

IF IsValid(iuds_ypmx) THEN
	Destroy iuds_ypmx
END IF
iuds_ypmx = Create u_datastore
iuds_ypmx.DataObject = 'd_sbypmx2'
iuds_ypmx.SetTransObject(sqlca)
iuds_ypmx.Retrieve(idt_begin,idt_end)

IF IsValid(iuds_bftp_fp) THEN
	Destroy iuds_bftp_fp
END IF
iuds_bftp_fp = Create u_datastore
iuds_bftp_fp.DataObject = 'dd_fplsh_bf'
iuds_bftp_fp.Reset()

ll_rowcount = iuds_ypmx.RowCount()
IF ll_rowcount > 0 THEN
	gf_waiting('正在生成药品明细.....',0)
	FOR ll_cur = 1 To ll_rowcount
		gf_waiting('正在生成药品明细.....', ll_cur / ll_rowcount * 100)
		ls_brbm = Trim(iuds_ypmx.Object.brbm[ll_cur])
		ls_brxm = Trim(iuds_ypmx.Object.brxm[ll_cur])
		ls_sfzh = Trim(iuds_ypmx.Object.sfzh[ll_cur])
		ld_ywlsh = iuds_ypmx.Object.ywlsh[ll_cur]
		ld_zjje = iuds_ypmx.Object.zjje[ll_cur]
		ld_zfje = iuds_ypmx.Object.zfje[ll_cur]
		ls_fplsh = iuds_ypmx.Object.fplsh[ll_cur]
		ls_jylx = iuds_ypmx.Object.jylx[ll_cur]
		ls_zxlsh = iuds_ypmx.Object.zxlsh[ll_cur]
		
		//判断是否部分退票
		ll_bfrow = iuds_bftp_fp.Find( "fplsh = '"+ls_fplsh+"' and jylx = '"+ls_jylx+"'", 1, iuds_bftp_fp.RowCount())
		IF ll_bfrow > 0 THEN
			CONTINUE
		ELSE
			//			lb_bf = wf_bftpxx(ls_fplsh,'CF',ls_zxlsh,ll_cur)
			lb_bf = wf_getbftp(ls_fplsh,'CF',ls_zxlsh,ll_cur)
			IF lb_bf THEN
				ll_bfrow = iuds_bftp_fp.InsertRow( 0)
				iuds_bftp_fp.Object.fplsh[ll_bfrow] = ls_fplsh
				iuds_bftp_fp.Object.jylx[ll_bfrow] = ls_jylx
				CONTINUE
			END IF
		END IF
		//--------------------------------
		ldt_cfsj = iuds_ypmx.Object.jssj[ll_cur]
		ls_cfdate = String(ldt_cfsj,'yyyymmdd')
		//药品编码、名称
		ls_xmbm = iuds_ypmx.Object.xmbm[ll_cur]
		ls_xmmc = iuds_ypmx.Object.xmmc[ll_cur]
		//单位、医生工号、自付比例、数量、单价、处方数
		ls_dw = iuds_ypmx.Object.dw[ll_cur]
		ls_jx = iuds_ypmx.Object.ybjx[ll_cur]
		ls_gg = iuds_ypmx.Object.gg[ll_cur]
		ls_ysgh = iuds_ypmx.Object.ysbm[ll_cur]
		ld_num = iuds_ypmx.Object.sl[ll_cur]
		ld_price = iuds_ypmx.Object.dj[ll_cur]
		ll_cfs = iuds_ypmx.Object.cfs[ll_cur]
		//自负比例
		ld_szfbl = iuds_ypmx.Object.szfbl[ll_cur]
		IF IsNull(ld_szfbl) THEN ld_szfbl = 1
		IF ld_szfbl = 1 And ld_zjje = ld_zfje THEN
			ld_jllsh = iuds_ypmx.Object.jllsh[ll_cur]
			IF wf_getzfbl(ld_jllsh,ls_fplsh,ld_ywlsh,'CF',ld_szfbl2) THEN
				IF IsNull(ld_szfbl2) THEN ld_szfbl2 = 0
				ld_szfbl = ld_szfbl2
			END IF
		END IF
		IF ld_szfbl = 1 And ld_zjje <> 0 And ld_zjje <> ld_zfje THEN
			IF Abs(ld_zjje) < Abs(ld_zfje) THEN
				ld_szfbl = 0
			ELSE
				ld_szfbl = ld_zfje / ld_zjje
			END IF
		END IF
		
		// //对于交易类型为RD01,SD01的则成负数
		//		ls_jylx = iuds_ypmx.Object.jylx[ll_cur]
		IF ls_jylx = 'RD01' Or ls_jylx = 'SD01' THEN
			ld_num  = -1 * ld_num
		END IF
		
		IF ld_num < 0 THEN
			ls_num = '-' +Right('0000000000'+String(Abs(ld_num),'#####.00'),9)
		ELSE
			ls_num = Right('0000000000'+String(Abs(ld_num),'#####.00'),10)
		END IF
		
		IF ld_price < 0 THEN
			ls_price = '-' +Right('0000000000'+String(Abs(ld_price),'#####.0000'),11)
		ELSE
			ls_price = Right('0000000000'+String(Abs(ld_price),'#####.0000'),12)
		END IF
		//对应科室编码和名称
		SELECT SBKS Into :ls_ksbm From mz_ks,mz_cfk Where mz_ks.ksbm = mz_cfk.ksbm And mz_cfk.cflsh = :ld_ywlsh;
		IF sqlca.SQLCode <> 0  THEN
			ls_ksbm = '1'
		END IF
		//		ls_ksbm = String(iuds_ypmx.Describe("Evaluate('LookUpDisplay(ksbm) ', "+ String(ll_cur) + ")"))
		IF IsNull(ls_ksbm) Or ls_ksbm = '' THEN ls_ksbm = '1'
		
		IF IsValid (gu_ybjk) = False THEN //创建医保接口
			gu_ybjk = Create u_ybjk_his
		END IF
		IF gu_ybjk.of_get_ybksbm( ls_ksbm, ls_ksmc) < 0 THEN
			ls_ksbm = '1'
			ls_ksmc = '内    科'
		END IF
		IF IsNull(ls_ksmc)  THEN ls_ksmc = ''
		
		//费用类别
		ls_fylb = String(iuds_ypmx.Describe("Evaluate('LookUpDisplay(fylb) ', "+ String(ll_cur) + ")"))
		IF IsNull(ls_fylb) THEN ls_fylb = ''
		ls_fylb = Right('00' + ls_fylb,2)
		//特殊病项目、门急诊、病人类型、中心流水号、职退标志、医保标志
		ls_tsb = iuds_ypmx.Object.thb[ll_cur]
		ls_mzbz = iuds_ypmx.Object.mjz[ll_cur]
		ls_brlx = iuds_ypmx.Object.brlx[ll_cur]
		ls_zhbz = iuds_ypmx.Object.yblx[ll_cur]
		ls_ztbz = Mid(ls_zhbz,2,1)
		IF ls_ztbz = '2' THEN ls_ztbz = '4'
		ls_ybbz = Mid(ls_zhbz,1 ,1)
		
		//========报销比例========== //
		ld_kbbl = 1 - ld_szfbl
		ls_kbbl = String(ld_kbbl,'0.00')
		IF ld_kbbl > 0 THEN
			ld_fyze = ld_num * ld_price * ld_kbbl
			IF ld_fyze < 0 THEN
				ls_fyze = '-' +Right('0000000000'+String(Abs(ld_fyze),'#####.00'),9)
			ELSE
				ls_fyze = Right('0000000000'+String(Abs(ld_fyze),'#####.00'),10)
			END IF
			ld_zlje = ld_num * ld_price * ld_szfbl
			IF ld_zlje < 0 THEN
				ls_zlje = '-' +Right('0000000000'+String(Abs(ld_zlje),'#####.00'),9)
			ELSE
				ls_zlje = Right('0000000000'+String(Abs(ld_zlje),'#####.00'),10)
			END IF
		ELSE
			ls_fyze = '0000000.00'
			ls_zlje = '0000000.00'
		END IF
		
		IF IsNull(ls_brbm) Or ls_brbm = '' THEN ls_brbm = '1'
		IF IsNull(ls_brxm) Or ls_brxm = '' THEN ls_brxm = '1'
		IF IsNull(ls_sfzh) Or Trim(ls_sfzh) = '' THEN ls_sfzh = '1'
		IF IsNull(ls_fylb) Or Trim(ls_fylb) = '' THEN ls_fylb = '03'
		IF IsNull(ls_xmbm) Or Trim(ls_xmbm) = '' THEN ls_xmbm = '1'
		IF IsNull(ls_xmmc) Or Trim(ls_xmmc) = '' THEN ls_xmmc = '1'
		IF IsNull(ls_dw) Or Trim(ls_dw) = '' THEN ls_dw = '无'
		IF IsNull(ls_jx) Or Trim(ls_jx) = '' THEN  ls_jx = '无'
		IF IsNull(ls_gg) Or Trim(ls_gg) = '' THEN  ls_gg = '无'
		
		IF IsNull(ls_ysgh) THEN ls_ysgh = ' '
		IF Len(ls_ksmc) > 10 THEN ls_ksmc = gf_midstring(ls_ksmc,10)
		IF Len(ls_ksbm) > 5  THEN ls_ksbm = gf_midstring(ls_ksbm,5)
		IF Len(ls_ysgh) > 6  THEN ls_ysgh = gf_midstring(ls_ysgh,6)
		IF Len(ls_xmmc) > 30 THEN ls_xmmc = gf_midstring(ls_xmmc,30)
		IF Len(ls_brbm) > 8  THEN ls_brbm = gf_midstring(ls_brbm,8)
		IF Len(ls_brxm) > 30 THEN ls_brxm = gf_midstring(ls_brxm,30)
		
		IF ls_fylb = '05' THEN //草药插到诊疗
			ll_insert = tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.InsertRow(0)
			tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.id[ll_insert] = ls_brbm
			tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.xm[ll_insert] = ls_brxm
			tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.sfzh[ll_insert] = ls_sfzh
			tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.cf_date[ll_insert] = ls_cfdate
			tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.fylb[ll_insert] = ls_fylb
			tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.xm_bm[ll_insert] = ls_xmbm
			tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.xm_na[ll_insert] = ls_xmmc
			tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.xm_unt[ll_insert] = ls_dw
			tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.num[ll_insert] = ls_num
			tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.price[ll_insert] = ls_price
			tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.kb_bl[ll_insert] = ls_kbbl
			tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.p_type[ll_insert] = ls_brlx
			tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.yb_bz[ll_insert] = ls_ybbz
			tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.zt_bz[ll_insert] = ls_ztbz
			tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.db_bz[ll_insert] = ls_tsb
			tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.mz_bz[ll_insert] = ls_mzbz
			tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.ys_gh[ll_insert] = ls_ysgh
			tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.ks_bm[ll_insert] = ls_ksbm
			tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.ks_na[ll_insert] = ls_ksmc
			tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.cen_lsh[ll_insert] = ls_zxlsh
			tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.cf_no[ll_insert] = ll_cfs
			tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.fyze[ll_insert] = ls_fyze
			tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.zlje[ll_insert] = ls_zlje
		ELSE
			ll_insert = tab_1.tab_ypmx.dw_ypmx.InsertRow(0)
			tab_1.tab_ypmx.dw_ypmx.Object.id[ll_insert] = ls_brbm
			tab_1.tab_ypmx.dw_ypmx.Object.xm[ll_insert] = ls_brxm
			tab_1.tab_ypmx.dw_ypmx.Object.sfzh[ll_insert] = ls_sfzh
			tab_1.tab_ypmx.dw_ypmx.Object.cf_date[ll_insert] = ls_cfdate
			tab_1.tab_ypmx.dw_ypmx.Object.fylb[ll_insert] = ls_fylb
			tab_1.tab_ypmx.dw_ypmx.Object.xm_bm[ll_insert] = ls_xmbm
			tab_1.tab_ypmx.dw_ypmx.Object.xm_na[ll_insert] = ls_xmmc
			tab_1.tab_ypmx.dw_ypmx.Object.mz_frm[ll_insert] = ls_jx
			tab_1.tab_ypmx.dw_ypmx.Object.xm_unt[ll_insert] = ls_dw
			tab_1.tab_ypmx.dw_ypmx.Object.xm_std[ll_insert] = ls_gg
			tab_1.tab_ypmx.dw_ypmx.Object.num[ll_insert] = ls_num
			tab_1.tab_ypmx.dw_ypmx.Object.price[ll_insert] = ls_price
			tab_1.tab_ypmx.dw_ypmx.Object.kb_bl[ll_insert] = ls_kbbl
			tab_1.tab_ypmx.dw_ypmx.Object.p_type[ll_insert] = ls_brlx
			tab_1.tab_ypmx.dw_ypmx.Object.yb_bz[ll_insert] = ls_ybbz
			tab_1.tab_ypmx.dw_ypmx.Object.zt_bz[ll_insert] = ls_ztbz
			tab_1.tab_ypmx.dw_ypmx.Object.db_bz[ll_insert] = ls_tsb
			tab_1.tab_ypmx.dw_ypmx.Object.mz_bz[ll_insert] = ls_mzbz
			tab_1.tab_ypmx.dw_ypmx.Object.ys_gh[ll_insert] = ls_ysgh
			tab_1.tab_ypmx.dw_ypmx.Object.ks_bm[ll_insert] = ls_ksbm
			tab_1.tab_ypmx.dw_ypmx.Object.ks_na[ll_insert] = ls_ksmc
			tab_1.tab_ypmx.dw_ypmx.Object.cen_lsh[ll_insert] = ls_zxlsh
			tab_1.tab_ypmx.dw_ypmx.Object.cf_no[ll_insert] = ll_cfs
			tab_1.tab_ypmx.dw_ypmx.Object.fyze[ll_insert] = ls_fyze
			tab_1.tab_ypmx.dw_ypmx.Object.zlje[ll_insert] = ls_zlje
		END IF
	NEXT
	gf_waiting('药品明细生成完成', -1)
ELSE
	MessageBox('提示','没有可生成的药品明细')
	Destroy iuds_ypmx
	RETURN False
END IF
Destroy iuds_ypmx
IF tab_1.tab_ypmx.dw_ypmx.RowCount() > 0 THEN
	ld_ypzje = tab_1.tab_ypmx.dw_ypmx.Object.ypze_total[1]
ELSE
	ld_ypzje = 0
END IF

IF IsNull(ld_ypzje) THEN ld_ypzje = 0

//=======草药=================================== //
IF tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.RowCount() > 0 THEN
	ld_cyzje = tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.zlze_total[1]
ELSE
	ld_cyzje = 0
END IF
IF IsNull(ld_cyzje) THEN ld_cyzje = 0
dw_1.Object.mzyp[1] = ld_ypzje
dw_1.Object.mzzl[1] = ld_cyzje

gf_begin_transaction(sqlca)
IF dw_1.Update( ) <> 1 THEN
	gf_rollback_transaction(sqlca)
	MessageBox('提示','更新对账信息失败，门诊药品总费用：' + String(ld_ypzje) + '草药总金额:' + String(ld_cyzje))
	dw_1.Retrieve(is_dzr)
	RETURN False
ELSE
	gf_commit_transaction(sqlca)
	dw_1.Retrieve(is_dzr)
	RETURN True
END IF
RETURN True





end function

public function boolean wf_setzlmx ();String ls_brbm,ls_brxm,ls_sfzh,ls_cfdate,ls_fylb,ls_xmbm,ls_xmmc,ls_jx,ls_dw,ls_gg,ls_num,ls_price,ls_cflb,ls_jylx
String ls_kbbl,ls_brlx,ls_ztbz,ls_tsb,ls_mzbz,ls_ysgh,ls_ksbm,ls_ksmc,ls_zxlsh,ls_fyze,ls_zlje,ls_ybbz,ls_zhbz,ls_fplsh
Long ll_cfs,ll_cur,ll_rowcount,ll_insert,ll_bfrow
Dec{2} ld_szfbl,ld_fyze,ld_zlje,ld_num,ld_zlzje,ld_kbbl,ld_szfbl2
Dec{4} ld_price,ld_zjje,ld_zfje
Dec ld_ywlsh,ld_jllsh
DateTime ldt_cfsj
//u_datastore luds_bftp_fp
Boolean lb_bf
ld_szfbl2 = -1
IF is_dzr = '' Or IsNull(is_dzr) THEN
	MessageBox('提示','请先统计汇总!')
	RETURN False
END IF
IF is_dzr <> String(idt_begin,'yyyymmdd') THEN
	MessageBox('提示','对账日与实际统计的时间不一致，请重新统计!')
	RETURN False
END IF

IF IsValid(iuds_zlmx) THEN Destroy iuds_zlmx
iuds_zlmx = Create u_datastore
iuds_zlmx.DataObject = 'd_sbzlmx2'
iuds_zlmx.SetTransObject(sqlca)
iuds_zlmx.Retrieve(idt_begin,idt_end)
ll_rowcount = iuds_zlmx.RowCount()

IF Not IsValid(iuds_bftp_fp) THEN
	iuds_bftp_fp = Create u_datastore
	iuds_bftp_fp.DataObject = 'dd_fplsh_bf'
	iuds_bftp_fp.Reset()
END IF

IF ll_rowcount > 0 THEN
	gf_waiting('正在生成诊疗明细......', 0)
	FOR ll_cur = 1 To ll_rowcount
		gf_waiting('正在生成诊疗明细......', ll_cur / ll_rowcount * 100 )
		ld_szfbl2 = -1
		ls_brbm = Trim(iuds_zlmx.Object.brbm[ll_cur])
		ls_brxm = Trim(iuds_zlmx.Object.brxm[ll_cur])
		ls_sfzh = Trim(iuds_zlmx.Object.sfzh[ll_cur])
		ld_ywlsh = iuds_zlmx.Object.ywlsh[ll_cur]
		ld_zjje = iuds_zlmx.Object.zjje[ll_cur]
		ld_zfje = iuds_zlmx.Object.zfje[ll_cur]
		ls_fplsh = iuds_zlmx.Object.fplsh[ll_cur]
		ls_jylx = iuds_zlmx.Object.jylx[ll_cur]
		ls_zxlsh = iuds_zlmx.Object.zxlsh[ll_cur]
		
		//判断是否部分退票
		ll_bfrow = iuds_bftp_fp.Find( "fplsh = '"+ls_fplsh+"' and jylx = '"+ls_jylx+"'", 1, iuds_bftp_fp.RowCount())
		IF ll_bfrow > 0 THEN
			CONTINUE
		ELSE
			//			lb_bf = wf_bftpxx(ls_fplsh,'YJ',ls_zxlsh,ll_cur)
			lb_bf = wf_getbftp(ls_fplsh,'YJ',ls_zxlsh,ll_cur)
			IF lb_bf THEN
				ll_bfrow = iuds_bftp_fp.InsertRow( 0)
				iuds_bftp_fp.Object.fplsh[ll_bfrow] = ls_fplsh
				iuds_bftp_fp.Object.jylx[ll_bfrow] = ls_jylx
				CONTINUE
			END IF
		END IF
		//--------------------------------------
		ldt_cfsj = iuds_zlmx.Object.jssj[ll_cur]
		ls_cfdate = String(ldt_cfsj,'yyyymmdd')
		
		ld_num = iuds_zlmx.Object.sl[ll_cur]
		ld_price = iuds_zlmx.Object.dj[ll_cur]
		//交易类型为RD01的乘-1
		//		ls_jylx = iuds_zlmx.Object.jylx[ll_cur]
		IF ls_jylx = 'RD01' Or ls_jylx = 'SD01' THEN
			ld_num  = -1 * ld_num
		END IF
		IF ld_num < 0 THEN
			ls_num = '-' +Right('0000000000'+String(Abs(ld_num),'#####.00'),9)
		ELSE
			ls_num = Right('0000000000'+String(Abs(ld_num),'#####.00'),10)
		END IF
		
		IF ld_price < 0 THEN
			ls_price = '-' +Right('0000000000'+String(Abs(ld_price),'#####.0000'),11)
		ELSE
			ls_price = Right('0000000000'+String(Abs(ld_price),'#####.0000'),12)
		END IF
		//科室编码、名称
		SELECT SBKS Into :ls_ksbm From mz_ks,mz_yjk1 Where mz_ks.ksbm = mz_yjk1.ksbm And mz_yjk1.yjlsh = :ld_ywlsh;
		IF sqlca.SQLCode <> 0  THEN
			ls_ksbm = '1'
		END IF
		//		ls_ksbm = String(iuds_zlmx.Describe("Evaluate('LookUpDisplay(ksbm) ', "+ String(ll_cur) + ")"))
		IF IsNull(ls_ksbm) Or ls_ksbm = '' THEN ls_ksbm = '1'
		IF IsValid (gu_ybjk) = False THEN //创建医保接口
			gu_ybjk = Create u_ybjk_his
		END IF
		IF gu_ybjk.of_get_ybksbm( ls_ksbm, ls_ksmc) < 0 THEN
			ls_ksbm = '1'
			ls_ksmc = '内    科'
		END IF
		IF IsNull(ls_ksmc)  THEN ls_ksmc = ''
		//费用类别
		ls_fylb = String(iuds_zlmx.Describe("Evaluate('LookUpDisplay(fylb) ', "+ String(ll_cur) + ")"))
		IF IsNull(ls_fylb) THEN ls_fylb = ''
		ls_fylb = Right('00' + ls_fylb,2)
		//---------------------------------------------
		ls_dw = iuds_zlmx.Object.dw[ll_cur]
		ls_xmbm = iuds_zlmx.Object.xmbm[ll_cur]
		ls_xmmc = iuds_zlmx.Object.xmmc[ll_cur]
		ls_ysgh = iuds_zlmx.Object.ysbm[ll_cur]
		ll_cfs = iuds_zlmx.Object.cfs[ll_cur]
		ls_tsb = iuds_zlmx.Object.thb[ll_cur]
		ls_mzbz = iuds_zlmx.Object.mjz[ll_cur]
		ls_brlx = iuds_zlmx.Object.brlx[ll_cur]
		ls_zxlsh = iuds_zlmx.Object.zxlsh[ll_cur]
		ls_zhbz = iuds_zlmx.Object.yblx[ll_cur]
		ls_ztbz = Mid(ls_zhbz,2,1)
		IF ls_ztbz = '2' THEN ls_ztbz = '4'
		ls_ybbz = Mid(ls_zhbz,1 ,1)
		
		//========自付比例========== //
		ld_szfbl = iuds_zlmx.Object.szfbl[ll_cur]
		IF ld_szfbl = 1 And (ld_zjje = ld_zfje or ls_xmbm= 'f25031003500') THEN
			ld_jllsh = iuds_zlmx.Object.jllsh[ll_cur]
			IF wf_getzfbl(ld_jllsh,ls_fplsh,ld_ywlsh,'YJ',ld_szfbl2) THEN
				IF IsNull(ld_szfbl2) THEN ld_szfbl2 = 0
				ld_szfbl = ld_szfbl2
			END IF
		END IF
		
		IF ld_szfbl = 1 And ld_zjje <> 0 And ld_zjje <> ld_zfje THEN
			IF Abs(ld_zjje) < Abs(ld_zfje) THEN
				ld_szfbl = 0
			ELSE
				ld_szfbl = ld_zfje / ld_zjje
//				IF ld_szfbl = 0.38 Or  ld_szfbl = 0.6 THEN
//					ld_szfbl = 0
//					ld_szfbl2 = 0
//				END IF
			END IF
		END IF
		
		IF IsNull(ld_szfbl) THEN ld_szfbl = 1
		ld_kbbl = 1 - ld_szfbl
		ls_kbbl = String(ld_kbbl,'0.00')
		//		IF ld_kbbl > 0 THEN
		//			ld_fyze = ld_num * ld_price * ld_kbbl
		//			IF ld_fyze < 0 THEN
		//				ls_fyze = '-' +Right('0000000000'+String(Abs(ld_fyze),'#####.00'),9)
		//			ELSE
		//				ls_fyze = Right('0000000000'+String(Abs(ld_fyze),'#####.00'),10)
		//			END IF
		//			ld_zlje = ld_num * ld_price * ld_szfbl
		//			IF ld_zlje < 0 THEN
		//				ls_zlje = '-' +Right('0000000000'+String(Abs(ld_zlje),'#####.00'),9)
		//			ELSE
		//				ls_zlje = Right('0000000000'+String(Abs(ld_zlje),'#####.00'),10)
		//			END IF
		//		ELSE
		//			ls_fyze = '0000000.00'
		//			ls_zlje = '0000000.00'
		//		END IF
		IF ld_kbbl > 0 THEN
			IF ld_szfbl2 = 0 THEN
				ld_fyze = ld_num * ld_price * ld_szfbl
				IF ld_fyze < 0 THEN
					ls_fyze = '-' +Right('0000000000'+String(Abs(ld_fyze),'#####.00'),9)
				ELSE
					ls_fyze = Right('0000000000'+String(Abs(ld_fyze),'#####.00'),10)
				END IF
				ld_zlje = ld_num * ld_price * ld_kbbl
				IF ld_zlje < 0 THEN
					ls_zlje = '-' +Right('0000000000'+String(Abs(ld_zlje),'#####.00'),9)
				ELSE
					ls_zlje = Right('0000000000'+String(Abs(ld_zlje),'#####.00'),10)
				END IF
			ELSE
				ld_fyze = ld_num * ld_price * ld_kbbl
				IF ld_fyze < 0 THEN
					ls_fyze = '-' +Right('0000000000'+String(Abs(ld_fyze),'#####.00'),9)
				ELSE
					ls_fyze = Right('0000000000'+String(Abs(ld_fyze),'#####.00'),10)
				END IF
				ld_zlje = ld_num * ld_price * ld_szfbl
				IF ld_zlje < 0 THEN
					ls_zlje = '-' +Right('0000000000'+String(Abs(ld_zlje),'#####.00'),9)
				ELSE
					ls_zlje = Right('0000000000'+String(Abs(ld_zlje),'#####.00'),10)
				END IF
			END IF
		ELSE
			ls_fyze = '0000000.00'
			ls_zlje = '0000000.00'
		END IF
		
		
		IF IsNull(ls_brbm) Or ls_brbm = '' THEN ls_brbm = '1'
		IF IsNull(ls_brxm) Or ls_brxm = '' THEN ls_brxm = '1'
		IF IsNull(ls_sfzh) Or Trim(ls_sfzh) = '' THEN ls_sfzh = '1'
		IF IsNull(ls_fylb) Or Trim(ls_fylb) = '' THEN ls_fylb = '16'
		IF IsNull(ls_xmbm) Or Trim(ls_xmbm) = '' THEN ls_xmbm = '1'
		IF IsNull(ls_xmmc) Or Trim(ls_xmmc) = '' THEN ls_xmmc = '1'
		IF IsNull(ls_dw) Or Trim(ls_dw) = '' THEN ls_dw = '无'
		
		IF IsNull(ls_ysgh) THEN ls_ysgh = '111111'
		IF Len(ls_ksmc) > 10 THEN ls_ksmc = gf_midstring(ls_ksmc,10)
		IF Len(ls_ksbm) > 5 THEN ls_ksbm = gf_midstring(ls_ksbm,5)
		IF Len(ls_ysgh) > 6 THEN ls_ysgh = gf_midstring(ls_ysgh,6)
		IF Len(ls_xmmc) > 30 THEN ls_xmmc = gf_midstring(ls_xmmc,30)
		IF Len(ls_brbm) > 8  THEN ls_brbm = gf_midstring(ls_brbm,8)
		IF Len(ls_brxm) > 30 THEN ls_brxm = gf_midstring(ls_brxm,30)
		
		ll_insert = tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.InsertRow(0)
		tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.id[ll_insert] = ls_brbm
		tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.xm[ll_insert] = ls_brxm
		tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.sfzh[ll_insert] = ls_sfzh
		tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.cf_date[ll_insert] = ls_cfdate
		tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.fylb[ll_insert] = ls_fylb
		tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.xm_bm[ll_insert] = ls_xmbm
		tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.xm_na[ll_insert] = ls_xmmc
		tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.xm_unt[ll_insert] = ls_dw
		tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.num[ll_insert] = ls_num
		tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.price[ll_insert] = ls_price
		tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.kb_bl[ll_insert] = ls_kbbl
		tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.p_type[ll_insert] = ls_brlx
		tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.yb_bz[ll_insert] = ls_ybbz
		tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.zt_bz[ll_insert] = ls_ztbz
		tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.db_bz[ll_insert] = ls_tsb
		tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.mz_bz[ll_insert] = ls_mzbz
		tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.ys_gh[ll_insert] = ls_ysgh
		tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.ks_bm[ll_insert] = ls_ksbm
		tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.ks_na[ll_insert] = ls_ksmc
		tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.cen_lsh[ll_insert] = ls_zxlsh
		tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.cf_no[ll_insert] = ll_cfs
		tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.fyze[ll_insert] = ls_fyze
		tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.zlje[ll_insert] = ls_zlje
	NEXT
	gf_waiting('诊疗明细生成完成', -1)
ELSE
	MessageBox('提示','没有可生成的诊疗明细')
	Destroy iuds_zlmx
	Destroy iuds_bftp_fp
	RETURN False
END IF
Destroy iuds_zlmx
Destroy iuds_bftp_fp

IF tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.RowCount() > 0 THEN
	ld_zlzje = tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.zlze_total[1]
ELSE
	ld_zlzje = 0
END IF
IF IsNull(ld_zlzje) THEN ld_zlzje = 0
dw_1.Object.mzzl[1] = ld_zlzje
gf_begin_transaction(sqlca)
IF dw_1.Update( ) <> 1 THEN
	gf_rollback_transaction(sqlca)
	MessageBox('提示','更新对账信息失败，门诊诊疗总费用：' + String(ld_zlzje) )
	dw_1.Retrieve(is_dzr)
	RETURN False
ELSE
	gf_commit_transaction(sqlca)
	dw_1.Retrieve(is_dzr)
	RETURN True
END IF
RETURN True





end function

public function long wf_auto_jdmz (datetime ld_start, datetime ld_end);datastore ds_sb_fpk,ds_sb_jymx
long ll_fpk_count,ll_jymx_count , i  , ll_find,ll_return ,ll_fplsh_count
string ls_zxlsh,ls_bz,ls_txt,ls_fplsh
dec {0} ll_lsh

ll_return=0

ds_sb_fpk=create datastore 
ds_sb_jymx=create datastore 

ds_sb_fpk.dataobject='d_sb_autodz_fpk'
ds_sb_jymx.dataobject='d_sb_autodz_jymx'

ds_sb_fpk.settransobject(sqlca)
ds_sb_jymx.settransobject(sqlca)


ds_sb_fpk.retrieve(ld_start,ld_end)
ds_sb_jymx.retrieve(ld_start,ld_end)

ll_fpk_count=ds_sb_fpk.rowcount()
ll_jymx_count=ds_sb_jymx.rowcount()
    
	
for i=1 to  ll_fpk_count
	 ls_zxlsh = ds_sb_fpk.object.zxlsh[i]
	 if isnull(ls_zxlsh) then ls_zxlsh=''
	 ll_find=ds_sb_jymx.FIND( "zxlsh='"+ls_zxlsh+"'", 1,  ll_jymx_count  )
	 if isnull(ll_find) then ll_find=0
    if ll_find>0 then 
		  ds_sb_jymx.object.bz[ll_find]='1'
	 else
		  if trim(ls_zxlsh)<='' or isnull(ls_zxlsh) then continue;
         messagebox('提示','zxlsh='+ls_zxlsh+'   需内部调帐' + string(ds_sb_fpk.object.grbm[i]))
			return 100;
	 end if
next

ls_txt=''
for i=1 to  ll_jymx_count
	 ls_bz= ds_sb_jymx.object.bz[i]
	 ll_lsh= ds_sb_jymx.object.lsh[i]
	 ls_fplsh= ds_sb_jymx.object.fplsh[i]
	 
 	 ls_zxlsh= ds_sb_jymx.object.zxlsh[i]
	 if isnull(ls_fplsh) then ls_fplsh=''
    if isnull(ls_bz) or trim(ls_bz)<='' then ls_bz=''
	 if ls_bz='0' then 
		 ll_fplsh_count=0
		 select count(*)  into :ll_fplsh_count from sb_jymx where fplsh=:ls_fplsh  and fplsh is not null;
		 if isnull(ll_fplsh_count) then ll_fplsh_count=0
		 if ll_fplsh_count>=2 then continue;
		 ls_txt=ls_txt+'  '+ls_zxlsh
	 else
		  continue;
	 end if
	 if trim(ls_zxlsh)<='' or isnull(ls_zxlsh) then continue;
	 
	 gf_begin_transaction(sqlca)
	 insert into sb_jymx_gzxx select * from sb_jymx where zxlsh=:ls_zxlsh   and lsh=:ll_lsh; 
	 if sqlca.sqlcode=0 then 
		 delete from sb_jymx where zxlsh=:ls_zxlsh   and lsh=:ll_lsh; 
		 if sqlca.sqlcode=0 then 
			  gf_commit_transaction(sqlca)
		else
			gf_rollback_transaction(sqlca)
			ll_return=101
			exit
		end if
	 else
			gf_rollback_transaction(sqlca)
			ll_return=101
			exit
	 end if
next

if ls_txt<>'' then 
	messagebox('提示','门诊需改帐的流水号有：'+ls_txt)
end if	

destroy ds_sb_fpk;
destroy ds_sb_jymx;


return ll_return



end function

public function boolean wf_out_mzmx ();String ls_file,ls_dzr_hd
Boolean lb_exist
DateTime ld_jssj
Int li_suss
messagebox(is_dzr,string(dw_1.Object.dzr[1]))
IF IsNull(dw_1.Object.dzr[1]) Or dw_1.Object.dzr[1] = '' Or IsNull(is_dzr) Or is_dzr = '' THEN
	MessageBox('提示','请先汇总统计')
	RETURN False
END IF

IF tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.RowCount() > 0 THEN
	ld_jssj = tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.Object.jssj[1]
	ls_dzr_hd = String(ld_jssj,'yyyymmdd')
	IF ls_dzr_hd <> is_dzr THEN
		MessageBox('提示','对账日期与交易明细的接收时间不在同一时间段，请重新统计！')
		RETURN False
	END IF
END IF
//文件导出放在'c:\sb'
lb_exist = FileExists('c:\sb')
IF Not lb_exist THEN
	MessageBox('提示','c:\sb 目录不存在，请建立此目录!')
	RETURN False
END IF
//获取导出文件名-导出
//挂号明细
ls_file = wf_getfilename(Mid(is_yljgdm,7,3),'A',Date(idt_begin),'0')
li_suss = tab_1.tab_ghmx.dw_ghmx.SaveAs('c:\sb\'+ls_file,Text!,False)
IF li_suss <> 1 THEN
	MessageBox('提示','挂号明细导出存盘出错，请重试！')
	RETURN False
END IF
//药品明细
ls_file = wf_getfilename(Mid(is_yljgdm,7,3),'B',Date(idt_begin),'0')
li_suss = tab_1.tab_ypmx.dw_ypmx.SaveAs('c:\sb\'+ls_file,Text!,False)
IF li_suss <> 1 THEN
	MessageBox('提示','门诊药品明细导出存盘出错，请重试')
	RETURN False
END IF
//诊疗明细
ls_file = wf_getfilename(Mid(is_yljgdm,7,3),'C',Date(idt_begin),'0')
li_suss = tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.SaveAs('c:\sb\'+ls_file,Text!,False)
IF li_suss <> 1 THEN
	MessageBox('提示','门诊药品明细导出存盘出错，请重试')
	RETURN False
END IF
RETURN TRUE

end function

private function string wf_getfilename (string as_yydm, string as_lb, date ad_dzrq, string as_fybz);string ls_filename
long ll_sbnf,ll_sbyf,ll_sbr
string ls_sbnf,ls_sbyf,ls_sbr,ls_dzrq
ls_dzrq = string(ad_dzrq ,'yyyymmdd')
ll_sbnf = year(ad_dzrq)
ll_sbyf = month(ad_dzrq)
ll_sbr = day(ad_dzrq)
if ll_sbnf > 2009 then
	ls_sbnf = char(asc('A') + ll_sbnf - 2010)
else
	ls_sbnf = string(ll_sbnf - 2000)
end if
if ll_sbyf > 9 then
	ls_sbyf = char(asc('A') + ll_sbyf - 10)
else
	ls_sbyf = string(ll_sbyf)
end if
if ll_sbr > 9 then
	ls_sbr = char(asc('A') + ll_sbr - 10)
else
	ls_sbr = string(ll_sbr)
end if
ls_filename = as_yydm + as_lb + ls_sbnf + ls_sbyf + ls_sbr + trim(as_fybz) + '.txt'
return ls_filename
end function

public function boolean wf_bftpxx (string as_fplsh, string as_mxlx, string as_zxlsh, long al_cur);//====================================================================
// 事件: w_sbdz.wf_bftpxx()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:判断窪AT*
梅⑵笔遣皇遣糠滞似

//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	      	string	as_fplsh	需做判断的发票号
// 	      	string	as_mxlx 	对应的类型CF:药品，YJ:诊疗
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  boolean 是否是部分退票
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	sxl		日期: 2011.08.03
//====================================================================


Long ll_rowcount,ll_cur,ll_insert,ll_xmlsh
Boolean lb_bf
u_datastore luds_tpxx_bf,luds_bfmx
String ls_first,ls_new,ls_y,ls_brbm,ls_sfzh,ls_brxm,ls_zhbz,ls_jylx,ls_date
String ls_fplshs[]
String ls_dw,ls_gg,ls_jx,ls_xmmc,ls_xmbm,ls_fylb,ls_ztbz,ls_num,ls_price,ls_ksbm,ls_ksmc,ls_kbbl,ls_fyze,ls_zlje,ls_ysgh
Dec{2} ld_fyze,ld_zlje,ld_num,ld_szfbl,ld_kbbl,ld_szfbl2
Dec{4} ld_price,ld_zjje,ld_zfje
DateTime ldt_jssj
Int li_arry
IF IsValid(luds_tpxx_bf) THEN
	Destroy luds_tpxx_bf
END IF
luds_tpxx_bf = Create u_datastore
luds_tpxx_bf.DataObject = 'dd_tpxx_bf'
luds_tpxx_bf.SetTransObject( sqlca)
ll_rowcount = luds_tpxx_bf.Retrieve(as_fplsh)
lb_bf = False
IF ll_rowcount > 0 THEN
	lb_bf = True
	ls_fplshs[1] = luds_tpxx_bf.Object.y_fplsh[1]
	ls_fplshs[2] = luds_tpxx_bf.Object.newfplsh[1]
	ls_first = luds_tpxx_bf.Object.firstfplsh[1]
	ls_fplshs[3] = ls_first
	li_arry = 3
	DO WHILE ls_first <> luds_tpxx_bf.Object.y_fplsh[1]
		IF luds_tpxx_bf.Retrieve(luds_tpxx_bf.Object.y_fplsh[1]) > 0 THEN
			li_arry ++
			ls_fplshs[li_arry] = luds_tpxx_bf.Object.y_fplsh[1]
		ELSE
			EXIT
		END IF
	LOOP
	
	IF IsValid(luds_bfmx) THEN
		Destroy luds_bfmx
	END IF
	luds_bfmx = Create u_datastore
	IF as_mxlx = 'CF' THEN
		luds_bfmx.DataObject = 'd_sbypmx_bf'
	ELSEIF as_mxlx = 'YJ' THEN
		luds_bfmx.DataObject = 'd_sbzlmx_bf'
	END IF
	luds_bfmx.SetTransObject( sqlca)
	ll_rowcount = luds_bfmx.Retrieve(ls_fplshs)
	//对于交易类型为RD01,SD01的则成负数
	IF ll_rowcount > 0 THEN
		IF as_mxlx = 'CF' THEN
			ls_brbm = Trim(iuds_ypmx.Object.brbm[al_cur])
			ls_brxm = Trim(iuds_ypmx.Object.brxm[al_cur])
			ls_sfzh = Trim(iuds_ypmx.Object.sfzh[al_cur])
			ls_zhbz = iuds_ypmx.Object.yblx[al_cur]
			ls_jylx = iuds_ypmx.Object.jylx[al_cur]
			ls_ysgh = iuds_ypmx.Object.ysbm[al_cur]
			ld_fyze = iuds_ypmx.Object.fyze[al_cur]
			ld_zlje = iuds_ypmx.Object.zlje[al_cur]
			ldt_jssj = iuds_ypmx.Object.jssj[al_cur]
			ls_date = String(ldt_jssj,'yyyymmdd')
			ls_ztbz = Mid(ls_zhbz,2,1)
			IF ls_ztbz = '2' THEN ls_ztbz = '4'
		ELSEIF as_mxlx = 'YJ' THEN
			ls_brbm = Trim(iuds_zlmx.Object.brbm[al_cur])
			ls_brxm = Trim(iuds_zlmx.Object.brxm[al_cur])
			ls_sfzh = Trim(iuds_zlmx.Object.sfzh[al_cur])
			ls_zhbz = iuds_zlmx.Object.yblx[al_cur]
			ls_jylx = iuds_zlmx.Object.jylx[al_cur]
			ls_ysgh = iuds_zlmx.Object.ysbm[al_cur]
			ld_fyze = iuds_zlmx.Object.fyze[al_cur]
			ld_zlje = iuds_zlmx.Object.zlje[al_cur]
			ldt_jssj = iuds_zlmx.Object.jssj[al_cur]
			ls_date = String(ldt_jssj,'yyyymmdd')
			ls_ztbz = Mid(ls_zhbz,2,1)
			IF ls_ztbz = '2' THEN ls_ztbz = '4'
		END IF
		
		FOR ll_cur = 1 To ll_rowcount
			ld_num = luds_bfmx.Object.sl[ll_cur]
			ld_price = luds_bfmx.Object.dj[ll_cur]
			ls_xmbm = luds_bfmx.Object.xmbm[ll_cur]
			ls_xmmc = luds_bfmx.Object.xmmc[ll_cur]
			ls_dw = luds_bfmx.Object.dw[ll_cur]
			ld_szfbl = luds_bfmx.Object.szfbl[ll_cur]
			ld_zjje =  luds_bfmx.Object.zjje[ll_cur]
			ld_zfje =  luds_bfmx.Object.zfje[ll_cur]
			IF as_mxlx = 'CF' THEN
				ls_gg = luds_bfmx.Object.gg[ll_cur]
				ls_jx = luds_bfmx.Object.ybjx[ll_cur]
			END IF
			IF ls_jylx = 'RD01' Or ls_jylx = 'SD01' THEN
				ld_num  = -1 * ld_num
			END IF
			
			IF ld_num < 0 THEN
				ls_num = '-' +Right('0000000000'+String(Abs(ld_num),'#####.00'),9)
			ELSE
				ls_num = Right('0000000000'+String(Abs(ld_num),'#####.00'),10)
			END IF
			
			IF ld_price < 0 THEN
				ls_price = '-' +Right('0000000000'+String(Abs(ld_price),'#####.0000'),11)
			ELSE
				ls_price = Right('0000000000'+String(Abs(ld_price),'#####.0000'),12)
			END IF
			//对应科室编码和名称
			IF as_mxlx = 'CF' THEN
				SELECT SBKS Into :ls_ksbm From mz_ks,mz_cfk Where mz_ks.ksbm = mz_cfk.ksbm And mz_cfk.fplsh = :ls_first And rownum = 1;
			ELSEIF as_mxlx = 'YJ' THEN
				SELECT SBKS Into :ls_ksbm From mz_ks,mz_yjk1 Where mz_ks.ksbm = mz_yjk1.ksbm And mz_yjk1.fplsh = :ls_first And rownum = 1;
			END IF
			IF sqlca.SQLCode <> 0  THEN
				ls_ksbm = '1'
			END IF
			IF IsNull(ls_ksbm) Or ls_ksbm = '' THEN ls_ksbm = '1'
			
			IF IsValid (gu_ybjk) = False THEN //创建医保接口
				gu_ybjk = Create u_ybjk_his
			END IF
			IF gu_ybjk.of_get_ybksbm( ls_ksbm, ls_ksmc) < 0 THEN
				ls_ksbm = '1'
				ls_ksmc = '内    科'
			END IF
			IF IsNull(ls_ksmc)  THEN ls_ksmc = ''
			
			//		
			//费用类别
			ls_fylb = String(luds_bfmx.Describe("Evaluate('LookUpDisplay(fylb) ', "+ String(ll_cur) + ")"))
			IF IsNull(ls_fylb) THEN ls_fylb = ''
			ls_fylb = Right('00' + ls_fylb,2)
			
			//========报销比例========== //
			IF IsNull(ld_szfbl) THEN ld_szfbl = 1
			IF ld_szfbl = 1 And ld_zjje <> 0 And ld_zjje <> ld_zfje THEN
				IF Abs(ld_zjje) < Abs(ld_zfje) THEN
					ld_szfbl = 0
				ELSE
					ld_szfbl = ld_zfje / ld_zjje
					IF ld_szfbl = 0.38 Or  ld_szfbl = 0.6 THEN
						ld_szfbl = 0
					END IF
				END IF
			END IF
			
			ld_kbbl = 1 - ld_szfbl
			ls_kbbl = String(ld_kbbl,'0.00')
			IF ld_kbbl > 0 THEN
				ld_fyze = ld_num * ld_price * ld_kbbl
				IF ld_fyze < 0 THEN
					ls_fyze = '-' +Right('0000000000'+String(Abs(ld_fyze),'#####.00'),9)
				ELSE
					ls_fyze = Right('0000000000'+String(Abs(ld_fyze),'#####.00'),10)
				END IF
				ld_zlje = ld_num * ld_price * ld_szfbl
				IF ld_zlje < 0 THEN
					ls_zlje = '-' +Right('0000000000'+String(Abs(ld_zlje),'#####.00'),9)
				ELSE
					ls_zlje = Right('0000000000'+String(Abs(ld_zlje),'#####.00'),10)
				END IF
			ELSE
				ls_fyze = '0000000.00'
				ls_zlje = '0000000.00'
			END IF
			
			IF IsNull(ls_brbm) Or ls_brbm = '' THEN ls_brbm = '1'
			IF IsNull(ls_brxm) Or ls_brxm = '' THEN ls_brxm = '1'
			IF IsNull(ls_sfzh) Or Trim(ls_sfzh) = '' THEN ls_sfzh = '1'
			IF IsNull(ls_fylb) Or Trim(ls_fylb) = '' THEN ls_fylb = '03'
			IF IsNull(ls_xmbm) Or Trim(ls_xmbm) = '' THEN ls_xmbm = '1'
			IF IsNull(ls_xmmc) Or Trim(ls_xmmc) = '' THEN ls_xmmc = '1'
			IF IsNull(ls_dw) Or Trim(ls_dw) = '' THEN ls_dw = '无'
			IF IsNull(ls_jx) Or Trim(ls_jx) = '' THEN  ls_jx = '无'
			IF IsNull(ls_gg) Or Trim(ls_gg) = '' THEN  ls_gg = '无'
			
			IF IsNull(ls_ysgh) THEN ls_ysgh = ' '
			IF Len(ls_ksmc) > 10 THEN ls_ksmc = gf_midstring(ls_ksmc,10)
			IF Len(ls_ksbm) > 5  THEN ls_ksbm = gf_midstring(ls_ksbm,5)
			IF Len(ls_ysgh) > 6  THEN ls_ysgh = gf_midstring(ls_ysgh,6)
			IF Len(ls_xmmc) > 30 THEN ls_xmmc = gf_midstring(ls_xmmc,30)
			IF Len(ls_brbm) > 8  THEN ls_brbm = gf_midstring(ls_brbm,8)
			IF Len(ls_brxm) > 30 THEN ls_brxm = gf_midstring(ls_brxm,30)
			
			If (as_mxlx = 'CF' And ls_fylb = '05') Or as_mxlx = 'YJ' THEN //草药插到诊疗
				ll_insert = tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.InsertRow(0)
				tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.id[ll_insert] = ls_brbm
				tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.xm[ll_insert] = ls_brxm
				tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.sfzh[ll_insert] = ls_sfzh
				tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.cf_date[ll_insert] = ls_date
				tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.fylb[ll_insert] = ls_fylb
				tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.xm_bm[ll_insert] = ls_xmbm
				tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.xm_na[ll_insert] = ls_xmmc
				tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.xm_unt[ll_insert] = ls_dw
				tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.num[ll_insert] = ls_num
				tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.price[ll_insert] = ls_price
				tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.kb_bl[ll_insert] = ls_kbbl
				tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.p_type[ll_insert] = '0'
				tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.yb_bz[ll_insert] = Mid(ls_zhbz,1 ,1)
				tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.zt_bz[ll_insert] = ls_ztbz
				tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.db_bz[ll_insert] = '0'
				tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.mz_bz[ll_insert] = '1'
				tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.ys_gh[ll_insert] = ls_ysgh
				tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.ks_bm[ll_insert] = ls_ksbm
				tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.ks_na[ll_insert] = ls_ksmc
				tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.cen_lsh[ll_insert] = as_zxlsh
				tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.cf_no[ll_insert] = 1
				tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.fyze[ll_insert] = ls_fyze
				tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.zlje[ll_insert] = ls_zlje
			ELSEIF as_mxlx = 'CF' THEN
				ll_insert = tab_1.tab_ypmx.dw_ypmx.InsertRow(0)
				tab_1.tab_ypmx.dw_ypmx.Object.id[ll_insert] = ls_brbm
				tab_1.tab_ypmx.dw_ypmx.Object.xm[ll_insert] = ls_brxm
				tab_1.tab_ypmx.dw_ypmx.Object.sfzh[ll_insert] = ls_sfzh
				tab_1.tab_ypmx.dw_ypmx.Object.cf_date[ll_insert] = ls_date
				tab_1.tab_ypmx.dw_ypmx.Object.fylb[ll_insert] = ls_fylb
				tab_1.tab_ypmx.dw_ypmx.Object.xm_bm[ll_insert] = ls_xmbm
				tab_1.tab_ypmx.dw_ypmx.Object.xm_na[ll_insert] = ls_xmmc
				tab_1.tab_ypmx.dw_ypmx.Object.mz_frm[ll_insert] = ls_jx
				tab_1.tab_ypmx.dw_ypmx.Object.xm_unt[ll_insert] = ls_dw
				tab_1.tab_ypmx.dw_ypmx.Object.xm_std[ll_insert] = ls_gg
				tab_1.tab_ypmx.dw_ypmx.Object.num[ll_insert] = ls_num
				tab_1.tab_ypmx.dw_ypmx.Object.price[ll_insert] = ls_price
				tab_1.tab_ypmx.dw_ypmx.Object.kb_bl[ll_insert] = ls_kbbl
				tab_1.tab_ypmx.dw_ypmx.Object.p_type[ll_insert] = '0'
				tab_1.tab_ypmx.dw_ypmx.Object.yb_bz[ll_insert] = Mid(ls_zhbz,1 ,1)
				tab_1.tab_ypmx.dw_ypmx.Object.zt_bz[ll_insert] = ls_ztbz
				tab_1.tab_ypmx.dw_ypmx.Object.db_bz[ll_insert] = '0'
				tab_1.tab_ypmx.dw_ypmx.Object.mz_bz[ll_insert] = '1'
				tab_1.tab_ypmx.dw_ypmx.Object.ys_gh[ll_insert] = ls_ysgh
				tab_1.tab_ypmx.dw_ypmx.Object.ks_bm[ll_insert] = ls_ksbm
				tab_1.tab_ypmx.dw_ypmx.Object.ks_na[ll_insert] = ls_ksmc
				tab_1.tab_ypmx.dw_ypmx.Object.cen_lsh[ll_insert] = as_zxlsh
				tab_1.tab_ypmx.dw_ypmx.Object.cf_no[ll_insert] = 1
				tab_1.tab_ypmx.dw_ypmx.Object.fyze[ll_insert] = ls_fyze
				tab_1.tab_ypmx.dw_ypmx.Object.zlje[ll_insert] = ls_zlje
			END IF
		NEXT
	END IF
ELSE
	lb_bf = False
END IF
Destroy luds_bfmx
Destroy luds_tpxx_bf
RETURN lb_bf






end function

public function boolean wf_getbftp (string as_fplsh, string as_mxlx, string as_zxlsh, long al_cur);//====================================================================
// 事件: w_sbdz.wf_bftpxx()
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 描述:判断该发票是不是部分退票
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 参数:
// 	      	string	as_fplsh	需做判断的发票号
// 	      	string	as_mxlx 	对应的类型CF:药品，YJ:诊疗
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 返回:  boolean 是否是部分退票
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// 作者:	sxl		日期: 2011.08.03
//====================================================================


Long ll_rowcount,ll_cur,ll_insert,ll_yjcount,ll_xmlsh
Boolean lb_bf
u_datastore luds_tpxx_bf,luds_bfcfmx,luds_bfyjmx
String ls_first,ls_new,ls_y,ls_brbm,ls_sfzh,ls_brxm,ls_zhbz,ls_jylx,ls_date
String ls_fplshs[]
String ls_dw,ls_gg,ls_jx,ls_xmmc,ls_xmbm,ls_fylb,ls_ztbz,ls_num,ls_price,ls_ksbm,ls_ksmc,ls_kbbl,ls_fyze,ls_zlje,ls_ysgh
Dec{2} ld_fyze,ld_zlje,ld_num,ld_szfbl,ld_kbbl,ld_szfbl2
Dec{4} ld_price,ld_zjje,ld_zfje
DateTime ldt_jssj
Int li_arry
IF Not IsValid(luds_tpxx_bf) THEN luds_tpxx_bf = Create u_datastore
luds_tpxx_bf.DataObject = 'dd_tpxx_bf'
luds_tpxx_bf.SetTransObject( sqlca)
ll_rowcount = luds_tpxx_bf.Retrieve(as_fplsh)
lb_bf = False
IF ll_rowcount > 0 THEN
	lb_bf = True
	ls_fplshs[1] = luds_tpxx_bf.Object.y_fplsh[1]
	ls_fplshs[2] = luds_tpxx_bf.Object.newfplsh[1]
	ls_first = luds_tpxx_bf.Object.firstfplsh[1]
	ls_fplshs[3] = ls_first
	li_arry = 3
	DO WHILE ls_first <> luds_tpxx_bf.Object.y_fplsh[1]
		IF luds_tpxx_bf.Retrieve(luds_tpxx_bf.Object.y_fplsh[1]) > 0 THEN
			li_arry ++
			ls_fplshs[li_arry] = luds_tpxx_bf.Object.y_fplsh[1]
		ELSE
			EXIT
		END IF
	LOOP
	
	IF Not IsValid(luds_bfcfmx) THEN luds_bfcfmx = Create u_datastore
	IF Not IsValid(luds_bfyjmx) THEN luds_bfyjmx = Create u_datastore
	//	IF as_mxlx = 'CF' THEN
	luds_bfcfmx.DataObject = 'd_sbypmx_bf'
	//	ELSEIF as_mxlx = 'YJ' THEN
	luds_bfyjmx.DataObject = 'd_sbzlmx_bf'
	//	END IF
	luds_bfcfmx.SetTransObject( sqlca)
	luds_bfyjmx.SetTransObject( sqlca)
	ll_rowcount = luds_bfcfmx.Retrieve(ls_fplshs)
	ll_yjcount = luds_bfyjmx.Retrieve(ls_fplshs)
	//处方或者医技有部分退后还有数据则
	IF ll_rowcount > 0 Or  ll_yjcount > 0 THEN
		IF as_mxlx = 'CF' THEN
			ls_brbm = Trim(iuds_ypmx.Object.brbm[al_cur])
			ls_brxm = Trim(iuds_ypmx.Object.brxm[al_cur])
			ls_sfzh = Trim(iuds_ypmx.Object.sfzh[al_cur])
			ls_zhbz = iuds_ypmx.Object.yblx[al_cur]
			ls_jylx = iuds_ypmx.Object.jylx[al_cur]
			ls_ysgh = iuds_ypmx.Object.ysbm[al_cur]
			ld_fyze = iuds_ypmx.Object.fyze[al_cur]
			ld_zlje = iuds_ypmx.Object.zlje[al_cur]
			ldt_jssj = iuds_ypmx.Object.jssj[al_cur]
			ls_date = String(ldt_jssj,'yyyymmdd')
			ls_ztbz = Mid(ls_zhbz,2,1)
			IF ls_ztbz = '2' THEN ls_ztbz = '4'
		ELSEIF as_mxlx = 'YJ' THEN
			ls_brbm = Trim(iuds_zlmx.Object.brbm[al_cur])
			ls_brxm = Trim(iuds_zlmx.Object.brxm[al_cur])
			ls_sfzh = Trim(iuds_zlmx.Object.sfzh[al_cur])
			ls_zhbz = iuds_zlmx.Object.yblx[al_cur]
			ls_jylx = iuds_zlmx.Object.jylx[al_cur]
			ls_ysgh = iuds_zlmx.Object.ysbm[al_cur]
			ld_fyze = iuds_zlmx.Object.fyze[al_cur]
			ld_zlje = iuds_zlmx.Object.zlje[al_cur]
			ldt_jssj = iuds_zlmx.Object.jssj[al_cur]
			ls_date = String(ldt_jssj,'yyyymmdd')
			ls_ztbz = Mid(ls_zhbz,2,1)
			IF ls_ztbz = '2' THEN ls_ztbz = '4'
		END IF
		//如果处方有剩余
		IF ll_rowcount > 0 THEN
			FOR ll_cur = 1 To ll_rowcount
				ld_szfbl2 = -1
				ld_num = luds_bfcfmx.Object.sl[ll_cur]
				ld_price = luds_bfcfmx.Object.dj[ll_cur]
				ls_xmbm = luds_bfcfmx.Object.xmbm[ll_cur]
				ls_xmmc = luds_bfcfmx.Object.xmmc[ll_cur]
				ls_dw = luds_bfcfmx.Object.dw[ll_cur]
				ld_szfbl = luds_bfcfmx.Object.szfbl[ll_cur]
				ld_zjje =  luds_bfcfmx.Object.zjje[ll_cur]
				ld_zfje =  luds_bfcfmx.Object.zfje[ll_cur]
				ll_xmlsh = luds_bfcfmx.Object.xmlsh[ll_cur]
				ls_gg = luds_bfcfmx.Object.gg[ll_cur]
				ls_jx = luds_bfcfmx.Object.ybjx[ll_cur]
				IF ls_jylx = 'RD01' Or ls_jylx = 'SD01' THEN
					ld_num  = -1 * ld_num
				END IF
				
				IF ld_num < 0 THEN
					ls_num = '-' +Right('0000000000'+String(Abs(ld_num),'#####.00'),9)
				ELSE
					ls_num = Right('0000000000'+String(Abs(ld_num),'#####.00'),10)
				END IF
				
				IF ld_price < 0 THEN
					ls_price = '-' +Right('0000000000'+String(Abs(ld_price),'#####.0000'),11)
				ELSE
					ls_price = Right('0000000000'+String(Abs(ld_price),'#####.0000'),12)
				END IF
				//对应科室编码和名称
				IF as_mxlx = 'CF' THEN
					SELECT SBKS Into :ls_ksbm From mz_ks,mz_cfk Where mz_ks.ksbm = mz_cfk.ksbm And mz_cfk.fplsh = :ls_first And rownum = 1;
				ELSEIF as_mxlx = 'YJ' THEN
					SELECT SBKS Into :ls_ksbm From mz_ks,mz_yjk1 Where mz_ks.ksbm = mz_yjk1.ksbm And mz_yjk1.fplsh = :ls_first And rownum = 1;
				END IF
				IF sqlca.SQLCode <> 0  THEN
					ls_ksbm = '1'
				END IF
				IF IsNull(ls_ksbm) Or ls_ksbm = '' THEN ls_ksbm = '1'
				
				IF IsValid (gu_ybjk) = False THEN //创建医保接口
					gu_ybjk = Create u_ybjk_his
				END IF
				IF gu_ybjk.of_get_ybksbm( ls_ksbm, ls_ksmc) < 0 THEN
					ls_ksbm = '1'
					ls_ksmc = '内    科'
				END IF
				IF IsNull(ls_ksmc)  THEN ls_ksmc = ''
				
				//		
				//费用类别
				ls_fylb = String(luds_bfcfmx.Describe("Evaluate('LookUpDisplay(fylb) ', "+ String(ll_cur) + ")"))
				IF IsNull(ls_fylb) THEN ls_fylb = ''
				ls_fylb = Right('00' + ls_fylb,2)
				
				//========报销比例========== //
				IF IsNull(ld_szfbl) THEN ld_szfbl = 1
				IF ld_szfbl = 1 And ld_zjje = ld_zfje THEN
					IF wf_getzfbl(0,ls_first,ll_xmlsh,'CF',ld_szfbl2) THEN
						IF IsNull(ld_szfbl2) THEN ld_szfbl2 = 0
						ld_szfbl = ld_szfbl2
					END IF
				END IF
				IF ld_szfbl = 1 And ld_zjje <> 0 And ld_zjje <> ld_zfje THEN
					IF Abs(ld_zjje) < Abs(ld_zfje) THEN
						ld_szfbl = 0
					ELSE
						ld_szfbl = ld_zfje / ld_zjje
					END IF
				END IF
				
				ld_kbbl = 1 - ld_szfbl
				ls_kbbl = String(ld_kbbl,'0.00')
				IF ld_kbbl > 0 THEN
					ld_fyze = ld_num * ld_price * ld_kbbl
					IF ld_fyze < 0 THEN
						ls_fyze = '-' +Right('0000000000'+String(Abs(ld_fyze),'#####.00'),9)
					ELSE
						ls_fyze = Right('0000000000'+String(Abs(ld_fyze),'#####.00'),10)
					END IF
					ld_zlje = ld_num * ld_price * ld_szfbl
					IF ld_zlje < 0 THEN
						ls_zlje = '-' +Right('0000000000'+String(Abs(ld_zlje),'#####.00'),9)
					ELSE
						ls_zlje = Right('0000000000'+String(Abs(ld_zlje),'#####.00'),10)
					END IF
				ELSE
					ls_fyze = '0000000.00'
					ls_zlje = '0000000.00'
				END IF
				
				IF IsNull(ls_brbm) Or ls_brbm = '' THEN ls_brbm = '1'
				IF IsNull(ls_brxm) Or ls_brxm = '' THEN ls_brxm = '1'
				IF IsNull(ls_sfzh) Or Trim(ls_sfzh) = '' THEN ls_sfzh = '1'
				IF IsNull(ls_fylb) Or Trim(ls_fylb) = '' THEN ls_fylb = '03'
				IF IsNull(ls_xmbm) Or Trim(ls_xmbm) = '' THEN ls_xmbm = '1'
				IF IsNull(ls_xmmc) Or Trim(ls_xmmc) = '' THEN ls_xmmc = '1'
				IF IsNull(ls_dw) Or Trim(ls_dw) = '' THEN ls_dw = '无'
				IF IsNull(ls_jx) Or Trim(ls_jx) = '' THEN  ls_jx = '无'
				IF IsNull(ls_gg) Or Trim(ls_gg) = '' THEN  ls_gg = '无'
				
				IF IsNull(ls_ysgh) THEN ls_ysgh = ' '
				IF Len(ls_ksmc) > 10 THEN ls_ksmc = gf_midstring(ls_ksmc,10)
				IF Len(ls_ksbm) > 5  THEN ls_ksbm = gf_midstring(ls_ksbm,5)
				IF Len(ls_ysgh) > 6  THEN ls_ysgh = gf_midstring(ls_ysgh,6)
				IF Len(ls_xmmc) > 30 THEN ls_xmmc = gf_midstring(ls_xmmc,30)
				IF Len(ls_brbm) > 8  THEN ls_brbm = gf_midstring(ls_brbm,8)
				IF Len(ls_brxm) > 30 THEN ls_brxm = gf_midstring(ls_brxm,30)
				
				IF ls_fylb = '05' THEN //草药插到诊疗
					ll_insert = tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.InsertRow(0)
					tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.id[ll_insert] = ls_brbm
					tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.xm[ll_insert] = ls_brxm
					tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.sfzh[ll_insert] = ls_sfzh
					tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.cf_date[ll_insert] = ls_date
					tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.fylb[ll_insert] = ls_fylb
					tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.xm_bm[ll_insert] = ls_xmbm
					tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.xm_na[ll_insert] = ls_xmmc
					tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.xm_unt[ll_insert] = ls_dw
					tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.num[ll_insert] = ls_num
					tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.price[ll_insert] = ls_price
					tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.kb_bl[ll_insert] = ls_kbbl
					tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.p_type[ll_insert] = '0'
					tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.yb_bz[ll_insert] = Mid(ls_zhbz,1 ,1)
					tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.zt_bz[ll_insert] = ls_ztbz
					tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.db_bz[ll_insert] = '0'
					tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.mz_bz[ll_insert] = '1'
					tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.ys_gh[ll_insert] = ls_ysgh
					tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.ks_bm[ll_insert] = ls_ksbm
					tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.ks_na[ll_insert] = ls_ksmc
					tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.cen_lsh[ll_insert] = as_zxlsh
					tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.cf_no[ll_insert] = 1
					tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.fyze[ll_insert] = ls_fyze
					tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.zlje[ll_insert] = ls_zlje
				ELSE
					ll_insert = tab_1.tab_ypmx.dw_ypmx.InsertRow(0)
					tab_1.tab_ypmx.dw_ypmx.Object.id[ll_insert] = ls_brbm
					tab_1.tab_ypmx.dw_ypmx.Object.xm[ll_insert] = ls_brxm
					tab_1.tab_ypmx.dw_ypmx.Object.sfzh[ll_insert] = ls_sfzh
					tab_1.tab_ypmx.dw_ypmx.Object.cf_date[ll_insert] = ls_date
					tab_1.tab_ypmx.dw_ypmx.Object.fylb[ll_insert] = ls_fylb
					tab_1.tab_ypmx.dw_ypmx.Object.xm_bm[ll_insert] = ls_xmbm
					tab_1.tab_ypmx.dw_ypmx.Object.xm_na[ll_insert] = ls_xmmc
					tab_1.tab_ypmx.dw_ypmx.Object.mz_frm[ll_insert] = ls_jx
					tab_1.tab_ypmx.dw_ypmx.Object.xm_unt[ll_insert] = ls_dw
					tab_1.tab_ypmx.dw_ypmx.Object.xm_std[ll_insert] = ls_gg
					tab_1.tab_ypmx.dw_ypmx.Object.num[ll_insert] = ls_num
					tab_1.tab_ypmx.dw_ypmx.Object.price[ll_insert] = ls_price
					tab_1.tab_ypmx.dw_ypmx.Object.kb_bl[ll_insert] = ls_kbbl
					tab_1.tab_ypmx.dw_ypmx.Object.p_type[ll_insert] = '0'
					tab_1.tab_ypmx.dw_ypmx.Object.yb_bz[ll_insert] = Mid(ls_zhbz,1 ,1)
					tab_1.tab_ypmx.dw_ypmx.Object.zt_bz[ll_insert] = ls_ztbz
					tab_1.tab_ypmx.dw_ypmx.Object.db_bz[ll_insert] = '0'
					tab_1.tab_ypmx.dw_ypmx.Object.mz_bz[ll_insert] = '1'
					tab_1.tab_ypmx.dw_ypmx.Object.ys_gh[ll_insert] = ls_ysgh
					tab_1.tab_ypmx.dw_ypmx.Object.ks_bm[ll_insert] = ls_ksbm
					tab_1.tab_ypmx.dw_ypmx.Object.ks_na[ll_insert] = ls_ksmc
					tab_1.tab_ypmx.dw_ypmx.Object.cen_lsh[ll_insert] = as_zxlsh
					tab_1.tab_ypmx.dw_ypmx.Object.cf_no[ll_insert] = 1
					tab_1.tab_ypmx.dw_ypmx.Object.fyze[ll_insert] = ls_fyze
					tab_1.tab_ypmx.dw_ypmx.Object.zlje[ll_insert] = ls_zlje
				END IF
			NEXT
		END IF
		//如果部分退后剩余有诊疗
		IF ll_yjcount > 0 THEN
			FOR ll_cur = 1 To ll_yjcount
				ld_szfbl2 = -1
				ld_num = luds_bfyjmx.Object.sl[ll_cur]
				ld_price = luds_bfyjmx.Object.dj[ll_cur]
				ls_xmbm = luds_bfyjmx.Object.xmbm[ll_cur]
				ls_xmmc = luds_bfyjmx.Object.xmmc[ll_cur]
				ls_dw = luds_bfyjmx.Object.dw[ll_cur]
				ll_xmlsh = luds_bfyjmx.Object.xmlsh[ll_cur]
				ld_szfbl = luds_bfyjmx.Object.szfbl[ll_cur]
				ld_zjje =  luds_bfyjmx.Object.zjje[ll_cur]
				ld_zfje =  luds_bfyjmx.Object.zfje[ll_cur]
				IF ls_jylx = 'RD01' Or ls_jylx = 'SD01' THEN
					ld_num  = -1 * ld_num
				END IF
				
				IF ld_num < 0 THEN
					ls_num = '-' +Right('0000000000'+String(Abs(ld_num),'#####.00'),9)
				ELSE
					ls_num = Right('0000000000'+String(Abs(ld_num),'#####.00'),10)
				END IF
				
				IF ld_price < 0 THEN
					ls_price = '-' +Right('0000000000'+String(Abs(ld_price),'#####.0000'),11)
				ELSE
					ls_price = Right('0000000000'+String(Abs(ld_price),'#####.0000'),12)
				END IF
				//对应科室编码和名称
				IF as_mxlx = 'CF' THEN
					SELECT SBKS Into :ls_ksbm From mz_ks,mz_cfk Where mz_ks.ksbm = mz_cfk.ksbm And mz_cfk.fplsh = :ls_first And rownum = 1;
				ELSEIF as_mxlx = 'YJ' THEN
					SELECT SBKS Into :ls_ksbm From mz_ks,mz_yjk1 Where mz_ks.ksbm = mz_yjk1.ksbm And mz_yjk1.fplsh = :ls_first And rownum = 1;
				END IF
				IF sqlca.SQLCode <> 0  THEN
					ls_ksbm = '1'
				END IF
				IF IsNull(ls_ksbm) Or ls_ksbm = '' THEN ls_ksbm = '1'
				
				IF IsValid (gu_ybjk) = False THEN //创建医保接口
					gu_ybjk = Create u_ybjk_his
				END IF
				IF gu_ybjk.of_get_ybksbm( ls_ksbm, ls_ksmc) < 0 THEN
					ls_ksbm = '1'
					ls_ksmc = '内    科'
				END IF
				IF IsNull(ls_ksmc)  THEN ls_ksmc = ''
				
				//		
				//费用类别
				ls_fylb = String(luds_bfyjmx.Describe("Evaluate('LookUpDisplay(fylb) ', "+ String(ll_cur) + ")"))
				IF IsNull(ls_fylb) THEN ls_fylb = ''
				ls_fylb = Right('00' + ls_fylb,2)
				
				//========报销比例========== //
				IF IsNull(ld_szfbl) THEN ld_szfbl = 1
				IF ld_szfbl = 1 And (ld_zjje = ld_zfje or ls_xmbm= 'f25031003500')  THEN
					IF wf_getzfbl(0,ls_first,ll_xmlsh,'YJ',ld_szfbl2) THEN
						IF IsNull(ld_szfbl2) THEN ld_szfbl2 = 0
						ld_szfbl = ld_szfbl2
					END IF
				END IF
				
				IF ld_szfbl = 1 And ld_zjje <> 0 And ld_zjje <> ld_zfje THEN
					IF Abs(ld_zjje) < Abs(ld_zfje) THEN
						ld_szfbl = 0
					ELSE
						ld_szfbl = ld_zfje / ld_zjje
//						IF ld_szfbl = 0.38 Or  ld_szfbl = 0.6 THEN
//							ld_szfbl = 0
//						END IF
					END IF
				END IF
				
				ld_kbbl = 1 - ld_szfbl
				ls_kbbl = String(ld_kbbl,'0.00')
//				IF ld_kbbl > 0 THEN
//					ld_fyze = ld_num * ld_price * ld_kbbl
//					IF ld_fyze < 0 THEN
//						ls_fyze = '-' +Right('0000000000'+String(Abs(ld_fyze),'#####.00'),9)
//					ELSE
//						ls_fyze = Right('0000000000'+String(Abs(ld_fyze),'#####.00'),10)
//					END IF
//					ld_zlje = ld_num * ld_price * ld_szfbl
//					IF ld_zlje < 0 THEN
//						ls_zlje = '-' +Right('0000000000'+String(Abs(ld_zlje),'#####.00'),9)
//					ELSE
//						ls_zlje = Right('0000000000'+String(Abs(ld_zlje),'#####.00'),10)
//					END IF
//				ELSE
//					ls_fyze = '0000000.00'
//					ls_zlje = '0000000.00'
//				END IF
				IF ld_kbbl > 0 THEN
					IF ld_szfbl2 = 0 THEN
						ld_fyze = ld_num * ld_price * ld_szfbl
						IF ld_fyze < 0 THEN
							ls_fyze = '-' +Right('0000000000'+String(Abs(ld_fyze),'#####.00'),9)
						ELSE
							ls_fyze = Right('0000000000'+String(Abs(ld_fyze),'#####.00'),10)
						END IF
						ld_zlje = ld_num * ld_price * ld_kbbl
						IF ld_zlje < 0 THEN
							ls_zlje = '-' +Right('0000000000'+String(Abs(ld_zlje),'#####.00'),9)
						ELSE
							ls_zlje = Right('0000000000'+String(Abs(ld_zlje),'#####.00'),10)
						END IF
					ELSE
						ld_fyze = ld_num * ld_price * ld_kbbl
						IF ld_fyze < 0 THEN
							ls_fyze = '-' +Right('0000000000'+String(Abs(ld_fyze),'#####.00'),9)
						ELSE
							ls_fyze = Right('0000000000'+String(Abs(ld_fyze),'#####.00'),10)
						END IF
						ld_zlje = ld_num * ld_price * ld_szfbl
						IF ld_zlje < 0 THEN
							ls_zlje = '-' +Right('0000000000'+String(Abs(ld_zlje),'#####.00'),9)
						ELSE
							ls_zlje = Right('0000000000'+String(Abs(ld_zlje),'#####.00'),10)
						END IF
					END IF
				ELSE
					ls_fyze = '0000000.00'
					ls_zlje = '0000000.00'
				END IF
				
				IF IsNull(ls_brbm) Or ls_brbm = '' THEN ls_brbm = '1'
				IF IsNull(ls_brxm) Or ls_brxm = '' THEN ls_brxm = '1'
				IF IsNull(ls_sfzh) Or Trim(ls_sfzh) = '' THEN ls_sfzh = '1'
				IF IsNull(ls_fylb) Or Trim(ls_fylb) = '' THEN ls_fylb = '03'
				IF IsNull(ls_xmbm) Or Trim(ls_xmbm) = '' THEN ls_xmbm = '1'
				IF IsNull(ls_xmmc) Or Trim(ls_xmmc) = '' THEN ls_xmmc = '1'
				IF IsNull(ls_dw) Or Trim(ls_dw) = '' THEN ls_dw = '无'
				IF IsNull(ls_jx) Or Trim(ls_jx) = '' THEN  ls_jx = '无'
				IF IsNull(ls_gg) Or Trim(ls_gg) = '' THEN  ls_gg = '无'
				
				IF IsNull(ls_ysgh) THEN ls_ysgh = ' '
				IF Len(ls_ksmc) > 10 THEN ls_ksmc = gf_midstring(ls_ksmc,10)
				IF Len(ls_ksbm) > 5  THEN ls_ksbm = gf_midstring(ls_ksbm,5)
				IF Len(ls_ysgh) > 6  THEN ls_ysgh = gf_midstring(ls_ysgh,6)
				IF Len(ls_xmmc) > 30 THEN ls_xmmc = gf_midstring(ls_xmmc,30)
				IF Len(ls_brbm) > 8  THEN ls_brbm = gf_midstring(ls_brbm,8)
				IF Len(ls_brxm) > 30 THEN ls_brxm = gf_midstring(ls_brxm,30)
				
				ll_insert = tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.InsertRow(0)
				tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.id[ll_insert] = ls_brbm
				tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.xm[ll_insert] = ls_brxm
				tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.sfzh[ll_insert] = ls_sfzh
				tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.cf_date[ll_insert] = ls_date
				tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.fylb[ll_insert] = ls_fylb
				tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.xm_bm[ll_insert] = ls_xmbm
				tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.xm_na[ll_insert] = ls_xmmc
				tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.xm_unt[ll_insert] = ls_dw
				tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.num[ll_insert] = ls_num
				tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.price[ll_insert] = ls_price
				tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.kb_bl[ll_insert] = ls_kbbl
				tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.p_type[ll_insert] = '0'
				tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.yb_bz[ll_insert] = Mid(ls_zhbz,1 ,1)
				tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.zt_bz[ll_insert] = ls_ztbz
				tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.db_bz[ll_insert] = '0'
				tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.mz_bz[ll_insert] = '1'
				tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.ys_gh[ll_insert] = ls_ysgh
				tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.ks_bm[ll_insert] = ls_ksbm
				tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.ks_na[ll_insert] = ls_ksmc
				tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.cen_lsh[ll_insert] = as_zxlsh
				tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.cf_no[ll_insert] = 1
				tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.fyze[ll_insert] = ls_fyze
				tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.zlje[ll_insert] = ls_zlje
			NEXT
		END IF
	END IF
ELSE
	lb_bf = False
END IF
Destroy luds_bfcfmx
Destroy luds_bfyjmx
Destroy luds_tpxx_bf
RETURN lb_bf









end function

public function boolean wf_getzfbl (decimal ad_jllsh, string as_fplsh, long al_xmlsh, string as_ywlx, ref decimal ad_zfbl);
//如果ad_jllsh =0, 则找到对应的jllsh,不为0则根据JLLSH来定位
Long ll_count
ad_zfbl = -1
IF ad_jllsh = 0 THEN//根据fplsh和xmlsh,ywlx来判断是否自付比例有变动
	SELECT count(jllsh) Into :ll_count From SB_ZFBL_XG Where fplsh = :as_fplsh And xmlsh = :al_xmlsh And ywlx = :as_ywlx;
	IF ll_count > 0 THEN
		SELECT X_ZFBL Into :ad_zfbl From SB_ZFBL_XG Where fplsh = :as_fplsh And xmlsh = :al_xmlsh And ywlx = :as_ywlx and rownum = 1;
	ELSE
		ad_zfbl = -1
		RETURN False
	END IF
ELSE
	SELECT X_ZFBL Into :ad_zfbl From SB_ZFBL_XG Where jllsh = :ad_jllsh;
END IF

IF sqlca.SQLCode = 0 THEN
	RETURN True
ELSE
	ad_zfbl = -1
	RETURN False
END IF

end function

		INTO :ld_mztotal
		From sb_jymx Where jssj >= :idt_begin And jssj < :idt_end And zxlsh Is Not Null And NVL(zymz,'0') = '0' ;
	//	
END IF
	//住院+ NVL(tczfs,0)
	gf_waiting('正在统计数据......',20)
	SELECT sum(NVL(dnzfs,0) + NVL(qfddnzhzfs,0) + NVL(lnzfs,0) + NVL(ybzfxjzfs,0) +  NVL(qfdlnzhzfs,0) + NVL(tcdlnzhzfs,0) + NVL(jzdlnzhzfs,0) +  NVL(jzdslnzhzfs,0) + 		NVL(qfdxjzfs,0) + NVL(tcdxjzfs,0) + NVL(jzdxjzfs,0) + NVL(jzdsxjzfs,0) + nvl(jmqfdxjzf,0) + 		NVL(tcdtczfs,0)  + NVL(qfdgbzfs,0) + NVL(tcdgbzfs,0) + NVL(jzdgbzfs,0) + 		NVL(jzdsgbzfs,0) + NVL(gbzfs,0)   + NVL(jzdjzzfs,0) + NVL(zyjjzfs,0)+ NVL(jmjjzf,0) +NVL(jmxjzf,0) + NVL(jmfdxsgrxjzf,0) + NVL(qfdgrxjzfs,0) + NVL(tcdfdxsgrxjzfs,0) + NVL(tcdjjzfs,0) )
		INTO :ld_zytotal
		From sb_jymx Where jssj >= :idt_begin And jssj < :idt_end And zxlsh Is Not Null And NVL(zymz,'0') = '1';
		
	gf_waiting('正在统计数据......',30)
	IF IsNull(ld_zytotal) THEN ld_zytotal = 0
	IF IsNull(ld_mztotal) THEN ld_mztotal = 0
	
	IF IsNull(ld_dnzhzfze) THEN ld_dnzhzfze = 0
	IF IsNull(ld_lnzhzfze) THEN ld_lnzhzfze = 0
	IF IsNull(ld_ybzfxjzfze) THEN ld_ybzfxjzfze = 0
	IF IsNull(ld_tczfze) THEN ld_tczfze = 0
	IF IsNull(ld_gbzfze) THEN ld_gbzfze = 0
	IF IsNull(ld_jzzfze)  THEN ld_jzzfze = 0
	IF IsNull(ld_zyjjzfze) THEN ld_zyjjzfze = 0
	IF IsNull(ld_jmybjjzfze) THEN ld_jmybjjzfze = 0
	
	IF IsNull(ld_sdmztotal) THEN ld_sdmztotal = 0
	
	IF IsNull(ld_sddnzhzfze) THEN ld_sddnzhzfze = 0
	IF IsNull(ld_sdlnzhzfze) THEN ld_sdlnzhzfze = 0
	IF IsNull(ld_sdybzfxjzfze) THEN ld_sdybzfxjzfze = 0
	IF IsNull(ld_sdtczfze) THEN ld_sdtczfze = 0
	IF IsNull(ld_sdgbzfze) THEN ld_sdgbzfze = 0
	IF IsNull(ld_sdjzzfze)  THEN ld_sdjzzfze = 0
	IF IsNull(ld_sdzyjjzfze) THEN ld_sdzyjjzfze = 0
	IF IsNull(ld_sdjmybjjzfze) THEN ld_sdjmybjjzfze = 0
	
	dw_1.Object.dzr[1] = is_dzr
	dw_1.Object.dnzhzfze[1] = ld_dnzhzfze - ld_sddnzhzfze
	dw_1.Object.lnzhzfze[1] = ld_lnzhzfze - ld_sdlnzhzfze
	dw_1.Object.ybzfxjzfze[1] = ld_ybzfxjzfze - ld_sdybzfxjzfze
	dw_1.Object.tczfze[1] = ld_tczfze - ld_sdtczfze
	dw_1.Object.gbzfze[1] = ld_gbzfze - ld_sdgbzfze
	dw_1.Object.jzzfze[1] = ld_jzzfze - ld_sdjzzfze
	dw_1.Object.zyjjzfze[1] = ld_zyjjzfze - ld_sdzyjjzfze
	dw_1.Object.mzsjjy[1] = ld_mztotal - ld_sdmztotal
	dw_1.Object.zysjjy[1] = ld_zytotal
	dw_1.Object.dcbz[1] = 0
	dw_1.Object.jmybjjzfze[1] = ld_jmybjjzfze - ld_sdjmybjjzfze
	gf_begin_transaction(sqlca)
	IF dw_1.Update( ) = 1 THEN
		gf_commit_transaction(sqlca)
		dw_1.Retrieve(is_dzr)
		SELECT Sum(zlje) Into :ld_zzlje From sb_jymx Where XMLB = 'GH' And zxlsh Is Not Null And jssj >= :idt_begin And jssj < :idt_end;
		dw_1.Object.zlje[1] = ld_zzlje
	ELSE
		gf_rollback_transaction(sqlca)
		gf_waiting('汇总数据出错，请重试......',-1)
		dw_1.Reset( )
		dw_1.InsertRow(1)
		MessageBox('提示','汇总数据出错，请重试!')
		dw_toolbar.Enabled = True
		SetNull(is_dzr)
		RETURN
	END IF
//END IF
//
//gf_waiting('正在生成挂号明细......',40)
//IF Not wf_setghmx() THEN
//	gf_waiting('统计挂号明细出错......',-1)
//END IF

event clicked;u_datastore luds_sbzmx
DateTime ldt_begin,ldt_end
Long ll_rowcount,ll_cur,ll_find,ll_mxcount
String ls_brbm
Dec{2} ld_fyze,ld_zlje
IF Not IsValid(luds_sbzmx) THEN luds_sbzmx = Create u_datastore
luds_sbzmx.DataObject = "d_sbzje"
luds_sbzmx.SetTransObject( sqlca)
ll_rowcount = luds_sbzmx.Retrieve( idt_begin,idt_end )
ll_mxcount = tab_1.tab_sbjd.dw_2.RowCount( )
FOR ll_cur = 1 To ll_rowcount
	ls_brbm = luds_sbzmx.Object.brbm[ll_cur]
	ll_find = tab_1.tab_sbjd.dw_2.Find( "brbm = '"+ls_brbm+"'", 1, ll_mxcount)
	IF ll_find > 0 THEN
		ld_fyze = tab_1.tab_sbjd.dw_2.Object.fyze[ll_find]
		ld_zlje = tab_1.tab_sbjd.dw_2.Object.zlje[ll_find]
		If (ld_fyze + ld_zlje) <> Dec(luds_sbzmx.Object.zje[ll_cur]) THEN
			tab_1.tab_sbjd.dw_2.Object.bz[ll_find] = 1
			tab_1.tab_sbjd.dw_2.Object.zje[ll_find] = Dec(luds_sbzmx.Object.zje[ll_cur])
			tab_1.tab_sbjd.dw_2.Object.fyze2[ll_find] = Dec(luds_sbzmx.Object.fyze[ll_cur])
			tab_1.tab_sbjd.dw_2.Object.zlje2[ll_find] = Dec(luds_sbzmx.Object.zlje[ll_cur])
			gf_applog(string(idt_begin,'yyyymmdd') + "---brbm = '"+ls_brbm+"' 金额不符,相差" + String(ld_fyze + ld_zlje - luds_sbzmx.Object.zje[ll_cur] ))
		ELSE
			tab_1.tab_sbjd.dw_2.Object.zje[ll_find] = Dec(luds_sbzmx.Object.zje[ll_cur])
			tab_1.tab_sbjd.dw_2.Object.fyze2[ll_find] = Dec(luds_sbzmx.Object.fyze[ll_cur])
			tab_1.tab_sbjd.dw_2.Object.zlje2[ll_find] = Dec(luds_sbzmx.Object.zlje[ll_cur])
		END IF
	ELSE
		IF  luds_sbzmx.Object.zje[ll_cur] <> 0 THEN
			gf_applog(string(idt_begin,'yyyymmdd') + "---找不到对应的brbm = '"+ls_brbm+"' 金额不符,相差" + String(luds_sbzmx.Object.zje[ll_cur]))
		END IF
	END IF
NEXT

u_office_excel uo_excel
uo_excel.of_savexlsfile('明细校对',tab_1.tab_sbjd.dw_2,'制表时间:' + String(idt_begin))

end event

//		iuds_mxdz.Object.zlje[ll_find] = ld_zlje
//	END IF
//NEXT

FOR ll_cur = 1 To ll_rowcount
	ld_fyze = Dec(tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.fyze[ll_cur])
	ld_zlje = Dec(tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.zlje[ll_cur])
	ls_brbm = tab_1.tab_zlmx.dw_zlmx.Object.id[ll_cur]
	ll_find = tab_1.tab_sbjd.dw_2.Find("brbm = '"+ls_brbm+"'",1,tab_1.tab_sbjd.dw_2.RowCount())
	IF ll_find > 0  THEN
		tab_1.tab_sbjd.dw_2.Object.fyze[ll_find] = tab_1.tab_sbjd.dw_2.Object.fyze[ll_find] + ld_fyze
		tab_1.tab_sbjd.dw_2.Object.zlje[ll_find] = tab_1.tab_sbjd.dw_2.Object.zlje[ll_find] + ld_zlje
	ELSE
		ll_find = tab_1.tab_sbjd.dw_2.InsertRow(0)
		tab_1.tab_sbjd.dw_2.Object.brbm[ll_find] = ls_brbm
		tab_1.tab_sbjd.dw_2.Object.fyze[ll_find] = ld_fyze
		tab_1.tab_sbjd.dw_2.Object.zlje[ll_find] = ld_zlje
	END IF
NEXT
end event

on w_sfyz_0.create
int iCurrent
call super::create
this.cb_2=create cb_2
this.em_2=create em_2
this.cb_4=create cb_4
this.cb_1=create cb_1
this.cb_3=create cb_3
this.cb_5=create cb_5
this.sle_1=create sle_1
iCurrent=UpperBound(this.Control)
this.Control[iCurrent+1]=this.cb_2
this.Control[iCurrent+2]=this.em_2
this.Control[iCurrent+3]=this.cb_4
this.Control[iCurrent+4]=this.cb_1
this.Control[iCurrent+5]=this.cb_3
this.Control[iCurrent+6]=this.cb_5
this.Control[iCurrent+7]=this.sle_1
end on

on w_sfyz_0.destroy
call super::destroy
destroy(this.cb_2)
destroy(this.em_2)
destroy(this.cb_4)
destroy(this.cb_1)
destroy(this.cb_3)
destroy(this.cb_5)
destroy(this.sle_1)
end on

Dec{0} ldc_jylsh,ldc_recid

uo_brxx luo_brxx
n_smsobject ln_smsobject
IF IsValid(ln_smsobject) = False THEN ln_smsobject = Create n_smsobject
luo_brxx = Create uo_brxx
ll_count = dw_list.RowCount( )
IF Not IsValid(gu_mz_zhjz) THEN
	gu_mz_zhjz = Create u_mz_zhjz
	IF gu_mz_zhjz.set_worktrans(sqlca) < 0 THEN
		MessageBox('创建gu_mz_zhjz失败',gu_mz_zhjz.is_error)
		RETURN
	END IF
END IF
gu_mz_zhjz.uf_setyybz(2)
FOR ll_row = 1 To ll_count
	ls_yzhm = ''
	lstr_brxx = lstr_brxx_null
	ldc_jyje = dw_list.Object.czje[ll_row]
	ls_brbm = dw_list.Object.brbm[ll_row]
	lstr_brxx.brbm = ls_brbm
	lstr_return = luo_brxx.uf_get_brxx( false,'BRBM', lstr_brxx)

	if lstr_return.ai_return < 0 then
		gf_applog(  '获取病人基本信息失败:' + lstr_return.as_return + ' BRBM:' + ls_brbm)
		continue
	end if
	ls_brxm = dw_list.Object.brxm[ll_row]
	ls_smsmobile = dw_list.Object.yddh[ll_row]
	IF IsNull(ls_smsmobile) Or Trim(ls_smsmobile) = '' THEN
		ls_smsmobile = dw_list.Object.gddh[ll_row]
	END IF
	IF gu_mz_zhjz.uf_zhck( lstr_brxx,'YDZF', 'YDZF', ldc_jyje,ldc_zhye,ldc_jylsh, ls_yzhm, 'YDZFYC',False,1,7,'移动支付预存',2,98) < 0 THEN
		gf_applog(  '预存失败:' + String(ldc_jylsh) +  gu_mz_zhjz.is_error)
		gf_rollback_transaction(sqlca)
		CONTINUE
	END IF
	ls_bzxx = ' 预存JYLSH'+String(ldc_jylsh) + '; 预存账户是否支付 //	lstr_yb_mzsfqq.ybsfjs = '1' //ELSE //	lstr_yb_mzsfqq.smkzhsfzf = '1'
//	lstr_yb_mzsfqq.ybsfjs = '2'
//END IF

lstr_yb_mzsfqq.JZLSH = ldc_jzlsh
lstr_yb_mzsfqq.KSBM = ls_ksbm
lstr_yb_mzsfqq.fplsh = ''
//lstr_yb_mzsfqq.jzlsh = 
IF ls_jylx = 'TSB' Or ls_jylx = 'MXB' THEN
	lstr_yb_mzsfqq.tsbxmdm = String(lstr_brxx.tsbxm ) //特殊病编码
	lstr_yb_mzsfqq.mxbxmdm = String(lstr_brxx.mxbxm ) //慢性病编码
END IF
str_yb_mzghqq_new lstr_yb_mzghqq
IF金额:' + String(ldc_jyje) 	UPDATE jkxt.zhyb_ydjsmx SET ztbz = 2,bzxx = to_char(sysdate,'yyyymmdd hh24:mi:ss') ||  :ls_bzxx WHERE  JSSJ >= to_date('20221216','yyyymmdd') AND 		JSSJ < to_date('20230101','yyyymmdd') AND YWLSH  LIKE 'YDZF%' AND NVL(CZJE,0) <> 0 AND ztbz = 1 		And brbm = :ls_brbm Using sqlca;
	IF sqlca.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
		ls_error = ls_brbm + 'jyje:' + String(ldc_jyje) + '失败：' + sqlca.SQLErrText
		gf_applog( ls_error)
		gf_rollback_transaction(sqlca)
		CONTINUE
	ELSE
		gf_commit_transaction(sqlca)
		gf_applog(  '预存成功:' + String(ldc_jylsh) + + String(ldc_jyje,'0.00'))
	END IF
//	if messagebox('提示','是否继续',question!,yesno!,2) = 1 then
		IF IsNull(ls_smsmobile) Or Trim(ls_smsmobile) = '' THEN
			ls_smsmobile = dw_list.Object.gddh[ll_row]
		ELSE
			ls_content = ls_brxm + "您好，由于您近期在我院使用医保移动支付，经过对帐后发现存在重复交易情况，目前已经完成医保反交易，现金部分已经存入我院门诊预存款帐户（存款金额为："
			ls_content = ls_content + String(ldc_jyje) + "元），如需取现可到医院收费窗口取现（咨询电话：88002287）"
			ldc_recid = ln_smsobject.uf_sendsm(String(base_info.syscode), ls_smsmobile, ls_content, 'YDZF', true, ls_smserror)
			IF ldc_recid < 0 THEN
//			IF ln_smsobject.uf_sendsm(String(base_info.syscode), ls_content, ls_smsmobile,ls_brxm, gf_midstring(ls_brbm,22), 'YDZF', ldt_senddate, ls_smserror) < 0 THEN

				gf_applog(  '预存成功:' + String(ldc_jylsh) + '   短信发送成功srcid：' + STRING(ldc_recid))

event modified;string ls_filter
long ll_row,ll_rowcount ,ll_index

ll_rowcount = dw_1.rowcount( )
for ll_index = 1 to ll_rowcount

	dw_1.selectrow(ll_index, false)
next 

ls_filter = "(ygdm like '"+ trim(this.text)+"%')"

ll_row = dw_1.find( ls_filter,il_row +1 ,ll_rowcount)

if ll_row > 0 then 
	il_row = ll_row
	dw_1.scrolltorow( ll_row)
	dw_1.selectrow(ll_row, true)
else
	il_row = 0
end if

event clicked;
String ls_error = '',ls_fail = '',ls_sfhx
String ls_czgh,ls_dzlsh,ls_czyzh,ls_suc,ls_zdjylsh = '0'

Long ll_row ,ll_rowcount,ll_xzts
ll_rowcount = dw_1.RowCount( )

FOR ll_row = 1 To ll_rowcount
	ls_czgh = ''
	ls_dzlsh = ''
	IF dw_1.Object.xz[ll_row] = 0  THEN CONTINUE
	ls_czgh = dw_1.Object.ygdm[ll_row]
	ls_czyzh = dw_1.Object.sptbm[ll_row]
	ls_dzlsh = dw_1.Object.jyzqh[ll_row]
	ls_zdjylsh = '0'
	ls_sfhx = '1'
	DO WHILE ls_sfhx = '1'
		gu_ybjk_public.iu_sybjk_his.uf_send_init ( '9255')
		gu_ybjk_public.iu_sybjk_his.uf_send_add( '已下载最大交易流水号',ls_zdjylsh)
		gu_ybjk_public.iu_sybjk_his.uf_send_add( '操作员账号',ls_czgh) //008049   3311001000050036
		gu_ybjk_public.iu_sybjk_his.uf_send_add( '对帐流水号',ls_dzlsh)
		
		IF gu_ybjk_public.iu_sybjk_his.uf_send( ls_error,0,'330000' ) THEN
			ls_sfhx = gu_ybjk_public.iu_sybjk_his.uf_getstring( '是否还有需下载的记录')
			ll_xzts = long(gu_ybjk_public.iu_sybjk_his.uf_getstring( '本次下载记录条数'))
			gu_ybjk_public.iu_sybjk_his.uf_getstring_mxnr( '交易明细列表') 
			ls_zdjylsh = gu_ybjk_public.iu_sybjk_his.uf_getstring_in( '交易流水号', ll_xzts)
			ls_suc = ls_czgh
		ELSE
			ls_fail = ls_czgh + "下载失败："+ls_error+"~r~n"
			ls_sfhx = '0'
		END IF
	LOOP
NEXT

MessageBox('信息提示','下载成功!'+ls_suc + ls_fail)



end event

public function integer wf_load_jdmx (ref string as_error);IF is_ybjk = 'syd' THEN
	st_1.Text = '医保结算明细(JKXT.SYDYB_JSMX)'
ELSEIF is_ybjk = 'ep' THEN
	st_1.Text = '医保结算明细(JKXT.PYYB_JSMX)'
ELSEIF is_ybjk = 'wd' THEN
	st_1.Text = '医保结算明细(JKXT.YB_JSMX)'
ELSEIF is_ybjk = 'tzsyd' THEN
	st_1.Text = '医保结算明细(JKXT.TZYB_JSMX_SYD)'
ELSEIF is_ybjk = 'lb' THEN
	st_1.Text = '医保结算明细(JKXT.LSYB_JSMX)'
ELSEIF is_ybjk = 'tzsbd' THEN
	st_1.Text = '医保结算明细(JKXT.TZYB_JSMX_SBD)'	
END IF
dw_ybjsmx.setfilter("")
dw_ybjsmx.FILter( )
CHOOSE CASE ii_bplx
	CASE 1 //预存不平
		dw_ybjsmx.Visible = False
		rb_1.visible = False
		rb_2.visible = False
		rb_3.visible = False
		rb_4.visible = False
		st_1.Text = "门诊账户交易明细(MZXT.H_MZ_ZHJYMX)"
		dw_zhjymx.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_zhjymx'
		dw_zhjymx.SetTransObject( sqlca )
		dw_zhjymx.Retrieve( is_brbm, idt_begin, idt_end )
		
		dw_fpzffs.SetTransObject( sqlca )
		dw_fpzffs.Retrieve( is_brbm, idt_begin, idt_end )
		
		st_2.Text = "门诊交易明细(MZXT.MZ_FPK)"
		dw_mxdz.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_fpkdz'
		dw_mxdz.SetTransObject( sqlca )
		dw_mxdz.Retrieve( is_brbm, idt_begin, idt_end )
	CASE 2 //预存挂号不平
		dw_ybjsmx.Visible = False
		rb_1.visible = False
		rb_2.visible = False
		rb_3.visible = False
		rb_4.visible = False
		st_1.Text = "门诊账户交易明细(MZXT.H_MZ_ZHJYMX)"
		dw_zhjymx.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_zhjymx_gh'
		dw_zhjymx.SetTransObject( sqlca )
		dw_zhjymx.Retrieve( is_brbm, idt_begin, idt_end )
		
		st_2.Text = "门诊挂号明细(MZXT.MZ_GHXX)"
		dw_mxdz.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_ghxxdz'
		dw_mxdz.SetTransObject( sqlca )
		dw_mxdz.Retrieve( is_brbm, idt_begin, idt_end )
	CASE 31 //基金支付不平（门诊）
		IF is_ybjk = 'ep' THEN
			dw_ybjsmx.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_jsmx_pymz'
		ELSEIF is_ybjk = 'syd' THEN
			dw_ybjsmx.DataObject = 'd_syd_jsmx_mz'
		ELSEIF is_ybjk = 'tzsbd' THEN
			dw_ybjsmx.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_jsmx_tzsbd_mz'
		ELSEIF is_ybjk = 'tzsyd' THEN
			dw_ybjsmx.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_jsmx_tzsydmz'
		ELSEIF is_ybjk = 'lb' THEN
			dw_ybjsmx.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_jsmx_lsmz'
		ELSE
			dw_ybjsmx.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_jsmx_mz'
		END IF
		dw_ybjsmx.SetTransObject( sqlca )
		dw_ybjsmx.Retrieve( is_brbm, idt_begin, idt_end )
		dw_mxdz.SetTransObject( sqlca )
	CASE 32 //基金支付不平（住院）
		IF is_ybjk = 'ep' THEN
			dw_ybjsmx.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_jsmx_pyzy'
		ELSEIF is_ybjk = 'syd' THEN
			dw_ybjsmx.DataObject = 'd_syd_jsmx_zy'
		ELSEIF is_ybjk = 'tzsbd' THEN
			dw_ybjsmx.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_jsmx_tzsbdzy'	
		ELSEIF is_ybjk = 'tzsyd' THEN
			dw_ybjsmx.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_jsmx_tzsydzy'
		ELSEIF is_ybjk = 'lb' THEN
			dw_ybjsmx.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_jsmx_lszy'
		ELSE
			dw_ybjsmx.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_jsmx_zy'
		END IF
		dw_ybjsmx.SetTransObject( sqlca )
		dw_ybjsmx.Retrieve( il_zyh )
		dw_mxdz.SetTransObject( sqlca )
	CASE 4,7,41 //门诊收费不平
		
		IF is_ybjk = 'ep' THEN
			dw_ybjsmx.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_jsmx_pymz'
		ELSEIF is_ybjk = 'syd' THEN
			dw_ybjsmx.DataObject = 'd_syd_jsmx_mz'
		ELSEIF is_ybjk = 'tzsyd' THEN
			dw_ybjsmx.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_jsmx_tzsydmz'
		ELSEIF is_ybjk = 'lb' THEN
			dw_ybjsmx.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_jsmx_lsmz'
		ELSEIF is_ybjk = 'tzsbd' THEN
			dw_ybjsmx.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_jsmx_tzsbd_mz'	
		ELSE
			dw_ybjsmx.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_jsmx_mz'
		END IF
		dw_ybjsmx.SetTransObject( sqlca )
		dw_ybjsmx.Retrieve( is_brbm, idt_begin, idt_end )
		st_2.Text = "门诊交易明细(MZXT.MZ_FPK)"
		dw_mxdz.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_fpkdz'
		dw_mxdz.SetTransObject( sqlca )
		dw_mxdz.Retrieve( is_brbm, idt_begin, idt_end )
		
		if ii_bplx = 4 or  ii_bplx = 41 then
			dw_ybjsmx.setfilter("YWLX = 'SF'")
			dw_ybjsmx.FILter( )
			cb_gzcl.event clicked( )
			cb_save.event clicked( )
			if ii_bplx = 41 then cb_exit.event clicked( )
		end if
		
//			cb_exit.event clicked( )
	CASE 5,8 //门诊挂号不平
		
		IF is_ybjk = 'ep' THEN
			dw_ybjsmx.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_jsmx_pymz'
		ELSEIF is_ybjk = 'syd' THEN
			dw_ybjsmx.DataObject = 'd_syd_jsmx_mz'
		ELSEIF is_ybjk = 'tzsyd' THEN
			dw_ybjsmx.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_jsmx_tzsydmz'
		ELSEIF is_ybjk = 'lb' THEN
			dw_ybjsmx.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_jsmx_lsmz'
		ELSEIF is_ybjk = 'tzsbd' THEN
			dw_ybjsmx.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_jsmx_tzsbd_mz'			
		ELSE
			dw_ybjsmx.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_jsmx_mz'
		END IF
		dw_ybjsmx.SetTransObject( sqlca )	
			dw_ybjsmx.Retrieve( is_brbm, idt_begin, idt_end )
		if ii_bplx = 5 then
			dw_ybjsmx.setfilter("YWLX = 'GH'")
			dw_ybjsmx.FILter( )
		end if
		st_2.Text = "门诊挂号明细(MZXT.MZ_GHXX)"
		dw_mxdz.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_ghxxdz'
		dw_mxdz.SetTransObject( sqlca )
		dw_mxdz.Retrieve( is_brbm, idt_begin, idt_end )
	CASE 6,9 //住院不平
		IF il_zyh <= 0 Or IsNull(il_zyh) THEN
			IF IsNull(il_zyh) THEN il_zyh = 0
			as_error = '传入住院号有误ZYH' + String(il_zyh)
			RETURN -1
		END IF
		IF is_ybjk = 'ep' THEN
			dw_ybjsmx.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_jsmx_pyzy'
		ELSEIF is_ybjk = 'syd' THEN
			dw_ybjsmx.DataObject = 'd_syd_jsmx_zy'
		ELSEIF is_ybjk = 'tzsyd' THEN
			dw_ybjsmx.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_jsmx_tzsydzy'
		ELSEIF is_ybjk = 'lb' THEN
			dw_ybjsmx.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_jsmx_lszy'
		ELSEIF is_ybjk = 'tzsbd' THEN
			dw_ybjsmx.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_jsmx_tzsbdzy'			
			
		ELSE
			dw_ybjsmx.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_jsmx_zy'
		END IF
		dw_ybjsmx.SetTransObject( sqlca )
		dw_ybjsmx.Retrieve( il_zyh )
		if ii_bplx = 6 then
			dw_ybjsmx.setfilter("YWLX = 'ZY'")
			dw_ybjsmx.FILter( )
		end if
		st_2.Text = "住院结算明细(BQXT.ZY_ZYJS)"
		dw_mxdz.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_zyjsdz'
		dw_mxdz.SetTransObject( sqlca )
		dw_mxdz.Retrieve( il_zyh )
END CHOOSE

RETURN 1



end function

public subroutine wf_get_sql ();String ls_sql, ls_sql1, ls_sql2, ls_sql3, ls_sql4, ls_sql5
Integer li_pos1, li_pos2, li_pos3

//JKXT.YB_JSMX的SQL语句
IF ii_bplx = 32 Or ii_bplx = 6 THEN
	ls_sql = dw_ybjsmx.Object.DataWindow.Table.SELECT
	li_pos1 = Pos(ls_sql, ":an_zyh")
	ls_sql = Replace(ls_sql, li_pos1, 7, String(il_zyh))
ELSEIF ii_bplx = 31 Or ii_bplx = 4 Or ii_bplx = 5 or ii_bplx = 41 THEN
	ls_sql = dw_ybjsmx.Object.DataWindow.Table.SELECT
	li_pos1 = Pos(ls_sql, ":as_brbm")
	ls_sql = Replace(ls_sql, li_pos1, 8, "'" + is_brbm + "'")
	li_pos2 = Pos(ls_sql, ":adt_begin")
	ls_sql = Replace(ls_sql, li_pos2, 10, gf_dtinsql(idt_begin))
	li_pos3 = Pos(ls_sql, ":adt_end")
	ls_sql = Replace(ls_sql, li_pos3, 8, gf_dtinsql(idt_end))
END IF

//MZXT.MZ_FPK的SQL语句
IF ii_bplx = 1 Or ii_bplx = 4 or ii_bplx = 41 THEN
	ls_sql1 = dw_mxdz.Object.DataWindow.Table.SELECT
	li_pos1 = Pos(ls_sql1, ":as_brbm")
	ls_sql1 = Replace(ls_sql1, li_pos1, 8, "'" + is_brbm + "'")
	li_pos2 = Pos(ls_sql1, ":adt_begin")
	ls_sql1 = Replace(ls_sql1, li_pos2, 10, gf_dtinsql(idt_begin))
	li_pos3 = Pos(ls_sql1, ":adt_end")
	ls_sql1 = Replace(ls_sql1, li_pos3, 8, gf_dtinsql(idt_end))
END IF

//MZXT.MZ_GHXX的SQL语句
IF ii_bplx = 2 Or ii_bplx = 5 THEN
	ls_sql2 = dw_mxdz.Object.DataWindow.Table.SELECT
	li_pos1 = Pos(ls_sql2, ":as_brbm")
	ls_sql2 = Replace(ls_sql2, li_pos1, 8, "'" + is_brbm + "'")
	li_pos2 = Pos(ls_sql2, ":adt_begin")
	ls_sql2 = Replace(ls_sql2, li_pos2, 10, gf_dtinsql(idt_begin))
	li_pos3 = Pos(ls_sql2, ":adt_end")
	ls_sql2 = Replace(ls_sql2, li_pos3, 8, gf_dtinsql(idt_end))
END IF

//BQXT.ZY_ZYJS的SQL语句
IF ii_bplx = 6 THEN
	ls_sql3 = dw_mxdz.Object.DataWindow.Table.SELECT
	li_pos1 = Pos(ls_sql3, ":an_zyh")
	ls_sql3 = Replace(ls_sql3, li_pos1, 7, String(il_zyh))
END IF

//MZXT.H_MZ_ZHJYMX的SQL语句
IF ii_bplx = 1 Or ii_bplx = 2 THEN
	ls_sql4 = dw_zhjymx.Object.DataWindow.Table.SELECT
	li_pos1 = Pos(ls_sql4, ":as_brbm")
	ls_sql4 = Replace(ls_sql4, li_pos1, 8, "'" + is_brbm + "'")
	li_pos2 = Pos(ls_sql4, ":adt_begin")
	ls_sql4 = Replace(ls_sql4, li_pos2, 10, gf_dtinsql(idt_begin))
	li_pos3 = Pos(ls_sql4, ":adt_end")
	ls_sql4 = Replace(ls_sql4, li_pos3, 8, gf_dtinsql(idt_end))
END IF

//MZXT.H_FP_ZFFS的SQL语句
IF ii_bplx = 1 Or ii_bplx = 2 THEN
	ls_sql5 = dw_fpzffs.Object.DataWindow.Table.SELECT
	li_pos1 = Pos(ls_sql5, ":as_brbm")
	ls_sql5 = Replace(ls_sql5, li_pos1, 8, "'" + is_brbm + "'")
	li_pos2 = Pos(ls_sql5, ":adt_begin")
	ls_sql5 = Replace(ls_sql5, li_pos2, 10, gf_dtinsql(idt_begin))
	li_pos3 = Pos(ls_sql5, ":adt_end")
	ls_sql5 = Replace(ls_sql5, li_pos3, 8, gf_dtinsql(idt_end))
END IF

IF ls_sql <> "" And Not IsNull(ls_sql) THEN
	IF is_sql <> "" And Not IsNull(is_sql) THEN
		is_sql = is_sql + ls_sql + ";~n"
	ELSE
		is_sql = "~n" + ls_sql + ";~n"
	END IF
END IF

IF ls_sql1 <> "" And Not IsNull(ls_sql1) THEN
	IF is_sql <> "" And Not IsNull(is_sql) THEN
		is_sql = is_sql + ls_sql1 + ";~n"
	ELSE
		is_sql = "~n" + ls_sql1 + ";~n"
	END IF
END IF

IF ls_sql2 <> "" And Not IsNull(ls_sql2) THEN
	IF is_sql <> "" And Not IsNull(is_sql) THEN
		is_sql = is_sql + ls_sql2 + ";~n"
	ELSE
		is_sql = "~n" + ls_sql2 + ";~n"
	END IF
END IF

IF ls_sql3 <> "" And Not IsNull(ls_sql3) THEN
	IF is_sql <> "" And Not IsNull(is_sql) THEN
		is_sql = is_sql + ls_sql3 + ";~n"
	ELSE
		is_sql = "~n" + ls_sql3 + ";~n"
	END IF
END IF

IF ls_sql4 <> "" And Not IsNull(ls_sql4) THEN
	IF is_sql <> "" And Not IsNull(is_sql) THEN
		is_sql = is_sql + ls_sql4 + ";~n"
	ELSE
		is_sql = "~n" + ls_sql4 + ";~n"
	END IF
END IF

IF ls_sql5 <> "" And Not IsNull(ls_sql5) THEN
	IF is_sql <> "" And Not IsNull(is_sql) THEN
		is_sql = is_sql + ls_sql5 + ";~n"
	ELSE
		is_sql = "~n" + ls_sql5 + ";~n"
	END IF
END IF


end subroutine
