public subroutine wf_hdjy_bd ();String ls_jsjylsh,ls_ybfyze,ls_error1,ls_error2 ,ls_error3,ls_errortext,ls_error4,ls_jssj,ls_grbh
Dec{2} ld_fyze,ld_ybfyze,ld_jzje,ld_bxje
Long ll_jymx_count,ll_dzxx_count,ll_find,i,ll_jdrow
DateTime ldt_jssj
String ls_ztbz,ls_yxbz,ls_bxzje,ls_jzxlh
ls_error1 = '结算交易流水号：'
ls_error3 = '结算交易流水号：'
ls_error2 = ''
ls_error4 = ''
ls_errortext = ''
tab_1.tab_errortext.mle_1.Text = ''


//==========================
ll_jymx_count = tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.RowCount() //本地
ll_dzxx_count = tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.RowCount() //导入的社保明细

IF ll_jymx_count <= 0 THEN
	MessageBox('提示','请先统计交易明细')
	RETURN
END IF
IF ll_dzxx_count <= 0 THEN
	MessageBox('提示','请先下载交易明细，并检查是否已正确导入')
	RETURN
END IF
tab_1.tab_mzjd.dw_mzjd.dataobject = 'd_pyyb_zxmx'
tab_1.tab_mzjd.dw_mzjd.settransobject( sqlca)
FOR i = 1 To ll_jymx_count
	ls_jsjylsh = tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.Object.qrjylsh[i]
	ld_fyze = tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.Object.fyze[i]
	ld_jzje = tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.Object.hjbxje[i]
	ls_jzxlh = tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.Object.jzxlh[i]
	ll_find = tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Find("jslsh='"+ls_jsjylsh+"'",1,ll_dzxx_count)
	IF ll_find > 0 THEN
		ls_ybfyze = tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.zfy[ll_find]
		ls_bxzje = tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.bxzje[ll_find]
		ld_bxje = Dec(ls_bxzje)
		ld_ybfyze = Dec(ls_ybfyze)
		IF ld_fyze <> ld_ybfyze Or  ld_jzje <> ld_bxje THEN
			ls_error2 += ls_jsjylsh + ':本地费用总额:'+String(ld_fyze,'###.00')+'   中心费用总额：'+String(ld_ybfyze,'###.00')+'~n'
			ls_error2 += ':本地报销总额:'+String(ld_jzje,'###.00')+'   中心报销总额：'+String(ld_bxje,'###.00')+'~n'
		END IF
	ELSE
		//本地有,中心没有的
		ll_jdrow = tab_1.tab_jywx.dw_2.InsertRow( 0)
		tab_1.tab_jywx.dw_2.Object.ywlx[ll_jdrow] = tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.Object.ywlx[i]
		tab_1.tab_jywx.dw_2.Object.jslsh[ll_jdrow] = ls_jsjylsh
		tab_1.tab_jywx.dw_2.Object.jzxlh[ll_jdrow] = ls_jzxlh
		tab_1.tab_jywx.dw_2.Object.ztbz[ll_jdrow] = tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.Object.ztbz[i]
		ls_error1 = ls_error1 + " or ( jsjylsh='"+ls_jsjylsh +"' and jzxlh = '" +ls_jzxlh+ "')~t"
	END IF
NEXT

IF ls_error1 <> '结算交易流水号：' THEN
	MessageBox('本地有而中心没有的数据',ls_error1)
END IF

MessageBox('社保笔数：'+String(ll_dzxx_count),'本地有效笔数：'+String(ll_jymx_count))
String ls_brbm,ls_jylx,ls_cbd
FOR i = 1 To ll_dzxx_count
	ls_jsjylsh = tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.jslsh[i]
	ls_ybfyze = tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.zfy[i]
	ls_bxzje = tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.bxzje[i]
	ls_jssj =  tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.jssj[i]
	ldt_jssj = DateTime(Date(Long(Mid(ls_jssj,1,4)),Long(Mid(ls_jssj,5,2)),Long(Mid(ls_jssj,7,2))),Time(Mid(ls_jssj,8,10)))
	ls_grbh =  tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.grbh[i]
	ls_brbm = ls_grbh
	ls_jylx = tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.bxlx[i]
	ld_ybfyze = Dec(ls_ybfyze)
	ld_bxje = Dec(ls_bxzje)
	//	if ld_ybfyze < 0 then continue
	ll_find = tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.Find("qrjylsh='"+ls_jsjylsh+"'",1,ll_jymx_count)
	IF ll_find <= 0 THEN
		IF tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.RowCount() > 0 THEN
			ll_find = tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.Find("qrjylsh='"+ls_jsjylsh+"'",1,tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.RowCount())
			//对于交易明细和改帐信息中都没有的中心交易作改帐处理
			IF ll_find <= 0 THEN
				tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.RowsCopy( i, i, Primary!, tab_1.tab_mzjd.dw_mzjd, 1, Primary!)
				ls_error3 = ls_error3 + "qrjylsh='"+ls_jsjylsh+"'" +'~t' + "费用总额:" + ls_ybfyze +'~t'
			ELSE
				IF ld_ybfyze <> Dec(tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.Object.fyze[ll_find]) Or ld_bxje <>  Dec(tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.Object.hjbxje[ll_find]) THEN
					MessageBox('总额不一致' , ls_jsjylsh + "社保:" + ls_ybfyze + "本地:" + String(tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.Object.fyze[ll_find]) & 						+ "社保:" + String(ld_bxje) +"本地" + String(tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.Object.hjbxje[ll_find]))
				END IF
			END IF
		ELSE
			tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.RowsCopy( i, i, Primary!, tab_1.tab_mzjd.dw_mzjd, 1, Primary!)
			ls_error3 = ls_error3 + "qrjylsh='"+ls_jsjylsh+"'" +'~t' + "费用总额:" + ls_ybfyze +'~t'
		END IF
	END IF
NEXT

IF ls_error1 <> '结算交易流水号：' THEN ls_errortext += '本地有而中心没有的数据' + '~t' + ls_error1 + '~t'
IF ls_error3 <> '结算交易流水号：' THEN ls_errortext += '本地没有而中心有的数据' + '~t' + ls_error3 + '~t'
IF ls_error2 <> '' THEN
	ls_errortext += '本地与中心有出入的有：' + '~t' +  ls_error2
	MessageBox('提示',ls_errortext)
END IF
tab_1.tab_errortext.mle_1.Text = ls_errortext
tab_1.SelectTab(6)
IF tab_1.tab_errortext.mle_1.Text = '' THEN
	tab_1.tab_errortext.mle_1.Text = '祝贺你此次对帐顺利通过，哈哈 请客！'
	MessageBox('提示','对帐已通过')
END IF
tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.Retrieve(idt_begin,idt_end)


end subroutine

public subroutine wf_ini (integer ai_ywlx);IF ai_ywlx = 1 THEN
	IF is_yybz = 'TZFBY' THEN
		IF Date(idt_begin) >= Date(2021,8,9) THEN
			dw_1.DataObject = 'd_tzyb_dzxx_sbd'
			tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.DataObject = 'd_tzyb_jsmx_sbd_dz'
			tab_1.tab_dzxx.dw_dzxx.DataObject = 'd_tzyb_dzxx_sbd_list'
			tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.DataObject = 'd_tzyb_gzxx_sbd'
		ELSE
			dw_1.DataObject = 'd_tzyb_dzxx'
			tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.DataObject = 'd_tzyb_jsmx'
			tab_1.tab_dzxx.dw_dzxx.DataObject = 'd_tzyb_dzxx_list'
			tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.DataObject = 'd_pyyb_gzxx'
		END IF
	ELSE
		dw_1.DataObject = 'd_pyyb_dzxx'
		tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.DataObject = 'd_pyyb_jsmx'
		tab_1.tab_dzxx.dw_dzxx.DataObject = 'd_pyyb_dzxx_list'
		tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.DataObject = 'd_pyyb_gzxx'
	END IF
ELSEIF ai_ywlx = 2 THEN
	IF is_yybz = 'TZFBY' THEN
		dw_1.DataObject = 'd_tzyb_dzxx_syd'
		tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.DataObject = 'd_tzyb_jsmx_syd2'
		tab_1.tab_dzxx.dw_dzxx.DataObject = 'd_tzyb_dzxx_syd_list'
		tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.DataObject = 'd_tzyb_gzxx_syd'
	ELSE
		dw_1.DataObject = 'd_yb_dzxx'
		tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.DataObject = 'd_yb_jsmx'
		tab_1.tab_dzxx.dw_dzxx.DataObject = 'd_yb_dzxx_list'
		tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.DataObject = 'd_yb_gzxx'
	END IF
END IF
dw_1.SetTransObject( sqlca)
tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.SetTransObject(sqlca)
tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.SetTransObject(sqlca)
tab_1.tab_dzxx.dw_dzxx.SetTransObject(sqlca)
dw_1.InsertRow(0)





end subroutine

public subroutine wf_delrep (string as_ywlb, datetime adt_begin, datetime adt_end);u_datastore luds_del
luds_del = Create u_datastore
IF as_ywlb = '1' THEN
	luds_del.DataObject = 'd_jsjylsh_pydel'
ELSEIF as_ywlb = '2' THEN
	luds_del.DataObject = 'd_jsjylsh_del'
END IF
luds_del.SetTransObject(SQLCA)
luds_del.Retrieve(adt_begin, adt_end)

Long ll_rowcount,ll_zyh,ll_cur
String ls_brbm,ls_jsjylsh,ls_mxzdh
ll_rowcount = luds_del.RowCount()
IF ll_rowcount > 0 THEN
	IF as_ywlb = '2' THEN
		ls_brbm = luds_del.Object.brbm[1]
		ll_zyh = luds_del.Object.zyh[1]
		ls_jsjylsh = luds_del.Object.jsjylsh[1]
		ls_mxzdh = luds_del.Object.mxzdh[1]
		
		FOR ll_cur = 2 To ll_rowcount
			IF ll_zyh = 0 THEN
				IF ls_brbm = luds_del.Object.brbm[ll_cur] And ls_jsjylsh = luds_del.Object.jsjylsh[ll_cur] THEN
					luds_del.Object.ztbz[ll_cur] = -8
				ELSE
					ls_brbm = luds_del.Object.brbm[ll_cur]
					ls_jsjylsh = luds_del.Object.jsjylsh[ll_cur]
					ls_mxzdh = luds_del.Object.mxzdh[ll_cur]
					ll_zyh = luds_del.Object.zyh[ll_cur]
					CONTINUE
				END IF
			ELSE
				IF ll_zyh = luds_del.Object.zyh[ll_cur] And ls_jsjylsh = luds_del.Object.jsjylsh[ll_cur] THEN
					luds_del.Object.ztbz[ll_cur] = -8
				ELSE
					ls_brbm = luds_del.Object.brbm[ll_cur]
					ls_jsjylsh = luds_del.Object.jsjylsh[ll_cur]
					ls_mxzdh = luds_del.Object.mxzdh[ll_cur]
					ll_zyh = luds_del.Object.zyh[ll_cur]
					CONTINUE
				END IF
			END IF
		NEXT
	ELSE
		ls_brbm = luds_del.Object.brbm[1]
		ll_zyh = luds_del.Object.zyh[1]
		ls_jsjylsh = luds_del.Object.qrjylsh[1]

		FOR ll_cur = 2 To ll_rowcount
			IF ll_zyh = 0 THEN
				IF ls_brbm = luds_del.Object.brbm[ll_cur] And ls_jsjylsh = luds_del.Object.qrjylsh[ll_cur] THEN
					luds_del.Object.ztbz[ll_cur] = -8
				ELSE
					ls_brbm = luds_del.Object.brbm[ll_cur]
					ls_jsjylsh = luds_del.Object.qrjylsh[ll_cur]
					ll_zyh = luds_del.Object.zyh[ll_cur]
					CONTINUE
				END IF
			ELSE
				IF ll_zyh = luds_del.Object.zyh[ll_cur] And ls_jsjylsh = luds_del.Object.qrjylsh[ll_cur] THEN
					luds_del.Object.ztbz[ll_cur] = -8
				ELSE
					ls_brbm = luds_del.Object.brbm[ll_cur]
					ls_jsjylsh = luds_del.Object.qrjylsh[ll_cur]
//					ls_mxzdh = luds_del.Object.mxzdh[ll_cur]
					ll_zyh = luds_del.Object.zyh[ll_cur]
					CONTINUE
				END IF
			END IF
		NEXT
	END IF
//	luds_del.SetFilter( 'ztbz = -8')
//	luds_del.Filter( )
//	luds_del.SetFilter( '')
//	luds_del.Filter( )
	
	gf_begin_transaction(sqlca)
	IF luds_del.Update( ) = 1 THEN
		gf_commit_transaction(sqlca)
//		MessageBox('提示','保存成功!')
	ELSE
		gf_rollback_transaction(sqlca)
		MessageBox('提示','del失败')
	END IF
END IF
end subroutine

public subroutine wf_insert_dzxx (datetime adt_begin, datetime adt_end, string as_dzr);Decimal	ld_ylfyze,ld_zfze,ld_zlze,ld_xjzf,ld_jjzfze,ld_dnzhze,ld_lnzhze,ld_gbze,ld_tcze,ld_jzze,	ld_bzze
Decimal	ld_lxze,ld_eyze,ld_lmze1,ld_lmze2,ld_jmze1,ld_jmze2,ld_dxsze,ld_wcnze ,ld_xnhze,ld_qtjjze
Dec{2} ld_ybfy,ld_zyzf,ld_qfx,ld_GRZFXJZF,ld_GRZF_XJZF,ld_dbbz,ld_qtjj1,ld_qtjj2,ld_qtjj3
Integer li_row
FOR li_row = 1 To dw_1.RowCount( )
	CHOOSE CASE li_row
		CASE 1
			//门诊
			IF is_yybz = 'TZFBY' THEN

					SUM(NVL(GRZF_XJZF,0)),SUM(NVL(HJXJZF,0)),SUM(NVL(HJBXJE,0)),SUM(NVL(LNZHZF,0)),SUM(NVL(DNZHZF,0)),  SUM(NVL(TCJJZF,0)),
					SUM(NVL(DBBZZF ,0)),SUM(NVL(GWYBZZF,0)) ,SUM(NVL(LXJJZF,0)),SUM(NVL(EYJJZF,0)),SUM(nvl(LMYLBZZF,0)),SUM(NVL(JMJJZF,0)),SUM(NVL(DXSJJZF,0)),
					SUM(NVL(WCNRJJZF,0)),SUM(NVL(XNHJJZF,0)),SUM(NVL(QTJJZF,0)),SUM(NVL(QTZFS1,0)),SUM(NVL(QTZFS2,0)),SUM(NVL(QTZFS3,0)),SUM(NVL(BZJJZF,0))
					INTO :ld_ylfyze,:ld_zfze,:ld_zlze,:ld_ybfy,:ld_zyzf,:ld_qfx,:ld_GRZFXJZF,

					:ld_dbbz,:ld_gbze,:ld_lxze,:ld_eyze,:ld_lmze1,:ld_jmze1,:ld_dxsze,
					:ld_wcnze,:ld_xnhze ,:ld_qtjjze,:ld_qtjj1,:ld_qtjj2,:ld_qtjj3,:ld_bzze
					From JKXT.PYYB_JSMX Where JSSJ >= :adt_begin And JSSJ < :adt_end And ZTBZ > 0 And QRJYLSH Is Not Null And ywlx <> 'ZY' And cbrlb < '39';
			ELSE

					SUM(NVL(DBBZZF ,0)),SUM(NVL(GWYBZZF,0)) ,SUM(NVL(LXJJZF,0)),SUM(NVL(EYJJZF,0)),SUM(nvl(LMYLBZZF,0)),SUM(NVL(JMJJZF,0)),SUM(NVL(DXSJJZF,0)),
					SUM(NVL(WCNRJJZF,0)),SUM(NVL(XNHJJZF,0)),SUM(NVL(QTJJZF,0)),SUM(NVL(QTZFS1,0)),SUM(NVL(QTZFS2,0)),SUM(NVL(QTZFS3,0)),SUM(NVL(BZJJZF,0))
					INTO :ld_ylfyze,:ld_zfze,:ld_zlze,:ld_ybfy,:ld_zyzf,:ld_qfx,:ld_GRZFXJZF,
					:ld_GRZF_XJZF,:ld_xjzf,:ld_jjzfze,:ld_lnzhze,:ld_dnzhze,:ld_tcze,
					:ld_dbbz,:ld_gbze,:ld_lxze,:ld_eyze,:ld_lmze1,:ld_jmze1,:ld_dxsze,
					:ld_wcnze,:ld_xnhze ,:ld_qtjjze,:ld_qtjj1,:ld_qtjj2,:ld_qtjj3,:ld_bzze
					From JKXT.PYYB_JSMX Where JSSJ >= :adt_begin And JSSJ < :adt_end And ZTBZ > 0 And QRJYLSH Is Not Null And ywlx <> 'ZY';
			END IF
		CASE 2
			//住院
			IF is_yybz = 'TZFBY' THEN
				SELECT SUM(NVL(FYZE,0)),SUM(NVL(ZFZE,0)),SUM(NVL(ZLZE,0)),SUM(NVL(YBFY,0)),SUM(NVL(ZYZF,0)),SUM(NVL(QFX ,0)),SUM(NVL(GRZFXJZF,0)),
					SUM(NVL(GRZF_XJZF,0)),SUM(NVL(HJXJZF,0)),SUM(NVL(HJBXJE,0)),SUM(NVL(LNZHZF,0)),SUM(NVL(DNZHZF,0)),  SUM(NVL(TCJJZF,0)),

			ELSE

					:ld_wcnze,:ld_xnhze ,:ld_qtjjze,:ld_qtjj1,:ld_qtjj2,:ld_qtjj3,:ld_bzze
					From JKXT.PYYB_JSMX Where JSSJ >= :adt_begin And JSSJ < :adt_end And ZTBZ > 0 And QRJYLSH Is Not Null And ywlx = 'ZY';
			END IF

			//台州门诊-城乡
			SELECT SUM(NVL(FYZE,0)),SUM(NVL(ZFZE,0)),SUM(NVL(ZLZE,0)),SUM(NVL(YBFY,0)),SUM(NVL(ZYZF,0)),SUM(NVL(QFX ,0)),SUM(NVL(GRZFXJZF,0)),
				SUM(NVL(GRZF_XJZF,0)),SUM(NVL(HJXJZF,0)),SUM(NVL(HJBXJE,0)),SUM(NVL(LNZHZF,0)),SUM(NVL(DNZHZF,0)),  SUM(NVL(TCJJZF,0)),
				SUM(NVL(DBBZZF ,0)),SUM(NVL(GWYBZZF,0)) ,SUM(NVL(LXJJZF,0)),SUM(NVL(EYJJZF,0)),SUM(nvl(LMYLBZZF,0)),SUM(NVL(JMJJZF,0)),SUM(NVL(DXSJJZF,0)),
				SUM(NVL(WCNRJJZF,0)),SUM(NVL(XNHJJZF,0)),SUM(NVL(QTJJZF,0)),SUM(NVL(QTZFS1,0)),SUM(NVL(QTZFS2,0)),SUM(NVL(QTZFS3,0)),SUM(NVL(BZJJZF,0))
				INTO :ld_ylfyze,:ld_zfze,:ld_zlze,:ld_ybfy,:ld_zyzf,:ld_qfx,:ld_GRZFXJZF,
				:ld_GRZF_XJZF,:ld_xjzf,:ld_jjzfze,:ld_lnzhze,:ld_dnzhze,:ld_tcze,
				:ld_dbbz,:ld_gbze,:ld_lxze,:ld_eyze,:ld_lmze1,:ld_jmze1,:ld_dxsze,
				:ld_wcnze,:ld_xnhze ,:ld_qtjjze,:ld_qtjj1,:ld_qtjj2,:ld_qtjj3,:ld_bzze
				From JKXT.PYYB_JSMX Where JSSJ >= :adt_begin And JSSJ < :adt_end And ZTBZ > 0 And QRJYLSH Is Not Null And ywlx <> 'ZY' And cbrlb > '39';
		CASE 4
			//台州门诊-城乡
			SELECT SUM(NVL(FYZE,0)),SUM(NVL(ZFZE,0)),SUM(NVL(ZLZE,0)),SUM(NVL(YBFY,0)),SUM(NVL(ZYZF,0)),SUM(NVL(QFX ,0)),SUM(NVL(GRZFXJZF,0)),
				SUM(NVL(GRZF_XJZF,0)),SUM(NVL(HJXJZF,0)),SUM(NVL(HJBXJE,0)),SUM(NVL(LNZHZF,0)),SUM(NVL(DNZHZF,0)),  SUM(NVL(TCJJZF,0)),
				SUM(NVL(DBBZZF ,0)),SUM(NVL(GWYBZZF,0)) ,SUM(NVL(LXJJZF,0)),SUM(NVL(EYJJZF,0)),SUM(nvl(LMYLBZZF,0)),SUM(NVL(JMJJZF,0)),SUM(NVL(DXSJJZF,0)),
				SUM(NVL(WCNRJJZF,0)),SUM(NVL(XNHJJZF,0)),SUM(NVL(QTJJZF,0)),SUM(NVL(QTZFS1,0)),SUM(NVL(QTZFS2,0)),SUM(NVL(QTZFS3,0)),SUM(NVL(BZJJZF,0))
				INTO :ld_ylfyze,:ld_zfze,:ld_zlze,:ld_ybfy,:ld_zyzf,:ld_qfx,:ld_GRZFXJZF,
				:ld_GRZF_XJZF,:ld_xjzf,:ld_jjzfze,:ld_lnzhze,:ld_dnzhze,:ld_tcze,
				:ld_dbbz,:ld_gbze,:ld_lxze,:ld_eyze,:ld_lmze1,:ld_jmze1,:ld_dxsze,
				:ld_wcnze,:ld_xnhze ,:ld_qtjjze,:ld_qtjj1,:ld_qtjj2,:ld_qtjj3,:ld_bzze
				From JKXT.PYYB_JSMX Where JSSJ >= :adt_begin And JSSJ < :adt_end And ZTBZ > 0 And QRJYLSH Is Not Null And ywlx = 'ZY' And cbrlb > '39';
		CASE ELSE
			//
	END CHOOSE
	
	IF IsNull(ld_ylfyze) THEN ld_ylfyze = 0
	IF IsNull(ld_zfze) THEN ld_zfze = 0
	IF IsNull(ld_zlze) THEN ld_zlze = 0
	IF IsNull(ld_ybfy) THEN ld_ybfy = 0
	IF IsNull(ld_zyzf) THEN ld_zyzf = 0
	IF IsNull(ld_qfx) THEN ld_qfx = 0
	IF IsNull(ld_GRZFXJZF) THEN ld_GRZFXJZF = 0
	IF IsNull(ld_GRZF_XJZF)  THEN ld_GRZF_XJZF = 0

	IF gu_tzybjk.uf_send( as_return) = False THEN

			gf_waiting('正在导入明细...',ll_cur / ll_jymxts * 100)

			//				2	报销类型	string	3	是

end function

event ue_zxdz();String ls_dzr,ls_dzlx
Long ll_count
ll_count = 0
ls_dzr = String(idt_begin,'yyyymmdd')
ls_dzlx = ddlb_ywlx.getcode( )
IF ls_dzlx = '1' THEN
	MessageBox('提示',ddlb_ywlx.Text + '，无需中心对账！')
	RETURN
ELSEIF ls_dzlx = '-1' OR  ls_dzlx = '-2' THEN
	MessageBox('提示',ddlb_ywlx.Text + '，仅限下载明细，无需对账！')
	RETURN
END IF
IF gu_ybjk_public.is_ybkfs = 'WD' THEN
	SELECT count(1) Into :ll_count From JKXT.YB_DZXX   Where YB_DZXX.dzr = :ls_dzr And YB_DZXX.ywlx = 1 ;
ELSEIF gu_ybjk_public.is_ybkfs = 'EP' Or gu_ybjk_public.is_ybkfs = 'EPTZ' THEN
	IF gu_ybjk_public.is_ybkfs = 'EPTZ' And ls_dzr >= '20210809' THEN
		SELECT count(1) Into :ll_count From JKXT.TZYB_DZXX_SBD  Where to_char(DZRQ,'yyyymmdd') = :ls_dzr and   DZLX = '2'	;
	ELSE
		SELECT count(1) Into :ll_count From JKXT.PYYB_DZXX  Where dzr = :ls_dzr ;
	END IF
ELSEIF gu_ybjk_public.is_ybkfs = 'LB' THEN
	SELECT count(1) Into :ll_count From JKXT.LSYB_DZXX  Where to_char(dzr,'yyyymmdd') = :ls_dzr ;
END IF
IF ll_count = 0 THEN
	MessageBox('提示','请先本地对账!')
	RETURN
END IF

IF tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.RowCount() < 0 THEN
	MessageBox('提示','请先下载明细，再对账')
	RETURN
END IF
String ls_mess
IF gu_ybjk_public.iu_sybjk_his.uf_yljg_rdz( Date(idt_begin), ls_dzlx, ls_mess) < 0 THEN
	MessageBox('提示',ls_mess)
END IF
//if ls_dzlx = '0' or ls_dzlx = '2' then
//else
	dw_1.Retrieve( Date(idt_begin),-1,ls_dzlx )
//end if


end event

event ue_hdjy();String ls_jsjylsh,ls_error1,ls_error2 ,ls_error3,ls_errortext,ls_error4,ls_jslsh //,ls_jssj,ls_ybfyze
String ls_dzlx
Dec{2} ld_fyze,ld_ybfyze,ld_bxje,ld_ybbxje,ld_grxjje,ld_ybgrxjje
Long ll_jymx_count,ll_dzxx_count,ll_find,i,ll_insert
//DateTime ldt_jssj
String ls_ztbz
ls_error1 = '结算交易流水号：'
ls_error3 = '结算交易流水号：'
ls_error2 = ''
ls_error4 = ''
ls_errortext = ''
tab_1.tab_errortext.mle_1.Text = ''
tab_1.tab_mzjd.dw_mzjd.Reset( )
ll_jymx_count = tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.RowCount() //本地
ll_dzxx_count = tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.RowCount() //导入的社保明细

ls_dzlx = ddlb_ywlx.getcode( )

//IF (ls_dzlx = '-1' OR ls_dzlx = '-2') AND base_info.userid <> '209134' THEN
//	MessageBox('提示','月结算数据无法核对')
//	RETURN
//END IF
IF ll_jymx_count <= 0 THEN
	MessageBox('提示','请先统计交易明细')
	RETURN
END IF
IF ll_dzxx_count <= 0 THEN
	MessageBox('提示','请先下载交易明细，并检查是否已正确导入')
	RETURN
END IF
IF ls_dzlx = '1' THEN
	FOR i = 1 To ll_jymx_count
		ls_jsjylsh = tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.Object.jsjylsh[i]
		ld_fyze = tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.Object.ylfyze[i]
		ld_bxje = tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.Object.hjzf[i]
		ld_grxjje = tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.Object.grxj[i]
		ll_find = tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Find("jsjylsh='"+ls_jsjylsh+"' ",1,ll_dzxx_count)
		IF ll_find > 0 THEN
			ld_ybfyze = tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.ylfyze[ll_find]
			ld_ybbxje = tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.bxje[ll_find]
			ld_ybgrxjje = tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.grxjzf[ll_find]
			//		ld_ybfyze = Dec(ls_ybfyze)
			IF ld_fyze <> ld_ybfyze THEN
				ls_error2 += ls_jsjylsh + ':本地费用总额:'+String(ld_fyze,'###.00')+'   中心费用总额：'+String(ld_ybfyze,'###.00')+'~n'
			END IF
			IF ld_bxje <> ld_ybbxje THEN
				ls_error2 += ls_jsjylsh + ':本地报销金额:'+String(ld_bxje,'###.00')+'   中心报销金额：'+String(ld_ybbxje,'###.00')+'~n'
			END IF
			IF ld_grxjje <> ld_ybgrxjje THEN
				ls_error2 += ls_jsjylsh + ':本地个人现金支付:'+String(ld_grxjje,'###.00')+'   中心个人现金支付：'+String(ld_ybgrxjje,'###.00')+'~n'
			END IF
		ELSE
			//本地有,中心没有的
			ls_error1 = ls_error1 + "jsjylsh='"+ls_jsjylsh +"'~t"
		END IF
	NEXT
	
	IF ls_error1 <> '结算交易流水号：' THEN
		MessageBox('本地有而中心没有的数据',ls_error1)
	END IF
	
	MessageBox('社保笔数：'+String(ll_dzxx_count),'本地有效笔数：'+String(ll_jymx_count))
ELSE
	FOR i = 1 To ll_jymx_count
		ls_jsjylsh = tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.Object.jylsh[i]
		ld_fyze = tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.Object.fyze[i]
		ls_jslsh = tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.Object.jslsh[i]
		IF ls_dzlx = '-1' OR ls_dzlx = '-2' THEN
			ll_find = tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Find("cbdjslsh='"+ls_jslsh+"'",1,ll_dzxx_count)
		ELSE
			ll_find = tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Find("jsjylsh='"+ls_jsjylsh+"'",1,ll_dzxx_count)
		END IF
		IF ll_find > 0 THEN
			ld_ybfyze = tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.ylfyze[ll_find]
			//		ld_ybfyze = Dec(ls_ybfyze)
			IF ld_fyze <> ld_ybfyze THEN
				ls_error2 += ls_jsjylsh + ':本地费用总额:'+String(ld_fyze,'###.00')+'   中心费用总额：'+String(ld_ybfyze,'###.00')+'~n'
			END IF
			IF ls_jslsh <> tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.cbdjslsh[ll_find] THEN
				ls_error2 += ls_jsjylsh + ':本地jslsh:'+ls_jslsh+'   参保地jslsh：'+String(tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.cbdjslsh[ll_find])+'~n'
			END IF
		ELSE
			//本地有,中心没有的
			IF ls_dzlx = '-1' OR ls_dzlx = '-2' THEN
				ls_error1 = ls_error1 + "jsLsh='"+ls_jslsh +"'~t"
				ll_insert = tab_1.tab_mzjd.dw_mzjd.insertrow( 0)
				tab_1.tab_mzjd.dw_mzjd.object.jsjylsh[ll_insert] = tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.Object.jylsh[i]
				tab_1.tab_mzjd.dw_mzjd.object.ylfyze[ll_insert] = ld_fyze
				tab_1.tab_mzjd.dw_mzjd.object.bxje[ll_insert] = tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.Object.hjbxje[i]
				tab_1.tab_mzjd.dw_mzjd.object.jysj[ll_insert] = string(tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.Object.jssj[i],'yyyymmdd hh:mm:ss')
				tab_1.tab_mzjd.dw_mzjd.object.cbdxzqhdm[ll_insert] = tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.Object.cbdxzqh[i]
				tab_1.tab_mzjd.dw_mzjd.object.cbdjslsh[ll_insert] = ls_jslsh
				if string(tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.Object.jssj[i],'yyyymm') <> string(idt_begin,'yyyymm')  then
					tab_1.tab_mzjd.dw_mzjd.object.jylx[ll_insert] = '-1'
				else
					tab_1.tab_mzjd.dw_mzjd.object.jylx[ll_insert] = '0'
				end if
				tab_1.tab_mzjd.dw_mzjd.object.xlh[ll_insert] = tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.Object.jyid[i]
				
			ELSE
				ls_error1 = ls_error1 + "jsjylsh='"+ls_jsjylsh +"'~t"
			END IF
		END IF
	NEXT	
	IF ls_error1 <> '结算交易流水号：' THEN
		MessageBox('本地有而中心没有的数据',ls_error1)
	END IF
	
	MessageBox('社保笔数：'+String(ll_dzxx_count),'本地有效笔数：'+String(ll_jymx_count))
	//String ls_brbm,ls_jylx,ls_cbd
	FOR i = 1 To ll_dzxx_count
		ls_jsjylsh = tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.jsjylsh[i]
		ld_ybfyze = tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.ylfyze[i]
		ls_jslsh = tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.cbdjslsh[i]
		IF ls_dzlx = '-1' OR ls_dzlx = '-2' THEN
			ll_find = tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.Find("jslsh='"+ls_jslsh+"'",1,ll_jymx_count)
		ELSE
			ll_find = tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.Find("jylsh='"+ls_jsjylsh+"'",1,ll_jymx_count)
		END IF
		IF ll_find <= 0 THEN
			
			IF ls_dzlx = '-1' OR ls_dzlx = '-2' THEN
				ll_find = tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.Find("jslsh='"+ls_jslsh+"'",1,tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.RowCount())
			ELSE
				ll_find = tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.Find("jylsh='"+ls_jsjylsh+"'",1,tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.RowCount())
			END IF
			//对于交易明细和改帐信息中都没有的中心交易作改帐处理
			IF ll_find <= 0 THEN
				tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.RowsCopy( i, i, Primary!, tab_1.tab_mzjd.dw_mzjd, 1, Primary!)
				
				if left(string(tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.object.jysj[i]),6) <> string(idt_begin,'yyyymm')  then
					tab_1.tab_mzjd.dw_mzjd.object.jylx[1] = '-1'
				end if
				ls_error3 = ls_error3 + "jslsh='"+ls_jslsh+"'" +'~t' + "费用总额:" + String(ld_ybfyze) +'~t'
			ELSE
				IF ld_ybfyze <> Dec(tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.Object.fyze[ll_find]) THEN
					MessageBox('总额不一致' , ls_jslsh + "社保:" + String(ld_ybfyze) + "本地:" + String(tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.Object.fyze[ll_find]))
				END IF
			END IF
		END IF
	NEXT
END IF
IF ls_error1 <> '结算交易流水号：' THEN ls_errortext += '本地有而中心没有的数据' + '~t' + ls_error1 + '~t'
IF ls_error3 <> '结算交易流水号：' THEN ls_errortext += '本地没有而中心有的数据' + '~t' + ls_error3 + '~t'
IF ls_error2 <> '' THEN
	ls_errortext += '本地与中心有出入的有：' + '~t' +  ls_error2

	MessageBox('提示','对帐已通过')
END IF

end event

				ls_jysj = String(gu_ybjk_public.iu_sybjk_his.uf_getdatetime_in( "就诊结算时间",ll_cur),'yyyymmdd hh:mm:ss')
				//			ldc_fyze = gu_ybjk_public.iu_sybjk_his.uf_getdecimal_in( "医疗费用总额",ll_cur)
				ll_insert = tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.InsertRow( 0)
				tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.jsjylsh[ll_insert] = ls_jsjylshm
				tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.cbdjslsh[ll_insert] = ls_cbdjslsh
				tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.cbdxzqhdm[ll_insert] = ls_cbd
				tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.jylx[ll_insert] = ls_jylx
				tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.xlh[ll_insert] = gu_ybjk_public.iu_sybjk_his.uf_getstring_in( "就诊序列号",ll_cur)
				tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.jysj[ll_insert] = ls_jysj
				tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.ylfyze[ll_insert] = gu_ybjk_public.iu_sybjk_his.uf_getdecimal_in( "费用总额",ll_cur)
				tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.bxje[ll_insert] = gu_ybjk_public.iu_sybjk_his.uf_getdecimal_in( "报销金额",ll_cur) //14	报销金额
				ld_fyze = ld_fyze + tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.ylfyze[ll_insert] //gu_ybjk_public.iu_sybjk_his.uf_getdecimal_in( "医疗费用总额",ll_cur)
				ldc_bxje = ldc_bxje +  tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.bxje[ll_insert] //gu_ybjk_public.iu_sybjk_his.uf_getdecimal_in( "报销金额",ll_cur)
				ldc_xjje = ldc_xjje + (ld_fyze - ldc_bxje)
			NEXT
			gf_waiting('正在导入明细...',-1)
		ELSE
			MessageBox("提示",ls_return)
			RETURN
		END IF
	LOOP
END IF
w_sbdz_syd.SetRedraw(True)
IF ls_dzlx <> '-1'  And ls_dzlx <> '-2' THEN
	tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.zxjje.Text = String(ldc_xjje)
	tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.zfy.Text = String(ld_fyze)
	tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.zbxje.Text = String(ldc_bxje)
end if
tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.SaveAs( "C:\SB\download\syd"+ls_dzr+String(ddlb_ywlx.Text) + ".txt", Text! ,True)

IF tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.RowCount()  = 0  THEN
	ls_return = gu_ybjk_public.iu_sybjk_his.uf_getstring("错误信息")
	MessageBox("提示",ls_return)
ELSE
	MessageBox("提示",'下载成功!')
END IF





end event

event ue_bptz();String ls_jsjylsh, ls_tsxx
ls_tsxx = "请输入本地有而医保中心的明细中没有的结算交易流水号~n" +&
	"（提示：该功能只进行本地有而中心没有的明细调整，本地没有而医保中心有的明细【门诊校对】双击具体明细。）"
ls_jsjylsh = Trim(gf_inputbox(ls_tsxx, ""))

IF ls_jsjylsh = '-1' Or ls_jsjylsh = "" THEN
	RETURN
END IF

DateTime ldt_begin
ldt_begin = DateTime(RelativeDate(Date(idt_begin), -1), Time("00:00:00"))

String ls_brbm, ls_ywlx
Long ll_zyh
DateTime ldt_jysj

String ls_sql
ls_sql = "SELECT brbm, ywlx,zyh,jssj From jkxt.yb_jsmx Where jssj >= " + gf_dtinsql(ldt_begin) + " And jsjylsh = '" + ls_jsjylsh + "' And ztbz > 0 Order By jssj Desc "
u_datastore lds_brxx
lds_brxx = Create u_datastore
IF lds_brxx.createfromsql(ls_sql) < 0 THEN
	MessageBox("提示", "创建'病人信息查询'对象失败。")
	
RETURN
END IF
lds_brxx.SetTransObject(sqlca)
IF lds_brxx.Retrieve() <= 0 THEN
	MessageBox("提示", "该结算交易流水号没找到对应的病人信息")
	RETURN
ELSE
	ls_brbm = lds_brxx.Object.brbm[1]
	ls_ywlx = lds_brxx.Object.ywlx[1]
	ll_zyh = lds_brxx.Object.zyh[1]
	IF Trim(Upper(ls_ywlx)) = 'SF' Or ls_ywlx = '' THEN
		ii_bplx = 4
	ELSEIF Trim(Upper(ls_ywlx)) = 'GH' THEN
		ii_bplx = 5
	ELSEIF Trim(Upper(ls_ywlx)) = 'ZY' THEN
		ii_bplx = 6
	END IF
	
	s_exchange ls_exchange
	ls_exchange.LongParm[1] = ii_bplx
	ls_exchange.LongParm[2] = ll_zyh
	ls_exchange.StringParm[1] = ls_brbm
	ls_exchange.StringParm[2] = ls_jsjylsh
	ls_exchange.datetimeparm[1] = idt_begin
	ls_exchange.datetimeparm[2] = idt_end
	ls_exchange.datetimeparm[3] = ldt_jysj
	ls_exchange.StringParm[3] = 'wd'
	
	OpenWithParm(w_sbdz_bptz, ls_exchange)
END IF
destroy lds_brxx
end event

end event

event ue_gzcl();Long ll_row,ll_count
ll_count = tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.RowCount()
String ls_ywlx,ls_brbm,ls_knxx,ls_mzyh,ls_jylsh,ls_error,ls_kh,ls_sbm,ls_jylx,ls_jyh,ls_cbd,ls_err
Dec{0} ldc_zyh
DateTime ldt_jssj
ls_error = ''
FOR ll_row = 1 To ll_count
	ls_ywlx = tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.Object.ywlx[ll_row]
	ldc_zyh = tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.Object.zyh[ll_row]
	ldt_jssj = tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.Object.jssj[ll_row]
	ls_mzyh = tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.Object.jyid[ll_row]
	ls_jylsh = tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.Object.jylsh[ll_row]
	ls_cbd = tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.Object.cbdxzqh[ll_row]
	
	IF Time(ldt_jssj) > Time(23:55:00) THEN
		IF MessageBox('提示',ls_jylsh + '的交易时间'+String(ldt_jssj)+'可能存在跨天，是否继续作废！',question!,yesno!,2) = 2 THEN
			CONTINUE
		END IF
	END IF
	IF ldc_zyh > 0 THEN
		//	tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.uf_send_add( '社会保障卡卡号', istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.shbzkkh )
		//	tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.uf_send_add( '社会保障卡卡的识别码', istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.shbzksbm)
		SELECT ybkh,zhbz Into :ls_kh,:ls_sbm From bqxt.zy_brry Where zyh = :ldc_zyh;
		gu_ybjk_public.iu_sybjk_his.istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.shbzkkh = ls_kh
		gu_ybjk_public.iu_sybjk_his.istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.shbzksbm = ls_sbm
		IF tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.Object.fyze[ll_row] < 0 THEN
			ls_jylx = 'ZYTF'
			ls_jyh = '9209'
		ELSE
			ls_jylx = 'ZYSF'
			ls_jyh = '9208'
		END IF
	ELSE
		String ls_brxm,ls_sfzh,ls_dkfs,ls_zjlx,ls_lpsj,ls_cbd4
		ls_brbm = tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.Object.BRBM[ll_row]
		SELECT JZKH,BRXM,SFZH Into :ls_knxx,:ls_brxm,:ls_sfzh From MZXT.MZ_BRDA Where BRBM = :ls_brbm;
		gu_ybjk_public.iu_sybjk_his.istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.knsj = ls_knxx
		IF ls_dkfs = '3' THEN
			SELECT BRXM,ZJLX,ZJHM,LPSJ INTO :ls_brxm,:ls_zjlx,:ls_sfzh,:ls_lpsj
				From JKXT.YB_BRJBXXKZ Where (ZJHM = :ls_sfzh And cbdxzqh = :ls_cbd) Or (BRBM = :ls_brbm And cbdxzqh = :ls_cbd );
			IF ls_lpsj > ' ' THEN
			ELSE
				ls_lpsj = ''
				ls_cbd4 = Left(ls_cbd,4)
				SELECT BRXM,zjlx,ZJHM,lpsj INTO :ls_brxm,:ls_zjlx,:ls_sfzh,:ls_lpsj
					From JKXT.YB_BRJBXXKZ Where (ZJHM = :ls_sfzh And substr(cbdxzqh,1,4) = :ls_cbd4) ;
				IF ls_lpsj > ' ' THEN
				ELSE
					ls_zjlx = '01'
					IF Left(ls_knxx,6) = 'YBDZPZ' THEN
						ls_lpsj =  Mid(ls_knxx,7)
					ELSE
						MessageBox('提示','获取医保电子凭证信息失败：' + sqlca.SQLErrText )
						CONTINUE
					END IF
				END IF
			END IF
		END IF
		IF Left(ls_knxx,6) = 'YBDZPZ' Or ls_dkfs = '3' THEN
			gu_ybjk_public.iu_sybjk_his.istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.knsj = ls_brxm + "|" +ls_zjlx+ "|" +ls_sfzh+'|' + ls_lpsj
			gu_ybjk_public.iu_sybjk_his.istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.shbzkkh = ''
			gu_ybjk_public.iu_sybjk_his.istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.shbzksbm = ""
		ELSE
			gu_ybjk_public.iu_sybjk_his.istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.shbzkkh = Right(ls_knxx,9)
			gu_ybjk_public.iu_sybjk_his.istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.shbzksbm = Mid(ls_knxx,1,Len(ls_knxx) -9)
		END IF
		IF tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.Object.fyze[ll_row] < 0 THEN
			ls_jylx = 'MZTF'
			ls_jyh = '9204'
		ELSE
			ls_jylx = 'MZSF'
			ls_jyh = '9203'
		END IF
	END IF
	String ls_jyjg
	str_yb_jsxx_syb lstr_yb_jsxx
	
	//9203【门诊结算】，9204【门诊退费】，9205【住院登记】，9208【住院结算】，9209【住院退费】
	IF gu_ybjk_public.iu_sybjk_his.uf_jycx( ls_jyh, ls_mzyh, ls_cbd, ls_jyjg,lstr_yb_jsxx, ls_error) >= 0 THEN
		IF ls_jyjg <> '1' THEN
			ls_error  = '查询失败:jyjg' + ls_jyjg
		END IF
	ELSE
		IF MessageBox('提示','查询状态异常' + ls_error + ",是否继续作废？",question!,yesno! ,2) = 2 THEN RETURN
	END IF
	IF gu_ybjk_public.iu_sybjk_his.uf_jyzf( ldt_jssj, ls_jylFRE* sh, ls_jyh, ls_cbd, ls_err) <= 0 THEN
		ls_error += ls_mzyh +'作废失败：' + ls_err +'~r~n'
	END IF
NEXT
IF ll_count > 0 THEN
	IF  ls_error = '' THEN
		MessageBox('提示','作废成功'  )
	ELSE
		MessageBox('提示','作废失败：' + ls_error)
	END IF
END IF



end event

event ue_mxsc();//省移动支付才需要上传
if ddlb_ywlx.getcode( ) <> '1' then return
long ll_row
string ls_dzr,ls_return
date ld_dzr
IF IsNull(idt_begin) Or IsNull(idt_end)  THEN
	MessageBox('提示','请先汇总统计，再上传')
	RETURN
ELSE
	ld_dzr = Date(idt_begin)
	ls_dzr = String(ld_dzr,'yyyymmdd')

		MessageBox('提示','对账时间'+String(em_1.getdate( ),'yyyymmdd')+'与对账信息汇总中的对账日' + ls_dzr+'不一致,请重新统计汇总')
		RETURN
	END IF
END IF
gu_ybjk_public.iu_sydzf.uf_send_init('8032')
gu_ybjk_public.iu_sydzf.uf_send_add('结算日期',String(ld_dzr,'yyyy-mm-dd'))

gu_ybjk_public.iu_sydzf.uf_send_add_in_mxnr( '交易明细列表')

	gu_ybjk_public.iu_sydzf.uf_send_add_in( '参保地行政代码', string(tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.object.cbdxzqh[ll_row]), ll_row)
	gu_ybjk_public.iu_sydzf.uf_send_add_in( '门诊序列号', string(tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.object.brbm[ll_row]), ll_row)
	gu_ybjk_public.iu_sydzf.uf_send_add_in( '社会保障卡卡号', string(tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.object.shbzkkh[ll_row]), ll_row)
	gu_ybjk_public.iu_sydzf.uf_send_add_in( '姓名', string(tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.object.brxm[ll_row]), ll_row)
	gu_ybjk_public.iu_sydzf.uf_send_add_in( '交易时间', string(tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.object.jssj[ll_row],'yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss'), ll_row)
	gu_ybjk_public.iu_sydzf.uf_send_add_in( '医疗费用总额', Round(tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.object.ylfyze[ll_row],2), ll_row)
	gu_ybjk_public.iu_sydzf.uf_send_add_in( '报销金额', Round(tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.object.hjzf[ll_row],2), ll_row)
	gu_ybjk_public.iu_sydzf.uf_send_add_in( '个人现金支付', Round(tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.object.grxj[ll_row],2), ll_row)
	gu_ybjk_public.iu_sydzf.uf_send_add_in( '交易类型', 1, ll_row)
next
IF gu_ybjk_public.iu_sydzf.uf_send(ls_return) THEN
	gu_ybjk_public.iu_sydzf.uf_send_init('8035')
	gu_ybjk_public.iu_sydzf.uf_send_add('结算日期',String(ld_dzr,'yyyy-mm-dd'))
	gu_ybjk_public.iu_sydzf.uf_send_add('确认总记录条数',integer(tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.RowCount()))

		messagebox('提示','上传确认成功!')
	else
		messagebox('提示','上传确认失败!'+ls_return)
	end if
else
	messagebox('提示','上传失败!'+ls_return)

public function integer wf_dzyz ();
u_datastore lds_bpmx
lds_bpmx = Create u_datastore

String ls_bpmx
Long ll_rowcount, ll_temp

gf_waiting('开始校验数据......',1)

//判断预存是否有过正确结转
//=======================核对==============================//
Dec{2} ld_kyc, ld_yck_fp,ldc_yck_gh
Long ll_count

ld_kyc = 0
SELECT SUM(JYJE) INTO :ld_kyc FROM H_MZ_ZHJYMX
	Where JYSJ >= :idt_begin And JYSJ < :idt_end And JYLB In (11,12) ;//And Upper(JYDD) Not In ('GH','ZZGH');
IF IsNull(ld_kyc) THEN ld_kyc = 0

gf_waiting('开始校验数据......',10)

//====预存款－－扣款fpk,zffs
ld_yck_fp = 0
SELECT sum(NVL(H_FP_ZFFS.ZFJE,0)) INTO :ld_yck_fp FROM mz_fpk,H_FP_ZFFS
	WHERE mz_fpk.kpsj >= :idt_begin AND mz_fpk.kpsj < :idt_end
//	AND (H_FP_ZFFS.zffs = '5' OR H_FP_ZFFS.zffs = '7' OR H_FP_ZFFS.zffs = '8' or H_FP_ZFFS.zffs = '10')
   AND (H_FP_ZFFS.zffs in (select to_char(dmsb) from xtgl.gy_dmzd where dmlb = 34 and bzbm2 = 1))
	And NVL(mz_fpk.fpzf,0) <> 9  And mz_fpk.fplsh = H_FP_ZFFS.fplsh;
IF IsNull(ld_yck_fp) THEN ld_yck_fp = 0
//挂号非现金支付
ldc_yck_gh = 0.00
SELECT sum(NVL(xjje,0)) INTO :ldc_yck_gh FROM MZ_GHXX
	WHERE GHRQ >= :idt_begin AND GHRQ < :idt_end
   AND ZFFS in (select to_char(dmsb) from xtgl.gy_dmzd where dmlb = 34 and bzbm2 = 1)
	And NVL(THBZ,'0') IN ('0','s','t','r');
IF IsNull(ldc_yck_gh) THEN ldc_yck_gh = 0

gf_waiting('正在校验数据......',20)

IF Abs(ld_kyc + ld_yck_fp + ldc_yck_gh) > 1 THEN
	dw_bpmx.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_yc'
	dw_bpmx.SetTransObject( sqlca )
	ll_rowcount = dw_bpmx.Retrieve( idt_begin, idt_end )
	
	IF ll_rowcount > 0 THEN
		gf_waiting('预存发票未正确结转......',-1)
		dw_bpmx.Title = "预存发票未正确结转"
		dw_bpmx.Visible = True
		ii_bplx = 1 //预存不平
		
		dw_toolbar.Enabled = True
		SetNull(is_dzr)
		RETURN -1
	END IF
	
	dw_bpmx.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_ycgh'
	dw_bpmx.SetTransObject( sqlca )
	ll_rowcount = dw_bpmx.Retrieve( idt_begin, idt_end )
	
	IF ll_rowcount > 0 THEN
		gf_waiting('预存发票未正确结转......',-1)
		dw_bpmx.Title = "预存发票未正确结转（挂号）"
		dw_bpmx.Visible = True
		ii_bplx = 2 //预存挂号不平
		
		dw_toolbar.Enabled = True
		SetNull(is_dzr)
		RETURN -1
	END IF
	
	dw_toolbar.Enabled = True
	SetNull(is_dzr)
	RETURN -1
	
	//	lds_bpmx.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_yc'
	//	lds_bpmx.SetTransObject( sqlca )
	//	ll_rowcount = lds_bpmx.Retrieve( idt_begin, idt_end )
	//	
	//	IF ll_rowcount > 0 THEN

//重复的2,3清理

SELECT COUNT(*) INTO :ll_count FROM jkxt.yb_jsmx t
	WHERE jjzfze <> (tczfs + jzzfs + grdnzhzfs + grlnzhzfs + gbjjzfs + bzjjzfs + lxjjzfs + eyjjzfs + lmjjzfs + jmjjzfs + dxsjjzfs + wcnrjjzfs + xnhjjzfs + qtjjzfs + qtzfs1 + qtzfs2 + qtzfs3)
	And jssj >= :idt_begin And jssj < :idt_end And  jsjylsh Is Not Null  And ZTBZ > 0 ;

//------验证门诊数据一致性----社保门诊发票记帐金额-------- //

	Where kpsj >= :idt_begin And kpsj < :idt_end And NVL(fpzf,0) <> 9 And jslb In (SELECT brxz From gy_brxz Where ybpb = 1);

SELECT sum(NVL(jzce,0)), SUM(jzce + zfce) INTO :ld_jzce, :ld_jzzfce FROM sb_jejd

ld_fpzje = ld_fpzje + ld_jzzfce

gf_waiting('正在校验数据......',50)

SELECT sum(nvl(jjzfze,0)), sum(nvl(ylfyze,0)) INTO :ld_mzjz, :ld_ylfyze FROM jkxt.yb_jsmx
	WHERE jssj >= :idt_begin AND jssj < :idt_end AND jsjylsh Is NOT NULL
	And NVL(ywlx,'SF') = 'SF' And ZTBZ > 0 And YWLSH Not Like 'A%';
SELECT sum(nvl(xjzfze,0)) into :ldc_gbxjzf FROM jkxt.yb_jsmx
	WHERE jssj >= :idt_begin AND jssj < :idt_end AND jsjylsh Is NOT NULL
	And NVL(ywlx,'SF') = 'SF' And ZTBZ > 0 And YWLSH Not Like 'A%' and gbbjdx >= '1';	

SELECT sum(nvl(tszje,0)) into :ldc_tsje FROM jkxt.js_tsjl
	WHERE tssj >= :idt_begin AND tssj < :idt_end AND ybywh Is NOT NULL
	And NVL(ywly,'SF') = 'SF' And ZTBZ > 0 And YWLSH Not Like 'A%' ;	
	
IF IsNull(ld_mzjz) THEN ld_mzjz = 0
IF IsNull(ld_sdjzje) THEN ld_sdjzje = 0
IF IsNull(ld_ylfyze) THEN ld_ylfyze = 0
if isnull(ldc_gbxjzf) then ldc_gbxjzf = 0
if isnull(ldc_tsje) then ldc_tsje = 0

ld_sbzje = ld_mzjz - ld_sdjzje + (ldc_gbxjzf - ldc_tsje)
ld_zjece = ld_ylfyze - ld_fpzje

IF ld_sbzje <> ld_sbjzje Or ld_ylfyze <> ld_fpzje THEN
	dw_bpmx.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_sfjz'
	dw_bpmx.SetTransObject( sqlca )
	ll_rowcount = dw_bpmx.Retrieve( idt_begin, idt_end )
	
	IF ll_rowcount > 0 THEN
		gf_waiting('门诊交易数据不一致......',-1)
		dw_bpmx.Title = "门诊交易数据不一致"
		dw_bpmx.Visible = True
		ii_bplx = 4 //门诊收费不平
	END IF

	//	END IF

	dw_toolbar.Enabled = True
	SetNull(is_dzr)
	RETURN -1
END IF

//挂号记账金额是否一致验证------------------
Dec{2} ld_ghjz, ld_sbghjz, ld_sdghjz, ld_ghzje, ld_zce, ld_ghzjje

SELECT sum(NVL(ZJJE,0) - NVL(XJJE,0)), sum(NVL(ZJJE,0)) INTO :ld_ghjz, :ld_ghzjje FROM mz_ghxx
	WHERE GHRQ >= :idt_begin AND GHRQ < :idt_end AND (nvl(THBZ,0) NOT IN ('i','3'))
	And jslb In (SELECT brxz From gy_brxz Where ybpb = 1);
IF IsNull(ld_ghjz) THEN ld_ghjz = 0
IF IsNull(ld_ghzjje) THEN ld_ghzjje = 0

SELECT sum(jzce),sum(jzce + zfce) INTO :ld_jzce, :ld_zce FROM sb_jejd
	Where kpsj >= :idt_begin And kpsj < :idt_end And XMLB = 1;
	
IF IsNull(ld_jzce) THEN ld_jzce = 0
IF IsNull(ld_zce) THEN ld_zce = 0

ld_ghjz = ld_ghjz + ld_jzce
ld_sdghjz = ld_ghzjje + ld_zce

gf_waiting('正在校验数据......',70)

SELECT sum(nvl(jjzfze,0)), sum(nvl(ylfyze,0)) INTO :ld_sbghjz, :ld_ylfyze FROM jkxt.yb_jsmx
	WHERE jssj >= :idt_begin AND jssj < :idt_end AND jsjylsh Is NOT NULL
	And NVL(ywlx,'SF') = 'GH' And ZTBZ > 0 And YWLSH Not Like 'A%';
SELECT sum(nvl(xjzfze,0)) into :ldc_gbxjzf FROM jkxt.yb_jsmx
	WHERE jssj >= :idt_begin AND jssj < :idt_end AND jsjylsh Is NOT NULL
	And NVL(ywlx,'SF') = 'GH' And ZTBZ > 0 And YWLSH Not Like 'A%' and gbbjdx >= '1';	

SELECT sum(nvl(tszje,0)) into :ldc_tsje FROM jkxt.js_tsjl
	WHERE tssj >= :idt_begin AND tssj < :idt_end AND ybywh Is NOT NULL
	And NVL(ywly,'SF') = 'GH' And ZTBZ > 0 And YWLSH Not Like 'A%' ;	
	
IF IsNull(ld_ghjz) THEN ld_ghjz = 0
IF IsNull(ld_sbghjz) THEN ld_sbghjz = 0
IF IsNull(ld_sdghjz) THEN ld_sdghjz = 0
IF IsNull(ld_ylfyze) THEN ld_ylfyze = 0
if isnull(ldc_gbxjzf) then ldc_gbxjzf = 0
if isnull(ldc_tsje) then ldc_tsje = 0
ld_ghzje = ld_sbghjz  + (ldc_gbxjzf - ldc_tsje)

IF ld_ghjz <> ld_ghzje Or ld_sdghjz <> ld_ylfyze THEN
	dw_bpmx.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_gh'
	dw_bpmx.SetTransObject( sqlca )
	ll_rowcount = dw_bpmx.Retrieve( idt_begin, idt_end )
	
	IF ll_rowcount > 0 THEN
		gf_waiting('门诊挂号交易数据不一致......',-1)
		dw_bpmx.Title = "门诊挂号交易数据不一致"
		dw_bpmx.Visible = True
		ii_bplx = 5 //门诊挂号不平
	END IF
	
	//	lds_bpmx.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_gh'
	//	lds_bpmx.SetTransObject( sqlca )
	//	ll_rowcount = lds_bpmx.Retrieve( idt_begin, idt_end )
	//	
	//	IF ll_rowcount > 0 THEN
	//		FOR ll_temp = 1 To ll_rowcount
	//			ls_bpmx = ls_bpmx + lds_bpmx.Object.#1[ll_temp] + " " + String(lds_bpmx.Object.#2[ll_temp]) +&
	//				" " + String(lds_bpmx.Object.#3[ll_temp]) + "~n"
	//		NEXT
	//	END IF
	//	
	//	gf_waiting('门诊挂号交易数据不一致......',-1)
	//	MessageBox('提示,不能对帐，请与计算中心联系','门诊挂号数据不一致：社保理论交易(yb_jsmx) :总金额'+String(ld_ylfyze)+',记账金额'+String(ld_sbghjz)+'  门诊实际发生额 (MZ_GHXX)：总金额'+String(ld_sdghjz)+',记账金额'+String(ld_ghjz)+'  差值：'+String(ld_ylfyze - ld_sdghjz) + '----'+String(ld_ghzje - ld_ghjz) + '~n' + ls_bpmx)
	dw_toolbar.Enabled = True
	SetNull(is_dzr)
	RETURN -1
END IF

//住院病人结算金额是否一致验证----------------------
Dec{2} ldc_zyjz, ldc_zyjzzf, ldc_zyzje, ldc_zyzjezf, ldc_sbzyjz, ldc_sbzyzje

SELECT sum(NVL(fyhj,0) - NVL(zfhj,0)), sum(NVL(fyhj,0)) INTO :ldc_zyjz, :ldc_zyzje FROM zy_zyjs
	WHERE jsrq >= :idt_begin AND jsrq < :idt_end
	And brxz In (SELECT brxz From gy_brxz Where ybpb = 1);
IF IsNull(ldc_zyjz) THEN ldc_zyjz = 0
IF IsNull(ldc_zyzje) THEN ldc_zyzje = 0

SELECT sum(NVL(fyhj,0) - NVL(zfhj,0)), sum(NVL(fyhj,0)) INTO :ldc_zyjzzf, :ldc_zyzjezf FROM zy_zyjs
	WHERE zfrq >= :idt_begin AND zfrq < :idt_end AND zfpb = 1
	And brxz In (SELECT brxz From gy_brxz Where ybpb = 1);
IF IsNull(ldc_zyjzzf) THEN ldc_zyjzzf = 0
IF IsNull(ldc_zyzjezf) THEN ldc_zyzjezf = 0

ldc_zyjz = ldc_zyjz - ldc_zyjzzf
ldc_zyzje = ldc_zyzje - ldc_zyzjezf

gf_waiting('正在校验数据......',90)

SELECT sum(NVL(jjzfze,0)), sum(NVL(ylfyze,0)) INTO :ldc_sbzyjz, :ldc_sbzyzje FROM jkxt.yb_jsmx
	WHERE jssj >= :idt_begin AND jssj < :idt_end AND jsjylsh Is NOT NULL
	And NVL(ywlx,'SF') = 'ZY' And ZTBZ > 0;
IF IsNull(ldc_sbzyjz) THEN ldc_sbzyjz = 0
IF IsNull(ldc_sbzyzje) THEN ldc_sbzyzje = 0

IF ldc_zyzje <> ldc_sbzyzje THEN
	dw_bpmx.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_zy' 
	dw_bpmx.SetTransObject( sqlca )
	ll_rowcount = dw_bpmx.Retrieve( idt_begin, idt_end )
	
	IF ll_rowcount > 0 THEN
		gf_waiting('住院病人交易数据不一致......',-1)
		dw_bpmx.Title = "住院病人交易数据不一致"
		dw_bpmx.Visible = True
		ii_bplx = 6 //住院不平
	END IF
	
	//	lds_bpmx.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_zy'
	//	lds_bpmx.SetTransObject( sqlca )
	//	ll_rowcount = lds_bpmx.Retrieve( idt_begin, idt_end )
	//	
	//	IF ll_rowcount > 0 THEN
	//		FOR ll_temp = 1 To ll_rowcount
	//			ls_bpmx = ls_bpmx + string(lds_bpmx.Object.#1[ll_temp]) + " " + String(lds_bpmx.Object.#2[ll_temp]) +&
	//				" " + String(lds_bpmx.Object.#3[ll_temp]) + "~n"
	//		NEXT
	//	END IF
	//	
	//	gf_waiting('住院病人交易数据不一致......',-1)
	//	MessageBox('提示,不能对帐，请与计算中心联系','住院病人交易数据不一致：社保理论交易(YB_JSMX) :总金额'+String(ldc_sbzyzje)+',记账金额'+String(ldc_sbzyjz)+'  住院实际发生额 (ZY_ZYJS)：总金额'+String(ldc_zyzje)+',记账金额'+String(ldc_zyjz)+'  差值：'+String(ldc_sbzyzje - ldc_zyzje) + '----'+String(ldc_sbzyjz - ldc_zyjz) + '~n' + ls_bpmx)
	
	dw_toolbar.Enabled = True
	SetNull(is_dzr)
	RETURN -1
END IF

gf_waiting('正在校验数据......',-1)
RETURN 1
end function

public subroutine wf_delrep (datetime adt_begin, datetime adt_end);u_datastore luds_del
luds_del = Create u_datastore
luds_del.DataObject = 'd_jsjylsh_syddel'
luds_del.SetTransObject(SQLCA)
luds_del.Retrieve(adt_begin, adt_end)

Long ll_rowcount,ll_zyh,ll_cur
String ls_brbm,ls_jsjylsh,ls_mxzdh
ll_rowcount = luds_del.RowCount()
IF ll_rowcount > 0 THEN
	ls_brbm = luds_del.Object.brbm[1]
	ll_zyh = luds_del.Object.zyh[1]
	ls_jsjylsh = luds_del.Object.jslsh[1]
	ls_mxzdh = luds_del.Object.jylsh[1]
	
	FOR ll_cur = 2 To ll_rowcount
		IF ll_zyh = 0 THEN
			IF ls_brbm = luds_del.Object.brbm[ll_cur] And ls_jsjylsh = luds_del.Object.jslsh[ll_cur] THEN
				luds_del.Object.ztbz[ll_cur] = -8
			ELSE
				ls_brbm = luds_del.Object.brbm[ll_cur]
				ls_jsjylsh = luds_del.Object.jslsh[ll_cur]
				ls_mxzdh = luds_del.Object.jylsh[ll_cur]
				ll_zyh = luds_del.Object.zyh[ll_cur]
				CONTINUE
			END IF
		ELSE
			IF ll_zyh = luds_del.Object.zyh[ll_cur] And ls_jsjylsh = luds_del.Object.jslsh[ll_cur] THEN
				luds_del.Object.ztbz[ll_cur] = -8
			ELSE
				ls_brbm = luds_del.Object.brbm[ll_cur]
				ls_jsjylsh = luds_del.Object.jslsh[ll_cur]
				ls_mxzdh = luds_del.Object.jylsh[ll_cur]
				ll_zyh = luds_del.Object.zyh[ll_cur]
				CONTINUE
			END IF
		END IF
	NEXT

END IF

gf_begin_transaction(SQLCA)
IF luds_del.Update( ) = 1 THEN
	gf_commit_transaction(SQLCA)
//	MessageBox('提示','保存成功!')
ELSE
	gf_rollback_transaction(SQLCA)
	MessageBox('提示','del失败')
END IF


end subroutine

public subroutine wf_getycym (date ad_sj, ref date ad_yc, ref date ad_ym);date ld_first
ld_first = date(year(ad_sj),month(ad_sj),1)
ad_ym = relativedate(ld_first,-1)
ad_yc = date(year(ad_ym),month(ad_ym),1)
end subroutine

on w_sbdz_syd.create
int iCurrent

call super::create
this.em_1=create em_1
this.st_1=create st_1
this.cbx_sbgz=create cbx_sbgz
this.ddlb_ywlx=create ddlb_ywlx
this.st_2=create st_2
this.dw_bpmx=create dw_bpmx
iCurrent=UpperBound(this.Control)
this.Control[iCurrent+1]=this.em_1
this.Control[iCurrent+2]=this.st_1
this.Control[iCurrent+3]=this.cbx_sbgz
this.Control[iCurrent+4]=this.ddlb_ywlx
this.Control[iCurrent+5]=this.st_2
this.Control[iCurrent+6]=this.dw_bpmx
end on

on w_sbdz_syd.destroy
call super::destroy
destroy(this.em_1)
destroy(this.st_1)
destroy(this.cbx_sbgz)
destroy(this.ddlb_ywlx)
destroy(this.st_2)
destroy(this.dw_bpmx)
end on

IF sqlca.SQLCode = 0 THEN
	li_year = Integer(Left(ls_dzr,4))
	li_month = Integer(Mid(ls_dzr,5,2))
	li_day = Integer(Mid(ls_dzr,7,2))

ddlb_ywlx.AddItem('2', '省内跨市(日)', 'KSZYRSJ')
ddlb_ywlx.AddItem('3', '跨省住院(日)', 'KSZYRSJ')
ddlb_ywlx.AddItem('4', '跨省门诊(日)', 'KSMZRSJ')
ddlb_ywlx.AddItem('5', '罕见病对账', 'HJBDZ')
ddlb_ywlx.AddItem('-1', '跨省数据(月)', 'KSZYYSJ')
ddlb_ywlx.AddItem('-2', '跨省门诊(月)', 'KSMZYSJ')

//ddlb_ywlx.AddItem('1', '操作员日对账', 'CZYRDZ')
ddlb_ywlx.itemselect( '0')
IF IsValid (gu_ybjk_public) = False THEN //创建医保接口
	gu_ybjk_public = Create u_ybjk_public
	IF Not gu_ybjk_public.uf_init( ls_return) THEN
		MessageBox('提示','医保接口初始化失败:' + ls_return)
	END IF
END IF
if gu_ybjk_public.ii_sydzfqy = 1 then 
//	iu_sydzf = create u_sydzf_his
//	IF Not iu_sydzf.uf_init( ls_return) THEN
//		MessageBox('提示','省移动支付初始化失败:' + ls_return)
//	END IF
	ddlb_ywlx.AddItem('1', '移动支付对账', 'YDZFDZ')
end if
end event

event resize;call super::resize;inv_resize.of_resize_handler(this, sizetype, width, height)

tab_1.y = dw_1.y
tab_1.height = dw_1.height
tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.height = tab_1.height - 158

tab_1.tab_dzxx.dw_dzxx.height = tab_1.height - 158

end event

event ue_ref;call super::ue_ref;String ls_dzr,ls_mess,ls_yf,ls_dzlx,ls_yllb,ls_filter,ls_ywlx
Integer li_ywlx
Long ll_rowcount,ll_count
//IF em_1.getdate( ) > Date(gf_server_date()) THEN
//	MessageBox('提示','不能对当日之后的时间进行统计!')
//	RETURN
//END IF
idt_begin = em_1.getdatetime(1)
idt_end = DateTime(RelativeDate(em_1.getdate(),1),Time(00:00:00))

//获取统计月份
ls_yf = String(em_1.getdate( ),'yyyymm')
ls_dzr = String(em_1.getdate( ),'yyyymmdd')

type variables
integer ii_pybyd = 0

forward prototypes
public subroutine wf_toolbar_constructor ()
public function integer wf_update_zjk (string ls_brbm, string ls_fplsh, string ls_fplsh_new)
end prototypes

public subroutine wf_toolbar_constructor ();//
end subroutine

public function integer wf_update_zjk (string ls_brbm, string ls_fplsh, string ls_fplsh_new);
UPDATE h_mz_ycfp Set fplsh = :ls_fplsh_new Where brbm = :ls_brbm And fplsh = :ls_fplsh ;
IF sqlca.SQLCode = 0 THEN
	UPDATE h_mz_ycfp_zffs Set fplsh = :ls_fplsh_new Where brbm = :ls_brbm And fplsh = :ls_fplsh ;
	IF sqlca.SQLCode = 0 THEN
		UPDATE mz_yjk1 Set fplsh = :ls_fplsh_new Where brbm = :ls_brbm And fplsh = :ls_fplsh ;
		IF sqlca.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
			gf_applog(ls_fplsh +":"+ sqlca.SQLErrText)
			GOTO Error
		ELSE
			UPDATE zjk.yj_lisjk Set fplsh = :ls_fplsh_new  Where brbm = :ls_brbm And fplsh = :ls_fplsh ;
			IF sqlca.SQLCode = 0 THEN
				UPDATE zjk.yj_tjjk Set fplsh = :ls_fplsh_new  Where brbm = :ls_brbm And fplsh = :ls_fplsh ;
				IF sqlca.SQLCode = 0 THEN
					UPDATE jkxt.yb_jsmx Set YWlsh = :ls_fplsh_new Where brbm = :ls_brbm And YWlsh = :ls_fplsh and ywlx ='SF' ;
					IF sqlca.SQLCode = 0 THEN
						gf_commit_transaction(sqlca)
					ELSE
						gf_applog(ls_fplsh +":"+ 'yb_jsmx:'+sqlca.SQLErrText)
						GOTO Error
					END IF
				ELSE
					gf_applog(ls_fplsh +":"+ 'yj_tjjk更新失败:'+sqlca.SQLErrText)
					GOTO Error
				END IF
			ELSE
				gf_applog(ls_fplsh +":"+ 'yj_lisjk更新失败:'+sqlca.SQLErrText)
				GOTO Error
			END IF
		END IF
	ELSE
		gf_applog(ls_fplsh +":"+ 'h_mz_ycfp_zffs更新失败:'+sqlca.SQLErrText)
		GOTO Error
	END IF
ELSE
	gf_applog(ls_fplsh +":"+ 'h_mz_ycfp更新失败:'+sqlca.SQLErrText)
	GOTO Error
END IF
RETURN 1
Error:
gf_rollback_transaction(sqlca)
RETURN -1




end function

this.em_1=create em_1

type cb_2 from commandbutton within tabpage_1
integer x = 558
integer y = 16
integer width = 402
integer height = 72
integer taborder = 40

integer weight = 400
fontcharset fontcharset = gb2312charset!

event clicked;String ls_brbm,ls_fplsh,ls_brxm
Long ll_rowcount,ll_cur,li_yjkrowcount,ll_row,li_index,ll_bh,ll_sfxm2,ll_tjm2,ll_sfxm ,ll_tjxm ,k,ll_yybz,ll_yhms,li_cfkrowcount,ll_cfmxcount,j
DateTime ldt_kpsj
u_datastore ds_sfmx,ds_fpk,ds_yjk,ds_yjk2_sfxm,ds_cfk,ds_cfmx
ll_yhms = 1
ll_rowcount = tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_2.RowCount()
IF ll_rowcount > 0 THEN
	Dec{2} ldc_ce,ldc_zje,ldc_yhje,ld_jzje = 0.00,ld_zfje = 0.00,ld_sumjzje,ld_sumzfje,ld_sum_xmzje,ld_sl,ld_szfbl,ldc_yhje_sum,ldc_bscje,ld_mx_jzje,ld_mx_zfje
	Dec{4} ld_xmdj
	Dec{0} ldc_yjlsh,ldc_cflsh,ld_lsh //,ll_ghlsh,ll_yjlshgl,
	String ls_czybm,ls_ysbm,ls_sfxm,ls_tjm,ls_czbz,ls_xmmc
	Boolean lb_qtbz = False
	Long ll_ypxh,ll_ypcd
	//sfmx
	ds_sfmx = Create u_datastore
	ds_sfmx.DataObject = 'd_cwsf_mz_sfmx'
	ds_sfmx.SetTransObject( sqlca)
	//fpk
	ds_fpk = Create u_datastore
	ds_fpk.DataObject = 'd_cwsf_mz_sf'
	ds_fpk.SetTransObject( sqlca)
	//yjk
	ds_yjk = Create u_datastore
	ds_yjk.DataObject = 'd_ycrj_yjk' //医技库
	ds_yjk.SetTransObject(sqlca)
	ds_yjk2_sfxm = Create u_datastore
	ds_yjk2_sfxm.DataObject = 'd_ycrj_yjk2'
	ds_yjk2_sfxm.SetTransObject(sqlca)
	//cfk	
	ds_cfk = Create u_datastore
	ds_cfk.DataObject = 'd_ycrj_cfk' //处方库
	ds_cfk.SetTransObject(sqlca)
	ds_cfmx = Create u_datastore
	ds_cfmx.DataObject = 'd_ycrj_cfmx'
	ds_cfmx.SetTransObject(sqlca)
	FOR ll_cur = 1 To ll_rowcount
		ldc_zje = 0.00
		ldc_yhje = 0.00
		ld_sumjzje = 0.00
		ld_sumzfje = 0.00
		ld_sum_xmzje = 0.00
		ldc_ce = tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_2.Object.ce[ll_cur] * -1
		IF ldc_ce = 0 Or IsNull(ldc_ce) THEN CONTINUE
		ls_brbm =  tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_2.Object.brbm[ll_cur]
		ls_fplsh =  tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_2.Object.fplsh[ll_cur]
		ds_fpk.Retrieve(ls_fplsh )
		IF ds_fpk.RowCount( ) <= 0 THEN
			gf_applog(ls_fplsh + 'fpk找不到记录')
			CONTINUE
		ELSE
			ls_brxm = ds_fpk.Object.brxm[1]
			ldt_kpsj = ds_fpk.Object.kpsj[1]
			ll_yybz = Long(ds_fpk.Object.yybz[1])
		END IF
		ds_sfmx.Retrieve(ls_fplsh )
		li_yjkrowcount = ds_yjk.Retrieve(ls_fplsh,ls_brbm)
		IF li_yjkrowcount > 0 THEN
			FOR ll_row = 1 To li_yjkrowcount
				ldc_yjlsh = ds_yjk.Object.yjlsh[ll_row]
				IF ds_sfmx.Find("ywlx = 'YJ' AND YWLSH = "+String(ldc_yjlsh),1,ds_sfmx.RowCount()) > 0 THEN CONTINUE
				ls_czybm = ds_yjk.Object.czybm[ll_row]
				ldc_yjlsh = ds_yjk.Object.yjlsh[ll_row]
				ls_ysbm = ds_yjk.Object.ysbm[ll_row]
				ls_sfxm = ds_yjk.Object.sfxm[ll_row]
				ls_tjm = ds_yjk.Object.tjm[ll_row]
				//======对yj中的明细按收费项目汇总======== //
				IF IsNull(ls_sfxm)  THEN ls_sfxm = ''
				IF IsNull(ls_tjm)  THEN ls_tjm = ''
				IF ls_sfxm = '' Or ls_tjm = '' THEN
					ll_bh = ds_yjk.Object.bh[ll_row]
					SELECT nvl(fygb,0),nvl(wyey_tjm,0) Into :ll_sfxm2,:ll_tjm2 From gy_ylsf  Where fyxh = :ll_bh Using sqlca;
					IF sqlca.SQLCode = 0 THEN
						IF ls_sfxm = '' THEN
							ls_sfxm = String(ll_sfxm2)
						END IF
						IF ls_tjm = '' THEN
							ls_tjm = String(ll_tjm2)
						END IF
					ELSE
						IF ls_sfxm = '' THEN
							ls_sfxm = '0'
						END IF
						IF ls_tjm = '' THEN
							ls_tjm = '0'
						END IF
						gf_applog(String(ll_bh) +"  获取sfxm和tjm失败null" + sqlca.SQLErrText)
					END IF
				END IF
				ll_sfxm = Long(ls_sfxm)
				ll_tjxm = Long(ls_tjm)
				ls_czbz = Lower(ds_yjk.Object.czbz[ll_row])
				//czbz为z的(全退)发票结转的时候均为0
				IF ls_czbz = 'z' THEN
					ld_jzje = 0
					ld_zfje = 0
				ELSE
					lb_qtbz = False
					ld_jzje = ds_yjk.Object.jzje[ll_row]
					ld_zfje = ds_yjk.Object.zfje[ll_row]
				END IF
				
				ld_sumjzje += ld_jzje
				ld_sumzfje += ld_zfje
				ld_sum_xmzje = ld_sumjzje + ld_sumzfje
				ds_yjk2_sfxm.Reset()
				IF ls_czybm = '11' Or ls_czybm = '5'  Or ls_czybm = '12' THEN //有yjk2
					ds_yjk2_sfxm.Retrieve(ldc_yjlsh)
					IF ds_yjk2_sfxm.RowCount() > 0 THEN
						FOR k = 1 To  ds_yjk2_sfxm.RowCount()
							ll_bh = ds_yjk2_sfxm.Object.bh[k]
							ld_xmdj = ds_yjk2_sfxm.Object.dj[k]
							ld_szfbl = ds_yjk2_sfxm.Object.szfbl[k]
							IF IsNull(ld_szfbl) THEN ld_szfbl = 1
							ls_xmmc = ds_yjk2_sfxm.Object.pm[k]
							IF IsNull(ls_xmmc) THEN ls_xmmc = ''
							IF ls_czbz = 'z' THEN
								ld_sl = 0
								ld_mx_jzje = 0
								ld_mx_zfje = 0
								ldc_yhje = 0
							ELSE
								lb_qtbz = False
								ld_sl = ds_yjk2_sfxm.Object.sl[k]
								ld_mx_jzje = ds_yjk2_sfxm.Object.jzje[k]
								ld_mx_zfje = ds_yjk2_sfxm.Object.zfje[k]
								ldc_yhje = ds_yjk2_sfxm.Object.yhje[k]
								ld_lsh = ds_yjk2_sfxm.Object.lsh[k]
								IF IsNull(ld_mx_jzje) THEN ld_mx_jzje = 0
								IF IsNull(ld_mx_zfje) THEN ld_mx_zfje = 0
							END IF
							IF IsNull(ldc_yhje) THEN ldc_yhje = 0
							ldc_yhje_sum += ldc_yhje
							//由于mz_yjk1所对应的sfxm和tjm和mz_yjk2中的项目会不一致，所以mz_yjk2的sfxm和tjm都重新获取
							SELECT fygb,wyey_tjm INTO :ll_sfxm2,:ll_tjm2 FROM gy_ylsf
								Where fyxh = :ll_bh Using sqlca;
							IF sqlca.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
								ll_sfxm2 = ll_sfxm
								ll_tjm2 = ll_tjxm
								gf_applog(String(ll_bh) +"  获取sfxm和tjm失败：(yjlsh2 = '"+String(ldc_yjlsh)+"')" + sqlca.SQLErrText)
							END IF
							//ll_sfxm2,ll_tjm2
							//插入发票明细
							li_index = ds_sfmx.InsertRow(0)
							ds_sfmx.Object.fplsh[li_index] = ls_fplsh
							ds_sfmx.Object.brbm[li_index] = ls_brbm
							ds_sfmx.Object.brxm[li_index] = gf_midstring(ls_brxm,20)
							ds_sfmx.Object.xmlsh[li_index] = ll_bh
							ds_sfmx.Object.cdlsh[li_index] = 0
							ds_sfmx.Object.sfxm[li_index] = ll_sfxm2
							ds_sfmx.Object.tjxm[li_index] = ll_tjm2
							ds_sfmx.Object.xmmc[li_index] = ls_xmmc
							ds_sfmx.Object.ywlsh[li_index] = ldc_yjlsh
							ds_sfmx.Object.ywlx[li_index] = 'YJ'
							ds_sfmx.Object.xmdj[li_index] = ld_xmdj
							ds_sfmx.Object.xmsl[li_index] = ld_sl
							ds_sfmx.Object.zjje[li_index] = Round(ld_xmdj * ld_sl,2)
							ds_sfmx.Object.zfje[li_index] = ld_mx_zfje
							ds_sfmx.Object.yhje[li_index] = ldc_yhje
							ds_sfmx.Object.zfbl[li_index] = ld_szfbl
							ds_sfmx.Object.ysbm[li_index] = ls_ysbm
							ds_sfmx.Object.yqbm[li_index] = ll_yybz
							ds_sfmx.Object.ztbz[li_index] = 0
							ds_sfmx.Object.sfybm[li_index] = '9999'
							ds_sfmx.Object.sfsj[li_index] = ldt_kpsj
							ds_sfmx.Object.sjpjh[li_index] = '0'
							ds_sfmx.Object.mxxh[li_index] = ld_lsh
							ds_sfmx.Object.czybm[li_index] = ls_czybm
						NEXT
					END IF
					//======对yj中的明细按收费项目汇总======== //
				ELSE
					//插入发票明细
					ll_bh = ds_yjk.Object.bh[ll_row]
					ld_xmdj = ds_yjk.Object.dj[ll_row]
					IF ls_czbz = 'z' THEN
						ld_sl = 0
						ldc_yhje = 0
					ELSE
						lb_qtbz = False
						ld_sl = ds_yjk.Object.sl[ll_row]
						ldc_yhje = ds_yjk.Object.yhje[ll_row]
					END IF
					IF IsNull(ldc_yhje) THEN ldc_yhje = 0
					ldc_yhje_sum += ldc_yhje
					//					ld_sl = ds_yjk.Object.sl[ll_row]
					ld_szfbl = ds_yjk.Object.szfbl[ll_row]
					IF IsNull(ld_szfbl) THEN ld_szfbl = 1
					SELECT fymc Into :ls_xmmc From gy_ylsf Where fyxh = :ll_bh Using sqlca;
					IF sqlca.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
						SELECT fymc INTO :ls_xmmc FROM gy_ylsf
							Where fyxh = :ll_bh Using sqlca;
						IF sqlca.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
							ls_xmmc = ''
							gf_applog(String(ll_bh) +"  获取收费项目名称失败：(yjlsh = '"+String(ldc_yjlsh)+"')" + sqlca.SQLErrText)
						END IF
					END IF
					IF IsNull(ls_xmmc) THEN ls_xmmc = ''
					li_index = ds_sfmx.InsertRow(0)
					ds_sfmx.Object.fplsh[li_index] = ls_fplsh
					ds_sfmx.Object.brbm[li_index] = ls_brbm
					ds_sfmx.Object.brxm[li_index] = gf_midstring(ls_brxm,20)
					ds_sfmx.Object.xmlsh[li_index] = ll_bh
					ds_sfmx.Object.cdlsh[li_index] = 0
					ds_sfmx.Object.sfxm[li_index] = ll_sfxm
					ds_sfmx.Object.tjxm[li_index] = ll_tjxm
					ds_sfmx.Object.xmmc[li_index] = ls_xmmc
					ds_sfmx.Object.ywlsh[li_index] = ldc_yjlsh
					ds_sfmx.Object.ywlx[li_index] = 'YJ'
					ds_sfmx.Object.xmdj[li_index] = ld_xmdj
					ds_sfmx.Object.xmsl[li_index] = ld_sl
					ds_sfmx.Object.zjje[li_index] = Round(ld_xmdj * ld_sl,2 ) //ld_jzje + ld_zfje
					ds_sfmx.Object.zfje[li_index] = ld_zfje
					ds_sfmx.Object.yhje[li_index] = ldc_yhje
					ds_sfmx.Object.zfbl[li_index] = ld_szfbl
					ds_sfmx.Object.ysbm[li_index] = ls_ysbm
					ds_sfmx.Object.yqbm[li_index] = ll_yybz
					ds_sfmx.Object.ztbz[li_index] = 0
					ds_sfmx.Object.sfybm[li_index] = '9999'
					ds_sfmx.Object.sfsj[li_index] = ldt_kpsj
					ds_sfmx.Object.sjpjh[li_index] = '0'
					ds_sfmx.Object.mxxh[li_index] = 0
					ds_sfmx.Object.czybm[li_index] = ls_czybm
				END IF
			NEXT
			
			//将取出来的流水号在处方库里检索一遍,如果有则生成发票明细和发票
			li_cfkrowcount = ds_cfk.Retrieve(ls_fplsh,ls_brbm)
			IF li_cfkrowcount > 0 THEN
				FOR ll_row = 1 To li_cfkrowcount
					ldc_cflsh = ds_cfk.Object.cflsh[ll_row]
					IF ds_sfmx.Find("ywlx = 'CF' AND YWLSH = "+String(ldc_cflsh),1,ds_sfmx.RowCount()) > 0 THEN CONTINUE
					ls_ysbm = ds_cfk.Object.ysbm[ll_row]
					ls_czbz = Lower(ds_cfk.Object.fybz[ll_row])
					
					//----------------------------
					CHOOSE CASE Upper(ds_cfk.Object.cflb[ll_row])
						CASE '1','M','J','J2','J1','D' //cflb,小写变大写
							ls_sfxm = '1' //sfxm由01->1
							ll_sfxm = 1
						CASE 'K' //颗粒
							ls_sfxm = '3'
							ll_sfxm = 3
						CASE ELSE
							ls_sfxm = Upper(ds_cfk.Object.cflb[ll_row])
							ll_sfxm  = Long(ls_sfxm)
							IF ll_sfxm = 0 THEN ll_sfxm = 1
					END CHOOSE
					ls_tjm = ls_sfxm
					ll_tjxm = ll_sfxm
					IF ls_czbz = 'z' THEN
						ld_jzje = 0
						ld_zfje = 0
						ldc_yhje = 0
					ELSE
						lb_qtbz = False
						ld_jzje = ds_cfk.Object.jzje[ll_row]
						ld_zfje = ds_cfk.Object.zfje[ll_row]
						ldc_yhje = ds_cfk.Object.yhje[ll_row]
						IF IsNull(ld_jzje) THEN
							ld_jzje = 0
						END IF
						IF IsNull(ld_zfje) THEN
							ld_zfje = 0
						END IF
						IF IsNull(ldc_yhje) THEN ldc_yhje = 0
					END IF
					ld_sumjzje += ld_jzje
					ld_sumzfje += ld_zfje
					//				ldc_yhje_sum += ldc_yhje
					ld_sum_xmzje = ld_sumjzje + ld_sumzfje
					ll_cfmxcount = ds_cfmx.Retrieve(ldc_cflsh)
					//生成发票明细,插入发票明细库中
					IF ll_cfmxcount > 0 THEN
						IF ds_cfmx.Find( 'yhms = 1', 1, 9999) > 0 THEN ll_yhms = 1
						FOR j = 1 To ll_cfmxcount
							ll_ypxh = ds_cfmx.Object.ypxh[j]
							ll_ypcd = ds_cfmx.Object.ypcd[j]
							ld_lsh = ds_cfmx.Object.xh[j]
							ld_xmdj = ds_cfmx.Object.dj[j]
							IF ls_czbz = 'z' THEN
								ld_mx_jzje = 0
								ld_mx_zfje = 0
								ldc_yhje = 0
								ld_sl = 0
							ELSE
								lb_qtbz = False
								ld_mx_jzje = ds_cfmx.Object.jzje[j]
								ld_mx_zfje = ds_cfmx.Object.zfje[j]
								ldc_yhje = ds_cfmx.Object.yhje[j]
								ld_sl = ds_cfmx.Object.fs[j] * ds_cfmx.Object.sl[j]
								IF IsNull(ld_mx_jzje) THEN
									ld_mx_jzje = 0
								END IF
								IF IsNull(ld_mx_zfje) THEN
									ld_mx_zfje = 0
								END IF
							END IF
							IF IsNull(ldc_yhje) THEN ldc_yhje = 0
							ldc_yhje_sum = ldc_yhje_sum + ldc_yhje
							ld_szfbl = ds_cfmx.Object.szfbl[j]
							IF IsNull(ld_szfbl) THEN ld_szfbl = 0
							SELECT ypmc Into :ls_xmmc From yk_typk Where ypxh = :ll_ypxh Using sqlca;
							IF sqlca.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
								gf_applog(String(ll_ypxh) +"  获取褼AT* ┢访�称失败� (cflsh = '"+String(ldc_cflsh)+"')" + sqlca.SQLErrText)
								ls_xmmc = ''
							END IF
							li_index = ds_sfmx.InsertRow(0)
							ds_sfmx.Object.fplsh[li_index] = ls_fplsh
							ds_sfmx.Object.brbm[li_index] = ls_brbm
							ds_sfmx.Object.brxm[li_index] = gf_midstring(ls_brxm,20)
							ds_sfmx.Object.xmlsh[li_index] = ll_ypxh
							ds_sfmx.Object.cdlsh[li_index] = ll_ypcd
							ds_sfmx.Object.sfxm[li_index] = ll_sfxm
							ds_sfmx.Object.tjxm[li_index] = ll_tjxm
							ds_sfmx.Object.xmmc[li_index] = ls_xmmc
							ds_sfmx.Object.ywlsh[li_index] = ldc_cflsh
							ds_sfmx.Object.ywlx[li_index] = 'CF'
							ds_sfmx.Object.xmdj[li_index] = ld_xmdj
							ds_sfmx.Object.xmsl[li_index] = ld_sl
							ds_sfmx.Object.zjje[li_index] = Round(ld_xmdj * ld_sl,2) //ld_mx_jzje + ld_mx_zfje
							ds_sfmx.Object.zfje[li_index] = ld_mx_zfje
							ds_sfmx.Object.yhje[li_index] = ldc_yhje
							ds_sfmx.Object.zfbl[li_index] = ld_szfbl
							ds_sfmx.Object.ysbm[li_index] = ls_ysbm
							ds_sfmx.Object.yqbm[li_index] = ll_yybz
							ds_sfmx.Object.ztbz[li_index] = 0
							ds_sfmx.Object.sfybm[li_index] = '9999'
							ds_sfmx.Object.sfsj[li_index] = ldt_kpsj
							ds_sfmx.Object.sjpjh[li_index] = '0'
							ds_sfmx.Object.mxxh[li_index] = ld_lsh
							ds_sfmx.Object.czybm[li_index] = '0'
						NEXT
					END IF
				NEXT
			END IF
			
			
			
			IF ds_fpk.RowCount() = 0 Or  ds_sfmx.RowCount( ) = 0 THEN
				gf_applog("fpk，sfmx结转后明细为空" + ls_fplsh)
				CONTINUE
			ELSE
				IF ldc_ce <> ld_sum_xmzje THEN
					gf_applog("差额和新增明细总额不一致：" +String(ldc_ce) +'--' + String(ld_sum_xmzje)+ + 'fplsh:'+ ls_fplsh)
					CONTINUE
				END IF
				IF ll_yhms = 1  THEN
					ds_fpk.Object.xmzje[1] = ds_fpk.Object.xmzje[1] + ld_sum_xmzje + ldc_yhje_sum
				ELSE
					ds_fpk.Object.xmzje[1] = ds_fpk.Object.xmzje[1] + ld_sum_xmzje
				END IF
				ds_fpk.Object.xjje[1] = ds_fpk.Object.xjje[1] + ld_sum_xmzje
				ds_fpk.Object.yhje[1] = ds_fpk.Object.yhje[1] + ldc_yhje_sum
			END IF
			gf_begin_transaction(sqlca)
			IF ds_sfmx.Update() <> 1 THEN
				gf_rollback_transaction(sqlca)
				gf_applog("ds_sfmx,更新失败：" + ds_sfmx.is_error+ ls_fplsh)
				CONTINUE
			END IF
			
			IF  ds_fpk.Update() <> 1   THEN
				gf_rollback_transaction(sqlca)
				gf_applog("ds_fpk更新失败：" + ds_fpk.is_error+ ls_fplsh)
				CONTINUE
			END IF
			gf_commit_transaction(sqlca)
			gf_applog("更新成功：" + ls_fplsh)
		END IF
	NEXT
END IF

IF IsValid(ds_sfmx) THEN Destroy ds_sfmx
IF IsValid(ds_fpk) THEN Destroy ds_fpk
IF IsValid(ds_yjk) THEN Destroy ds_yjk
IF IsValid(ds_yjk2_sfxm) THEN Destroy ds_yjk2_sfxm
IF IsValid(ds_cfk) THEN Destroy ds_cfk
IF IsValid(ds_cfmx) THEN Destroy ds_cfmx

end event

IF ldc_count > 0 THEN
	
	
	FOR ldc_row = 1 To ldc_count
//		IF Time(tab_1.tabpage_4.dw_8.Object.rq[ldc_row]) = Time(23:59:59) THEN

            if ldc_row = ldc_count then continue
				ldc_row ++
				GOTO Begin
			ELSE
				gf_splitparm_sms(ls_bzxx,ls_pjs,'  ')
				ll_pjs = UpperBound(ls_pjs)
				FOR ll_cur = 1 To ll_pjs
					IF Trim(ls_pjs[ll_cur])  = '' Or IsNull(ls_pjs[ll_cur]) THEN CONTINUE
					ls_pjsmx = ls_null
					gf_splitparm_sms(ls_pjs[ll_cur],ls_pjsmx,'-')
					ll_mxpjs = UpperBound(ls_pjsmx)
					IF ll_mxpjs <> 2 THEN
						gf_applog(ls_pjs[ll_cur] + '有问题')
						if ldc_row = ldc_count then continue
						ldc_row ++
						GOTO Begin
					ELSE
						ldc_pjs_TEMP = Dec(ls_pjsmx[2]) - Dec(ls_pjsmx[1]) + 1
						ldc_pjs = ldc_pjs + ldc_pjs_TEMP
					END IF
				NEXT
			END IF
//		END IF
		tab_1.tabpage_4.dw_8.Object.dqsjkcs[ldc_row] = ldc_pjs
	NEXT
END IF



end event

event doubleclicked;call super::doubleclicked;IF row <= 0 Or row > This.RowCount( ) THEN RETURN
IF tab_1.tabpage_4.dw_8.DataObject = 'd_zypj_cl' THEN
	
	
	String ls_zsm,ls_xm,ls_pjlx,ls_error
	DateTime ldt_rq
	Long ll_kcbc
	ls_zsm = This.Object.zsm[row]
	ldt_rq = This.Object.rq[row]
	ls_xm = This.Object.xm[row]
	ls_pjlx = This.Object.pjlx[row]
	IF This.Object.bqkcs[row] < 0 THEN
		ll_kcbc = This.Object.bqkcs[row] * -1
		UPDATE gy_pjsfc SET bqkcs = 0, sys = sys - :ll_kcbc,dqsjkcs = 0
			Where zsm = :ls_zsm And pjlx = :ls_pjlx  And rq = :ldt_rq ;
			
		IF sqlca.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
			ls_error = sqlca.SQLErrText
			ROLLBACK Using sqlca;
			MessageBox('1','sb'  + ls_error)
			RETURN
		END IF
		ldt_rq = This.Object.rq[row + 1]
		UPDATE gy_pjsfc SET sqkcs = 0, sys = sys + :ll_kcbc
			Where zsm = :ls_zsm And pjlx = :ls_pjlx  And rq = :ldt_rq ;
			
		IF sqlca.SQLCode = 0 THEN
			COMMIT Using sqlca;
			MessageBox('1','cg')
		ELSE
			ls_error = sqlca.SQLErrText
			ROLLBACK Using sqlca;
			MessageBox('2','sb'  + ls_error)
		END IF
		ldt_rq = This.Object.rq[row]
		em_3.setdate(RelativeDate(Date(ldt_rq),-1))
	ELSE
		ll_kcbc = Long(gf_inputbox('请输入需要补差的差','0'))
		em_3.setdate(RelativeDate(Date(ldt_rq),-1))
		UPDATE gy_pjsfc SET bqkcs = bqkcs  - :ll_kcbc, sys = sys + :ll_kcbc
			Where zsm = :ls_zsm And pjlx = :ls_pjlx  And rq = :ldt_rq ;
			
		IF sqlca.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
			ls_error = sqlca.SQLErrText
			ROLLBACK Using sqlca;
			MessageBox('1','sb'  + ls_error)
			RETURN
		END IF
		UPDATE gy_pjsfc SET bqkcs = bqkcs  - :ll_kcbc, sqkcs = sqkcs - :ll_kcbc
			Where zsm = :ls_zsm And pjlx = :ls_pjlx  And rq > :ldt_rq ;
			
		IF sqlca.SQLCode = 0 THEN
			COMMIT Using sqlca;
			MessageBox('1','cg')
		ELSE
			ls_error = sqlca.SQLErrText
			ROLLBACK Using sqlca;
			MessageBox('2','sb'  + ls_error)
		END IF
	END IF
END IF

Union All 
SELECT sum(ylfze) * -1 zje,sum(nvl(hjbxje,0)) * -1 je,brbm FROM jkxt.lsyb_jsmx

SELECT lb,
		 0 as JBRC,
		SUM(FPZE) as FPZE,
		SUM(KBJE) as KBJE,
		SUM(SBJE - NVL(DBBZ,0)) as SBJE ,
      sum(NVL(DBBZ,0)) AS DBBZ,
      0 as KJRC,
      0 as KJBS,
      0 as KJJE,
      SUM(SBJE) as ZBCJE,
      SUM(SBJE) as SJBFJE,
      SUM(JTGJ) AS JTGJZHZF,
      SUM(YLJZ) AS YLJZ,
      SUM(JTGJ) AS JTGJZHZF,
      0 AS YLJZRC
FROM

event ue_ref;call super::ue_ref;datetime ldt_start,ldt_end
dec {2}  ld_xmzje,ld_jzje,ld_xjje 
string ls_ysbm,ls_sj
long ll_find,ll_count,i

dw_main.reset()

ldt_start=datetime(em_begin.getdate(),time('00:00:00'))
ldt_end=datetime(relativedate(em_end.getdate(),1),time('00:00:00'))

string ls_bz
ls_bz = ddlb_zhlb.getcode( )
if lower(ls_bz)='z' then 
	ls_bz = 'z'
else
   ls_bz = upper(ls_bz)
end if

dw_main.retrieve(ldt_start,ldt_end,ls_bz)

ll_count=dw_main.rowcount()
if ll_count<=0 then 
	messagebox('提示','该时间段没有当前类别病人的交易数据')
	return 
end if

dw_main.object.title.text=Base_info.Hospital+'门诊医疗保险病人费用结算明细表'
dw_main.object.tjrq.text='统计日期： '+string(ldt_start,'yyyy.mm.dd')+ ' 至 '+string(relativedate(date(ldt_end),-1),'yyyy.mm.dd')
dw_main.object.zbr.text = base_info.username
		 
end event

event ue_open;call super::ue_open;//sqlca_query = Create Transaction
//uo_support.SetTransObject(sqlca_query)
//IF Not uo_support.dbconnect(gs_ini,"Database_TJ") THEN

IF IsValid(sqlca_query) = True THEN
	IF sqlca_query.DBHandle( ) > 0 THEN
	ELSE
		uo_support.SetTransObject(sqlca_query)
		IF Not uo_support.dbconnect(gs_ini,"Database_TJ") THEN
			uo_support.SetTransObject(sqlca)
			messagebox('提示1','查询数据库连接失败！')
			RETURN
		END IF
		uo_support.SetTransObject(sqlca)
	END IF
ELSE
	sqlca_query = Create Transaction
	uo_support.SetTransObject(sqlca_query)
	IF Not uo_support.dbconnect(gs_ini,"Database_TJ") THEN
		uo_support.SetTransObject(sqlca)
		messagebox('提示2','查询数据库连接失败！')
		RETURN
	END IF
	uo_support.SetTransObject(sqlca)
END IF

lds_yblb.DataObject = 'd_yblx'
lds_yblb.SetTransObject(sqlca_query)
lds_yblb.Retrieve()
li_rowscount = lds_yblb.RowCount()
ddlb_zhlb.reset( )
ddlb_zhlb.AddItem('z','全部','全部')
IF li_rowscount > 0 THEN
	FOR i = 1 To li_rowscount
		ddlb_zhlb.AddItem(String(lds_yblb.Object.yblx[i]) ,String(lds_yblb.Object.dwmc[i])+'['+String(lds_yblb.Object.yblx[i])+']',String(lds_yblb.Object.dwmc[i]))
	NEXT
END IF
ddlb_zhlb.itemselect('z')
dw_main.settransobject(sqlca_query)
Destroy lds_yblb
end event

public subroutine wf_filter ();String ls_bz,ls_filter,ls_title
ls_bz = ddlb_zhlb.getcode( )

ls_filter = ''
ls_title = ''
IF Lower(ls_bz) = 'z' THEN
	ls_filter = ''
ELSEIF Lower(ls_bz) = 'y' THEN
	ls_filter = "cbrlb <> 'E00'"
	ls_title = "(" + ddlb_zhlb.text + ")"
ELSE
	ls_filter = "cbrlb = '"+ls_bz+"'"
	ls_title = "(" + ddlb_zhlb.text + ")"
END IF

IF rb_yd.Checked THEN
	IF ls_filter > ''  then
		ls_filter += " AND "
	END IF
	ls_filter += " lx = 'YD'"
	ls_title += "-----异地"
ELSEIF rb_bd.Checked THEN
	IF ls_filter > ''  then
		ls_filter += " AND "
	END IF
	ls_filter += "lx = 'BD'"
	ls_title += "-----本地"
END IF

dw_main.SetFilter( ls_filter)
dw_main.Filter( )

dw_main.Object.Title.Text = Base_info.Hospital + '门诊医疗保险病人费用结算明细表' + ls_title
end subroutine

event ue_ref;call super::ue_ref;DateTime ldt_start,ldt_end
Long ll_count
String ls_ywlx,ls_title
Integer li_byd = 0
dw_main.Reset()

ldt_start = DateTime(em_begin.getdate(),Time('00:00:00'))
ldt_end = DateTime(RelativeDate(em_end.getdate(),1),Time('00:00:00'))
IF rb_mz.Checked THEN
	ls_title = '医保公费门诊记账计算总表'
ELSEIF rb_zy.Checked THEN
	ls_title = '医保公费住院记账计算总表'
END IF
IF is_yqpd = 'CNSY' THEN
	IF rb_qb.Checked THEN
		li_byd = 0
		ls_title = ls_title
	ELSEIF rb_bd.Checked THEN
		li_byd = 1
		ls_title = ls_title + '（本地）'
	ELSEIF rb_yd.Checked THEN
		li_byd = 2
		ls_title = ls_title + '（异地）'
	END IF
	dw_main.Retrieve(ldt_start,ldt_end,li_byd)
	dw_main.Object.t_yymc.Text = base_info.hospital
	dw_main.Object.title.Text = String(ldt_start,'yyyy年mm月dd日')+ ' 至 '+String(RelativeDate(Date(ldt_end),-1),'yyyy年mm月dd日') + ls_title
ELSE
	dw_main.Retrieve(ldt_start,ldt_end)
	//过滤
	wf_filter()
	//dw_main.Object.Title.Text = Base_info.Hospital + '门诊医疗保险病人费用结算明细表'
END IF
//-------------------------------
dw_main.Object.tjrq.Text = '统计日期：'+String(ldt_start,'yyyy.mm.dd')+ ' 至 '+String(RelativeDate(Date(ldt_end),-1),'yyyy.mm.dd')
dw_main.Object.zbr.Text = Base_info.username
ll_count = dw_main.RowCount()
IF ll_count <= 0 THEN
	MessageBox('提示','该时间段没有当前类别病人的交易数据')
END IF

end event

event ue_open;call super::ue_open;IF IsValid(sqlca_query) = True THEN
	IF sqlca_query.DBHandle( ) > 0 THEN
	ELSE
		uo_support.SetTransObject(sqlca_query)
		IF Not uo_support.dbconnect(gs_ini,"Database_TJ") THEN
			uo_support.SetTransObject(sqlca)
			MessageBox('提示1','查询数据库连接失败！')
			RETURN
		END IF
		uo_support.SetTransObject(sqlca)
	END IF
ELSE
	sqlca_query = Create Transaction
	uo_support.SetTransObject(sqlca_query)
	IF Not uo_support.dbconnect(gs_ini,"Database_TJ") THEN
		uo_support.SetTransObject(sqlca)
		MessageBox('提示2','查询数据库连接失败！')
		RETURN
	END IF
	uo_support.SetTransObject(sqlca)
END IF

is_yqpd = Upper(gf_getpara(base_info.syscode,"YQPD",'PYEY',"院区判断"))
IF is_yqpd = 'CNSY' THEN
	rb_zy.checked = true
	rb_mz.checked = false
	dw_main.dataobject = 'd_sb_mxbb_zycnsy'
ELSE
	rb_mz.checked = true
	rb_zy.checked = false
	dw_main.dataobject = 'd_sb_mxbb_py'
END IF
datastore lds_yblb
int li_rowscount,i
em_begin.setdate( date(gf_server_date()))
em_end.setdate( date(gf_server_date()))

if not isvalid(lds_yblb) then lds_yblb = Create datastore
lds_yblb.DataObject = 'dd_cbrlb'
lds_yblb.SetTransObject(sqlca_query)
lds_yblb.Retrieve()
li_rowscount = lds_yblb.RowCount()

ddlb_zhlb.reset( )
ddlb_zhlb.AddItem('z','全部','全部')
ddlb_zhlb.AddItem('y','医保','医保')
IF li_rowscount > 0 THEN
	FOR i = 1 To li_rowscount
		ddlb_zhlb.AddItem(String(lds_yblb.Object.dmsb[i]) ,String(lds_yblb.Object.dmmc[i])+'['+String(lds_yblb.Object.dmsb[i])+']',String(lds_yblb.Object.pydm[i]))
	NEXT
END IF
ddlb_zhlb.itemselect('z')
dw_main.settransobject( sqlca_query)
Destroy lds_yblb

end event

event ue_find;call super::ue_find;Int i,li_count,li_row
Long ll_find
DateTime ldt_start,ldt_end
datastore lds_sbjymx
String ls_jymx_yblx,ls_tgdw_yblx,ls_yblx,ls_zbrxm,ls_zbrbm,ls_dwmc
Dec ldc_sjzs,ldc_jzrc,ldc_sjzs_t
Dec {2} ldc_fpjzje,ld_jzce
ls_zbrxm = base_info.username
ls_zbrbm = base_info.UserID
ls_dwmc = ddlb_yblb.Text
ldt_start = DateTime(Date(em_1.Text),Time('00:00:00'))
ldt_end = DateTime(RelativeDate(Date(em_2.Text),1),Time('00:00:00'))

if date(ldt_start) > date(2011,9,2) or  date(ldt_end) > date(2011,9,3) then
	messagebox('提示','20110903之前和以后的数据请分开统计，20110903之后的数据请在新医保月汇总报表中统计!')
	return
end if
dw_main.Reset( )
ls_yblx = ddlb_yblb.getcode()
lds_sbjymx = Create datastore
lds_sbjymx.DataObject = 'd_sbjymx'
lds_sbjymx.SetTransObject(sqlca_query)
lds_sbjymx.Retrieve(ldt_start, ldt_end)
dw_main.SetTransObject(sqlca_query)
dw_main.Retrieve(ls_yblx)
li_count = lds_sbjymx.RowCount( )
li_row = dw_main.RowCount( )
gf_waiting('正在统计报表,请稍候......',1)
IF li_count > 0 THEN
	IF li_row > 0 THEN
		FOR i = 1 To li_row
			gf_waiting('正在统计报表,请稍候......',(i*100/li_row))
			ll_find = 0
			ldc_sjzs = 0
			ldc_fpjzje = 0.00
			ls_tgdw_yblx = dw_main.Object.yblx[i]
			ll_find = lds_sbjymx.Find( "yblx='"+String(ls_tgdw_yblx)+"'", 1, li_count)
			IF ll_find > 0 THEN
				SELECT  nvl(count(Distinct(fplsh)),0) Into :ldc_sjzs From sb_jymx Where xmlb Not In ('GH') And substr(zhbz,1,1) = :ls_tgdw_yblx And jssj >= :ldt_start And jssj < :ldt_end And nvl(zymz,'0') = '0' And zxlsh Is Not Null And jylx In ('RA11','RA01') using sqlca_query;
				SELECT  nvl(count(Distinct(fplsh)),0) Into :ldc_sjzs_t From sb_jymx Where xmlb Not In ('GH') And substr(zhbz,1,1) = :ls_tgdw_yblx And jssj >= :ldt_start And jssj < :ldt_end And nvl(zymz,'0') = '0' And zxlsh Is Not Null And jylx In ('SD01','RD01') using sqlca_query;
				
				SELECT  sum(NVL(dnzfs,0) + NVL(qfddnzhzfs,0) + NVL(lnzfs,0) + NVL(tcdtczfs,0) + NVL(qfdgbzfs,0) + NVL(tcdgbzfs,0) + NVL(jzdgbzfs,0) + NVL(jzdsgbzfs,0) + NVL(gbzfs,0)   + NVL(jzdjzzfs,0) + NVL(zyjjzfs,0) + NVL(jmjjzf,0) + NVL(tcdjjzfs,0) + NVL(jzzfs,0) + NVL(qfdlnzhzfs,0) + NVL(jzdslnzhzfs,0) + NVL(tcdlnzhzfs,0)) As jzje INTO :ldc_fpjzje FROM sb_jymx
					Where substr(zhbz,1,1) = :ls_tgdw_yblx And zxlsh Is Not Null And xmlb <> 'GH' And nvl(zymz,'0') = '0' And jssj >= :ldt_start And jssj < :ldt_end using sqlca_query;
				//				SELECT  nvl(Sum(mz_fpk.jzje),0) into :ldc_fpjzje From mz_fpk,gy_brxz,gy_tgdw Where mz_fpk.jslb=gy_brxz.brxz and gy_brxz.ybpb=1 And gy_brxz.brxz=gy_tgdw.brxz And gy_tgdw.tgdw=mz_fpk.jsdw And  gy_tgdw.yblx=:ls_tgdw_yblx;
				SELECT  nvl(Count(jzlsh),0) INTO :ldc_jzrc FROM mz_jzxx,gy_brxz,gy_tgdw,mz_ghxx
					WHERE mz_ghxx.jslb = gy_brxz.brxz AND gy_brxz.ybpb = 1 AND gy_brxz.brxz = gy_tgdw.brxz AND
					gy_tgdw.tgdw = mz_ghxx.jsdw And mz_ghxx.ghlsh = mz_jzxx.ghlsh  And gy_tgdw.yblx = :ls_tgdw_yblx  And mz_ghxx.ghrq >= :ldt_start And mz_ghxx.ghrq < :ldt_end using sqlca_query;
				IF IsNull(ldc_sjzs) THEN ldc_sjzs = 0
				IF IsNull(ldc_sjzs_t) THEN ldc_sjzs_t = 0
				dw_main.Object.jzje[i] = lds_sbjymx.Object.jzje[ll_find]
				dw_main.Object.zfje[i] = lds_sbjymx.Object.xjje[ll_find]
				dw_main.Object.sjzs[i] = ldc_sjzs - ldc_sjzs_t
				dw_main.Object.fpjzje[i] = ldc_fpjzje
				dw_main.Object.jzrc[i] = ldc_jzrc
			END IF
		NEXT
	ELSE
		gf_waiting('正在统计报表,请稍候......',-1)
		Destroy lds_sbjymx
		MessageBox('提示','检索社保类型失败，请退出程序重试！')
		RETURN
	END IF
END IF
Long ll_count,ll_cur
ll_count = dw_main.RowCount( )
IF ll_count > 0 THEN
	FOR ll_cur = 1 To ll_count
		IF dw_main.Object.compute_hjje[ll_cur] = 0 THEN
			dw_main.DeleteRow(ll_cur)
			ll_cur --
			ll_count --
		END IF
	NEXT
END IF
SELECT sum(jzce) Into :ld_jzce From sb_jejd Where kpsj >= :ldt_start And kpsj < :ldt_end using sqlca_query;
IF IsNull(ld_jzce) THEN ld_jzce = 0
//9月份存在-132.07的交易补差额
IF ld_jzce <> 0 THEN
	st_text.Text = em_1.Text+"至"+em_2.Text+",记账共计差：" +String(ld_jzce)
ELSEIF ld_jzce = 0  THEN
	st_text.Text = ''
END IF
dw_main.Object.t_dwmc.Text = '温州市社会保障局'+'['+ls_dwmc+']'

Destroy lds_sbjymx
