event ue_zxdz();String ls_dzr, ls_return, ls_dzjg
Long ll_jyzbs, ll_zcxfbs, ll_tkjybs
Decimal{2} ldc_zfzje, ldc_zcxfje, ldc_tkjyje

Boolean lb_smkdz

//判断是否统计汇总过，汇总日期是否与显示一致
IF IsNull(idt_begin) Or IsNull(idt_end) Or dw_1.RowCount( ) <= 0 Or IsNull(dw_1.Object.qsrq[1]) THEN
	MessageBox('提示','请先汇总统计，再对账')
	RETURN
ELSE
	ls_dzr = dw_1.Object.qsrq[1]
	IF IsNull(ls_dzr) THEN
		MessageBox('提示','请先汇总统计，再对账')
		RETURN
	ELSE
		IF String(em_1.getdate( ),'yyyymmdd') <> ls_dzr Or Date(idt_begin) <> em_1.getdate( ) THEN
			MessageBox('提示','对账时间' + String(em_1.getdate( ),'yyyymmdd') + '与对账信息汇总中的对账菵AT* ' + ls_dzr + '不一致,请重新统计汇总')
			RETURN
		END IF
	END IF
END IF

ls_dzr = dw_1.Object.qsrq[1]
ll_jyzbs = dw_1.Object.jyzbs[1]
ldc_zfzje = dw_1.Object.zhzfzje[1]
ll_zcxfbs = dw_1.Object.zcxfbs[1]
ldc_zcxfje = dw_1.Object.zhzcxfje[1]
ll_tkjybs = dw_1.Object.tkjybs[1]
ldc_tkjyje = dw_1.Object.tkjyje[1]

IF gu_ybjk_public.is_ybkfs ='EP'  THEN
	IF IsValid (gu_pyybjk) = False THEN //创建医保接口
		gu_pyybjk = Create u_pyybjk_his
		IF Not gu_pyybjk.uf_init(ls_return) THEN
			MessageBox('提示', '医保接口初始化失败:' + ls_return)
			RETURN
		END IF
	END IF
	gu_pyybjk.uf_send_init('110')
	gu_pyybjk.uf_send_add('是否有医保卡','0')
	gu_pyybjk.uf_send_add('IC信息','')
	gu_pyybjk.uf_send_add('现金支付方式','1')
	gu_pyybjk.uf_send_add('银行卡信息','')
	gu_pyybjk.uf_send_add('清算日期',ls_dzr)
	gu_pyybjk.uf_send_add('交易总笔数',Right('000000' + String(ll_jyzbs),6))
	gu_pyybjk.uf_send_add('账户支付总金额',ldc_zfzje)
	gu_pyybjk.uf_send_add('正常消费笔数',Right('000000' + String(ll_zcxfbs),6))
	gu_pyybjk.uf_send_add('账户正常消费金额',ldc_zcxfje)
	gu_pyybjk.uf_send_add('退款交易笔数',Right('000000' + String(ll_tkjybs),6))
	gu_pyybjk.uf_send_add('退款交易金额',ldc_tkjyje)
	lb_smkdz = gu_pyybjk.uf_send(ls_return)
	IF lb_smkdz THEN
		ls_dzjg = gu_pyybjk.uf_getstring("对帐结果")
		dw_1.Object.dzjg[1] = ls_dzjg
		IF ls_dzjg = '1' THEN
			dw_1.Object.sctgsj[1] = gf_server_date()
		END IF
		gf_begin_transaction(sqlca)
		IF dw_1.Update( ) = 1 THEN
			gf_commit_transaction(sqlca)
			dw_1.Retrieve(ls_dzr)
			tab_1.tabpage_dzxx.dw_dzxx.Retrieve(Left(ls_dzr,6))
			MessageBox("提示", "对账结果：" + ls_dzjg + "," + String(dw_1.Describe("Evaluate('LookUpDisplay(dzjg)', 1)")) )
		ELSE
			gf_rollback_transaction(sqlca)
			MessageBox("提示", ls_dzr + '对账结果：' + ls_dzjg + ",保存失败!")
		END IF
	ELSE
		MessageBox("提示", '市民卡对账失败。' + ls_return)
	END IF
ELSE
	gu_ybjk_public.uf_send_init('K011')
	gu_ybjk_public.uf_send_add('清算日期',ls_dzr)
	gu_ybjk_public.uf_send_add('交易总笔数',Right('000000' + String(ll_jyzbs),6))
	gu_ybjk_public.uf_send_add('账户支付总金额',ldc_zfzje)
	gu_ybjk_public.uf_send_add('正常消费笔数',Right('000000' + String(ll_zcxfbs),6))
	gu_ybjk_public.uf_send_add('账户正常消费金额',ldc_zcxfje)
	gu_ybjk_public.uf_send_add('退款交易笔数',Right('000000' + String(ll_tkjybs),6))
	gu_ybjk_public.uf_send_add('退款交易金额',ldc_tkjyje)
	
	lb_smkdz = gu_ybjk_public.uf_send(ls_return)
	
	IF lb_smkdz THEN
		ls_dzjg = gu_ybjk_public.uf_getstring("对帐结果")
		dw_1.Object.dzjg[1] = ls_dzjg
		IF ls_dzjg = '1' THEN
			dw_1.Object.sctgsj[1] = gf_server_date()
		END IF
		gf_begin_transaction(sqlca)
		IF dw_1.Update( ) = 1 THEN
			gf_commit_transaction(sqlca)
			dw_1.Retrieve(ls_dzr)
			tab_1.tabpage_dzxx.dw_dzxx.Retrieve(Left(ls_dzr,6))
			MessageBox("提示", "对账结果：" + ls_dzjg + "," + String(dw_1.Describe("Evaluate('LookUpDisplay(dzjg)', 1)")) )
		ELSE
			gf_rollback_transaction(sqlca)
			MessageBox("提示", ls_dzr + '对账结果：' + ls_dzjg + ",保存失败!")
		END IF
	ELSE
		MessageBox("提示", '市民卡对账失败。' + ls_return)
	END IF
END IF


end event

event ue_mxsc();String ls_dzr, ls_dzjg, ls_return, ls_jsbz
Long ll_row, ll_rowcount, ll_mxtop, ll_i, ll_cur
Integer li_xhcs, li_jymxts

Boolean lb_return

String ls_cbd, ls_mxzdh, ls_jsjylsh
Dec{2} ldc_zhzfje = 0.00

IF IsNull(idt_begin) Or IsNull(idt_end) Or dw_1.RowCount( ) <= 0 Or IsNull(dw_1.Object.qsrq[1]) THEN
	MessageBox('提示','请先汇总统计，再对账')
	RETURN
ELSE
	ls_dzr = dw_1.Object.qsrq[1]
	IF String(em_1.getdate( ),'yyyymmdd') <> ls_dzr Or Date(idt_begin) <> em_1.getdate( ) THEN
		MessageBox('提示','对账时间' + String(em_1.getdate( ),'yyyymmdd') + '与对账信息汇总中的对账日' + ls_dzr + '不一致,请重新统计汇总')
		RETURN
	END IF
END IF

IF IsNull(dw_1.Object.dzjg[1]) Or dw_1.Object.dzjg[1] = '' THEN
	MessageBox('提示','请先对账，再确定是否要上传不平明细。')
	RETURN
END IF

IF dw_1.Object.dzjg[1] <> '0' THEN
	MessageBox('提示','市民卡对账已完成，无需上传市民卡账户不平明细。')
	RETURN
END IF

ll_rowcount = tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.RowCount( )
li_xhcs = Ceiling( ll_rowcount / ii_mxts )
IF gu_ybjk_public.is_ybkfs ='EP' THEN //gi_pyyq = 1 THEN
	IF IsValid(gu_pyybjk) = False THEN
		gu_pyybjk = Create u_pyybjk_his
		IF gu_pyybjk.uf_init(ls_return) = False THEN
			MessageBox("提示", '医保接口初始化失败:' + ls_return)
			RETURN
		END IF
	END IF
	
	FOR ll_i = 1 To li_xhcs
		gu_pyybjk.uf_send_init('111')	
		gu_pyybjk.uf_send_add('是否有医保卡','0')
		gu_pyybjk.uf_send_add('IC信息','')
		gu_pyybjk.uf_send_add('现金支付方式','1')
		gu_pyybjk.uf_send_add('银行卡信息','')
		gu_pyybjk.uf_send_add('清算日期',ls_dzr)
		IF ll_i * ii_mxts >= ll_rowcount THEN
			ll_mxtop = ll_rowcount
			li_jymxts = ll_rowcount - (ll_i - 1) * ii_mxts
			ls_jsbz = '1'
		ELSE
			ll_mxtop = ll_i * ii_mxts
			li_jymxts = ii_mxts
			ls_jsbz = '0'
		END IF
		gu_pyybjk.uf_send_add('交易流水循环体条数', Right('000000' +String(li_jymxts),6))
		gu_pyybjk.uf_send_add('是否上传结束', ls_jsbz)
		ll_cur = 0
		FOR ll_row = (ll_i - 1) * ii_mxts + 1 To ll_mxtop
			ls_cbd = tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.Object.cbdxzqh[ll_row]
			ls_mxzdh = tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.Object.mxzdh[ll_row]
			ls_jsjylsh = tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.Object.jylsh[ll_row]
			ldc_zhzfje = tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.Object.zhzfje[ll_row]
			IF ldc_zhzfje < 0 THEN
				ldc_zhzfje = -ldc_zhzfje
			END IF
			ll_cur ++
			gu_pyybjk.uf_send_add_in('参保地行政区划代码', ls_cbd, ll_cur)
			gu_pyybjk.uf_send_add_in('明细账单号', ls_mxzdh, ll_cur)
			gu_pyybjk.uf_send_add_in('市民卡交易流水号', ls_jsjylsh, ll_cur)
			gu_pyybjk.uf_send_add_in('账户支付金额', ldc_zhzfje, ll_cur)
			gu_pyybjk.uf_send_add_in('清算日期', ls_dzr, ll_cur)
		NEXT
		lb_return = gu_pyybjk.uf_send(ls_return)
		IF Not lb_return THEN
			MessageBox('提示','市民卡账户明细上传失败，请重新上传。' + ls_return)
			
			gu_pyybjk.uf_send_init('111')	
			gu_pyybjk.uf_send_add('是否有医保卡','0')
			gu_pyybjk.uf_send_add('IC信息','')
			gu_pyybjk.uf_send_add('现金支付方式','1')
			gu_pyybjk.uf_send_add('银行卡信息','')
			gu_pyybjk.uf_send_add('清算日期',ls_dzr)
			gu_pyybjk.uf_send_add('交易流水循环体条数', '000000')
			gu_pyybjk.uf_send_add('是否上传结束', '1')
			gu_pyybjk.uf_send_add('交易流水循环体','')
			lb_return = gu_pyybjk.uf_send(ls_return)
			IF Not lb_return THEN
				MessageBox('提示', '市民卡账户明细上传失败处理异常，请用明细上传异常处理重试。')
			END IF
			RETURN
		END IF
		IF ls_jsbz = '1' THEN
			gu_pyybjk.uf_send_init('112')
			gu_pyybjk.uf_send_add('是否有医保卡','0')
			gu_pyybjk.uf_send_add('IC信息','')
			gu_pyybjk.uf_send_add('现金支付方式','1')
			gu_pyybjk.uf_send_add('银行卡信息','')
			gu_pyybjk.uf_send_add('清算日期',ls_dzr)
			
			lb_return = gu_pyybjk.uf_send(ls_return)
			
			IF Not lb_return THEN
				MessageBox('提示','市民卡对账结果查询失败，请重试。' + ls_return )
				RETURN
			ELSE
				ls_dzjg = gu_pyybjk.uf_getstring("对帐结果")
				dw_1.Object.dzjg[1] = ls_dzjg
				gf_begin_transaction(sqlca)
				IF dw_1.Update( ) = 1 THEN
					gf_commit_transaction(sqlca)
					dw_1.Retrieve(ls_dzr)
					tab_1.tabpage_dzxx.dw_dzxx.Retrieve(Left(ls_dzr,6))
					MessageBox("提示", "对账结果：" + ls_dzjg + "," + String(dw_1.Describe("Evaluate('LookUpDisplay(dzjg)', 1)")) )
				ELSE
					gf_rollback_transaction(sqlca)
					MessageBox("提示", ls_dzr + '对账结果：' + ls_dzjg + ",保存失败!")
				END IF
			END IF
			//	MessageBox('提示','市民卡账户明细上传成功。')
		END IF
	NEXT
ELSE
//	IF IsValid(gu_ybjk_public) = False THEN
//		gu_ybjk_public = Create u_ybjk_public
//		IF gu_ybjk_public.uf_init(ls_return) = False THEN
//			MessageBox("提示", '医保接口初始化失败:' + ls_return)
//			RETURN
//		END IF
//	END IF
	//w_smkdz.SetRedraw(False)
	FOR ll_i = 1 To li_xhcs
		gu_ybjk_public.uf_send_init('K012')
		gu_ybjk_public.uf_send_add('清算日期',ls_dzr)
		IF ll_i * ii_mxts >= ll_rowcount THEN
			ll_mxtop = ll_rowcount
			li_jymxts = ll_rowcount - (ll_i - 1) * ii_mxts
			ls_jsbz = '1'
		ELSE
			ll_mxtop = ll_i * ii_mxts
			li_jymxts = ii_mxts
			ls_jsbz = '0'
		END IF
		gu_ybjk_public.uf_send_add('交易流水循环体条数', Right('000000' +String(li_jymxts),6))
		gu_ybjk_public.uf_send_add('是否上传结束', ls_jsbz)
		//	gu_ybjk_new.uf_send_add('交易流水循环体','')
		ll_cur = 0
		FOR ll_row = (ll_i - 1) * ii_mxts + 1 To ll_mxtop
			ls_cbd = tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.Object.cbdxzqh[ll_row]
			ls_mxzdh = tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.Object.mxzdh[ll_row]
			ls_jsjylsh = tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.Object.jylsh[ll_row]
			ldc_zhzfje = tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.Object.zhzfje[ll_row]
			IF ldc_zhzfje < 0 THEN
				ldc_zhzfje = -ldc_zhzfje
			END IF
			ll_cur ++
			gu_ybjk_public.uf_send_add_in('参保地行政区划代码', ls_cbd, ll_cur)
			gu_ybjk_public.uf_send_add_in('明细账单号', ls_mxzdh, ll_cur)
			gu_ybjk_public.uf_send_add_in('市民卡交易流水号', ls_jsjylsh, ll_cur)
			gu_ybjk_public.uf_send_add_in('账户支付金额', ldc_zhzfje, ll_cur)
			gu_ybjk_public.uf_send_add_in('清算日期', ls_dzr, ll_cur)
		NEXT
		lb_return = gu_ybjk_public.uf_send(ls_return)
		IF Not lb_return THEN
			MessageBox('提示','市民卡账户明细上传失败，请重新上传。' + ls_return)
			
			gu_ybjk_public.uf_send_init('K012')
			gu_ybjk_public.uf_send_add('清算日期',ls_dzr)
			gu_ybjk_public.uf_send_add('交易流水循环体条数', '000000')
			gu_ybjk_public.uf_send_add('蔇AT* 欠裆洗�结� ', '1')
			gu_ybjk_public.uf_send_add('交易流水循环体','')
			lb_return = gu_ybjk_public.uf_send(ls_return)
			IF Not lb_return THEN
				MessageBox('提示', '市民卡账户明细上传失败处理异常，请用明细上传异常处理重试。')
			END IF
			//	w_smkdz.SetRedraw(true)
			RETURN
		END IF
		//END IF	
		IF ls_jsbz = '1' THEN
			gu_ybjk_public.uf_send_init('K013')
			gu_ybjk_public.uf_send_add('清算日期',ls_dzr)
			
			lb_return = gu_ybjk_public.uf_send(ls_return)
			
			IF Not lb_return THEN
				MessageBox('提示','市民卡对账结果查询失败，请重试。' + ls_return )
				RETURN
			ELSE
				ls_dzjg = gu_ybjk_public.uf_getstring("对帐结果")
				dw_1.Object.dzjg[1] = ls_dzjg
				gf_begin_transaction(sqlca)
				IF dw_1.Update( ) = 1 THEN
					gf_commit_transaction(sqlca)
					dw_1.Retrieve(ls_dzr)
					tab_1.tabpage_dzxx.dw_dzxx.Retrieve(Left(ls_dzr,6))
					MessageBox("提示", "对账结果：" + ls_dzjg + "," + String(dw_1.Describe("Evaluate('LookUpDisplay(dzjg)', 1)")) )
				ELSE
					gf_rollback_transaction(sqlca)
					MessageBox("提示", ls_dzr + '对账结果：' + ls_dzjg + ",保存失败!")
				END IF
			END IF
			//	MessageBox('提示','市民卡账户明细上传成功。')
		END IF
	NEXT
END IF
//w_smkdz.SetRedraw(true)



end event

public function integer wf_dzyz ();
u_datastore lds_bpmx
lds_bpmx = Create u_datastore

String ls_bpmx, ls_sql
Long ll_rowcount, ll_temp

gf_waiting('开始校验数据......',1)

//校验市民卡账户支付金额（医保）
//=======================核对==============================//
Dec{2} ldc_zhzfje, ldc_smkzhzf,ldc_smkzhzf_py

SELECT SUM(nvl(zhzfje,0)) INTO :ldc_zhzfje FROM jkxt.yb_zjjs
	Where qsrq >= :idt_begin And qsrq < :idt_end And (jslb = 'XF' Or jslb = 'TK') And ztbz > 0;
IF IsNull(ldc_zhzfje) THEN ldc_zhzfje = 0.00

gf_waiting('开始校验数据......',30)

SELECT SUM(nvl(smkzhzf,0)) INTO :ldc_smkzhzf FROM jkxt.yb_jsmx
	Where jssj >= :idt_begin And jssj < :idt_end And ztbz > 0;
IF IsNull(ldc_smkzhzf) THEN ldc_smkzhzf = 0.00
// add by sxl 平阳市民卡诊间结算
IF gi_pyyq = 1 THEN
	SELECT SUM(nvl(smkzhzf,0)) INTO :ldc_smkzhzf_py FROM jkxt.pyyb_jsmx
		Where jssj >= :idt_begin And jssj < :idt_end And ztbz > 0;
END IF
IF IsNull(ldc_smkzhzf_py) THEN ldc_smkzhzf_py = 0.00
gf_waiting('正在校验数据......',60)

IF ldc_zhzfje <> (ldc_smkzhzf + ldc_smkzhzf_py) THEN
	IF ldc_smkzhzf_py > 0 THEN
		ls_sql = "SELECT brbm, Sum(je) From " +&
			"(SELECT sum(nvl(zhzfje,0)) je, brbm From jkxt.yb_zjjs " +&
			"Where qsrq >= to_date('" + String(idt_begin) + "','yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss') " +&
			"And qsrq < to_date('" + String(idt_end) + "','yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss') And nvl(zhzfje,0) <> 0 " +&
			"And (jslb = 'XF' Or jslb = 'TK') And jylsh Is Not Null And ztbz > 0 Group By brbm " +&
			"Union All " +&
			"SELECT sum(nvl(smkzhzf,0)) * -1 je, brbm FROM jkxt.yb_jsmx " +&
			"Where jssj >= to_date('" + String(idt_begin) + "','yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss') " +&
			"And jssj < to_date('" + String(idt_end) + "','yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss') And nvl(smkzhzf,0) <> 0 " +&
			"And ztbz > 0 Group By brbm " +&
			"Union All " +&
			"SELECT sum(nvl(smkzhzf,0)) * -1 je, brbm FROM jkxt.pyyb_jsmx " +&
			"Where jssj >= to_date('" + String(idt_begin) + "','yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss') " +&
			"And jssj < to_date('" + String(idt_end) + "','yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss') And nvl(smkzhzf,0) <> 0 " +&
			"And ztbz > 0 Group By brbm) " +&
			"Group By brbm " +&
			"Having Sum(je) <> 0"
	ELSE
		ls_sql = "SELECT brbm, Sum(je) From " +&
			"(SELECT sum(nvl(zhzfje,0)) je, brbm From jkxt.yb_zjjs " +&
			"Where qsrq >= to_date('" + String(idt_begin) + "','yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss') " +&
			"And qsrq < to_date('" + String(idt_end) + "','yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss') And nvl(zhzfje,0) <> 0 " +&
			"And (jslb = 'XF' Or jslb = 'TK') And jylsh Is Not Null And ztbz > 0 Group By brbm " +&
			"Union All " +&
			"SELECT sum(nvl(smkzhzf,0)) * -1 je, brbm FROM jkxt.yb_jsmx " +&
			"Where jssj >= to_date('" + String(idt_begin) + "','yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss') " +&
			"And jssj < to_date('" + String(idt_end) + "','yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss') And nvl(smkzhzf,0) <> 0 " +&
			"And ztbz > 0 Group By brbm) " +&
			"Group By brbm " +&
			"Having Sum(je) <> 0"
	END IF
	IF lds_bpmx.createfromsql( ls_sql ) < 0 THEN
		gf_waiting('医保病人市民卡账户支付金额不一致......',-1)
		MessageBox('提示','医保病人市民卡对账不平明细生成失败。')
		RETURN -1
	END IF
	lds_bpmx.SetTransObject( sqlca )
	ll_rowcount = lds_bpmx.Retrieve( )
	
	IF ll_rowcount > 0 THEN
		FOR ll_temp = 1 To ll_rowcount
			ls_bpmx = ls_bpmx + lds_bpmx.Object.#1[ll_temp] + " " + String(lds_bpmx.Object.#2[ll_temp]) + "~n"
		NEXT
	END IF
	gf_waiting('医保病人市民卡账户支付金额不一致......',-1)
	
	MessageBox('【提示】不能对帐，请与计算中心联系','医保病人市民卡账户支付数据不一致。理论交易额(YB_ZJJS)：'+String(ldc_zhzfje)+', 实际发生额(YB_JSMX)：'+String(ldc_smkzhzf)+', 差值：'+String(ldc_zhzfje - ldc_smkzhzf) + '~n' + ls_bpmx)
	dw_toolbar.Enabled = True
	//	SetNull(is_dzr)
	RETURN -1
END IF

//校验市民卡账户支付金额（医保&自费）
//=======================核对==============================//
Dec{2} ldc_zhjyje, ldc_smkzfje

SELECT SUM(nvl(zhzfje,0)) INTO :ldc_smkzfje FROM jkxt.yb_zjjs
	Where qsrq >= :idt_begin And qsrq < :idt_end And (jslb = 'XF' Or jslb = 'TK' Or jslb = 'ZFXF' Or jslb = 'ZFTK') And ztbz > 0;
IF IsNull(ldc_smkzfje) THEN ldc_smkzfje = 0.00

gf_waiting('开始校验数据......',20)

SELECT SUM(nvl(jyje,0)) INTO :ldc_zhjyje FROM H_MZ_ZHJYMX
	Where jysj >= :idt_begin And jysj < :idt_end And jkfs = 8;
IF IsNull(ldc_zhjyje) THEN ldc_zhjyje = 0.00

gf_waiting('正在校验数据......',40)

IF ldc_smkzfje <> - ldc_zhjyje THEN
	ls_sql = "SELECT brbm, Sum(je) From " +&
		"(SELECT sum(nvl(zhzfje,0)) je, brbm From jkxt.yb_zjjs " +&
		"Where qsrq >= to_date('" + String(idt_begin) + "','yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss') " +&
		"And qsrq < to_date('" + String(idt_end) + "','yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss') And nvl(zhzfje,0) <> 0 " +&
		"And (jslb = 'XF' Or jslb = 'TK' Or jslb = 'ZFXF' Or jslb = 'ZFTK') And ztbz > 0 Group By brbm " +&
		"Union All " +&
		"SELECT sum(nvl(jyje,0)) je, brbm FROM H_MZ_ZHJYMX " +&
		"Where jysj >= to_date('" + String(idt_begin) + "','yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss') " +&
		"And jysj < to_date('" + String(idt_end) + "','yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss') And nvl(jyje,0) <> 0 " +&
		"And jkfs = 8 Group By brbm) " +&
		"Group By brbm " +&
		"Having Sum(je) <> 0"
	
	IF lds_bpmx.createfromsql( ls_sql ) < 0 THEN
		gf_waiting('市民卡账户支付总金额不一致......',-1)
		MessageBox('提示','市民卡对账不平明细生成失败。')
		RETURN -1
	END IF
	lds_bpmx.SetTransObject( sqlca )
	ll_rowcount = lds_bpmx.Retrieve( )
	
	IF ll_rowcount > 0 THEN
		FOR ll_temp = 1 To ll_rowcount
			ls_bpmx = ls_bpmx + lds_bpmx.Object.#1[ll_temp] + " " + String(lds_bpmx.Object.#2[ll_temp]) + "~n"
		NEXT
	END IF
	gf_waiting('市民卡账户支付总金额不一致......',-1)
	
	MessageBox('【提示】不能对帐，请与计算中心联系','市民卡账户支付数据不一致：社保理论交易(YB_ZJJS)：'+String(ldc_smkzfje)+', 实际发生额(H_MZ_ZHJYMX)：'+String(-ldc_zhjyje)+', 差值：'+String(ldc_smkzfje+ldc_zhjyje) + '~n' + ls_bpmx)
	dw_toolbar.Enabled = True
	//	SetNull(is_dzr)
	RETURN -1
END IF

gf_waiting('正在校验数据......',-1)
RETURN 1



end function

public subroutine wf_getdzxx (datetime adt_dzrq);DateTime ldt_begin,ldt_end
String ls_dzr ,ls_error
Long ll_jyzbs, ll_zcxfbs, ll_tkjybs
Decimal{2} ldc_zfzje, ldc_zcxfje, ldc_tkjyje

ldt_begin = DateTime(Date(adt_dzrq),Time(00:00:00))
ldt_end = DateTime(RelativeDate(Date(adt_dzrq),1),Time(00:00:00))
ls_dzr = String(adt_dzrq,'YYYYMMDD')

SELECT count(*) INTO :ll_jyzbs FROM jkxt.yb_zjjs
	WHERE qsrq >= :ldt_begin AND qsrq < :ldt_end AND ztbz > 0
	And jylsh Is Not Null And nvl(zhzfje,0) <> 0;
IF IsNull(ll_jyzbs) THEN ll_jyzbs = 0
//SELECT sum(nvl(zhzfje,0)) INTO :ldc_zfzje FROM jkxt.yb_zjjs
//	WHERE qsrq >= :ldt_begin AND qsrq < :ldt_end AND ztbz > 0
//	And jsjylsh Is Not Null And nvl(zhzfje,0) <> 0;
//IF IsNull(ldc_zfzje) THEN ldc_zfzje = 0.00

SELECT count(*) INTO :ll_zcxfbs FROM jkxt.yb_zjjs
	WHERE qsrq >= :ldt_begin AND qsrq < :ldt_end AND ztbz > 0 AND (jslb = 'XF' OR jslb = 'ZFXF')
	And jylsh Is Not Null And nvl(zhzfje,0) <> 0;
IF IsNull(ll_zcxfbs) THEN ll_zcxfbs = 0

SELECT sum(nvl(zhzfje,0)) INTO :ldc_zcxfje FROM jkxt.yb_zjjs
	WHERE qsrq >= :ldt_begin AND qsrq < :ldt_end AND ztbz > 0 AND (jslb = 'XF' OR jslb = 'ZFXF')
	And jylsh Is Not Null And nvl(zhzfje,0) <> 0;
IF IsNull(ldc_zcxfje) THEN ldc_zcxfje = 0.00

SELECT count(*) INTO :ll_tkjybs FROM jkxt.yb_zjjs
	WHERE qsrq >= :ldt_begin AND qsrq < :ldt_end AND ztbz > 0 AND (jslb = 'TK' OR jslb = 'ZFTK')
	And jylsh Is Not Null And nvl(zhzfje,0) <> 0;
IF IsNull(ll_tkjybs) THEN ll_tkjybs = 0

SELECT sum(nvl(zhzfje,0)) INTO :ldc_tkjyje FROM jkxt.yb_zjjs
	WHERE qsrq >= :ldt_begin AND qsrq < :ldt_end AND ztbz > 0 AND (jslb = 'TK' OR jslb = 'ZFTK')
	And jylsh Is Not Null And nvl(zhzfje,0) <> 0;
IF IsNull(ldc_tkjyje) THEN ldc_tkjyje = 0.00

ldc_zfzje = ldc_zcxfje - ldc_tkjyje

dw_1.object.qsrq[1] = ls_dzr
dw_1.Object.jyzbs[1] = ll_jyzbs
dw_1.Object.zhzfzje[1] = ldc_zfzje
dw_1.Object.zcxfbs[1] = ll_zcxfbs
dw_1.Object.zhzcxfje[1] = ldc_zcxfje
dw_1.Object.tkjybs[1] = ll_tkjybs
dw_1.Object.tkjyje[1] = - ldc_tkjyje

end subroutine

	SELECT count(1) Into :ll_find From jkxt.pyyb_dzxx Where dzr = :ls_dzr And dzjg Is Not Null;
	IF ll_find = 0 THEN
		SELECT count(1) Into :ll_find From jkxt.yb_dzxx Where dzr = :ls_dzr And dzjg Is Not Null;
	END IF

	RETURN

public subroutine wf_jzje (integer ai_jzlx);dw_main.DataObject = 'd_pyyb_jzhbb'
dw_main.SetTransObject(sqlca)

DateTime ldt_begin,ldt_end
String ls_sjlx
Long ll_count ,ll_row
ldt_begin = em_1.getdatetime( 1)
ldt_end = em_2.getdatetime( 2)
dw_main.InsertRow(1)
dw_main.Object.jzlb[1] = '门诊'
dw_main.InsertRow(2)
dw_main.Object.jzlb[2] = '住院'
IF ai_jzlx = 1 THEN //城乡救助
	dw_main.Object.t_title.Text = '平阳县两定机构城乡社会救助费用核拨表'
	ls_sjlx = 'CX'
ELSEIF ai_jzlx = 2 THEN //职工救助
	dw_main.Object.t_title.Text = '平阳县两定机构职工社会救助费用核拨表'
	ls_sjlx = 'ZG'
END IF
dw_main.Object.t_sbdw.Text = '医疗机构名称及编号：' + base_info.hospital + '(' +is_yljgdm +')'
dw_main.Object.t_sbsj.Text = '结算时间：' + String(ldt_begin,'yyyy年mm月dd日') + '至' + String(ldt_end,'yyyy年mm月dd日')

u_datastore luds_bzsj
luds_bzsj = Create u_datastore
luds_bzsj.DataObject = 'd_pyyb_bzsj'
luds_bzsj.SetTransObject( sqlca)
ll_count = luds_bzsj.Retrieve(ldt_begin,ldt_end,ls_sjlx,is_cbd )
IF ll_count > 0 THEN
	FOR ll_row = 1 To ll_count
		IF luds_bzsj.Object.ywlx[ll_row] = 'ZY' THEN
			dw_main.Object.nrshjzje[2] = dw_main.Object.nrshjzje[2] + luds_bzsj.Object.ybfy[ll_row]
			dw_main.Object.sjshjzje[2] = dw_main.Object.sjshjzje[2] + luds_bzsj.Object.jzje[ll_row]
			dw_main.Object.jzrc[2] = dw_main.Object.jzrc[2] + luds_bzsj.Object.jzrc[ll_row]
		ELSE
			dw_main.Object.nrshjzje[1] = dw_main.Object.nrshjzje[1] + luds_bzsj.Object.ybfy[ll_row]
			dw_main.Object.sjshjzje[1] = dw_main.Object.sjshjzje[1] + luds_bzsj.Object.jzje[ll_row]
			dw_main.Object.jzrc[1] = dw_main.Object.jzrc[1] + luds_bzsj.Object.jzrc[ll_row]
		END IF
	NEXT
END IF

end subroutine

event dw_main::doubleclicked;

Long ll_rowcount,ll_index

ll_rowcount = dw_main.RowCount( )
IF dwo.Name = 'xz_t'  THEN
	IF   is_select = '0' THEN
		is_select = '1'
	ELSEIF  is_select = '1' THEN
		is_select = '0'
		
	END IF
	FOR ll_index = 1 To ll_rowcount
		This.Object.xz[ll_index] = Long(is_select)
	NEXT
else 
	if Row>0 then return
	SelectRow(0,False)  //取消选中
	gf_DWSortService(Dwo.Name,this,False)  //调用降序排序服务，Dwo.Name为列标题名
END IF

end event

event dw_main::clicked;call super::clicked;

public function integer wf_import (ref datastore ads_ysj);String ls_syd_hbbfl,ls_zhyb_hbbfl
String ls_rylb[],ls_zhybrylb[]

ls_syd_hbbfl = gf_getpara(0,'SYDHBBFL',',14,15,16,27,24,25,26,91,|,11,12,13,20,30,90,|,0,|,31,32,33,34,35,39,','省异地核拨表')
//ls_zhyb_hbbfl = gf_getpara(0,'ZHYBHBBFL',',11,12,|,14,15,16,|,99,|,13,33,34,5588,','省异地核拨表')
IF ls_syd_hbbfl = '0' THEN
	MessageBox('信息提示','省异地人员分类未归类，请设置后重新统计（SYDHBBFL）')
	RETURN -1
END IF
IF gf_splitparm_zdy(ls_syd_hbbfl,ls_rylb,'|') < 0 THEN
	MessageBox('信息提示','省异地人员分类错误，核对后重新设置（SYDHBBFL）')
	RETURN -1
END IF

//IF gf_splitparm_zdy(ls_zhyb_hbbfl,ls_zhybrylb,'|') < 0 THEN
//	MessageBox('信息提示','智慧医保人员分类错误，核对后重新设置（ZHYBHBBFL）')
//	RETURN -1
//END IF
this.SetRedraw(False)
Long ll_rowcnt,ll_index,ll_find
String ls_temp,ls_ybjk,ls_ylrylb,ls_wglrylb
ll_rowcnt = ads_ysj.RowCount()
FOR ll_index = 1 To ll_rowcnt
	gf_waiting('正在进行数据归并，请耐心等。。。',ll_index /ll_rowcnt * 100 )
	ls_temp = ''
	ls_temp = ads_ysj.Object.cbdxzqh[ll_index ]
	ls_ybjk = ads_ysj.Object.ybjk[ll_index ]
	ll_find = dw_main.Find("xzqh2 ='" +ls_temp +"'", 1,999999)
	IF ll_find <= 0 THEN
		ll_find = dw_main.InsertRow( 0)
		dw_main.Object.xzqh[ll_find ] = ads_ysj.Object.cbdmc[ll_index ]
		dw_main.Object.xzqh2[ll_find ] = ls_temp
	END IF
	ls_temp = ''
	ls_temp = ',' + ads_ysj.Object.ylrylb[ll_index ]  + ','
	ls_ylrylb = ads_ysj.Object.ylrylb[ll_index ]
	If (ls_ybjk = 'SYD' And Pos(ls_rylb[1] ,ls_temp) > 0) Or (ls_ybjk = 'ZHYB' And (Left(ls_ylrylb,2) = '11' Or Left(ls_ylrylb,2) = '12')) THEN
		ads_ysj.Object.fl[ll_index ] = 'ZG' //职工
		dw_main.Object.zg[ll_find ] =  ads_ysj.Object.bfje[ll_index ] + dw_main.Object.zg[ll_find ]
	ElseIf (ls_ybjk = 'SYD' And Pos(ls_rylb[2] ,ls_temp) > 0) Or (ls_ybjk = 'ZHYB' And (Left(ls_ylrylb,2) = '14' Or Left(ls_ylrylb,2) = '15' Or Left(ls_ylrylb,2) = '16'))  THEN
		ads_ysj.Object.fl[ll_index ] = 'CZJM' //城镇居民
		dw_main.Object.CZJM[ll_find ] = ads_ysj.Object.bfje[ll_index ] + dw_main.Object.CZJM[ll_find ]
	ElseIf (ls_ybjk = 'SYD' And Pos(ls_rylb[3] ,ls_temp) > 0)  THEN
		ads_ysj.Object.fl[ll_index ] = 'XXNC' //新型农村
		dw_main.Object.XXNC[ll_find ] = ads_ysj.Object.bfje[ll_index ] + dw_main.Object.XXNC[ll_find ]
	ElseIf (ls_ybjk = 'SYD' And Pos(ls_rylb[4] ,ls_temp) > 0) Or (ls_ybjk = 'ZHYB' And (Left(ls_ylrylb,2) = '13' Or Left(ls_ylrylb,2) = '33' Or Left(ls_ylrylb,2) = '34' Or ls_ylrylb = '5088'))  THEN
		ads_ysj.Object.fl[ll_index ] = 'LX' //离休
		dw_main.Object.LX[ll_find ] = ads_ysj.Object.bfje[ll_index ] + dw_main.Object.LX[ll_find ]
	ELSE
		IF ls_wglrylb > ' ' THEN
			IF Pos(',' + ls_wglrylb+',',',' + ls_ylrylb+',') = 0 THEN
				ls_wglrylb = ls_wglrylb+','+ls_ylrylb
			END IF
		ELSE
			ls_wglrylb = ls_ylrylb
		END IF
		ads_ysj.Object.fl[ll_index ] = 'XXNC' //新型农村
		dw_main.Object.XXNC[ll_find ] = ads_ysj.Object.bfje[ll_index ] + dw_main.Object.XXNC[ll_find ]
	END IF
NEXT
this.SetRedraw(true)
gf_waiting('正在进行数据归并，请耐心等。。。',-1 )
if ls_wglrylb > ' ' then MessageBox('信息提示','人员分类（'+ls_wglrylb+'）未归类，暂时计入【新型农村合作医疗/其他】')
RETURN 1



end function

public subroutine wf_hbb_new (datetime adt_begin, datetime adt_end, integer ai_ywlx);If (ai_ywlx = 8 Or ai_ywlx = 12) And Date(adt_begin) >= Date(2022,3,4)  THEN
	IF ai_ywlx = 8 THEN
		IF dw_main.DataObject <> 'd_ybhbb_zhyb' THEN
			dw_main.DataObject = 'd_ybhbb_zhyb'
		END IF
	ELSEIF ai_ywlx = 12 THEN
		IF dw_main.DataObject <> 'd_ybhbb_zhyb2' THEN
			dw_main.DataObject = 'd_ybhbb_zhyb2'
		END IF
	END IF
ELSEIF dw_main.DataObject <> 'd_ybhbb_2019'  THEN
	dw_main.DataObject = 'd_ybhbb_2019'
	rb_qb.Checked = True
	rb_mz.Checked = False
	rb_zy.Checked = False
END IF
dw_main.SetTransObject(sqlca_query)
IF Date(adt_begin) < Date(2022,3,4) And  Date(adt_end) >= Date(2022,3,4) THEN
	MessageBox('提示','2022年3月4日之后的数据，本地数据将不再区分市本地与市异地（2022年3月4日之前仍为原来统计口径）。~r~n 【本地】温州市及其县市的所有数据~r~n【市异地】2022年3月4日之后将为0')
END IF
dw_main.Reset( )
Long ll_mzcount,li_syd,ll_cur,ll_find,ll_insert,li_mzy = 0
String ls_cbds,ls_cbrlb,ls_ybjk,ls_temp = '',ls_jslsh
ls_cbds = is_yljgxzqh //'330399'
IF dw_main.DataObject = 'd_ybhbb_2019' THEN
	ll_insert = dw_main.InsertRow( 0) //1
	dw_main.Object.cbrlb[ll_insert] = 'jbyl'
	dw_main.Object.xmmc[ll_insert] = '职工基本医疗保险'
	dw_main.Object.sqbfje[ll_insert] = 0.00
	ll_insert = dw_main.InsertRow( 0) //2
	dw_main.Object.cbrlb[ll_insert] = 'cxjm'
	dw_main.Object.xmmc[ll_insert] = '城乡居民医疗保险'
	dw_main.Object.sqbfje[ll_insert] = 0.00
	//救助
	ll_insert = dw_main.InsertRow( 0) //3
	dw_main.Object.cbrlb[ll_insert] = 'zgyljz'
	dw_main.Object.xmmc[ll_insert] = '职工医疗救助'
	dw_main.Object.sqbfje[ll_insert] = 0.00
	ll_insert = dw_main.InsertRow( 0) //4
	dw_main.Object.cbrlb[ll_insert] = 'cxjmyljz'
	dw_main.Object.xmmc[ll_insert] = '城乡居民医疗救助'
	dw_main.Object.sqbfje[ll_insert] = 0.00
	//优抚
	//ZHYB	610200	优抚对象医疗补助基金		2	
	ll_insert = dw_main.InsertRow( 0) //5
	dw_main.Object.cbrlb[ll_insert] = 'zgyljz'
	dw_main.Object.xmmc[ll_insert] = '职工优抚'
	dw_main.Object.sqbfje[ll_insert] = 0.00
	ll_insert = dw_main.InsertRow( 0) //6
	dw_main.Object.cbrlb[ll_insert] = 'cxjmyljz'
	dw_main.Object.xmmc[ll_insert] = '城居优抚'
	dw_main.Object.sqbfje[ll_insert] = 0.00
	//益康保
	ll_insert = dw_main.InsertRow( 0) //7
	dw_main.Object.cbrlb[ll_insert] = 'zgykb'
	dw_main.Object.xmmc[ll_insert] = '职工益康保'
	dw_main.Object.sqbfje[ll_insert] = 0.00
	ll_insert = dw_main.InsertRow( 0) //8
	dw_main.Object.cbrlb[ll_insert] = 'cxykb'
	dw_main.Object.xmmc[ll_insert] = '城居益康保'
	dw_main.Object.sqbfje[ll_insert] = 0.00
	
	ll_insert = dw_main.InsertRow( 0) //9
	dw_main.Object.cbrlb[ll_insert] = 'lxry'
	dw_main.Object.xmmc[ll_insert] = '离休人员医疗保障'
	dw_main.Object.sqbfje[ll_insert] = 00.00
	ll_insert = dw_main.InsertRow( 0) //10
	dw_main.Object.cbrlb[ll_insert] = 'lxpo'
	dw_main.Object.xmmc[ll_insert] = '离休人员配偶医疗保障'
	dw_main.Object.sqbfje[ll_insert] = 0.00
	ll_insert = dw_main.InsertRow( 0) //11
	dw_main.Object.cbrlb[ll_insert] = 'qt'
	dw_main.Object.xmmc[ll_insert] = '其他'
	dw_main.Object.sqbfje[ll_insert] = 0.00
	u_datastore luds_cbr
	IF IsValid(luds_cbr) = False THEN luds_cbr = Create u_datastore
	luds_cbr.DataObject = "dd_ybhzxx_new"
	luds_cbr.SetTransObject(sqlca_query)
	gf_waiting("开始统计...",10)
	IF ai_ywlx = 8 Or ai_ywlx = 12 THEN
		ll_mzcount = luds_cbr.Retrieve(adt_begin,adt_end,ls_cbds,0 )
	ELSEIF ai_ywlx = 11 THEN
		ll_mzcount = luds_cbr.Retrieve(adt_begin,adt_end,ls_cbds,1 )
	END IF
	Dec{2} ld_fyje,ldc_jzzfze,ldc_yfje,ldc_ykb
	gf_waiting("开始统计...",60)
	FOR ll_cur = 1 To ll_mzcount
		gf_waiting("正在汇总数据...",ll_cur /(ll_mzcount) * 100 )
		ls_ybjk = luds_cbr.Object.ybjk[ll_cur]
		ls_cbrlb = luds_cbr.Object.cbrlb[ll_cur]
		ld_fyje = luds_cbr.Object.jjzfze[ll_cur]
		ldc_jzzfze = luds_cbr.Object.jzzfze[ll_cur]
		ldc_yfje  = luds_cbr.Object.yfje[ll_cur]
		ldc_ykb = luds_cbr.Object.ykbzf[ll_cur]
		IF IsNull(ldc_yfje) THEN ldc_yfje = 0.00
		//	is_cbrlb_snjbyl = "100,101,200,201,320,321,420,620,500,999"
		IF ls_ybjk = 'WD' THEN
			If (Pos ( is_cbrlb_snjbyl, ls_cbrlb) > 0 Or ls_cbrlb = 'C00' Or ls_cbrlb = "F00") And ls_cbrlb <> '999' THEN
				//	if ls_cbrlb = '100' or ls_cbrlb = '101' or ls_cbrlb = '200' or ls_cbrlb = '201' or ls_cbrlb = '320' or ls_cbrlb = '321' or ls_cbrlb = 'C00' then
				dw_main.Object.sqbfje[1] = dw_main.Object.sqbfje[1] + (ld_fyje - ldc_jzzfze - ldc_yfje - ldc_ykb)
				dw_main.Object.sqbfje[3] = dw_main.Object.sqbfje[3] + ldc_jzzfze
				dw_main.Object.sqbfje[5] = dw_main.Object.sqbfje[5] + ldc_yfje
				dw_main.Object.sqbfje[7] = dw_main.Object.sqbfje[7] + ldc_ykb
				//B00 居民医保  D00 未成年 E00 新农合 G00 大学生
			ELSEIF ls_cbrlb = 'B00' Or ls_cbrlb = 'D00' Or ls_cbrlb = 'E00' Or ls_cbrlb = 'G00'  THEN
				dw_main.Object.sqbfje[2] = dw_main.Object.sqbfje[2] + (ld_fyje - ldc_jzzfze - ldc_yfje - ldc_ykb)
				dw_main.Object.sqbfje[4] = dw_main.Object.sqbfje[4] + ldc_jzzfze
				dw_main.Object.sqbfje[6] = dw_main.Object.sqbfje[6] + ldc_yfje
				dw_main.Object.sqbfje[8] = dw_main.Object.sqbfje[8] + ldc_ykb
				//	ELSEIF ls_cbrlb = "F00" THEN //F00 子女统筹 算到其他
				//		dw_main.Object.sqbfje[3] = dw_main.Object.sqbfje[3] + ld_fyje
			ELSE
				dw_main.Object.sqbfje[11] = dw_main.Object.sqbfje[11] + ld_fyje
				MessageBox('提示',ls_cbrlb + '归入其他')
			END IF
		ELSEIF ls_ybjk = 'ZHYB' THEN
			IF Left(ls_cbrlb,2) = '11' Or Left(ls_cbrlb,2) = '12' THEN //职工
				//	if ls_cbrlb = '100' or ls_cbrlb = '101' or ls_cbrlb = '200' or ls_cbrlb = '201' or ls_cbrlb = '320' or ls_cbrlb = '321' or ls_cbrlb = 'C00' then
				dw_main.Object.sqbfje[1] = dw_main.Object.sqbfje[1] + (ld_fyje - ldc_jzzfze - ldc_yfje - ldc_ykb)
				dw_main.Object.sqbfje[3] = dw_main.Object.sqbfje[3] + ldc_jzzfze
				dw_main.Object.sqbfje[5] = dw_main.Object.sqbfje[5] + ldc_yfje
				dw_main.Object.sqbfje[7] = dw_main.Object.sqbfje[7] + ldc_ykb
				//B00 居民医保  D00 未成年 E00 新农合 G00 大学生
			ELSEIF Left(ls_cbrlb,2) = '14' Or Left(ls_cbrlb,2) = '15' Or Left(ls_cbrlb,2) = '16' THEN //城乡
				dw_main.Object.sqbfje[2] = dw_main.Object.sqbfje[2] + (ld_fyje - ldc_jzzfze - ldc_yfje - ldc_ykb)
				dw_main.Object.sqbfje[4] = dw_main.Object.sqbfje[4] + ldc_jzzfze
				dw_main.Object.sqbfje[6] = dw_main.Object.sqbfje[6] + ldc_yfje
				dw_main.Object.sqbfje[8] = dw_main.Object.sqbfje[8] + ldc_ykb
			ELSEIF Left(ls_cbrlb,2) = '13' THEN //13 离休			
				dw_main.Object.sqbfje[9] = dw_main.Object.sqbfje[9] + ld_fyje
			ELSEIF ls_cbrlb = '5088' THEN //离休配偶	
				dw_main.Object.sqbfje[10] = dw_main.Object.sqbfje[10] + ld_fyje
			ELSE
				dw_main.Object.sqbfje[11] = dw_main.Object.sqbfje[11] + ld_fyje
				MessageBox('提示',ls_cbrlb + '归入其他')
			END IF
		ELSE
			MessageBox('提示',ls_ybjk + '找不到归类')
		END IF
	NEXT
	dw_main.Object.t_jsny.Text = String(adt_begin,'yyyy年 mm月')
	IF ai_ywlx = 8 Or ai_ywlx = 12 THEN
		dw_main.Object.byd_t.Text = '(本地)'
	ELSEIF ai_ywlx = 11 THEN
		dw_main.Object.byd_t.Text = '(异地)'
	END IF
ELSEIF dw_main.DataObject = 'd_ybhbb_zhyb2' Or dw_main.DataObject = 'd_ybhbb_zhyb' THEN
	ls_jslsh = ''
	SELECT jslsh Into :ls_jslsh From jkxt.zhyb_jsmx Where jssj >= :adt_begin And jssj <= :adt_end And ztbz > 0 Group By jslsh Having count(1) > 1;
	IF ls_jslsh > ' ' THEN
		MessageBox('提示','存在多余数据，请联系信息科处理')
		RETURN
	END IF
	IF rb_qb.Checked THEN
		li_mzy = 0
		ls_temp = ''
	ELSEIF rb_mz.Checked THEN
		li_mzy = 1
		ls_temp = '(门诊)'
	ELSEIF rb_zy.Checked THEN
		li_mzy = 2
		ls_temp = '(住院)'
	END IF
	ll_mzcount = dw_main.Retrieve(adt_begin,adt_end,ls_cbds,0 ,li_mzy)
	IF ll_mzcount > 0 THEN
		FOR ll_cur = 1 To ll_mzcount
			IF dw_main.DataObject = 'd_ybhbb_zhyb2' THEN
				dw_main.Object.qsjbjg[ll_cur] = is_yljgxzqh
				dw_main.Object.jgbm[ll_cur] = is_yljldm
				dw_main.Object.jgmc[ll_cur] = base_info.hospital
			ELSEIF dw_main.DataObject = 'd_ybhbb_zhyb' THEN
				dw_main.Object.sqbffy[ll_cur] = Round(dw_main.Object.jjzfze[ll_cur] * 0.9,2)
			END IF
		NEXT
	END IF
	dw_main.Object.t_1.Text = '浙江省定点医疗费用申请核拨表（两定机构）' + ls_temp
	//	dw_main.Object.t_date.Text = '统计月份： ' + String(adt_begin,'yyyy年 mm月份')
END IF
IF dw_main.DataObject <> 'd_ybhbb_zhyb2' THEN
	IF ii_sfby = 0 THEN
		dw_main.Object.t_dddw.Text = '定点医疗机构名称(盖章)：' + base_info.hospital
	ELSE
		dw_main.Object.t_dddw.Text = '定点医疗机构名称(盖章)：' + base_info.hospital1
	END IF
	dw_main.Object.t_yljgbh.Text = '定点医药机构编号：' + is_yljldm
END IF
gf_waiting("结束统计...",-1 )






end subroutine

on w_ybhzbb.create
int iCurrent
call super::create
this.em_begin=create em_begin
this.em_end=create em_end
this.st_1=create st_1
this.st_2=create st_2
this.ddlb_ywlx=create ddlb_ywlx
this.st_3=create st_3
this.rb_mz=create rb_mz
this.rb_zy=create rb_zy
this.rb_qb=create rb_qb
iCurrent=UpperBound(this.Control)
this.Control[iCurrent+1]=this.em_begin
this.Control[iCurrent+2]=this.em_end
this.Control[iCurrent+3]=this.st_1
this.Control[iCurrent+4]=this.st_2
this.Control[iCurrent+5]=this.ddlb_ywlx
this.Control[iCurrent+6]=this.st_3
this.Control[iCurrent+7]=this.rb_mz
this.Control[iCurrent+8]=this.rb_zy
this.Control[iCurrent+9]=this.rb_qb
end on

on w_ybhzbb.destroy
call super::destroy
destroy(this.em_begin)
destroy(this.em_end)
destroy(this.st_1)
destroy(this.st_2)
destroy(this.ddlb_ywlx)
destroy(this.st_3)
destroy(this.rb_mz)
destroy(this.rb_zy)
destroy(this.rb_qb)
end on

	ELSE
		uo_support.SetTransObject(sqlca_query)

			uo_support.SetTransObject(sqlca)
			messagebox('提示1','查询数据库连接失败！')

	END IF
ELSE
	sqlca_query = Create Transaction
	uo_support.SetTransObject(sqlca_query)
	IF Not uo_support.dbconnect(gs_ini,"Database_TJ") THEN
		uo_support.SetTransObject(sqlca)
		messagebox('提示2','查询数据库连接失败！')
		RETURN
	END IF
	uo_support.SetTransObject(sqlca)
END IF

dw_main.settransobject(sqlca_query)
em_begin.setdate(date(gf_server_date()))
em_end.setdate(date(gf_server_date()))
is_cbrlb_jbyl = "100,101,200,201,320,321,420,620,500,999,E00"
is_cbrlb_snjbyl = "100,101,200,201,320,321,420,620,500,999"
if gf_getpara_eas(sqlca,0,'GJBMQY','0','国家编码是否启用：0不启用，1启用') = '1' then
	is_yljldm = gf_getpara_Eas(sqlca,0,"YB_GJYLJGBM","H33030200034","医保国家医疗机构编码")  
else
	is_yljldm = gf_getpara_Eas(sqlca,0,"YB_YYDM_NEW","00000001100","医保医院代码")
end if
ii_sfby = integer(gf_getpara(base_info.syscode ,"SFBY","1","是否本院:0.不是1.是"))
is_yljgxzqh  = gf_getpara(0,"YLJGSZDXZQH","330399","医疗机构所在地行政区划")
end event

event ue_ref;call super::ue_ref;DateTime ldt_begin,ldt_end,ldt_now
u_datastore luds_mzcbr,luds_zycbr,lds_syd_hbb
Long ll_insert,ll_row,ll_cur,ll_mzcount,ll_zycount,ll_mzrc,ll_zyrc

				dw_main.Object.jbyl[ll_insert] = dw_main.Object.jbyl[ll_insert] + ldc_ykbzf

				dw_main.Object.jmyb[ll_insert - 3] = ld_fyje - ldc_jzje - ldc_yfje - ldc_ykbzf

				dw_main.Object.jmyb[ll_insert - 1] = ldc_yfje

				dw_main.Object.nmg[ll_insert - 1] = ldc_yfje
				dw_main.Object.nmg[ll_insert] = ldc_ykbzf

				dw_main.Object.wcnr[ll_insert - 1] = ldc_yfje

			ELSEIF ls_cbrlb = "F00" THEN //F00 子女统筹

				dw_main.Object.zntc[ll_insert - 1] = ldc_yfje

	FOR ll_cur = 1 To ll_zycount

event ue_bptz();DateTime ldt_begin,ldt_end
ldt_begin = em_1.getdatetime(1)
ldt_end = em_2.getdatetime( 2)
Long ll_count,ll_cur,ll_row,ll_i
u_datastore luds_jd,luds_mxzdh
luds_jd = Create u_datastore
luds_jd.DataObject = 'd_mxsc_jd'
luds_jd.SetTransObject( sqlca_query)

ll_count = luds_jd.Retrieve(ldt_begin ,ldt_end)

String ls_brbm,ls_mxzdh,ls_ywlx,ls_error = ''
Dec{0} ldc_zyh,ldc_ywlsh,ldc_mxlsh
Dec{2} ldc_je,ldc_zjje
IF ll_count > 0 THEN
	luds_mxzdh = Create u_datastore
	luds_mxzdh.DataObject = 'd_mxzdh_mx'
	luds_mxzdh.SetTransObject( sqlca)
	FOR ll_cur = 1 To ll_count
		ls_brbm = luds_jd.Object.brbm[ll_cur]
		ldc_zyh = luds_jd.Object.zyh[ll_cur]
		ls_mxzdh = luds_jd.Object.mxzdh[ll_cur]
		ll_row = luds_mxzdh.Retrieve(ldc_zyh,ls_brbm,ls_mxzdh )
		FOR ll_i = 1 To ll_row
			ls_ywlx = luds_mxzdh.Object.ywlx[ll_i]
			ldc_ywlsh = luds_mxzdh.Object.ywlsh[ll_i]
			ldc_mxlsh = luds_mxzdh.Object.ywmxlsh[ll_i]
			IF ls_ywlx = 'GH' THEN
				CONTINUE
			ELSEIF ls_ywlx = 'YJ' Or ls_ywlx = 'CF' THEN
				IF IsNull(ldc_mxlsh) THEN ldc_mxlsh = 0
				SELECT zjje Into :ldc_zjje From mz_sfmx Where brbm = :ls_brbm And ywlsh = :ldc_ywlsh And mxxh = :ldc_mxlsh;
			ELSEIF ls_ywlx = 'ZY' THEN
				SELECT zjje Into :ldc_zjje From BQXT.ZY_FYMX Where JLXH = :ldc_ywlsh;
			END IF
			luds_mxzdh.Object.ylfyje[ll_i] = ldc_zjje
		NEXT
		gf_begin_transaction(sqlca)
		IF luds_mxzdh.Update( ) = 1 THEN
			gf_commit_transaction(sqlca)
		ELSE
			ls_error += luds_mxzdh.is_error
			gf_Rollback_transaction(sqlca)
		END IF
	NEXT
	Destroy luds_mxzdh
	IF ls_error > '' THEN
		MessageBox('失败', ls_error)
	ELSE
		MessageBox('成功', 'YEAH!YEAH!YEAH!')
	END IF
END IF
Destroy luds_jd




end event

public function integer wf_getsyd (datetime adt_begin, datetime adt_end, string as_ywlx, long al_tsmxbz, decimal adc_jcfy);Dec{2} ldc_fyze,ldc_xjzf,ldc_jjzf,ldc_zfze,ldc_zlze,ldc_fhybfy,ldc_fpjz
long ll_insert,ll_ljrc,ll_jzrc,ll_sjzs
datetime ldt_ljrc1 
if date(adt_end) < date(2017,6,1)  then return 1
ldt_ljrc1 = DateTime(Date(Year(Date(adt_begin)),1,1),Time(00:00:00))
IF as_ywlx = 'MZ' THEN
	SELECT  SUM(FYZE) YLFYZE,
			  SUM(GRXJZF) XJZFZE,
			  SUM(HJBXJE) JJZFZE,
			  sum(CASE WHEN YWLX = 'SF' THEN HJBXJE ELSE 0 END) AS FPJZ,
			  SUM(CASE WHEN YWLX = 'GH' THEN 0  		         WHEN YWLX = 'SF' AND ZTBZ = 3 THEN -1 ELSE 1 END) SJZS ,
		     SUM(ZFZE) YLFYZFZE,
			  SUM(ZLZE) YLFYZLZE,
		     SUM(FYZE -ZLZE - ZFZE) FHYBFY
		INTO :ldc_fyze,:ldc_xjzf,:ldc_jjzf,:ldc_fpjz,:ll_sjzs,:ldc_zfze,:ldc_zlze,:ldc_fhybfy
		FROM JKXT.SYDYB_JSMX
		WHERE ( ZTBZ > 0 ) AND
				( JSLSH is NOT NULL ) AND
				( JSSJ >= :adt_begin) AND
				( JSSJ < :adt_end) AND
				( YWLX In ('SF','GH')) and
				( (nvl(GDBZBJ,'00') = '00'  and :al_tsmxbz=1) or ( nvl(GDBZBJ,'00') = '01'  and :al_tsmxbz=2) or (:al_tsmxbz=3) ) and
				(FYZE -ZLZE - ZFZE  <= :adc_jcfy OR :adc_jcfy = 0)
		Using sqlca_query;
	if dw_main.rowcount( ) > 0 then
		ll_insert = dw_main.find( "cbrlb = 'SYD' and ywlx = '"+as_ywlx+"'", 1, dw_main.rowcount( ) )
		if ll_insert <= 0 then  ll_insert =	dw_main.insertrow( 0)
	else
		ll_insert =	dw_main.insertrow( 0)
	end if
	dw_main.object.cbrlb[ll_insert] = 'SYD'
	dw_main.object.lbmc[ll_insert] = '省异地'
	dw_main.object.ywlx[ll_insert] = as_ywlx
	dw_main.object.sjzs[ll_insert] = ll_sjzs
	dw_main.object.jzrc[ll_insert] = 0
	dw_main.object.ljrc[ll_insert] = 0
	dw_main.object.ylfyzfze[ll_insert] = ldc_zfze
	dw_main.object.ylfyzlze[ll_insert] = ldc_zlze
	dw_main.object.jjzfze[ll_insert] = ldc_jjzf
	dw_main.object.xjzfze[ll_insert] = ldc_xjzf
	dw_main.object.ylfyze[ll_insert] = ldc_fyze
	dw_main.object.fpjz[ll_insert] = ldc_fpjz
	dw_main.object.fhybfy[ll_insert] = ldc_fhybfy
	SELECT count(DISTINCT to_char(jssj,'yyyymmdd') || brbm) INTO :ll_jzrc
	 FROM JKXT.SYDYB_JSMX  
   WHERE ( ZTBZ > 0 ) AND  
         ( JSLSH is not null ) AND  
         ( JSSJ >= :adt_begin) AND  
         ( JSSJ < :adt_end) AND  
         ( YWLX In ('SF','GH')) and 
			( (nvl(GDBZBJ,'00') = '00'  and :al_tsmxbz=1) or ( nvl(GDBZBJ,'00') = '01'  and :al_tsmxbz=2) or (:al_tsmxbz=3) ) and
			( FYZE -ZLZE - ZFZE  <= :adc_jcfy OR :adc_jcfy = 0)
		Using sqlca_query;
  dw_main.object.jzrc[ll_insert] = ll_jzrc
   SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT GRBH||cbdxzqh) INTO :ll_ljrc
	 FROM JKXT.SYDYB_JSMX  
   WHERE ( ZTBZ > 0 ) AND  
         ( JSLSH is not null ) AND  
         ( JSSJ >= :ldt_ljrc1) AND  
         ( JSSJ < :adt_end) AND  
         ( YWLX In ('SF','GH')) and 
			( (nvl(GDBZBJ,'00') = '00'  and :al_tsmxbz=1) or ( nvl(GDBZBJ,'00') = '01'  and :al_tsmxbz=2) or (:al_tsmxbz=3) ) and
			( FYZE -ZLZE - ZFZE  <= :adc_jcfy OR :adc_jcfy = 0)
		Using sqlca_query;

	dw_main.object.ljrc[ll_insert] = ll_ljrc
ELSEIF as_ywlx = 'ZY' THEN
	SELECT  SUM(FYZE) YLFYZE,
			  SUM(GRXJZF) XJZFZE,
			  SUM(HJBXJE) JJZFZE,
		     SUM(ZFZE) YLFYZFZE,
			  SUM(ZLZE) YLFYZLZE,
		     SUM(FYZE -ZLZE - ZFZE) FHYBFY,
			  SUM(CASE WHEN  ZTBZ = 3 THEN -1 ELSE 1 END) SJZS 
		INTO :ldc_fyze,:ldc_xjzf,:ldc_jjzf,:ldc_zfze,:ldc_zlze,:ldc_fhybfy,:ll_sjzs
		FROM JKXT.SYDYB_JSMX
		WHERE ( ZTBZ > 0 ) AND
				( JSLSH is NOT NULL ) AND
				( JSSJ >= :adt_begin) AND
				( JSSJ < :adt_end) AND
				( YWLX In ('ZY')) and
				( (nvl(GDBZBJ,'00') = '00'  and :al_tsmxbz=1) or ( nvl(GDBZBJ,'00') = '01'  and :al_tsmxbz=2) or (:al_tsmxbz=3) ) and
				( FYZE -ZLZE - ZFZE  <= :adc_jcfy OR :adc_jcfy = 0)
		Using sqlca_query;
	if dw_main.rowcount( ) > 0 then
		ll_insert = dw_main.find( "cbrlb = 'SYD' and ywlx = '"+as_ywlx+"'", 1, dw_main.rowcount( ) )
		if ll_insert <= 0 then  ll_insert =	dw_main.insertrow( 0)
	else
		ll_insert =	dw_main.insertrow( 0)
	end if
	ldc_fpjz = ldc_jjzf
	dw_main.object.cbrlb[ll_insert] = 'SYD'
	dw_main.object.lbmc[ll_insert] = '省异地'
	dw_main.object.ywlx[ll_insert] = as_ywlx
	dw_main.object.sjzs[ll_insert] = ll_sjzs
	dw_main.object.jzrc[ll_insert] = 0
	dw_main.object.ljrc[ll_insert] = 0
	dw_main.object.ylfyzfze[ll_insert] = ldc_zfze
	dw_main.object.ylfyzlze[ll_insert] = ldc_zlze
	dw_main.object.jjzfze[ll_insert] = ldc_jjzf
	dw_main.object.xjzfze[ll_insert] = ldc_xjzf
	dw_main.object.ylfyze[ll_insert] = ldc_fyze
	dw_main.object.fpjz[ll_insert] = ldc_fpjz
	dw_main.object.fhybfy[ll_insert] = ldc_fhybfy
  
    SELECT count(DISTINCT JYID) INTO :ll_jzrc
	 FROM JKXT.SYDYB_JSMX  
   WHERE ( ZTBZ > 0 ) AND  
         ( JSLSH is not null ) AND  
         ( JSSJ >= :adt_begin) AND  
         ( JSSJ < :adt_end) AND  
         ( YWLX = 'ZY') and 
			( (nvl(GDBZBJ,'00') = '00'  and :al_tsmxbz=1) or ( nvl(GDBZBJ,'00') = '01'  and :al_tsmxbz=2) or (:al_tsmxbz=3) ) and
			( FYZE -ZLZE - ZFZE  <= :adc_jcfy OR :adc_jcfy = 0)
		Using sqlca_query;
  dw_main.object.jzrc[ll_insert] = ll_jzrc
   SELECT count(DISTINCT GRBH||cbdxzqh) INTO :ll_ljrc
	 FROM JKXT.SYDYB_JSMX  
   WHERE ( ZTBZ > 0 ) AND  
         ( JSLSH is not null ) AND  
         ( JSSJ >= :ldt_ljrc1) AND  
         ( JSSJ < :adt_end) AND  
         ( YWLX = 'ZY') and 
			( (nvl(GDBZBJ,'00') = '00'  and :al_tsmxbz=1) or ( nvl(GDBZBJ,'00') = '01'  and :al_tsmxbz=2) or (:al_tsmxbz=3) ) and
			( FYZE -ZLZE - ZFZE  <= :adc_jcfy OR :adc_jcfy = 0)
		Using sqlca_query;
	dw_main.object.ljrc[ll_insert] = ll_ljrc
END IF
RETURN 1

end function

public function integer wf_get_jcfy (datetime adt_begin, datetime adt_end, string as_ywlx, string as_ywlxs[], string as_byd, string as_jyjslxs[], string as_cbrlbs[]);//1：均次药品费，2：均次药品费占均次费用的盌AT*
嚷剩�即均次药占比�
3：均次材料费，4：均次材料费占均次费用的比率，即均次材料占比；
Long ll_count,ll_row,ll_find
String ls_ywlx
dec{2} ldc_zfy = 0.00
u_datastore luds_jcfy
luds_jcfy = Create u_datastore
IF as_ywlx = 'JBYL' Or as_ywlx = 'CXJM' Or as_ywlx = 'CXJMBHWCN' THEN
	luds_jcfy.DataObject = 'd_ylfyhzb_jc'//20210719zbq
	luds_jcfy.SetTransObject( sqlca_query)
	ll_count = luds_jcfy.Retrieve(adt_begin, adt_end,as_ywlxs,as_byd,as_jyjslxs,idc_jcje,as_cbrlbs)
	IF ll_count > 0 and dw_main.rowcount( ) > 0 THEN
		FOR ll_row =  1 To ll_count
			ldc_zfy = ldc_zfy + luds_jcfy.Object.zfy[ll_row]
			dw_main.Object.ypf[1] = luds_jcfy.Object.ypf[ll_row]
			dw_main.Object.clf[1] = luds_jcfy.Object.clf[ll_row]
			IF dw_main.Object.ylfyze[1]  <>  ldc_zfy THEN
				gf_applog( '业务：' + ls_ywlx +'汇总和均次总金额不一致（main' + String(dw_main.Object.ylfyze[1]) + "--jc"+String(ldc_zfy)+"）")
				MessageBox('提示', '业务：' + ls_ywlx +'汇总和均次总金额不一致（main' + String(dw_main.Object.ylfyze[1]) + "--jc"+String(ldc_zfy)+"）")
			END IF
		NEXT
	END IF
ELSE
	String ls_cbrlb
	luds_jcfy.DataObject = 'd_sbyhzbb_jc'//20210719zbq
	luds_jcfy.SetTransObject( sqlca_query)
	ll_count = luds_jcfy.Retrieve(adt_begin, adt_end,il_byd,il_tmb,idc_jcje)
	IF ll_count > 0 THEN
		FOR ll_row =  1 To ll_count
			ls_cbrlb = luds_jcfy.Object.cbrlb[ll_row]
			ls_ywlx = luds_jcfy.Object.ywlx[ll_row]
			ll_find = dw_main.Find("cbrlb = '"+ls_cbrlb+"' and ywlx = '" + ls_ywlx +"'",1,dw_main.RowCount())
			IF ll_find > 0 THEN
				IF dw_main.Object.ylfyze[ll_find]  <> luds_jcfy.Object.zfy[ll_row] THEN
					gf_applog('参保人类别：' + ls_cbrlb + '业务：' + ls_ywlx +'汇总和均次总金额不一致（main' + String(dw_main.Object.ylfyze[ll_find]) + "--jc"+String(luds_jcfy.Object.zfy[ll_row])+"）")
					MessageBox('提示','参保人类别：' + ls_cbrlb + '业务：' + ls_ywlx +'汇总和均次总金额不一致（main' + String(dw_main.Object.ylfyze[ll_find]) + "--jc"+String(luds_jcfy.Object.zfy[ll_row])+"）")
				END IF
				dw_main.Object.ypf[ll_find] = luds_jcfy.Object.ypf[ll_row]
				dw_main.Object.clf[ll_find] = luds_jcfy.Object.clf[ll_row]
			ELSE
				MessageBox('提示','找不到参保人类别：' + ls_cbrlb + '业务：' + ls_ywlx +'的汇总信息')
			END IF
		NEXT
	END IF
END IF
Destroy luds_jcfy
RETURN 1
end function

public function integer wf_ylfyhz (datetime adt_begin, datetime adt_end, datetime adt_ndks, string as_yblx, string as_ywlx, string as_byd, boolean ab_jcfy, ref string as_error);String ls_title,ls_error,ls_lx
String ls_ywlxs[],ls_cbrlbs[],ls_jyjslxs[]
gf_waiting('正在准备数据..........',1)
dw_main.DataObject  = 'd_ylfyhzb'//20210719zbq
dw_main.SetTransObject(sqlca_query)

IF as_yblx = 'JBYL' THEN
	ls_cbrlbs[1] = '100'
	ls_cbrlbs[2] = '101'
	ls_cbrlbs[3] = '200'
	ls_cbrlbs[4] = '201'
	ls_cbrlbs[5] = 'C00' //20210719zbq增加农民工
ELSEIF as_yblx = 'CXJM' THEN //'B00','D00','G00','E00'
	ls_cbrlbs[1] = 'B00'
	ls_cbrlbs[2] = 'D00'
	ls_cbrlbs[3] = 'G00'
	ls_cbrlbs[4] = 'E00'
ELSEIF as_yblx = 'CXJMBHWCN' THEN //'B00','G00','E00'
	ls_cbrlbs[1] = 'B00'
	ls_cbrlbs[2] = 'G00'
	ls_cbrlbs[3] = 'E00'
END IF

//"1本地;2异地;3全部" as_byd
IF as_ywlx = 'MZ' THEN
	ls_lx = '（门诊）'
	ls_ywlxs[1] = 'SF'
	ls_ywlxs[2] = 'GH'
	ls_jyjslxs[1] = '001'
	ls_jyjslxs[2] = '002'
ELSEIF as_ywlx = 'ZY' THEN
	ls_lx = '（住院）'
	ls_ywlxs[1] = 'ZY'
	ls_jyjslxs[1] = '011'
END IF
//	温州市基本医疗保险医疗费用汇总表（门诊）
//	温州市城乡居民保险医疗费用汇总表（住院）
dw_main.Object.title_t.Text = '温州市'+ ddlb_yblb.Text + '保险医疗费用汇总表' + ls_lx
dw_main.SetRedraw( False)

gf_waiting('正在统计基本数据..........',20)
dw_main.Retrieve(adt_begin, adt_end,ls_ywlxs,as_byd,ls_jyjslxs,idc_jcje,ls_cbrlbs)
// 人次数
u_datastore luds_rcs,luds_rts
gf_waiting('正在统计人次数.........',50)
IF as_ywlx = 'MZ' THEN
	luds_rcs = Create u_datastore
	luds_rcs.DataObject = 'd_ylfyhz_rc' //20210719zbq
	luds_rcs.SetTransObject( sqlca_query)
	luds_rcs.Retrieve(adt_begin, adt_end,ls_ywlxs,as_byd,ls_jyjslxs,idc_jcje,ls_cbrlbs)
ELSEIF as_ywlx = 'ZY' THEN
	luds_rcs = Create u_datastore
	luds_rcs.DataObject = 'd_ylfyhz_zyrc' //20210719zbq
	luds_rcs.SetTransObject( sqlca_query)
	luds_rcs.Retrieve(adt_begin, adt_end,ls_ywlxs,as_byd,ls_jyjslxs,idc_jcje,ls_cbrlbs)
END IF
//人头数
gf_waiting('正在统计人头数.........',70)
luds_rts = Create u_datastore
luds_rts.DataObject = 'd_ylfyhz_rt' //20210719zbq
luds_rts.SetTransObject( sqlca_query)
luds_rts.Retrieve(adt_ndks, adt_end,ls_ywlxs,as_byd,ls_jyjslxs,idc_jcje,ls_cbrlbs)
dw_main.Object.rcs[1] = luds_rcs.Object.rczs[1]
dw_main.Object.rts[1] = luds_rts.Object.rtzs[1]
IF String(adt_begin,'yyyy.mm') <> left(em_2.text,7) THEN
	dw_main.Object.st_tjrq.Text = String(adt_begin,'yyyymm') +"-" +String(em_2.getdate(),'yyyymm')
ELSE
	dw_main.Object.st_tjrq.Text = String(adt_begin,'yyyymm')
END IF
gf_waiting('正在计算均次费用..........',80)
if ab_jcfy then this.wf_get_jcfy( adt_begin, adt_end, as_yblx, ls_ywlxs, as_byd, ls_jyjslxs, ls_cbrlbs)
gf_waiting('数据完成..........',-1)
dw_main.SetRedraw( True)
RETURN 1
end function

on w_ybyhzbb.create
int iCurrent
call super::create
this.em_2=create em_2
this.em_1=create em_1
this.st_1=create st_1
this.st_2=create st_2
this.ddlb_yblb=create ddlb_yblb
this.st_text=create st_text
this.ddlb_byd=create ddlb_byd
this.st_3=create st_3
this.st_4=create st_4
this.st_5=create st_5
this.ddlb_tmb=create ddlb_tmb
this.cb_1=create cb_1
this.ddlb_ywlx=create ddlb_ywlx
this.cbx_jcfy=create cbx_jcfy
iCurrent=UpperBound(this.Control)
this.Control[iCurrent+1]=this.em_2
this.Control[iCurrent+2]=this.em_1
this.Control[iCurrent+3]=this.st_1
this.Control[iCurrent+4]=this.st_2
this.Control[iCurrent+5]=this.ddlb_yblb
this.Control[iCurrent+6]=this.st_text
this.Control[iCurrent+7]=this.ddlb_byd
this.Control[iCurrent+8]=this.st_3
this.Control[iCurrent+9]=this.st_4
this.Control[iCurrent+10]=this.st_5
this.Control[iCurrent+11]=this.ddlb_tmb
this.Control[iCurrent+12]=this.cb_1
this.Control[iCurrent+13]=this.ddlb_ywlx
this.Control[iCurrent+14]=this.cbx_jcfy
end on

on w_ybyhzbb.destroy

destroy(this.em_2)
destroy(this.em_1)
destroy(this.st_1)
destroy(this.st_2)
destroy(this.ddlb_yblb)
destroy(this.st_text)
destroy(this.ddlb_byd)
destroy(this.st_3)
destroy(this.st_4)
destroy(this.st_5)
destroy(this.ddlb_tmb)
destroy(this.cb_1)
destroy(this.ddlb_ywlx)
destroy(this.cbx_jcfy)
end on

event ue_exit;call super::ue_
exit;close(this)
end event

event ue_print;call super::ue_print;if dw_main.rowcount()<=0 then
	messagebox("提示","请先统计")
	return
end if
gu_mz_printer.uf_setprinter('mzbb')
IF dw_main.Visible = True THEN
	openwithparm(w_print_setup,dw_main)
END IF






end event

event ue_ref;call super::ue_ref;Long ll_find,ll_rowcount,ll_count,ll_row,ll_sjzs,ll_ljrc
DateTime ldt_start,ldt_end,ldt_ljrc1,ldt_ljrc2
u_datastore luds_jzrc,luds_sjzs,luds_ljrc
String ls_yblx,ls_zbrxm,ls_zbrbm,ls_dwmc,ls_cbrlb,ls_error,ls_filter
Dec{2} ld_jzce
Boolean lb_jcfy
lb_jcfy = cbx_jcfy.Checked
st_text.Text = ''
ls_zbrxm = base_info.username
ls_zbrbm = base_info.UserID
ls_dwmc = ddlb_yblb.Text
 
ldt_start = em_1.getdatetime(1)
ldt_end = DateTime(RelativeDate(em_2.getdate(),1))
ls_yblx = Upper(ddlb_yblb.getcode())
//用于确定年度开始时间，统计人头数，城乡居民（1月1）和基本医疗（4月1）年度开始时间不同
//ls_cbrlbs[1] = 'B00'
//	ls_cbrlbs[2] = 'D00'
//	ls_cbrlbs[3] = 'G00'
//	ls_cbrlbs[4] = 'E00'
IF ls_yblx = 'CXJM' Or ls_yblx = 'CXJMBHWCN' Or ls_yblx = 'B00' Or ls_yblx = 'D00' Or ls_yblx = 'G00' Or ls_yblx = 'E00' OR LS_YBLX='15' THEN
	ldt_ljrc1 = DateTime(Date(Year(Date(ldt_start)),1,1))
	ldt_ljrc2 = ldt_end
ELSE
	IF Month(Date(em_1.getdate())) < 7 THEN
		ldt_ljrc1 = DateTime(Date(Year(Date(ldt_start)) - 1,7,1),Time(00:00:00))
		ldt_ljrc2 = ldt_end //modify by sxl 3月或3月以前年度开始为上1年的4月1日，但是结束日期为当前结束日期
		//	ldt_ljrc2 = DateTime(Date(Year(Date(ldt_end)),Month(2014-04-01),Day(2014-04-01)),Time(00:00:00))
	ELSE
		ldt_ljrc1 = DateTime(Date(Year(Date(ldt_start)),7,1),Time(00:00:00))
		ldt_ljrc2 = ldt_end
	END IF
END IF
IF Date(ldt_start) <= Date(2011,9,2) Or  Date(ldt_end) <= Date(2011,9,3) THEN
	MessageBox('提示','20110903之前和以后的数据请分开统计,20110903之前的数据请在老的医保月汇总报表中统计!')
	RETURN
END IF
IF ls_yblx = 'JBYL' Or ls_yblx = 'CXJM' Or ls_yblx = 'CXJMBHWCN' THEN
	
	dw_main.SetFilter( "")
	dw_main.Filter( )
	//医疗费用汇总
	IF	wf_ylfyhz(ldt_start, ldt_end,ldt_ljrc1,ls_yblx,is_ywlx,String(il_byd),lb_jcfy,ls_error) < 0 THEN
		RETURN
	END IF
	idc_jcje = 0
ELSE
	dw_main.DataObject  = 'd_sbyhzbb_new' //20210719zbq
	dw_main.SetTransObject( sqlca_query)
	dw_main.SetRedraw( False)
	IF ls_yblx = 'SYD' THEN
		wf_getsyd(ldt_start, ldt_end,is_ywlx,il_tmb,idc_jcje)
		dw_main.SetRedraw( True)
		//		RETURN
	ELSE
		dw_main.Retrieve(ldt_start, ldt_end,il_byd,il_tmb,idc_jcje)
		dw_main.SetFilter( "ywlx='"+is_ywlx+"'")
		dw_main.Filter( )
	END IF
	ll_rowcount = dw_main.RowCount( )
	IF ll_rowcount > 0 THEN
		//获取就诊人次
		IF IsValid(luds_jzrc) = False THEN luds_jzrc = Create u_datastore
		IF ls_yblx = 'SYD' THEN
			IF is_ywlx = 'MZ' THEN
				dw_main.Object.title_t.Text = "医保月汇总报表（门诊）"
			ELSE
				dw_main.Object.title_t.Text = "医保月汇总报表（住院）"
			END IF
		ELSE
			IF is_ywlx = 'MZ' THEN
				dw_main.Object.title_t.Text = "医保月汇总报表（门诊）"
				luds_jzrc.DataObject = 'd_jzrc_cbrlb' //20210719zbq
			ELSE
				dw_main.Object.title_t.Text = "医保月汇总报表（住院）"
				luds_jzrc.DataObject = 'd_jzrc_cbrlb_zy' //20210719zbq
			END IF
			
			luds_jzrc.SetTransObject( sqlca_query)
			ll_count = luds_jzrc.Retrieve(ldt_start, ldt_end,il_byd,il_tmb,idc_jcje)
			IF ll_count > 0 THEN
				gf_waiting('正在统计报表,请稍候......',1)
				FOR ll_row = 1 To ll_count
					gf_waiting('正在统计报表,请稍候......',(ll_row / ll_count * 100))
					ls_cbrlb = luds_jzrc.Object.cbrlb[ll_row]
					//判断参保人类别是否为空
					IF IsNull(ls_cbrlb) THEN
						ll_find = dw_main.Find(" isnull(cbrlb) ",1, ll_rowcount)
					ELSE
						ll_find = dw_main.Find("cbrlb = '"+ls_cbrlb+"'",1, ll_rowcount)
					END IF
					IF ll_find > 0 THEN
						IF IsNull(dw_main.Object.jzrc[ll_find]) THEN dw_main.Object.jzrc[ll_find] = 0
						dw_main.Object.jzrc[ll_find] = dw_main.Object.jzrc[ll_find] + luds_jzrc.Object.jzrc[ll_row]
					ELSEIF ll_find = 0 THEN
						ll_find = dw_main.InsertRow(0)
						dw_main.Object.cbrlb[ll_find] = ls_cbrlb
						dw_main.Object.lbmc[ll_find] = ls_cbrlb
						dw_main.Object.jzrc[ll_find] = luds_jzrc.Object.jzrc[ll_row]
						dw_main.Object.sjzs[ll_find] = 0
						dw_main.Object.jjzfze[ll_find] = 0.00
						dw_main.Object.xjzfze[ll_find] = 0.00
						dw_main.Object.ylfyze[ll_find] = 0.00
						dw_main.Object.fpjz[ll_find] = 0.00
						dw_main.Object.ywlx[ll_find] = is_ywlx
					END IF
				NEXT
				Destroy luds_jzrc
				//获取累计人次
				IF IsValid(luds_ljrc) = False THEN luds_ljrc = Create u_datastore
				
				IF is_ywlx = 'MZ' THEN
					luds_ljrc.DataObject = 'd_ljrc_cbrlb' //20210719zbq
				ELSE
					luds_ljrc.DataObject = 'd_ljrc_cbrlb_zy'//20210719zbq
				END IF
				
				luds_ljrc.SetTransObject( sqlca_query)
				ll_count = luds_ljrc.Retrieve(ldt_ljrc1, ldt_ljrc2,il_byd,il_tmb,idc_jcje)
				IF ll_count > 0 THEN
					gf_waiting('正在统计报表,请稍候......',1)
					FOR ll_row = 1 To ll_count
						gf_waiting('正在统计报表,请稍候......',(ll_row / ll_count * 100))
						ls_cbrlb = luds_ljrc.Object.cbrlb[ll_row]
						ll_ljrc = luds_ljrc.Object.ljrc[ll_row]
						IF IsNull(ls_cbrlb) THEN
							ll_find = dw_main.Find(" isnull(cbrlb) ",1, ll_rowcount)
						ELSE
							ll_find = dw_main.Find("cbrlb = '"+ls_cbrlb+"'",1, ll_rowcount)
						END IF
						IF ll_find > 0 THEN
							IF IsNull(dw_main.Object.ljrc[ll_find]) THEN dw_main.Object.ljrc[ll_find] = 0
							dw_main.Object.ljrc[ll_find] = dw_main.Object.ljrc[ll_find] + ll_ljrc
						ELSEIF ll_find = 0 THEN
							ll_find = dw_main.InsertRow(0)
							dw_main.Object.cbrlb[ll_find] = ls_cbrlb
							dw_main.Object.lbmc[ll_find] = ls_cbrlb
							dw_main.Object.jzrc[ll_find] = 0
							dw_main.Object.ljrc[ll_find] = ll_ljrc
							dw_main.Object.jjzfze[ll_find] = 0.00
							dw_main.Object.xjzfze[ll_find] = 0.00
							dw_main.Object.ylfyze[ll_find] = 0.00
							dw_main.Object.fpjz[ll_find] = 0.00
							dw_main.Object.ywlx[ll_find] = is_ywlx
						END IF
					NEXT
					Destroy luds_ljrc
				END IF
				//获取收据张数
				IF IsValid(luds_sjzs) = False THEN luds_sjzs = Create u_datastore
				luds_sjzs.DataObject = 'd_sjzs_cbrlb'//20210719zbq
				luds_sjzs.SetTransObject( sqlca_query)
				luds_sjzs.Retrieve(ldt_start, ldt_end,il_byd,il_tmb,idc_jcje)
				//		luds_sjzs.setfilter( "")
				//		luds_sjzs.filter( ) 
				//		if is_ywlx='MZ' THEN
				luds_sjzs.SetFilter( "ywlx='"+is_ywlx+"'")
				luds_sjzs.Filter( )
				//		ELSE
				//			luds_sjzs.setfilter( "ywlx='ZY'")
				//			luds_sjzs.filter( ) 			 
				//		END IF
				ll_count = 	luds_sjzs.RowCount( )
				IF ll_count > 0 THEN
					gf_waiting('正在统计报表,请稍候......',1)
					FOR ll_row = 1 To ll_count
						gf_waiting('正在统计报表,请稍候......',(ll_row / ll_count * 100))
						ls_cbrlb = luds_sjzs.Object.cbrlb[ll_row]
						ll_sjzs = luds_sjzs.Object.sjzs[ll_row]
						IF IsNull(ls_cbrlb) THEN
							ll_find = dw_main.Find(" isnull(cbrlb) ",1, ll_rowcount)
						ELSE
							ll_find = dw_main.Find("cbrlb = '"+ls_cbrlb+"'",1, ll_rowcount)
						END IF
						IF ll_find > 0 THEN
							IF IsNull(dw_main.Object.sjzs[ll_find]) THEN dw_main.Object.sjzs[ll_find] = 0
							dw_main.Object.sjzs[ll_find] = dw_main.Object.sjzs[ll_find] + ll_sjzs
						ELSEIF ll_find = 0 THEN
							ll_find = dw_main.InsertRow(0)
							dw_main.Object.cbrlb[ll_find] = ls_cbrlb
							dw_main.Object.lbmc[ll_find] = ls_cbrlb
							dw_main.Object.jzrc[ll_find] = 0
							dw_main.Object.sjzs[ll_find] = ll_sjzs
							dw_main.Object.jjzfze[ll_find] = 0.00
							dw_main.Object.xjzfze[ll_find] = 0.00
							dw_main.Object.ylfyze[ll_find] = 0.00
							dw_main.Object.fpjz[ll_find] = 0.00
							dw_main.Object.ywlx[ll_find] = is_ywlx
						END IF
					NEXT
					Destroy luds_sjzs
				END IF
			END IF
		END IF
	END IF
	//根据对应的参保人类别做过滤
	IF ls_yblx = 'ALL' THEN
		dw_main.SetFilter( '')
		dw_main.Filter( )
		//wf_getsyd(ldt_start, ldt_end,is_ywlx,il_tmb,idc_jcje)
		dw_main.SetRedraw( True)
		ls_filter = ''
	ELSE
		ls_filter = "cbrlb = '"+ls_yblx+"'"
		dw_main.SetFilter( "cbrlb = '"+ls_yblx+"' ")
		dw_main.Filter( )
	END IF
	SELECT sum(jzce) Into :ld_jzce From sb_jejd Where kpsj >= :ldt_start And kpsj < :ldt_end Using sqlca_query;
	IF IsNull(ld_jzce) THEN ld_jzce = 0
	Dec{2} ld_pyjzce
	IF gi_pyyq = 1 THEN
		SELECT sum(NVL(HJBXJE,0)) Into :ld_pyjzce From JKXT.PYYB_JSMX Where JSSJ >= :ldt_start And JSSJ < :ldt_end And ZTBZ In (4,5) And QRJYLSH Is Not Null And ywlx In ('SF','GH') Using sqlca_query;
		IF IsNull(ld_pyjzce) THEN ld_pyjzce = 0
		ld_jzce = ld_jzce + ld_pyjzce
	END IF
	//9月份存在-132.07的交易补差额
	IF ld_jzce <> 0 THEN
		IF String(ldt_start,'yyyymm') = '201109' THEN
			ld_jzce = ld_jzce - 132.07
			st_text.Text = em_1.Text+"至"+em_2.Text+",记账共计差：" +String(ld_jzce) +"(201109存在-132.07的补交易差额,实际的总差额以全月的差额为准)"
		ELSE
			st_text.Text = em_1.Text+"至"+em_2.Text+",记账共计差：" +String(ld_jzce)
		END IF
	ELSEIF ld_jzce = 0  THEN
		st_text.Text = ''
	END IF
	dw_main.Object.t_dwmc.Text = '温州市社会保障局'+'['+ls_dwmc+']'
	dw_main.Object.zbr.Text = '制表人:'+ls_zbrxm+'['+ls_zbrbm+']'
	dw_main.Object.st_tjrq.Text = em_1.Text+' '+'至'+' '+em_2.Text
	dw_main.Object.zbsj.Text = String(gf_server_date(),'yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss')
	gf_waiting('正在统计均次费用,请稍候......',80)
	String ls_null[]
	IF lb_jcfy THEN This.wf_get_jcfy( ldt_start, ldt_end, ls_yblx,ls_null, '', ls_null, ls_null)
	//	wf_get_jcfy( ldt_start, ldt_end, ls_yblx)
	gf_waiting('正在统计报表,请稍候......',-1)
	idc_jcje = 0
	IF ls_filter > ' ' THEN
		ls_filter = ls_filter + " and ywlx='"+is_ywlx+"'"
	ELSE
		ls_filter =  "ywlx='"+is_ywlx+"'"
	END IF
	dw_main.SetFilter(ls_filter)
	dw_main.Filter( )
END IF
dw_main.SetRedraw( True)
IF idc_jcje <> 0.00 THEN
	st_text.Text = '当前设置的三倍均次费用为:' + String(idc_jcje) + st_text.Text
ELSE
	st_text.Text = '' + st_text.Text
END IF




end event

event clicked;//符合医保费用fhybfy=hjje-zfje-zlje
//医保均次费用=fhybfy/jzrc(zy:sjzs)
//三倍均次费用=3*医保均次费用  //自己输
//企业在职101企业退休100公务员在职201公务员退休200

String ls_mess,ls_default
String ls_je
Dec{2} ldc_jczje,ldc_jcfy
ldc_jczje = 0.00
 

If (Upper(ddlb_yblb.getcode( )) = 'JBYL' Or Upper(ddlb_yblb.getcode( )) = 'CXJM' Or Upper(ddlb_yblb.getcode( )) = 'CXJMBHWCN')  THEN
	IF dw_main.RowCount( ) > 0 And Lower(dw_main.DataObject) = 'd_ylfyhzb' THEN
		ldc_jczje = dw_main.Object.jcylf[1]
		ls_mess = String(em_1.getdatetime( 1))+'-'+String(em_2.getdatetime( 2))+"的医保均次费用为:"+String(ldc_jczje)
	ELSE
		ls_mess = String(em_1.getdatetime( 1))+'-'+String(em_2.getdatetime( 2))
	END IF
ELSE
	Int i,j
	Long ll_jzrc,ll_sjzs
	ldc_jczje = 0
	ll_jzrc = 0
	ll_sjzs = 0
	ldc_jcfy = 0
	FOR i = 1 To dw_main.RowCount( )
		IF dw_main.Object.cbrlb[i] = '100' Or dw_main.Object.cbrlb[i] = '101' Or dw_main.Object.cbrlb[i] = '200' Or dw_main.Object.cbrlb[i] = '201' THEN
			ldc_jczje = ldc_jczje+dw_main.Object.fhybfy[i]
			ll_jzrc = ll_jzrc+dw_main.Object.jzrc[i]
			ll_sjzs = ll_sjzs+dw_main.Object.sjzs[i]
		END IF
	NEXT
	
	IF ll_jzrc > 0 THEN
		IF is_ywlx = 'MZ' THEN
			ldc_jcfy = ldc_jczje/ll_jzrc
		ELSE
			//ldc_jcfy=ldc_jczje/ll_sjzs
			ldc_jcfy = ldc_jczje/ll_jzrc
		END IF
	ELSE
		ldc_jcfy = 0
	END IF
	
	ls_mess = String(em_1.getdatetime( 1))+'-'+String(em_2.getdatetime( 2))+"公务员在职、退休，企业在职退休总共的医保均次费用为:"+String(ldc_jcfy)
END IF

IF idc_jcje = 0.00 THEN
	st_text.Text = ''
ELSE
	st_text.Text = '当前设置的三倍均次费用为:' + String(idc_jcje)
END IF

public subroutine wf_hdjy_bd_new ();String ls_jsjylsh,ls_ybfyze,ls_error1,ls_error2 ,ls_error3,ls_errortext,ls_error4,ls_jssj,ls_grbh
Dec{2} ld_fyze,ld_ybfyze,ld_jzje,ld_bxje
Long ll_jymx_count,ll_dzxx_count,ll_find,i,ll_jdrow
DateTime ldt_jssj
String ls_ztbz,ls_yxbz,ls_bxzje
ls_error1 = '结算交易流水号：'
ls_error3 = '结算交易流水号：'
ls_error2 = ''
ls_error4 = ''
ls_errortext = ''
tab_1.tab_errortext.mle_1.Text = ''


//==========================
ll_jymx_count = tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.RowCount() //本地
ll_dzxx_count = tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.RowCount() //导入的社保明细

IF ll_jymx_count <= 0 THEN
	MessageBox('提示','请先统计交易明细')
	RETURN
END IF
IF ll_dzxx_count <= 0 THEN
	MessageBox('提示','请先下载交易明细，并检查是否已正确导入')
	RETURN
END IF
tab_1.tab_mzjd.dw_mzjd.dataobject = 'd_pyyb_zxmx_new' 
tab_1.tab_mzjd.dw_mzjd.settransobject( sqlca)
FOR i = 1 To ll_jymx_count
	ls_jsjylsh = tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.Object.jslsh[i]
	ld_fyze = tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.Object.fyze[i]
	ld_jzje = tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.Object.hjbxje[i]
	ll_find = tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Find("cbdjslsh='"+ls_jsjylsh+"'",1,ll_dzxx_count)
	IF ll_find > 0 THEN
		ld_ybfyze = Dec(tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.ylfyze[ll_find])
		ld_bxje = Dec(tab_1.tab_dzwj.dw_dzwj.Object.bxje[ll_find])
//		ld_bxje = Dec(ls_bxzje)
//		ld_ybfyze = Dec(ls_ybfyze)
		IF ld_fyze <> ld_ybfyze Or  ld_jzje <> ld_bxje THEN

event doubleclicked;call super::doubleclicked;String ls_brbm, ls_jsjylsh
Long ll_zyh
DateTime ldt_jysj
String ls_jzkh
s_exchange ls_exchange

IF row > 0 THEN
	il_select = row
	This.SelectRow( 0, False )
	This.SelectRow( il_select, True )
	
	IF ii_bplx = 6 THEN //住院
		ll_zyh = This.Object.zyh[il_select]
	ELSEIF ii_bplx = 3 THEN //基金支付不平
		IF IsNull(This.Object.brbm0[il_select]) Or This.Object.brbm0[il_select] = "" THEN
			ll_zyh = Long(This.Object.brbm[il_select])
			ii_bplx = 32 //基金支付不平（住院）
		ELSE
			ls_brbm = This.Object.brbm[il_select]
			ii_bplx = 31 //基金支付不平（门诊）
		END IF
	ELSE
		ls_brbm = This.Object.brbm[il_select]
	END IF
	ls_exchange.LongParm[1] = ii_bplx
	ls_exchange.LongParm[2] = ll_zyh
	ls_exchange.StringParm[1] = ls_brbm
	ls_exchange.StringParm[2] = ls_jsjylsh
	ls_exchange.datetimeparm[1] = idt_begin
	ls_exchange.datetimeparm[2] = idt_end
	ls_exchange.datetimeparm[3] = ldt_jysj
	IF ll_zyh > 0 THEN
		SELECT knxx Into :ls_jzkh From bqxt.zy_brry Where zyh = :ll_zyh Using sqlca;
	ELSE
		SELECT jzkh Into :ls_jzkh From mzxt.mz_brda Where brbm = :ls_brbm Using sqlca;
	END IF
	IF sqlca.SQLCode = 0 THEN
		IF Left(ls_jzkh,4) = '3311' Or Len(ls_jzkh) <  30 THEN
			ls_exchange.StringParm[3] = 'lb'
		ELSE
			ls_exchange.StringParm[3] = 'syd'
		END IF
	END IF
	OpenWithParm(w_sbdz_bptz, ls_exchange)
END IF
end event

//20190917 自动作废-1改帐记录
datastore lds_lsgz
Long ll_rowcount,ll_row
lds_lsgz = create datastore
lds_lsgz.dataobject = 'd_sbdz_jsmx_lsgz'
lds_lsgz.settransobject( sqlca)
ll_rowcount = lds_lsgz.retrieve( idt_begin,idt_end )
String ls_jylsh,ls_ywlx,ls_mzyh,ls_jyzqh,ls_czbxzqh,ls_grbm
dec{2} ldc_ylfze
FOR ll_row = 1 to ll_rowcount
	ls_jylsh = Trim(lds_lsgz.Object.jylsh[ll_row])
	ls_czbxzqh = Trim(lds_lsgz.Object.cbdxzhq[ll_row])
	ls_grbm = Trim(lds_lsgz.Object.grbh[ll_row])
	ls_ywlx = Trim(lds_lsgz.Object.ywlx[ll_row])
	ldc_ylfze = lds_lsgz.Object.ylfze[ll_row]
	
	IF ls_ywlx = 'ZY' THEN
		IF ldc_ylfze >= 0 THEN
			ls_ywlx = 'ZYSF'
		ELSE
			ls_ywlx = 'ZYTF'
		END IF
	ELSEIF ls_ywlx = 'SF' THEN
		IF ldc_ylfze >= 0 THEN
			ls_ywlx = 'MZSF'
		ELSE
			ls_ywlx = 'MZTF'
		END IF
	END IF
	ls_mzyh = Trim(lds_lsgz.Object.ywlsh[ll_row])
	ls_jyzqh = Trim(lds_lsgz.Object.jyzqh[ll_row])
	String ls_czybm
	SELECT sptdm Into :ls_czybm From jkxt.lsyb_czy_qrqc Where jyzqh = :ls_jyzqh;
	IF IsNull(ls_czybm) Or ls_czybm = '' THEN
		MessageBox('失败','找不到收费员信息!')
		RETURN
	END IF
	IF iu_lsyb.uf_jyzf_dz(ls_czybm, ls_czbxzqh, ls_grbm, ls_jyzqh, ls_ywlx, ls_mzyh, ls_jylsh,ls_err) > 0 THEN
	ELSE
		MessageBox('信息提示','失败'+ls_err)
		RETURN
	END IF
NEXT

MessageBox('信息提示','对账通过！')
Destroy iu_lsyb
end event

event dw_main::doubleclicked;call super::doubleclicked;IF ROW <= 0 Or ROW > This.RowCount( ) THEN RETURN
String ls_brbm,ls_lxdh,ls_lxdh2,lxfs
Dec{0} ldc_zyh
IF dw_main.Object.ywlx[ROW] = 'GH' Or dw_main.Object.ywlx[ROW] = 'SF' THEN
	ls_brbm = dw_main.Object.brbm[ROW]
	SELECT yddh,gddh Into :ls_lxdh,:ls_lxdh2 From mz_Brda Where brbm = :ls_brbm;
ELSEIF dw_main.Object.ywlx[ROW] = 'ZY' THEN
	ldc_zyh = dw_main.Object.zyh[ROW]
	SELECT jtdh,lxdh Into :ls_lxdh,:ls_lxdh2 From zy_Brry Where zyh = :ldc_zyh;
END IF
IF IsNull(ls_lxdh) Or ls_lxdh = '' THEN
ELSE
	lxfs = '联系电话:' +  ls_lxdh
END IF
IF IsNull(ls_lxdh2) Or ls_lxdh2 = '' THEN
ELSE
	IF IsNull(lxfs) Or lxfs = '' THEN
		lxfs = '联系电话:' +  ls_lxdh2
	ELSE
		lxfs = ' ,' +  ls_lxdh2
	END IF
END IF
IF IsNull(lxfs) Or lxfs = '' THEN
	lxfs = '暂无联系方式'
END IF
MessageBox("姓名：" + String( dw_main.Object.brxm[ROW]),lxfs)


end event

event selectionchanged;call super::selectionchanged;if ddlb_1.getcode() = 'QB' THEN
	dw_main.SETFIlter( '')
ELSEif ddlb_1.getcode() = 'MZ' THEN 
	IF rb_yb.checked THEN 
		dw_main.SETFIlter( "jyjslx <> '30'")
	ELSEIF rb_nb.checked THEN 
		dw_main.SETFIlter( "jyjslx in ('10','12','17','18')")

		dw_main.SETFIlter( '')

event modified;string ls_filter
long ll_row,ll_rowcount ,ll_index

ll_rowcount = dw_1.rowcount( )
for ll_index = 1 to ll_rowcount

	dw_1.selectrow(ll_index, false)
next

ll_row = dw_1.find( ls_filter,il_row +1 ,ll_rowcount)

if ll_row > 0 then 
	il_row = ll_row
	dw_1.scrolltorow( ll_row)
	dw_1.selectrow(ll_row, true)
else
	il_row = 0
end if

event clicked;
String ls_error = '',ls_fail = '',ls_sfhx
String ls_czgh,ls_dzlsh,ls_czyzh,ls_suc,ls_zdjylsh = '0'

Long ll_row ,ll_rowcount,ll_xzts
ll_rowcount = dw_1.RowCount( )

FOR ll_row = 1 To ll_rowcount
	ls_czgh = ''
	ls_dzlsh = ''
	IF dw_1.Object.xz[ll_row] = 0  THEN CONTINUE
	ls_czgh = dw_1.Object.ygdm[ll_row]
	ls_czyzh = dw_1.Object.sptbm[ll_row]
	ls_dzlsh = dw_1.Object.jyzqh[ll_row]
	ls_zdjylsh = '0'
	ls_sfhx = '1'
	DO WHILE ls_sfhx = '1'
		gu_ybjk_public.iu_tzsydjk.uf_send_init ( '9355')
		gu_ybjk_public.iu_tzsydjk.uf_send_add( '已下载最大交易流水号',ls_zdjylsh)
		gu_ybjk_public.iu_tzsydjk.uf_send_add( '操作员账号',ls_czyzh) //008049   3311001000050036

			END IF
		NEXT
		
	ELSE		
		ls_error = ''
		FOR ll_row = 1 To ll_count
			ls_ywlx = tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.Object.ywlx[ll_row]
			ldc_zyh = tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.Object.zyh[ll_row]
			ldt_jssj = tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.Object.jssj[ll_row]
			ls_mzyh = tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.Object.jyid[ll_row]
			ls_jylsh = tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.Object.jslsh[ll_row]
			ls_cbd = tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.Object.cbdxzqh[ll_row]
			IF ldc_zyh > 0 THEN
				SELECT ybkh,zhbz,knxx Into :ls_kh,:ls_sbm,:ls_knxx From bqxt.zy_brry Where zyh = :ldc_zyh;
				gu_ybjk_public.iu_tzsydjk.istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.knsj = ls_knxx
				gu_ybjk_public.iu_tzsydjk.istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.shbzkkh = ls_kh
				gu_ybjk_public.iu_tzsydjk.istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.shbzksbm = ls_sbm
				IF tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.Object.ylfyze[ll_row] < 0 THEN
					ls_jylx = 'ZYTF'
					ls_jyh = '9209'
				ELSE
					ls_jylx = 'ZYSF'
					ls_jyh = '9208'
				END IF
			ELSE
				ls_brbm = tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.Object.BRBM[ll_row]
				
				SELECT JZKH,BRXM,SFZH Into :ls_knxx,:ls_brxm,:ls_sfzh From MZXT.MZ_BRDA Where BRBM = :ls_brbm;
				IF Left(ls_knxx,6) = 'YBDZPZ' THEN
					SELECT ZJLX,LPSJ Into :ls_zjlx,:ls_zflp From  JKXT.YB_BRJBXXKZ Where ZJHM = :ls_sfzh And cbdxzqh = :ls_cbd;
					IF ls_zjlx > '' THEN
					ELSE
						ls_zflp = Mid(ls_knxx,7)
						ls_zjlx = '01'
					END IF
				END IF
				IF Left(ls_knxx,6) = 'YBDZPZ' THEN
					gu_ybjk_public.iu_tzsydjk.istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.knsj = ls_brxm + "|" +ls_zjlx + "|" +ls_sfzh+'|' + ls_zflp + '|' + ls_cbd + '|||ZJA06B07C36D70|'+ String(base_info.syscode)
					gu_ybjk_public.iu_tzsydjk.istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.shbzkkh = ''
					gu_ybjk_public.iu_tzsydjk.istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.shbzksbm = ""
				ELSE
					gu_ybjk_public.iu_tzsydjk.istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.knsj = ls_knxx
					gu_ybjk_public.iu_tzsydjk.istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.shbzkkh = Right(ls_knxx,9)
					gu_ybjk_public.iu_tzsydjk.istr_yb_grjbxx_syb.shbzksbm = Mid(ls_knxx,1,Len(ls_knxx) -9)
				END IF
				IF tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.Object.ylfyze[ll_row] < 0 THEN
					ls_jylx = 'MZTF'
					ls_jyh = '9204'
				ELSE
					ls_jylx = 'MZSF'
					ls_jyh = '9203'
				END IF
			END IF
			
			IF gu_ybjk_public.iu_tzsydjk.uf_jyzf( ldt_jssj, ls_jylsh, ls_jyh, ls_cbd, ls_return) <= 0 THEN
				ls_error = ls_error + ls_return
			END IF
		NEXT
	END IF
	IF ll_row >= ll_count THEN
		IF  ls_error > '' THEN
			MessageBox('提示','作废出错：' + ls_error)
		ELSE
			MessageBox('提示','作废成功')
		END IF
	END IF
END IF

on w_sbdz_py.create
int iCurrent
call super::create
this.em_1=create em_1
this.st_1=create st_1
this.cbx_sbgz=create cbx_sbgz
this.ddlb_ywlx=create ddlb_ywlx
this.st_2=create st_2
this.dw_bpmx=create dw_bpmx
iCurrent=UpperBound(this.Control)
this.Control[iCurrent+1]=this.em_1
this.Control[iCurrent+2]=this.st_1
this.Control[iCurrent+3]=this.cbx_sbgz
this.Control[iCurrent+4]=this.ddlb_ywlx
this.Control[iCurrent+5]=this.st_2
this.Control[iCurrent+6]=this.dw_bpmx
end on

on w_sbdz_py.destroy
call super::destroy
destroy(this.em_1)
destroy(this.st_1)
destroy(this.cbx_sbgz)
destroy(this.ddlb_ywlx)
destroy(this.st_2)
destroy(this.dw_bpmx)
end on

//根据异地本地做过滤处理
//IF li_ywlx = 1 THEN
//	tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.SetFilter("cbdxzhq = '"+is_cbdxzhq+"' or isnull(cbdxzhq)")
//	tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.Filter( )
//ELSE
//	tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.SetFilter("cbdxzhq <> '"+is_cbdxzhq+"'")
//	tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.Filter( )
//END IF
IF tab_1.tabpage_1.dw_jymx.RowCount( ) <= 0 THEN
	MessageBox('提示','该天没有社保交易明细!')
END IF
//有社保明细再进行判断计算reset()
dw_1.Reset()
tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.Reset()
tab_1.tab_dzxx.dw_dzxx.Reset()
//显示本月对账信息
tab_1.tab_dzxx.dw_dzxx.Retrieve(ls_yf)
//对对账结果进行判断，有记录则不再判断，无记录则对社保交易明细与fpk等是否保持一致
ll_rowcount = dw_1.Retrieve( is_dzr,li_ywlx)
tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.Retrieve(idt_begin,idt_end)
IF ll_rowcount > 0 THEN
	dw_toolbar.Enabled = True
	IF li_ywlx = 1 THEN
		IF gu_ybjk_public.ii_tzsybxjkqy=1 Then
			IF dw_1.Object.dzjgbz[1] = '0' THEN
				RETURN
			ELSEIF base_info.qxjb < 2 THEN
				RETURN
			END IF
		ELSE
			IF dw_1.Object.dzjg[1] = 0 THEN
				RETURN
			ELSEIF base_info.qxjb < 2 THEN
				RETURN
			END IF
		END IF
	ELSE
		IF base_info.hospitalcode = '9' THEN //台州市异地
			dw_1.Object.ywlx[1] = li_ywlx
			RETURN
		ELSE
			IF dw_1.Object.dzjg[1] <> 0 THEN
				RETURN
			ELSEIF base_info.qxjb < 2 THEN
				RETURN
			END IF
		END IF
	END IF
ELSE
	IF li_ywlx = 1 THEN
		dw_1.InsertRow(1)
		dw_1.Object.ywlx[1] = li_ywlx
		dw_1.Object.dzr[1] = is_dzr
		IF wf_dzyz() < 0 THEN
			RETURN
		END IF
	ELSEIF li_ywlx =  2 THEN
		IF base_info.hospitalcode = '9' THEN //台州市异地
			dw_1.Object.dzlx[1] = string(li_ywlx)
			dw_1.Object.dzrq[1] = em_1.getdate( )	
			dw_1.Object.ywlx[1] = li_ywlx
			dw_1.Object.dzr[1] = is_dzr	
			RETURN
		END IF	
		
		SELECT count(1) Into :ll_count From JKXT.PYYB_DZXX   Where PYYB_DZXX.dzr = :is_dzr ;
		IF ll_count > 0 THEN
			dw_1.InsertRow(1)
			dw_1.Object.ywlx[1] = li_ywlx
			dw_1.Object.dzr[1] = is_dzr	
		ELSE
			MessageBox('提示','请先本地对账!')
			RETURN
		END IF
	END IF
END IF

IF ddlb_ywlx.getCode()='1' and gu_ybjk_public.ii_tzsybxjkqy=1 THen
	tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.Retrieve(idt_begin,idt_end)
//	dw_1.InsertRow(1)
//	dw_1.Object.dzlx[1] = ls_dzlx
//	dw_1.Object.dzrq[1] =  Date(idt_begin)
ELSE
	//获取对应的总额值,进行中心对账
	wf_getdzxx(idt_begin,li_ywlx)
	//保存
	gf_begin_transaction(sqlca)
	IF dw_1.Update( ) = 1 THEN
		gf_commit_transaction(sqlca)
		dw_1.Retrieve(is_dzr,li_ywlx)
		tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.Retrieve(idt_begin,idt_end)
	ELSE
		gf_rollback_transaction(sqlca)
		gf_waiting('汇总数据出错，请重试......',-1)
		dw_1.Reset( )
		dw_1.InsertRow(1)
		MessageBox('提示','汇总数据出错，请重试!')
		SetNull(is_dzr)
		RETURN
	END IF
END IF
gf_waiting('统计数据完成......',-1)

end event

event clicked;call super::clicked;IF row > 0 THEN
	il_select = row
	This.SelectRow( 0, False )
	This.SelectRow( il_select, True )

END IF

end event

event doubleclicked;call super::doubleclicked;String ls_brbm, ls_jsjylsh
Dec{0} ll_zyh
DateTime ldt_jysj
String ls_jzkh
s_exchange ls_exchange

IF row > 0 THEN
	il_select = row
	nextrow:
	This.SelectRow( 0, False )
	This.SelectRow( il_select, True )
	
	IF ii_bplx = 6 THEN //住院
		ll_zyh = This.Object.zyh[il_select]
	ELSEIF ii_bplx = 3 THEN //基金支付不平
		IF This.Object.zyh[il_select] > 0 THEN
			ll_zyh = This.Object.zyh[il_select]
			ii_bplx = 32 //基金支付不平（住院）
		ELSE
			ls_brbm = This.Object.brbm[il_select]
			ii_bplx = 31 //基金支付不平（门诊）
		END IF
	ELSE
		ls_brbm = This.Object.brbm[il_select]
	END IF
	IF ii_bplx = 4 Or ii_bplx = 41 THEN
		IF cbx_1.Checked  THEN
			ii_bplx = 41
		ELSE
			ii_bplx = 4
		END IF
	END IF
	ls_exchange.LongParm[1] = ii_bplx
	ls_exchange.LongParm[2] = ll_zyh
	ls_exchange.StringParm[1] = ls_brbm
	ls_exchange.StringParm[2] = ls_jsjylsh
	ls_exchange.datetimeparm[1] = idt_begin
	ls_exchange.datetimeparm[2] = idt_end
	ls_exchange.datetimeparm[3] = ldt_jysj
	IF ll_zyh > 0 THEN
		SELECT SBHM Into :ls_jzkh From bqxt.zy_brry Where zyh = :ll_zyh Using sqlca;
	ELSE
		SELECT jzkh Into :ls_jzkh From mzxt.mz_brda Where brbm = :ls_brbm Using sqlca;
	END IF
	IF sqlca.SQLCode = 0 THEN
		IF Left(ls_jzkh,4) = '3303' OR len(ls_jzkh) < 30 THEN
			ls_exchange.StringParm[3] = 'wd'
		ELSE
			IF Left(ls_jzkh,6) = 'YBDZPZ' THEN
				Long ll_count
				SELECT COUNT(1) Into :ll_count From jkxt.yb_jsmx Where jssj >= :idt_begin And jssj <= :idt_end And brbm = :ls_brbm ;
				IF ll_count > 0  THEN
					ls_exchange.StringParm[3] = 'wd'
				ELSE
					ls_exchange.StringParm[3] = 'syd'
				END IF
			ELSE
				ls_exchange.StringParm[3] = 'syd'
			END IF
		END IF
	END IF
	OpenWithParm(w_sbdz_bptz, ls_exchange)
	IF ii_bplx = 41  THEN
		IF il_select + 1 <= This.RowCount( ) THEN
			il_select = il_select + 1
			GOTO nextrow
		ELSE
			MessageBox('提示','完成')
		END IF

					END IF
				END IF
			END IF
		END IF

		ll_zyh = lds_brxx.Object.zyh[1]
		ii_bplx = 9
	END IF

event doubleclicked;call super::doubleclicked;String ls_brbm,ls_jzkh,ls_sfzh,ls_cbd
Long ll_zyh
DateTime ldt_jysj

s_exchange ls_exchange

IF row > 0 THEN
	il_select = row
	nextrow:
	This.SelectRow( 0, False )
	This.SelectRow( il_select, True )
	
	IF ii_bplx = 6 THEN //住院
		ll_zyh = This.Object.zyh[il_select]
	ELSEIF ii_bplx = 3 THEN //基金支付不平
		IF IsNull(This.Object.brbm0[il_select]) Or This.Object.brbm0[il_select] = "" THEN
			ll_zyh = Long(This.Object.brbm[il_select])
			ii_bplx = 32 //基金支付不平（住院）
		ELSE
			ls_brbm = This.Object.brbm[il_select]
			ii_bplx = 31 //基金支窪AT*
恫黄剑�门诊�

		END IF
	ELSE
		ls_brbm = This.Object.brbm[il_select]
	END IF
	IF ii_bplx = 4 Or ii_bplx = 41 THEN
		IF tab_1.tabpage_1.cbx_1.Checked  THEN
			ii_bplx = 41
		ELSE
			ii_bplx = 4
		END IF
	END IF
	ls_exchange.LongParm[1] = ii_bplx
	ls_exchange.LongParm[2] = ll_zyh
	ls_exchange.StringParm[1] = ls_brbm
	ls_exchange.StringParm[2] = ''
	ls_exchange.datetimeparm[1] = idt_begin
	ls_exchange.datetimeparm[2] = idt_end
	ls_exchange.datetimeparm[3] = ldt_jysj
	IF ll_zyh > 0 THEN
		SELECT knxx,sfzh,sbhm Into :ls_jzkh,:ls_sfzh,:ls_cbd From bqxt.zy_brry Where zyh = :ll_zyh Using sqlca;
		if len(ls_jzkh) <  30  and posw(ls_jzkh,'|') = 0 then
			ls_cbd = gu_pyybjk.is_yljgxzqh
		else
			if isnull(ls_cbd) or ls_cbd = '' then
				ls_cbd = Left(ls_jzkh,6)
			end if
		end if
	ELSE
		SELECT jzkh,sfzh Into :ls_jzkh,:ls_sfzh From mzxt.mz_brda Where brbm = :ls_brbm Using sqlca;
		if left(ls_jzkh,6) = 'YBDZPZ' THEN
			SELECT CBDXZQH INTO :ls_cbd FROM JKXT.YB_BRJBXXKZ WHERE ZJHM = :ls_sfzh ORDER BY GXSJ DESC;
			IF ls_cbd > '0' THEN
			ELSE
				ls_cbd = gu_pyybjk.is_yljgxzqh
			END IF
		ELSE
			ls_cbd = Left(ls_jzkh,6)
		END IF
	END IF
	
	//IF sqlca.SQLCode = 0 THEN
	IF ls_cbd > '' THEN
		IF is_yybz = 'TZFBY' THEN //wangyi 20190424			
			//IF Left(ls_jzkh,6) = gu_tzybjk.is_yljgxzqh THEN
        IF Pos(is_tzsbj , ls_cbd) > 0 THEN
				ls_exchange.StringParm[3] = 'tzsbd'		
			ELSEIF Left(ls_cbd,4) = '3310' THEN
				ls_exchange.StringParm[3] = 'tzsyd'
			ELSE
				ls_exchange.StringParm[3] = 'syd'
			END IF
		ELSE
			IF ls_cbd = gu_pyybjk.is_yljgxzqh THEN
				ls_exchange.StringParm[3] = 'ep'
			ELSEIF Left(ls_jzkh,4) = '3303' or len(ls_jzkh) <  30 THEN
				ls_exchange.StringParm[3] = 'wd'
			ELSE
				ls_exchange.StringParm[3] = 'syd'
			END IF
		END IF
	END IF
//	ls_exchange.StringParm[3] = 'ep'
	OpenWithParm(w_sbdz_bptz, ls_exchange)

on w_tzyb_dbzcx.create
int iCurrent
call super::create
this.em_begin=create em_begin
this.em_end=create em_end
this.st_1=create st_1
this.st_2=create st_2
this.oleobject_1=create oleobject_1
iCurrent=UpperBound(this.Control)
this.Control[iCurrent+1]=this.em_begin
this.Control[iCurrent+2]=this.em_end
this.Control[iCurrent+3]=this.st_1
this.Control[iCurrent+4]=this.st_2
end on

on w_tzyb_dbzcx.destroy
call super::destroy
destroy(this.em_begin)
destroy(this.em_end)
destroy(this.st_1)
destroy(this.st_2)
destroy(this.oleobject_1)
end on

event open;call super::open;//sqlca_query = Create Transaction
//uo_support.SetTransObject(sqlca_query)
//IF Not uo_support.dbconnect(gs_ini,"Database_TJ") THEN
//	HALT CLOSE
//	RETURN
//END IF
IF IsValid(sqlca_query) = True THEN
	IF sqlca_query.DBHandle( ) > 0 THEN
	ELSE
		uo_support.SetTransObject(sqlca_query)
		IF Not uo_support.dbconnect(gs_ini,"Database_TJ") THEN
			uo_support.SetTransObject(sqlca)
			messagebox('提示1','查询数据库连接失败！')
			RETURN
		END IF
		uo_support.SetTransObject(sqlca)
	END IF
ELSE
	sqlca_query = Create Transaction
	uo_support.SetTransObject(sqlca_query)
	IF Not uo_support.dbconnect(gs_ini,"Database_TJ") THEN
		uo_support.SetTransObject(sqlca)
		messagebox('提示2','查询数据库连接失败！')
		RETURN
	END IF
	uo_support.SetTransObject(sqlca)
END IF

dw_main.settransobject(sqlca_query)
em_begin.setdate(date(gf_server_date()))
em_end.setdate(date(gf_server_date()))

end event

event ue_ref;call super::ue_ref;DateTime ldt_begin,ldt_end,ldt_now
long ll_row

ldt_begin = em_begin.getdatetime(1)
ldt_end = em_end.getdatetime(2)
ldt_now = gf_server_date()
dw_main.Reset( )
ll_row=dw_main.retrieve(ldt_begin,ldt_end)
if ll_row<=0 then
	messagebox('提示','此时间段内没有单边账')
end if





end event

event ue_find;call super::ue_find;u_office_excel uo_excel
IF dw_main.RowCount( ) <= 0 THEN
	MessageBox('提示','没有记录可导出！')
ELSE
	uo_excel.of_savexlsfile(dw_main.Object.t_title.Text,dw_main,'制表时间:' + String(gf_server_date()))
END IF

end event
