event clicked;Long ll_row, ll_rowCount
Integer li_checkValue

ll_rowCount = dw_hxhz.rowCount()
IF ll_rowCount<=0 Then Return


IF this.text='全选' Then
	li_checkValue = 1
ELSE
	li_checkValue = 0
END IF

	
For ll_row=1 to ll_rowCount Step 1
	IF Long(dw_hxhz.Object.ZTBZ[ll_row]) = 99 Then
		dw_hxhz.Object.isChecked[ll_row] = li_checkValue
	ELSE
		dw_hxhz.Object.isChecked[ll_row] = 0
	END IF
Next


// 修改按钮名称
IF li_checkValue=1 THen
	this.text='取消全选'
Else
	this.text='全选'
END IF
end event

type cb_hx from vu_buttonzx within w_tzyb_dbzhx
integer x = 2706
integer y = 68
integer taborder = 20
boolean bringtotop = true
string text = "核销(&T)"
end type

event clicked;call super::clicked;Long ll_row, ll_rowCount
Integer li_ZTBZ
String ls_jsjylsh
Decimal{2} ldc_fyze
DateTime ldt_jssj
str_yb_jsxx lstr_yb_jsxx
str_tzyb_jsxx lstr_tzyb_jsxx
String ls_error

ll_rowCount = dw_hxhz.rowCount()
IF ll_rowCount<=0 Then Return


gf_begin_transaction(sqlca)
For ll_row=1 to ll_rowCount Step 1
	
	IF dw_hxhz.Object.isChecked[ll_row]<>1 or dw_hxhz.Object.ztbz[ll_row]<>99 Then 
		Continue
	END IF
	
	ls_jsjylsh = String(dw_hxhz.Object.jsjylsh[ll_row])   // 结算交易流水号
	ldc_fyze = Double(dw_hxhz.Object.fyze[ll_row])        // 费用总额
	ldt_jssj = dw_hxhz.Object.jssj[ll_row]                // 结算时间
	
	IF gu_ybjk_public.uf_mzdbz_tfcl( istr_brxx.jzkh, ls_jsjylsh, base_info.userid, ldc_fyze, gstr_jqxx.as_jqm, ldt_jssj, lstr_tzyb_jsxx, lstr_yb_jsxx, ls_error)<0 THEN
		gf_rollBack_transaction(sqlca)
		ls_error = "核销失败！JLLSH="+string(dw_hxhz.Object.JLLSH[ll_row])+" 错误原因：" + ls_error
		Messagebox("错误", ls_error)
		st_mess.Text = ls_error
		return
	END IF
	
Next
gf_commit_transaction(sqlca)
Messagebox("成功", "单边账核销成功！")


cb_refresh.event clicked( )
end event

event ue_keyenter;String ls_zxbb, ls_mess
SELECT ZXBB Into :ls_zxbb From SS_ZXBB Where XTSB = :base_info.syscode;
IF  ls_zxbb > gs_zxbb THEN
	MessageBox('提示','您当前使用的门诊收费程序并不是最新版本，请马上退出程序重新登录!!!')
	mzsf_main.af_close()
	Close(Parent)
	HALT CLOSE;
	RETURN
END IF

str_brxx lstr_brxx
lstr_brxx.jzkh = This.Text
boolean lb_ybjk = true

IF isnull(lstr_brxx.jzkh) or Len(Trim(lstr_brxx.jzkh))<=0 THEN 
	ls_mess = "就诊卡号为空，请重新刷卡！"
	Messagebox('提示', ls_mess)
	st_mess.Text = ls_mess
	return
END IF
	
	
str_return lstr_return
IF Mid( This.Text,1,4) = 'BRBM' THEN
	lstr_brxx.brbm = Mid(This.Text,5)
	lstr_return = uf_get_brxx(lb_ybjk, 'BRBM',lstr_brxx)
ELSE
	lstr_return = uf_get_brxx(lb_ybjk,lstr_brxx) //获取病人信息
END IF
IF lstr_return.ai_return < 0 THEN
	MessageBox('提示','无效病人信息!' + lstr_return.as_error)
	st_mess.Text = '无效病人信息!' + lstr_return.as_error
	sle_jzkh.SetFocus( )
	RETURN
END IF
	
// 给窗体实例变量的病人基本信息赋值
istr_brxx = lstr_brxx
	
// 写病人基本信息
sle_brxm.Text = istr_brxx.brxm
IF istr_brxx.brxb=1 Then
	sle_xb.Text = '男'
ELSEIF istr_brxx.brxb=2 Then
	sle_xb.Text = '女'
ELSE
	sle_xb.Text = ''
END IF
sle_yddh.Text = String(istr_brxx.yddh)
sle_csny.Text = String(istr_brxx.csny, 'yyyy-mm-dd')
Select xzmc into :sle_jslb.Text From xtgl.gy_brxz Where brxz=:istr_brxx.jslb Using sqlca;
IF isnull(sle_jslb.Text) or Len(Trim(sle_jslb.Text))<=0 Then sle_jslb.Text = String(istr_brxx.jslb)
Select dwmc into :sle_jsdw.Text From xtgl.gy_tgdw Where brxz=:istr_brxx.jslb and tgdw=:istr_brxx.jsdw Using sqlca;
IF isnull(sle_jsdw.Text) or Len(Trim(sle_jsdw.Text))<=0 Then sle_jsdw.Text = String(istr_brxx.jsdw)
	

IF istr_brxx.ztbz < 0 THEN
	MessageBox('提示',istr_brxx.brxm+' 的病人档案已经作废或者锁定，无法在门诊进行操作!'+lstr_return.as_error)
	RETURN
END IF
IF istr_brxx.ybpb = 1 THEN
	IF gu_ybjk_public.istr_yb_grjbxx.zydjbz = 1 THEN
		IF MessageBox('提示','该病人已经进行过住院登记，无法在门诊进行，是否继续?',Question!,YesNo!,2) = 1 THEN
		ELSE
			sle_jzkh.SetFocus( )
			RETURN
		END IF
	END IF
END IF
	

// 单击“刷新”按钮
cb_refresh.event clicked( )
end event

		ls_yg[ll_j] = dw_main.Object.gy_ygdm_ygdm[ll_i]
		IF ls_yg[ll_j] = '9999' THEN
			MessageBox('警告','操作员9999不允许注销')
			RETURN -1
		END IF
	END IF
NEXT

String ls_suc=''
IF gu_ybjk_public.is_ybkfs = 'EPTZ' THEN //台州市异地
	IF gu_ybjk_public.iu_tzsbdjk.uf_czy_zx(ls_yg,ls_err) > 0 THEN
		FOR ll_i = 1 To UpperBound(ls_yg)
			ls_suc = ls_suc+ls_yg[ll_i]+','
		NEXT
	ELSE
		MessageBox('信息提示','失败：'+ls_err)
		
RETURN -1
	END IF
ELSE
	FOR ll_i = 1 To UpperBound(ls_yg)
		IF gu_ybjk_public.uf_czy_zx( ls_yg[ll_i],ls_err) > 0 THEN
			ls_suc = ls_suc+ ','+ls_yg[ll_i]+','
		ELSE
			MessageBox('信息提示','失败：'+ls_err)
			EXIT
		END IF
	NEXT
END IF
IF ls_suc > '' THEN MessageBox('信息提示','成功注销员工：'+ls_suc)
dw_main.Retrieve( )


end event

//判断是否统计汇总过，汇总日期是否与显示一致
IF IsNull(idt_begin) Or IsNull(is_dzr) Or dw_1.RowCount( ) <= 0  THEN
	//	post event ue_ref()
	MessageBox('提示','请先汇总统计，再对账')
	RETURN
ELSE
	ls_dzr = dw_1.Object.dzr[1]
	
IF IsNull(ls_dzr) THEN
		MessageBox('提示','请先汇总统计，再对账')
		RETURN
	ELSE
		IF String(em_1.getdate( ),'yyyymmdd') <> ls_dzr Or Date(idt_begin) <> em_1.getdate( ) THEN
			MessageBox('提示','对账时间'+String(em_1.getdate( ),'yyyymmdd')+'与对账信息汇总中的对账日' + ls_dzr+'不一致,请重新统计汇总')
			RETURN
		END IF
	END IF
END IF

IF iu_zhyl_his.uf_czy_qrqc(Date(gf_server_date()),base_info.UserID,1,ls_err) = -1 THEN
	MessageBox('出错提示','获取操作员签到编号' + ls_err)
	RETURN
END IF

ll_rowcount = dw_1.RowCount()
IF ddlb_ywlx.getcode() = '1' THEN //本地对账
	IF ll_rowcount > 0 THEN
		gf_waiting('正在对账，请稍后......',1)
		FOR ll_i = 1 To ll_rowcount
			gf_waiting('正在对账，请稍后......',(ll_i*100/ll_rowcount))
			li_ywlx = dw_1.Object.ywlx[ll_i]
			ls_dzr = dw_1.Object.dzr[ll_i]
			ll_jybs = dw_1.Object.jybs[ll_i]
			ls_xz = dw_1.Object.xz[ll_i]
			ls_qslb = dw_1.Object.qslb[ll_i]
			ld_ylfyze = dw_1.Object.ylfze[ll_i]
			ld_jjzfze = dw_1.Object.jjzfze[ll_i]
			ld_grzhzfze = dw_1.Object.grzhzfze[ll_i]
			iu_zhyl_his.uf_send_init('3201')
			iu_zhyl_his.uf_send_add('insutype',ls_xz)
			iu_zhyl_his.uf_send_add('clr_type',ls_qslb)

				iu_zhyl_his.uf_send_add('setl_optins','330000')
			else
				iu_zhyl_his.uf_send_add('setl_optins',iu_zhyl_his.is_yljgxzqh)
			end if
			iu_zhyl_his.uf_send_add('stmt_begndate',Date(idt_begin))
			iu_zhyl_his.uf_send_add('stmt_enddate',Date(idt_end))
			iu_zhyl_his.uf_send_add('medfee_sumamt',ld_ylfyze)
			iu_zhyl_his.uf_send_add('fund_pay_sumamt',ld_jjzfze)
			iu_zhyl_his.uf_send_add('acct_pay',ld_grzhzfze)
			iu_zhyl_his.uf_send_add('fixmedins_setl_cnt',ll_jybs)
			iu_zhyl_his.uf_send_add('refd_setl_flag','')
			IF iu_zhyl_his.uf_send(ls_err,'') THEN
				IF iu_zhyl_his.uf_getdecimal('infcode') <> 0 THEN
					MessageBox('提示',iu_zhyl_his.uf_getstring('err_msg'))
					RETURN
				ELSE
					iu_zhyl_his.uf_Getstring_mxnr('stmtinfo')
					ls_dzjg = iu_zhyl_his.uf_getstring_in('stmt_rslt',1)
					ls_dzjgsm = iu_zhyl_his.uf_getstring_in('stmt_rslt_dscr',1)
					dw_1.Object.dzjg[ll_i] = ls_dzjg
					dw_1.Object.dzjgsm[ll_i] = ls_dzjgsm
					
				END IF
			ELSE
				gf_waiting('正在对账，请稍后......',-1)
				MessageBox('提示','险种:'+ls_xz+',类别:'+ls_qslb+'对账失败'+ls_err+',请程序退出重试！')
				RETURN
			END IF
		NEXT
	END IF
	
ELSE //异地对账
	IF ll_rowcount > 0 THEN
		gf_waiting('正在对账，请稍后......',1)
		FOR ll_i = 1 To ll_rowcount
			gf_waiting('正在对账，请稍后......',(ll_i*100/ll_rowcount))
			if dw_1.Object.dzjg[ll_i] = '1' then continue
			ls_cbdybqh = dw_1.Object.cbdybqh[ll_i]
			ls_rybh = dw_1.Object.rybh[ll_i]
			ld_ylfyze = dw_1.Object.ylfze[ll_i]
			ld_jjzfze = dw_1.Object.jbjgzfze[ll_i]
			ldt_jssj = dw_1.Object.jzjssj[ll_i]

			li_ywlx = dw_1.Object.ywlx[ll_i]

			iu_zhyl_his.istr_jytsrx.insuplc_admdvs = '330000' //20220208
			iu_zhyl_his.uf_send_add_in_mxnr('data')

			iu_zhyl_his.uf_send_add_in('insuplcAdmdvs',ls_cbdybqh,1)
			iu_zhyl_his.uf_send_add_in('fixmedinsNo',iu_zhyl_his.is_yljgdm,1)
			iu_zhyl_his.uf_send_add_in('psnNo',ls_rybh,1)
			iu_zhyl_his.uf_send_add_in('medfeeSumamt',ld_ylfyze,1)
			iu_zhyl_his.uf_send_add_in('optinsPaySumamt',ld_jjzfze,1)
			IF ld_ylfyze >= 0 THEN
				li_jylx = 1 //正交易
			ELSE
				li_jylx = 0 //负交易
			END IF
			iu_zhyl_his.uf_send_add_in('mdtrtSetlTime',String(ldt_jssj,'yyyymmddhhmmss'),1)
			iu_zhyl_his.uf_send_add_in('trnsType',li_jylx,1)
			iu_zhyl_his.uf_send_add_in('mdtrtSeq',ls_jzid,1) //就诊id
			iu_zhyl_his.uf_send_add_in('setlSn',ls_jslsh,1)
			JX:
			IF iu_zhyl_his.uf_send(ls_err,'') THEN
				IF iu_zhyl_his.uf_getdecimal('infcode') <> 0 THEN
					MessageBox('提示',iu_zhyl_his.uf_getstring('err_msg'))
					RETURN
				ELSE
					//	ll_cwts = iu_zhyl_his.uf_Getstring_mxnr('data')
					//for ll_rec = 1 to ll_cwts
					ls_dzjg = iu_zhyl_his.uf_getstring_in('succFlag',1)
					ls_dzjgsm = iu_zhyl_his.uf_getstring_in('prmmsg',1)
					dw_1.Object.dzjg[ll_i] = ls_dzjg
					dw_1.Object.dzjgsm[ll_i] = ls_dzjgsm
					//	next 
				END IF
			ELSE
				IF Pos(ls_err,'timeout') > 0 Or (ls_err = '' Or IsNull(ls_err)) THEN
					GOTO JX
				END IF
				gf_waiting('正在对账，请稍后......',-1)
				MessageBox('提示',ls_rybh+'对账失败'+ls_err+',请程序退出重试！')
				RETURN
			END IF
		NEXT
	END IF
END IF

	gf_commit_transaction(sqlca)	
	dw_1.Retrieve(ls_dzr,li_ywlx)
	tab_1.tab_dzxx.dw_dzxx.Retrieve(Left(ls_dzr,6))
	MessageBox('提示','对账完成')
ELSE
	gf_rollback_transaction(sqlca)
	MessageBox('提示','险种:'+ls_xz+',类别:'+ls_qslb+'社保对账结果：' + ls_dzjg +",保存失败!")

//dw_ysb.SetFilter( "sbbz=1")

j = 0

IF Not IsValid(iu_zhyl_his) THEN
	iu_zhyl_his = Create u_zhyl_his
	IF Not iu_zhyl_his.uf_init(ls_err) THEN
		MessageBox('提示','初始化医保接口对象失败!'+ls_err)
		RETURN
	END IF
END IF

IF iu_zhyl_his.uf_czy_qrqc(Date(gf_server_date()),base_info.UserID,1,ls_err) = -1 THEN
	MessageBox('出错提示','获取操作员签到编号' + ls_err)
	RETURN
END IF

gf_waiting('正在取消上报，请稍后......',1)
//FOR ll_i = 1 To ll_row
	ll_i = dw_ysb.getrow()
	gf_waiting('正在取消上报，请稍后......',(ll_i*100/ll_row))
//	li_sbbz = dw_ysb.Object.sbbz[ll_i]
//	IF li_sbbz = 1 THEN
		ls_sqid = dw_ysb.Object.clr_appy_evt_id[ll_i]

	gf_ROLLBACK_transaction(sqlca);
	MessageBox('出错提示','保存失败！'+ls_err )
	RETURN false

	gf_commit_transaction(sqlca);

end event

event ue_qssq();

ls_czgh = base_info.UserID

IF Not IsValid(iu_zhyl_his) THEN

	MessageBox('出错提示','获取操作员签到编号' + ls_err)
	RETURN
END IF

ll_row = dw_qssq.RowCount()
IF ll_row > 0 THEN
 	ls_qslb = dw_qssq.Object.qslb[1]
	ls_qsfs = dw_qssq.Object.qsfs[1]  
	ls_qsny = dw_qssq.Object.qsny[1] 
	ll_rc = dw_qssq.Object.qsrc[1] 
	ll_ylfze = dw_qssq.Object.ylfze[1] 
	ll_ybrkze = dw_qssq.Object.ybrkfyze[1] 
	ll_jjsbze = dw_qssq.Object.jjsbze[1]

	ll_grzhzc = dw_qssq.Object.grzhzc[1]

	ld_end = dw_qssq.Object.jssj[1] 

	
	iu_zhyl_his.uf_send_init('3203')
	//	iu_zhyl_his.uf_send_add_in_mxnr('data')
	iu_zhyl_his.uf_send_add('clr_type',ls_qslb)
	iu_zhyl_his.uf_send_add('clr_way',ls_qsfs)
	iu_zhyl_his.uf_send_add('setlym',ls_qsny)
	iu_zhyl_his.uf_send_add('psntime',ll_rc)
	iu_zhyl_his.uf_send_add('medfee_sumamt',ll_ylfze)
	iu_zhyl_his.uf_send_add('med_sumfee',ll_ybrkze)
	iu_zhyl_his.uf_send_add('fund_appy_sum',ll_jjsbze)
	iu_zhyl_his.uf_send_add('cash_payamt',ll_xjzfje)
	iu_zhyl_his.uf_send_add('acct_pay',ll_grzhzc)
	iu_zhyl_his.uf_send_add('begndate',ld_start)
	iu_zhyl_his.uf_send_add('enddate',ld_end)
	IF iu_zhyl_his .uf_send(ls_error,'') = True THEN
		IF iu_zhyl_his.uf_getdecimal('infcode') <> 0 THEN
			MessageBox('提示',iu_zhyl_his.uf_getstring('err_msg'))
			RETURN
		ELSE
			iu_zhyl_his.uf_Getstring_mxnr('result')
			ls_qsid = iu_zhyl_his.uf_getstring_in('clr_appy_evt_id',1)
			ll_insertrow = dw_ysb.InsertRow(0)

			dw_ysb.Object.clr_way[ll_insertrow] = ls_qsfs
			dw_ysb.Object.setlym[ll_insertrow] = ls_qsny
			dw_ysb.Object.psntime[ll_insertrow] = ll_rc
			dw_ysb.Object.medfee_sumamt[ll_insertrow] = ll_ylfze
			dw_ysb.Object.med_sumfee[ll_insertrow] =  ll_ybrkze
			dw_ysb.Object.fund_appy_sum[ll_insertrow] =  ll_jjsbze
			dw_ysb.Object.cash_payamt[ll_insertrow] = ll_xjzfje
			dw_ysb.Object.acct_pay[ll_insertrow] = ll_grzhzc
			dw_ysb.Object.begndate[ll_insertrow] = ld_start
			dw_ysb.Object.enddate[ll_insertrow] = ld_end
			dw_ysb.Object.CZSJ[ll_insertrow] = gf_server_date()
			dw_ysb.Object.ZFPB[ll_insertrow] = 0
			dw_ysb.Object.clr_appy_evt_id[ll_insertrow] = ls_qsid
		END IF
	ELSE
		MessageBox('提示',ls_error)
		RETURN
	END IF
END IF


IF dw_ysb.Update( ) <> 1 THEN
	gf_ROLLBACK_transaction(sqlca);
	Destroy iu_zhyl_his
	gf_waiting('正在上报，请稍后......',-1)
	MessageBox('出错提示','更新ZHYB_QSSQ出错，请重试' + sqlca.SQLErrText)
	RETURN
ELSE
	gf_waiting('正在上报，请稍后......',-1)
	gf_commit_transaction(sqlca);
	MessageBox('提示','上报成功！')
	PostEvent("ue_ref")
END IF



























end event

event ue_tj();string ls_qslb,ls_qsfs

decimal ll_rc,ll_ylfze,ll_ybrkze,ll_jjsbze,ll_xjzfje,ll_grzhzc
DateTime ldt_start,ldt_end

ldt_start = em_4.getdatetime(1)
ldt_end = em_5.getdatetime(2)
dw_qssq.reset()
dw_qssq.Object.t_jsny.Text = "申请年月:"  +  String(ldt_start,'yyyymm')
IF String(ldt_start,'yyyymm') <> String(ldt_end,'yyyymm') THEN
	MessageBox('错误提示','清算时间要在同一个自然月内')
	RETURN
END IF
ls_qslb = ddlb_qslb.getcode()
ls_qsfs = ddlb_qsfs.getcode()
SELECT Count(1) ,Sum(ylfze),Sum(jjzfze+grfdzje),Sum(jjzfze),Sum(grxjzc),sum(grzhzc) INTO:ll_rc,:ll_ylfze,
	:ll_ybrkze,:ll_jjsbze,:ll_xjzfje,:ll_grzhzc FROM jkxt.zhyb_jsmx WHERE qslb = :ls_qslb //AND (qsfs = :is_qsfs or qsfs='')
	And (jssj >= :ldt_start And jssj <= :ldt_end)  and substr(cbdxzqh,1,4)=:is_cbdxzhq and ztbz<>0 and(grzhzc+jjzfze)<>0; 
IF ll_rc> 0 THEN
	dw_qssq.insertrow(0)
	dw_qssq.Object.qslb[1] = ls_qslb
	dw_qssq.Object.qsfs[1] = ls_qsfs
	dw_qssq.Object.qsny[1] = String(ldt_start,'yyyymm')
	dw_qssq.Object.qsrc[1] = ll_rc
	dw_qssq.Object.ylfze[1] = ll_ylfze
	dw_qssq.Object.ybrkfyze[1] = ll_ybrkze
	dw_qssq.Object.jjsbze[1] = ll_jjsbze+ll_grzhzc
	dw_qssq.Object.xjzfje[1] = ll_xjzfje
	dw_qssq.Object.grzhzc[1] = ll_grzhzc
	dw_qssq.Object.kssj[1] = date(ldt_start)
	dw_qssq.Object.jssj[1] = date(ldt_end)
	dw_toolbar.of_setenabled('ue_qssq',true)
ELSE
	MessageBox('错误提示','清算时间内没有数据')
	RETURN
END IF





end event

public function decimal wf_getzxjj (long al_materialmanu);//
//  功能:获得最新进价zxjj
//  参数:物品产家add ljp 进价限制时用
//
//
decimal ld_Price

SELECT ZXJJ INTO :ld_Price FROM WZ_WPKC WHERE CKBH=2 AND WPCJ=:al_MaterialManu;
if isNull(ld_Price) or ld_Price<=0 then  
	SELECT JHJG INTO :ld_Price FROM WZ_WPKC WHERE CKBH=2 AND WPCJ=:al_MaterialManu;
	if isNull(ld_Price) or ld_Price<=0 then  //如果还没有最新进价,则取批发价
		SELECT PFJG INTO :ld_Price FROM WZ_WPCJ WHERE WPCJ=:al_MaterialManu;
	end if
end if

return ld_Price
end function

IF as_ywlx = 'SF' THEN
	lstr_yb_mzsfqq.ads_mzfymx.SetSort('xmsl D')
	lstr_yb_mzsfqq.ads_mzfymx.Sort( )
END IF
IF as_ywlx = 'GH' THEN
	li_ret = gu_ybjk_public.uf_gh_jscl( lstr_brxx.BRBM, True, ls_jylx, gstr_jqxx.as_jqm, lstr_yb_mzsfqq, lstr_yb_mzghqq, as_error)
ELSE
	IF gu_ybjk_public.uf_mz_jscl(lstr_brxx.BRBM, 1, ls_jylx,gstr_jqxx.as_jqm,lstr_yb_mzsfqq, as_error ) < 0 THEN
		GOTO Error
	
END IF
	li_ret = gu_ybjk_public.uf_mz_jscl(lstr_brxx.BRBM, 2, ls_jylx,gstr_jqxx.as_jqm,lstr_yb_mzsfqq, as_error )
END IF
IF li_ret < 0 THEN
	GOTO Error
ELSE
	ls_jsjylsh = lstr_yb_mzsfqq.str_yb_jsxx.jsjylsh
	//本次结算所有的不够市民卡支付，但是如果有支付，那么回滚
	IF IsNull(lstr_yb_mzsfqq.str_yb_jsxx.smkzhzfje) THEN lstr_yb_mzsfqq.str_yb_jsxx.smkzhzfje = 0.00
	//	ldc_smkzf = ldc_smkzf + lstr_yb_mzsfqq.str_yb_jsxx.smkzhzfje
	as_error = ''
	IF ldc_smkzf = 0 And lstr_yb_mzsfqq.str_yb_jsxx.smkzhzfje <> 0 THEN
		lb_isyz = True
		as_error = '原非市民卡账户支付，但现存在市民卡账户支付:' + String(lstr_yb_mzsfqq.str_yb_jsxx.smkzhzfje)
	ELSEIF ldc_smkzf <> 0 And (lstr_yb_mzsfqq.str_yb_jsxx.smkzhzfje <> lstr_yb_mzsfqq.str_yb_jsxx.xjzfze Or ldc_smkzf <> lstr_yb_mzsfqq.str_yb_jsxx.smkzhzfje) THEN
		lb_isyz = True
		as_error = '市民卡支付不一致，原:'+String(ldc_smkzf)+'自负：'+String(lstr_yb_mzsfqq.str_yb_jsxx.xjzfze) +"市民卡："+ String(lstr_yb_mzsfqq.str_yb_jsxx.smkzhzfje)
	END IF
	IF lb_isyz THEN
		gu_ybjk_public.uf_tkqr( 'MZ', lstr_brxx.jzkh,ls_jsjylsh,ldc_zjje,gstr_jqxx.as_jqm,ldt_now,lstr_yb_mzsfqq.str_yb_jsxx,as_error)
		//		gu_ybjk_public.uf_tkqr(lstr_brxx.jzkh,ls_jsjylsh,ldc_zjje,gstr_jqxx.as_jqm,ldt_now,lstr_yb_mzsfqq.str_yb_jsxx,as_error)
		GOTO Error
	END IF
	as_error = as_error + '医保金额：' + String(lstr_yb_mzsfqq.str_yb_jsxx.ylfyze) + '--' +String(lstr_yb_mzsfqq.str_yb_jsxx.jjzfze)

public function integer wf_getsyd (datetime adt_begin, datetime adt_end, string as_ywlx, long al_tsmxbz, decimal adc_jcfy);Dec{2} ldc_fyze,ldc_xjzf,ldc_jjzf,ldc_zfze,ldc_zlze,ldc_fhybfy,ldc_fpjz

	SELECT  SUM(FYZE) YLFYZE,
			  SUM(GRXJZF) XJZFZE,
			  SUM(HJBXJE) JJZFZE,
			  sum(CASE WHEN YWLX = 'SF' THEN HJBXJE ELSE 0 END) AS FPJZ,
			  SUM(CASE WHEN YWLX = 'GH' THEN 0  		         WHEN YWLX = 'SF' AND ZTBZ = 3 THEN -1 ELSE 1 END) SJZS ,
		     SUM(ZFZE) YLFYZFZE,
			  SUM(ZLZE) YLFYZLZE,
		     SUM(FYZE -ZLZE - ZFZE) FHYBFY
		INTO :ldc_fyze,:ldc_xjzf,:ldc_jjzf,:ldc_fpjz,:ll_sjzs,:ldc_zfze,:ldc_zlze,:ldc_fhybfy
		FROM JKXT.SYDYB_JSMX
		WHERE ( ZTBZ > 0 ) AND
				( JSLSH is NOT NULL ) AND
				( JSSJ >= :adt_begin) AND
				( JSSJ < :adt_end) AND
				( YWLX In ('SF','GH')) and
				( (nvl(GDBZBJ,'00') = '00'  and :al_tsmxbz=1) or ( nvl(GDBZBJ,'00') = '01'  and :al_tsmxbz=2) or (:al_tsmxbz=3) ) and
				(FYZE -ZLZE - ZFZE  <= :adc_jcfy OR :adc_jcfy = 0)
		Using sqlca_query;
	if dw_main.rowcount( ) > 0 then
		ll_insert = dw_main.find( "cbrlb = 'SYD' and ywlx = '"+as_ywlx+"'", 1, dw_main.rowcount( ) )
		if ll_insert <= 0 then  ll_insert =	dw_main.insertrow( 0)
	else
		ll_insert =	dw_main.insertrow( 0)
	end if
	dw_main.object.cbrlb[ll_insert] = 'SYD'
	dw_main.object.lbmc[ll_insert] = '省异地'
	dw_main.object.ywlx[ll_insert] = as_ywlx
	dw_main.object.sjzs[ll_insert] = ll_sjzs
	dw_main.object.jzrc[ll_insert] = 0
	dw_main.object.ljrc[ll_insert] = 0
	dw_main.object.ylfyzfze[ll_insert] = ldc_zfze
	dw_main.object.ylfyzlze[ll_insert] = ldc_zlze
	dw_main.object.jjzfze[ll_insert] = ldc_jjzf
	dw_main.object.xjzfze[ll_insert] = ldc_xjzf
	dw_main.object.ylfyze[ll_insert] = ldc_fyze
	dw_main.object.fpjz[ll_insert] = ldc_fpjz
	dw_main.object.fhybfy[ll_insert] = ldc_fhybfy
	SELECT count(DISTINCT to_char(jssj,'yyyymmdd') || brbm) INTO :ll_jzrc
	 FROM JKXT.SYDYB_JSMX  
   WHERE ( ZTBZ > 0 ) AND  
         ( JSLSH is not null ) AND  
         ( JSSJ >= :adt_begin) AND  
         ( JSSJ < :adt_end) AND  
         ( YWLX In ('SF','GH')) and 
			( (nvl(GDBZBJ,'00') = '00'  and :al_tsmxbz=1) or ( nvl(GDBZBJ,'00') = '01'  and :al_tsmxbz=2) or (:al_tsmxbz=3) ) and
			( FYZE -ZLZE - ZFZE  <= :adc_jcfy OR :adc_jcfy = 0)
		Using sqlca_query;
  dw_main.object.jzrc[ll_insert] = ll_jzrc
   SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT GRBH||cbdxzqh) INTO :ll_ljrc
	 FROM JKXT.SYDYB_JSMX  
   WHERE ( ZTBZ > 0 ) AND  
         ( JSLSH is not null ) AND  
         ( JSSJ >= :ldt_ljrc1) AND  
         ( JSSJ < :adt_end) AND  
         ( YWLX In ('SF','GH')) and 
			( (nvl(GDBZBJ,'00') = '00'  and :al_tsmxbz=1) or ( nvl(GDBZBJ,'00') = '01'  and :al_tsmxbz=2) or (:al_tsmxbz=3) ) and
			( FYZE -ZLZE - ZFZE  <= :adc_jcfy OR :adc_jcfy = 0)
		Using sqlca_query;

	dw_main.object.ljrc[ll_insert] = ll_ljrc
ELSEIF as_ywlx = 'ZY' THEN
	SELECT  SUM(FYZE) YLFYZE,
			  SUM(GRXJZF) XJZFZE,
			  SUM(HJBXJE) JJZFZE,
		     SUM(ZFZE) YLFYZFZE,
			  SUM(ZLZE) YLFYZLZE,
		     SUM(FYZE -ZLZE - ZFZE) FHYBFY,
			  SUM(CASE WHEN  ZTBZ = 3 THEN -1 ELSE 1 END) SJZS 
		INTO :ldc_fyze,:ldc_xjzf,:ldc_jjzf,:ldc_zfze,:ldc_zlze,:ldc_fhybfy,:ll_sjzs
		FROM JKXT.SYDYB_JSMX
		WHERE ( ZTBZ > 0 ) AND
				( JSLSH is NOT NULL ) AND
				( JSSJ >= :adt_begin) AND
				( JSSJ < :adt_end) AND
				( YWLX In ('ZY')) and
				( (nvl(GDBZBJ,'00') = '00'  and :al_tsmxbz=1) or ( nvl(GDBZBJ,'00') = '01'  and :al_tsmxbz=2) or (:al_tsmxbz=3) ) and
				( FYZE -ZLZE - ZFZE  <= :adc_jcfy OR :adc_jcfy = 0)
		Using sqlca_query;
	if dw_main.rowcount( ) > 0 then
		ll_insert = dw_main.find( "cbrlb = 'SYD' and ywlx = '"+as_ywlx+"'", 1, dw_main.rowcount( ) )
		if ll_insert <= 0 then  ll_insert =	dw_main.insertrow( 0)
	else
		ll_insert =	dw_main.insertrow( 0)
	end if
	ldc_fpjz = ldc_jjzf
	dw_main.object.cbrlb[ll_insert] = 'SYD'
	dw_main.object.lbmc[ll_insert] = '省异地'
	dw_main.object.ywlx[ll_insert] = as_ywlx
	dw_main.object.sjzs[ll_insert] = ll_sjzs
	dw_main.object.jzrc[ll_insert] = 0
	dw_main.object.ljrc[ll_insert] = 0
	dw_main.object.ylfyzfze[ll_insert] = ldc_zfze
	dw_main.object.ylfyzlze[ll_insert] = ldc_zlze
	dw_main.object.jjzfze[ll_insert] = ldc_jjzf
	dw_main.object.xjzfze[ll_insert] = ldc_xjzf
	dw_main.object.ylfyze[ll_insert] = ldc_fyze
	dw_main.object.fpjz[ll_insert] = ldc_fpjz
	dw_main.object.fhybfy[ll_insert] = ldc_fhybfy
  
    SELECT count(DISTINCT JYID) INTO :ll_jzrc
	 FROM JKXT.SYDYB_JSMX  
   WHERE ( ZTBZ > 0 ) AND  
         ( JSLSH is not null ) AND  
         ( JSSJ >= :adt_begin) AND  
         ( JSSJ < :adt_end) AND  
         ( YWLX = 'ZY') and 
			( (nvl(GDBZBJ,'00') = '00'  and :al_tsmxbz=1) or ( nvl(GDBZBJ,'00') = '01'  and :al_tsmxbz=2) or (:al_tsmxbz=3) ) and
			( FYZE -ZLZE - ZFZE  <= :adc_jcfy OR :adc_jcfy = 0)
		Using sqlca_query;
  dw_main.object.jzrc[ll_insert] = ll_jzrc
   SELECT count(DISTINCT GRBH||cbdxzqh) INTO :ll_ljrc
	 FROM JKXT.SYDYB_JSMX  
   WHERE ( ZTBZ > 0 ) AND  
         ( JSLSH is not null ) AND  
         ( JSSJ >= :ldt_ljrc1) AND  
         ( JSSJ < :adt_end) AND  
         ( YWLX = 'ZY') and 
			( (nvl(GDBZBJ,'00') = '00'  and :al_tsmxbz=1) or ( nvl(GDBZBJ,'00') = '01'  and :al_tsmxbz=2) or (:al_tsmxbz=3) ) and
			( FYZE -ZLZE - ZFZE  <= :adc_jcfy OR :adc_jcfy = 0)
		Using sqlca_query;
	dw_main.object.ljrc[ll_insert] = ll_ljrc
END IF
RETURN 1

end function

public function integer wf_get_jcfy (datetime adt_begin, datetime adt_end, string as_ywlx, string as_ywlxs[], string as_byd, string as_jyjslxs[], string as_cbrlbs[]);//1：均次药品费，2：均次药品费占均次费用的比率，即均次药占比；3：均次材料费，4：均次材料费占均次费用的比率，即均次材料占比；
Long ll_count,ll_row,ll_find
String ls_ywlx
dec{2} ldc_zfy = 0.00
u_datastore luds_jcfy
luds_jcfy = Create u_datastore
IF as_ywlx = 'JBYL' Or as_ywlx = 'CXJM' Or as_ywlx = 'CXJMBHWCN' THEN
	luds_jcfy.DataObject = 'd_ylfyhzb_jc'//20210719zbq
	luds_jcfy.SetTransObject( sqlca_query)
	ll_count = luds_jcfy.Retrieve(adt_begin, adt_end,as_ywlxs,as_byd,as_jyjslxs,idc_jcje,as_cbrlbs)
	IF ll_count > 0 and dw_main.rowcount( ) > 0 THEN
		FOR ll_row =  1 To ll_count
			ldc_zfy = ldc_zfy + luds_jcfy.Object.zfy[ll_row]
			dw_main.Object.ypf[1] = luds_jcfy.Object.ypf[ll_row]
			dw_main.Object.clf[1] = luds_jcfy.Object.clf[ll_row]
			IF dw_main.Object.ylfyze[1]  <>  ldc_zfy THEN
				gf_applog( '业务：' + ls_ywlx +'汇总和均次总金额不一致（main' + String(dw_main.Object.ylfyze[1]) + "--jc"+String(ldc_zfy)+"）")
				MessageBox('提示', '业务：' + ls_ywlx +'汇总和均次总金额不一致（main' + String(dw_main.Object.ylfyze[1]) + "--jc"+String(ldc_zfy)+"）")
			END IF
		NEXT
	END IF
ELSE
	String ls_cbrlb
	luds_jcfy.DataObject = 'd_sbyhzbb_jc'//20210719zbq
	luds_jcfy.SetTransObject( sqlca_query)
	ll_count = luds_jcfy.Retrieve(adt_begin, adt_end,il_byd,il_tmb,idc_jcje)
	IF ll_count > 0 THEN
		FOR ll_row =  1 To ll_count
			ls_cbrlb = luds_jcfy.Object.cbrlb[ll_row]
			ls_ywlx = luds_jcfy.Object.ywlx[ll_row]
			ll_find = dw_main.Find("cbrlb = '"+ls_cbrlb+"' and ywlx = '" + ls_ywlx +"'",1,dw_main.RowCount())
			IF ll_find > 0 THEN
				IF dw_main.Object.ylfyze[ll_find]  <> luds_jcfy.Object.zfy[ll_row] THEN
					gf_applog('参保人类别：' + ls_cbrlb + '业务：' + ls_ywlx +'汇总和均次总金额不一致（main' + String(dw_main.Object.ylfyze[ll_find]) + "--jc"+String(luds_jcfy.Object.zfy[ll_row])+"）")
					MessageBox('提示','参保人类别：' + ls_cbrlb + '业务：' + ls_ywlx +'汇总和均次总金额不一致（main' + String(dw_main.Object.ylfyze[ll_find]) + "--jc"+String(luds_jcfy.Object.zfy[ll_row])+"）")
				END IF
				dw_main.Object.ypf[ll_find] = luds_jcfy.Object.ypf[ll_row]
				dw_main.Object.clf[ll_find] = luds_jcfy.Object.clf[ll_row]
			ELSE
				MessageBox('提示','找不到参保人类别：' + ls_cbrlb + '业务：' + ls_ywlx +'的汇总信息')
			END IF
		NEXT
	END IF
END IF
Destroy luds_jcfy
RETURN 1
end function

public function integer wf_ylfyhz (datetime adt_begin, datetime adt_end, datetime adt_ndks, string as_yblx, string as_ywlx, string as_byd, boolean ab_jcfy, ref string as_error);String ls_title,ls_error,ls_lx
String ls_ywlxs[],ls_cbrlbs[],ls_jyjslxs[]
gf_waiting('正在准备数据..........',1)
dw_main.DataObject  = 'd_ylfyhzb'//20210719zbq
dw_main.SetTransObject(sqlca_query)



//"1本地;2异地;3全部" as_byd
IF as_ywlx = 'MZ' THEN
	ls_lx = '（门诊）'
	ls_ywlxs[1] = 'SF'
	ls_ywlxs[2] = 'GH'
	ls_jyjslxs[1] = '001'
	ls_jyjslxs[2] = '002'
ELSEIF as_ywlx = 'ZY' THEN
	ls_lx = '（住院）'
	ls_ywlxs[1] = 'ZY'
	ls_jyjslxs[1] = '011'
END IF
//	温州市基本医疗保险医疗费用汇总表（门诊）
//	温州市城乡居民保险医疗费用汇总表（住院）
dw_main.Object.title_t.Text = '温州市'+ ddlb_qslb.Text + '保险医疗费用汇总表' + ls_lx
dw_main.SetRedraw( False)

gf_waiting('正在统计基本数据..........',20)
dw_main.Retrieve(adt_begin, adt_end,ls_ywlxs,as_byd,ls_jyjslxs,idc_jcje,ls_cbrlbs)
// 人次数
u_datastore luds_rcs,luds_rts
gf_waiting('正在统计人次数.........',50)
IF as_ywlx = 'MZ' THEN
	luds_rcs = Create u_datastore
	luds_rcs.DataObject = 'd_ylfyhz_rc' //20210719zbq
	luds_rcs.SetTransObject( sqlca_query)
	luds_rcs.Retrieve(adt_begin, adt_end,ls_ywlxs,as_byd,ls_jyjslxs,idc_jcje,ls_cbrlbs)
ELSEIF as_ywlx = 'ZY' THEN
	luds_rcs = Create u_datastore
	luds_rcs.DataObject = 'd_ylfyhz_zyrc' //20210719zbq
	luds_rcs.SetTransObject( sqlca_query)
	luds_rcs.Retrieve(adt_begin, adt_end,ls_ywlxs,as_byd,ls_jyjslxs,idc_jcje,ls_cbrlbs)
END IF
//人头数
gf_waiting('正在统计人头数.........',70)
luds_rts = Create u_datastore
luds_rts.DataObject = 'd_ylfyhz_rt' //20210719zbq
luds_rts.SetTransObject( sqlca_query)
luds_rts.Retrieve(adt_ndks, adt_end,ls_ywlxs,as_byd,ls_jyjslxs,idc_jcje,ls_cbrlbs)
dw_main.Object.rcs[1] = luds_rcs.Object.rczs[1]
dw_main.Object.rts[1] = luds_rts.Object.rtzs[1]
IF String(adt_begin,'yyyy.mm') <> left(em_2.text,7) THEN
	dw_main.Object.st_tjrq.Text = String(adt_begin,'yyyymm') +"-" +String(em_2.getdate(),'yyyymm')
ELSE
	dw_main.Object.st_tjrq.Text = String(adt_begin,'yyyymm')
END IF
gf_waiting('正在计算均次费用..........',80)
if ab_jcfy then this.wf_get_jcfy( adt_begin, adt_end, as_yblx, ls_ywlxs, as_byd, ls_jyjslxs, ls_cbrlbs)
gf_waiting('数据完成..........',-1)
dw_main.SetRedraw( True)
RETURN 1
end function

this.Control[iCurrent+2]=this.em_1
this.Control[iCurrent+3]=this.st_1
this.Control[iCurrent+4]=this.st_2

this.Control[iCurrent+7]=this.ddlb_qsfs
this.Control[iCurrent+8]=this.st_3
this.Control[iCurrent+9]=this.st_4

this.Control[iCurrent+11]=this.dw_ysq
end on

			RETURN
		END IF

	END IF
ELSE

	uo_support.SetTransObject(sqlca_query)
	IF Not uo_support.dbconnect(gs_ini,"Database_TJ") THEN
		uo_support.SetTransObject(sqlca)

		RETURN
	END IF
	uo_support.SetTransObject(sqlca)
END IF

	NEXT
END IF

	NEXT

event dw_main::doubleclicked;//
if Row > 0 then
	if ii_clipboard = 1 then 
		string ls_ColumnType,ls_data
		ls_ColumnType = Upper(this.Describe(dwo.name+".ColType"))
		
		choose case MID(ls_ColumnType,1,4)
		case "DATE"
			if ls_ColumnType = 'DATE' then
				ls_data = string(this.GetItemDate(row,string(dwo.name)))
			else
				ls_data = string(this.GetItemDateTime(row,string(dwo.name)))
			end if
		case 'DECI','NUME'
			ls_data = string(this.GetItemDecimal(row,string(dwo.name)))
		case 'NUMB','LONG'
			ls_data = string(this.GetItemNumber(row,string(dwo.name)))
		case 'TIME'
			ls_data = string(this.GetItemTime(row,string(dwo.name)))
		case 'STRI','CHAR'
			ls_data = string(this.GetItemString(row,string(dwo.name)))
		case else
			//messagebox(string(dwo.name),ls_ColumnType)
			return 
		end choose
		::clipboard(ls_data)
	end if
end if
end event

end event

event ue_bptz();String ls_jsjylsh, ls_tsxx
ls_tsxx = "请输入本地有而医保中心的明细中没有的结算交易流水号~n" +&
	"（提示：该功能只进行本地有而中心没有的明细调整，本地没有而医保中心有的明细【门诊校对】双击具体明细。）"
ls_jsjylsh = Trim(gf_inputbox(ls_tsxx, ""))

IF ls_jsjylsh = '-1' Or ls_jsjylsh = "" THEN
	RETURN
END IF

DateTime ldt_begin
ldt_begin = DateTime(RelativeDate(Date(idt_begin), -1), Time("00:00:00"))

String ls_brbm, ls_ywlx
Long ll_zyh
DateTime ldt_jysj

String ls_sql
ls_sql = "SELECT brbm, ywlx,zyh,jssj From jkxt.zhyb_jsmx Where jssj >= " + gf_dtinsql(ldt_begin) + " And (jslsh = '" + ls_jsjylsh + "' or jylsh = '"+ls_jsjylsh+"') And (ztbz >= 0 or ztbz = -1) Order By jssj Desc "
u_datastore lds_brxx
lds_brxx = Create u_datastore
IF lds_brxx.createfromsql(ls_sql) < 0 THEN
	MessageBox("提示", "创建'病人信息查询'对象失败。")
	RETURN
END IF
lds_brxx.SetTransObject(sqlca)
IF lds_brxx.Retrieve() <= 0 THEN
	MessageBox("提示", "该结算交易流水号没找到对应的病人信息")
	RETURN
ELSE
	ls_brbm = lds_brxx.Object.brbm[1]
	ls_ywlx = lds_brxx.Object.ywlx[1]
	ll_zyh = lds_brxx.Object.zyh[1]
	IF Trim(Upper(ls_ywlx)) = 'SF' Or ls_ywlx = '' THEN
		ii_bplx = 4
	ELSEIF Trim(Upper(ls_ywlx)) = 'GH' THEN
		ii_bplx = 5
	ELSEIF Trim(Upper(ls_ywlx)) = 'ZY' THEN
		ii_bplx = 6
	END IF
	
	s_exchange ls_exchange
	ls_exchange.LongParm[1] = ii_bplx
	ls_exchange.LongParm[2] = ll_zyh
	ls_exchange.StringParm[1] = ls_brbm
	ls_exchange.StringParm[2] = ls_jsjylsh
	ls_exchange.datetimeparm[1] = idt_begin
	ls_exchange.datetimeparm[2] = idt_end
//	ls_exchange.datetimeparm[3] = ldt_jysj
	ls_exchange.StringParm[3] = 'zhyb'
	
	OpenWithParm(w_sbdz_zhyb_bptz, ls_exchange)
END IF
destroy lds_brxx
end event

public function long wf_auto_jdmz (datetime ld_start, datetime ld_end);datastore ds_sb_fpk,ds_sb_jymx
Long ll_fpk_count,ll_jymx_count , i  , ll_find,ll_return ,ll_fplsh_count
String ls_zxlsh,ls_bz,ls_txt,ls_fplsh
Dec {0} ll_lsh

ll_return = 0

ds_sb_fpk = Create datastore
ds_sb_jymx = Create datastore

ds_sb_fpk.DataObject = 'd_sb_autodz_fpk'
ds_sb_jymx.DataObject = 'd_sb_autodz_jymx'

ds_sb_fpk.SetTransObject(sqlca)
ds_sb_jymx.SetTransObject(sqlca)


ds_sb_fpk.Retrieve(ld_start,ld_end)
ds_sb_jymx.Retrieve(ld_start,ld_end)

ll_fpk_count = ds_sb_fpk.RowCount()
ll_jymx_count = ds_sb_jymx.RowCount()


FOR i = 1 To  ll_fpk_count
	ls_zxlsh = ds_sb_fpk.Object.zxlsh[i]
	IF IsNull(ls_zxlsh) THEN ls_zxlsh = ''
	ll_find = ds_sb_jymx.Find( "zxlsh='"+ls_zxlsh+"'", 1,  ll_jymx_count  )
	IF IsNull(ll_find) THEN ll_find = 0
	IF ll_find > 0 THEN
		ds_sb_jymx.Object.bz[ll_find] = '1'
	ELSE
		IF Trim(ls_zxlsh) <= '' Or IsNull(ls_zxlsh) THEN CONTINUE;
		MessageBox('提示','zxlsh='+ls_zxlsh+'   需内部调帐' + String(ds_sb_fpk.Object.grbm[i]))
		RETURN 100;
	END IF
NEXT

ls_txt = ''
FOR i = 1 To ll_jymx_count
	ls_bz = ds_sb_jymx.Object.bz[i]
	ll_lsh = ds_sb_jymx.Object.lsh[i]
	ls_fplsh = ds_sb_jymx.Object.fplsh[i]
	
	ls_zxlsh = ds_sb_jymx.Object.zxlsh[i]
	IF IsNull(ls_fplsh) THEN ls_fplsh = ''
	IF IsNull(ls_bz) Or Trim(ls_bz) <= '' THEN ls_bz = ''
	IF ls_bz = '0' THEN
		ll_fplsh_count = 0
		SELECT count(*)  Into :ll_fplsh_count From sb_jymx Where fplsh = :ls_fplsh  And fplsh Is Not Null;
		IF IsNull(ll_fplsh_count) THEN ll_fplsh_count = 0
		IF ll_fplsh_count >= 2 THEN CONTINUE;
		ls_txt = ls_txt+'  '+ls_zxlsh
	ELSE
		CONTINUE;
	END IF
	IF Trim(ls_zxlsh) <= '' Or IsNull(ls_zxlsh) THEN CONTINUE;
	
	gf_begin_transaction(sqlca)
	INSERT Into sb_jymx_gzxx SELECT * From sb_jymx Where zxlsh = :ls_zxlsh   And lsh = :ll_lsh;
	IF sqlca.SQLCode = 0 THEN
		DELETE From sb_jymx Where zxlsh = :ls_zxlsh   And lsh = :ll_lsh;
		IF sqlca.SQLCode = 0 THEN
			gf_commit_transaction(sqlca)
		ELSE
			gf_rollback_transaction(sqlca)
			ll_return = 101
			EXIT
		END IF
	ELSE
		gf_rollback_transaction(sqlca)
		ll_return = 101
		EXIT
	END IF
NEXT

IF ls_txt <> '' THEN
	MessageBox('提示','门诊需改帐的流水号有：'+ls_txt)
END IF

Destroy ds_sb_fpk;
Destroy ds_sb_jymx;


RETURN ll_return




end function

public function integer wf_dzyz ();
u_datastore lds_bpmx
lds_bpmx = Create u_datastore

String ls_bpmx
Long ll_rowcount, ll_temp

gf_waiting('开始校验数据......',1)
cbx_1.visible =false
//判断预存是否有过正确结转
//=======================核对==============================//
Dec{2} ld_kyc, ld_yck_fp,ldc_yck_gh
Long ll_count

ld_kyc = 0
SELECT SUM(JYJE) INTO :ld_kyc FROM H_MZ_ZHJYMX
	Where JYSJ >= :idt_begin And JYSJ <= :idt_end And JYLB In (11,12) ;
//And Upper(JYDD) Not In ('GH','ZZGH');
IF IsNull(ld_kyc) THEN ld_kyc = 0

gf_waiting('开始校验数据......',10)

//====预存款－－扣款fpk,zffs
ld_yck_fp = 0
SELECT sum(NVL(H_FP_ZFFS.ZFJE,0)) INTO :ld_yck_fp FROM mz_fpk,H_FP_ZFFS
	WHERE mz_fpk.kpsj >= :idt_begin AND mz_fpk.kpsj <= :idt_end 
	//	AND (H_FP_ZFFS.zffs = '5' OR H_FP_ZFFS.zffs = '7' OR H_FP_ZFFS.zffs = '8' or H_FP_ZFFS.zffs = '10')
	AND (H_FP_ZFFS.zffs IN (SELECT to_char(dmsb) FROM xtgl.gy_dmzd WHERE dmlb = 34 AND bzbm2 = 1))
	And NVL(mz_fpk.fpzf,0) <> 9  And mz_fpk.fplsh = H_FP_ZFFS.fplsh;
IF IsNull(ld_yck_fp) THEN ld_yck_fp = 0
//挂号非现金支付
ldc_yck_gh = 0.00
SELECT sum(NVL(xjje,0)) INTO :ldc_yck_gh FROM MZ_GHXX
	WHERE GHRQ >= :idt_begin AND GHRQ <= :idt_end 
	AND ZFFS IN (SELECT to_char(dmsb) FROM xtgl.gy_dmzd WHERE dmlb = 34 AND bzbm2 = 1)
	And NVL(THBZ,'0') In ('0','s','t','r');
IF IsNull(ldc_yck_gh) THEN ldc_yck_gh = 0

gf_waiting('正在校验数据......',20)

IF Abs(ld_kyc + ld_yck_fp + ldc_yck_gh) > 1 THEN
	dw_bpmx.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_yc'
	dw_bpmx.SetTransObject( sqlca )
	ll_rowcount = dw_bpmx.Retrieve( idt_begin, idt_end )
	
	IF ll_rowcount > 0 THEN
		gf_waiting('预存发票未正确结转......',-1)
		dw_bpmx.Title = "预存发票未正确结转"
		dw_bpmx.Visible = True
		ii_bplx = 1 //预存不平
		
		dw_toolbar.Enabled = True
		SetNull(is_dzr)
		RETURN -1
	END IF
	
	dw_bpmx.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_ycgh'
	dw_bpmx.SetTransObject( sqlca )
	ll_rowcount = dw_bpmx.Retrieve( idt_begin, idt_end )
	
	IF ll_rowcount > 0 THEN
		gf_waiting('预存发票未正确结转......',-1)
		dw_bpmx.Title = "预存发票未正确结转（挂号）"
		dw_bpmx.Visible = True
		ii_bplx = 2 //预存挂号不平
		
		dw_toolbar.Enabled = True
		SetNull(is_dzr)
		RETURN -1
	END IF
	
	dw_toolbar.Enabled = True
	SetNull(is_dzr)
	RETURN -1
END IF

//重复的2,3清理
wf_delrep(idt_begin,idt_end)

gf_waiting('正在校验数据......',30)

//----验证基金支付总额是否和分基金支付总和一致------- //
SELECT COUNT(1) INTO :ll_count FROM jkxt.zhyb_jsmx t
	WHERE jjzfze <> (JBYLBXTCJJZC + GWYYLBZZJZC + QYBCYLBXJJZC + JMDBBXZJZC + ZGDEYLFYBZJJZC + YLJZJJZC + QTZC + nvl(SCRYYLBZJJZC,0))
	And jssj >= :idt_begin And jssj <= :idt_end  And  jslsh Is Not Null  And ZTBZ > 0 ;
IF ll_count > 0 THEN
	dw_bpmx.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_jjzf'
	dw_bpmx.SetTransObject( sqlca )
	ll_rowcount = dw_bpmx.Retrieve( idt_begin, idt_end )
	
	IF ll_rowcount > 0 THEN
		gf_waiting('基金支付总额和分基金支付总和不一致......',-1)
		dw_bpmx.Title = "基金支付总额和分基金支付总和不一致"
		dw_bpmx.Visible = True
		ii_bplx = 3 //基金支付不平
	END IF
	
	//	MessageBox('提示,不能对帐,请与计算中心联系','有'+String(ll_count) + "条记录，验证基金支付总额是否和稤AT*
只�金支付总和一�
") 	//	gf_waiting('基金支付总额和分基金支付总和不一致......',-1) 	SetNull(is_dzr) 	RETURN -1
END IF

//------验证门诊数据一致性----社保门诊发票记帐金额-------- //
Dec {2} ld_sbjzje, ld_mzjz, ld_sbzje, ld_jzce, ld_fpzje, ld_ylfyze,ldc_gbxjzf,ldc_tsje,ld_zce
//发票库
SELECT sum(jzje),SUM(CASE when gfje =1 then XMZJE - nvl(yhje,0) else XMZJE end)  INTO :ld_sbjzje, :ld_fpzje FROM mz_fpk
	WHERE kpsj >= :idt_begin AND kpsj <= :idt_end  AND NVL(fpzf,0) <> 9
	And jslb In (SELECT brxz From gy_brxz Where ybpb = 1);
IF IsNull(ld_sbjzje) THEN ld_sbjzje = 0
IF IsNull(ld_fpzje) THEN ld_fpzje = 0

SELECT sum(jzce),sum(jzce + zfce) INTO :ld_jzce, :ld_zce FROM mzxt.sb_jejd
	Where kpsj >= :idt_begin And kpsj <= :idt_end  And XMLB = 0;
	IF IsNull(ld_jzce) THEN ld_jzce = 0
IF IsNull(ld_zce) THEN ld_zce = 0

ld_sbjzje = ld_sbjzje + ld_jzce
ld_fpzje = ld_fpzje + ld_zce

//医保结算
SELECT sum(nvl(JJZFZE,0)+nvl(grzhzc,0)),sum(nvl(YLFZE,0) + nvl(bscje,0)) INTO :ld_mzjz, :ld_ylfyze FROM jkxt.zhyb_jsmx
	WHERE jssj >= :idt_begin AND jssj <= :idt_end  AND jslsh Is NOT NULL
	And NVL(ywlx,'SF') = 'SF' And ZTBZ > 0 And NVL(YWLSH,'0') Not Like 'A%' ;

SELECT sum(nvl(grxjzc,0) + nvl(bscje,0)) INTO :ldc_gbxjzf FROM jkxt.zhyb_jsmx
	WHERE jssj >= :idt_begin AND jssj <= :idt_end  AND jslsh Is NOT NULL
	And NVL(ywlx,'SF') = 'SF' And ZTBZ > 0 And NVL(YWLSH,'0') Not Like 'A%' 
	And (gbbjdx >= '1' OR YWLSH IN (SELECT YWLSH  FROM jkxt.js_tsjl 	WHERE tssj >= :idt_begin AND tssj <= :idt_end  AND ybywh Is NOT NULL 	And NVL(ywly,'SF') = 'SF' And ZTBZ > 0 AND JSFL = 'JRYF'));
SELECT sum(nvl(tszje,0)) INTO :ldc_tsje FROM jkxt.js_tsjl
	WHERE tssj >= :idt_begin AND tssj <= :idt_end  AND ybywh Is NOT NULL
	And NVL(ywly,'SF') = 'SF' And ZTBZ > 0 And NVL(YWLSH,'0') Not Like 'A%' ;
	
IF IsNull(ld_mzjz) THEN ld_mzjz = 0
//IF IsNull(ld_sdjzje) THEN ld_sdjzje = 0
IF IsNull(ld_ylfyze) THEN ld_ylfyze = 0
IF IsNull(ldc_gbxjzf) THEN ldc_gbxjzf = 0
IF IsNull(ldc_tsje) THEN ldc_tsje = 0

gf_waiting('正在校验数据......',60)

ld_sbzje = ld_mzjz  + (ldc_gbxjzf - ldc_tsje) 

IF ld_sbzje <> ld_sbjzje Or ld_ylfyze <> ld_fpzje THEN
	dw_bpmx.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_sfjz'
	dw_bpmx.SetTransObject( sqlca )
	ll_rowcount = dw_bpmx.Retrieve( idt_begin, idt_end )
	IF ll_rowcount > 0 THEN
		dw_bpmx.Title = "门诊交易数据不一致"
		dw_bpmx.Visible = True
		ii_bplx = 4 //门诊收费不平
		//		for ll_temp = 1 to ll_rowcount
		//			ls_bpmx = ls_bpmx + lds_bpmx.object.#1[ll_temp] + " " + string(lds_bpmx.object.#2[ll_temp]) +&
		//			" " + string(lds_bpmx.object.#3[ll_temp]) + "~n"
		//		next
	END IF
	
	gf_waiting('门诊交易数据不一致......',-1)	
	cbx_1.visible = true
	cbx_1.bringtotop = TRUE
	//	MessageBox('提示,不能对帐,请与计算中心联系','门诊交易数据不一致:社保理论交易(yb_jsmx) :总金额' + String(ld_ylfyze) + '，记账金额'+String(ld_sbzje)+'  sb实际发生额 (mz_fpk)：总金额'+String(ld_fpzje)+'，记账金额'+String(ld_sbjzje)+'  差值：'+ String(ld_ylfyze - ld_fpzje)+'----'+String(ld_sbzje - ld_sbjzje) + '~n' + ls_bpmx)
	dw_toolbar.Enabled = True
	SetNull(is_dzr)
	RETURN -1
END IF

//挂号记账金额是否一致验证------------------
Dec{2} ld_ghjz, ld_sbghjz, ld_sdghjz, ld_ghzje,  ld_ghzjje,ld_ckblf = 0.00

SELECT sum(NVL(ZJJE,0) - NVL(XJJE,0) - NVL(YHJE,0)), sum(NVL(ZJJE,0) - NVL(YHJE,0)) INTO :ld_ghjz, :ld_ghzjje FROM mz_ghxx
	WHERE GHRQ >= :idt_begin AND GHRQ <= :idt_end  AND (nvl(THBZ,0) NOT IN ('i','3'))
	And jslb In (SELECT brxz From gy_brxz Where ybpb = 1);


SELECT sum(nvl(ghfy,0)) Into :ld_ckblf From mz_ghxx,mz_ghfyxx 
	Where mz_ghxx.ghlsh = mz_ghfyxx.ghlsh And mz_ghxx.GHRQ >= :idt_begin And mz_ghxx.GHRQ <= :idt_end   
	And (nvl(mz_ghxx.THBZ,0) Not In ('i','3')) And mz_ghxx.jslb In (SELECT brxz From gy_brxz Where ybpb = 1) 
	And (mz_ghfyxx.fyxh = :il_ckf or mz_ghfyxx.fyxh = :il_blf);

IF IsNull(ld_ckblf) THEN ld_ckblf = 0
ld_jzce = 0
ld_zce = 0
SELECT sum(jzce),sum(jzce + zfce) INTO :ld_jzce, :ld_zce FROM mzxt.sb_jejd
	Where kpsj >= :idt_begin And kpsj <= :idt_end  And XMLB = 1;
	
IF IsNull(ld_jzce) THEN ld_jzce = 0
IF IsNull(ld_zce) THEN ld_zce = 0
IF IsNull(ld_ghjz) THEN ld_ghjz = 0
IF IsNull(ld_ghzjje) THEN ld_ghzjje = 0 
ld_ghjz = ld_ghjz + ld_jzce
ld_ghzjje = ld_ghzjje + ld_zce - ld_ckblf
gf_waiting('正在校验数据......',70)
ldc_tsje  = 0
SELECT sum(nvl(jjzfze,0)+nvl(grzhzc,0)), sum(nvl(ylfze,0) + nvl(bscje,0)) INTO :ld_sbghjz, :ld_ylfyze FROM jkxt.zhyb_jsmx
	WHERE jssj >= :idt_begin AND jssj <= :idt_end  AND jslsh Is NOT NULL
	And NVL(ywlx,'SF') = 'GH' And ZTBZ > 0 And NVL(YWLSH,'0') Not Like 'A%' ; 

SELECT sum(nvl(grxjzc,0) + nvl(bscje,0)) INTO :ldc_gbxjzf FROM jkxt.zhyb_jsmx
	WHERE jssj >= :idt_begin AND jssj <= :idt_end  AND jslsh Is NOT NULL
	And NVL(ywlx,'SF') = 'GH' And ZTBZ > 0 And NVL(YWLSH,'0') Not Like 'A%' 
	And (gbbjdx >= '1' OR YWLSH IN (SELECT YWLSH  FROM jkxt.js_tsjl 	WHERE tssj >= :idt_begin AND tssj <= :idt_end  AND ybywh Is NOT NULL 	And NVL(ywly,'SF') = 'GH' And ZTBZ > 0 AND JSFL = 'JRYF'));
	
SELECT sum(nvl(tszje,0)) INTO :ldc_tsje FROM jkxt.js_tsjl
	WHERE tssj >= :idt_begin AND tssj <= :idt_end  AND ybywh Is NOT NULL
	And NVL(ywly,'SF') = 'GH' And ZTBZ > 0 And NVL(YWLSH,'0') Not Like 'A%' ;
	
IF IsNull(ld_sbghjz) THEN ld_sbghjz = 0
IF IsNull(ld_ylfyze) THEN ld_ylfyze = 0
IF IsNull(ldc_gbxjzf) THEN ldc_gbxjzf = 0
IF IsNull(ldc_tsje) THEN ldc_tsje = 0
ld_sbghjz = ld_sbghjz + (ldc_gbxjzf - ldc_tsje) //+干保托收和优抚优惠的金额

IF ld_ghjz <> ld_sbghjz Or ld_ghzjje <> ld_ylfyze THEN
	gf_waiting('门诊挂号交易数据不一致......',-1)
	dw_bpmx.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_gh'
	dw_bpmx.SetTransObject( sqlca )
	long ll_ckbl[]
	ll_ckbl[1] = il_ckf
	ll_ckbl[2] = il_blf
	ll_rowcount = dw_bpmx.Retrieve( idt_begin, idt_end,ll_ckbl )
	
	IF ll_rowcount > 0 THEN
		dw_bpmx.Title = "门诊挂号交易数据不一致"
		dw_bpmx.Visible = True
		ii_bplx = 5 //门诊挂号不平
	END IF
	cbx_1.visible = true
	cbx_1.bringtotop = TRUE
	dw_toolbar.Enabled = True
	SetNull(is_dzr)
	RETURN -1
END IF

//住院病人结算金额是否一致验证----------------------
Dec{2} ldc_zyjz, ldc_zyjzzf, ldc_zyzje, ldc_zyzjezf, ldc_sbzyjz, ldc_sbzyzje

// 2021.12.17  CJN  27897  (WD)住院总金额计算需要剔除不上传费用NVL(BSCJE,0)
SELECT sum(NVL(fyhj,0) - NVL(zfhj,0) - NVL(YHJE,0)), sum(NVL(fyhj,0)- NVL(YHJE,0) -NVL(BSCJE,0)) INTO :ldc_zyjz, :ldc_zyzje FROM zy_zyjs
	WHERE jsrq >= :idt_begin AND jsrq <= :idt_end 
	And brxz In (SELECT brxz From gy_brxz Where ybpb = 1);
IF IsNull(ldc_zyjz) THEN ldc_zyjz = 0
IF IsNull(ldc_zyzje) THEN ldc_zyzje = 0

SELECT sum(NVL(fyhj,0) - NVL(zfhj,0) - NVL(YHJE,0)), sum(NVL(fyhj,0)- NVL(YHJE,0)-NVL(BSCJE,0)) INTO :ldc_zyjzzf, :ldc_zyzjezf FROM zy_zyjs
	WHERE zfrq >= :idt_begin AND zfrq <= :idt_end  AND zfpb = 1
	And brxz In (SELECT brxz From gy_brxz Where ybpb = 1);
IF IsNull(ldc_zyjzzf) THEN ldc_zyjzzf = 0
IF IsNull(ldc_zyzjezf) THEN ldc_zyzjezf = 0

ldc_zyjz = ldc_zyjz - ldc_zyjzzf
ldc_zyzje = ldc_zyzje - ldc_zyzjezf

gf_waiting('正在校验数据......',90)

SELECT sum(NVL(jjzfze,0)+NVL(grzhzc,0)), sum(NVL(ylfze,0)) INTO :ldc_sbzyjz, :ldc_sbzyzje FROM jkxt.zhyb_jsmx
	WHERE jssj >= :idt_begin AND jssj <= :idt_end  AND jslsh Is NOT NULL
	And NVL(ywlx,'SF') in ('ZY','ZYMZ') And ZTBZ > 0;
IF IsNull(ldc_sbzyjz) THEN ldc_sbzyjz = 0
IF IsNull(ldc_sbzyzje) THEN ldc_sbzyzje = 0
IF ldc_zyzje <> ldc_sbzyzje  THEN  //or ldc_zyjz <> ldc_sbzyjz
	gf_waiting('住院病人交易数据不一致......',-1)
	dw_bpmx.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_zy' 
	dw_bpmx.SetTransObject( sqlca )
	ll_rowcount = dw_bpmx.Retrieve( idt_begin, idt_end )
	
	IF ll_rowcount > 0 THEN
		dw_bpmx.Title = "住院病人交易数据不一致"
		dw_bpmx.Visible = True
		ii_bplx = 6 //住院不平
	END IF
	dw_toolbar.Enabled = True
	SetNull(is_dzr)
	RETURN -1
END IF
update  jkxt.zhyb_jsmx set dzzt = 1	WHERE jssj >= :idt_begin AND jssj <= :idt_end  AND jslsh Is NOT NULL and ZTBZ > 0 and (dzzt = 0 or dzzt is null );
commit;
gf_waiting('正在校验数据......',-1)
RETURN 1

end function

public subroutine wf_getdzxx (datetime adt_dzrq, integer ai_ywlx);DateTime ldt_begin,ldt_end,ldt_jssj[]
String ls_dzr ,ls_error,ls_xz[],ls_qslb[],ls_cbdxzqh[],ls_rybh[],ls_jslsh[],ls_jzid[]
Long   	ll_jybs[],ll_insertrow,ll_find,ll_jlxh[]
Decimal	ld_ylfze[],ld_jjzfze[],ld_grzhzfze[],ld_xjzfje[],ld_GRXJZC[]
Int li_i,i
ldt_begin = DateTime(Date(adt_dzrq),Time(00:00:00))
ldt_end = DateTime(RelativeDate(Date(adt_dzrq),1),Time(00:00:00))
ls_dzr = String(adt_dzrq,'YYYYMMDD')
IF ai_ywlx = 1 THEN
	// 2.声明游标
	DECLARE cur_bddzxx CURSOR FOR //本地对账
		SELECT xzlx,qslb,SUM(NVL(YLFZE,0)),SUM(NVL(jjzfze,0)),SUM(NVL(GRZHZC,0)),SUM(NVL(GRXJZC,0))
		From JKXT.ZHYB_JSMX Where JSSJ >= :ldt_begin And JSSJ < :ldt_end And ZTBZ > 0 And JSLSH Is Not Null And substr(CBDXZQH,1,4) = :is_cbdxzhq   Group By xzlx,qslb;
	// 3.打开游标
	OPEN cur_bddzxx;
	IF sqlca.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
		CLOSE cur_bddzxx;
		RETURN
	END IF
	// 4.移动游标，获取数据。
	li_i = 1
	FETCH cur_bddzxx Into :ls_xz[li_i], :ls_qslb[li_i],:ld_ylfze[li_i],:ld_jjzfze[li_i],:ld_grzhzfze[li_i],:ld_xjzfje[li_i];
	DO WHILE sqlca.SQLCode = 0
		SELECT COUNT(*) Into :ll_jybs[li_i]  From JKXT.ZHYB_JSMX Where JSSJ >= :ldt_begin And JSSJ < :ldt_end And ZTBZ > 0 And JSLSH Is Not Null And substr(CBDXZQH,1,4) = :is_cbdxzhq And xzlx = :ls_xz[li_i] And qslb = :ls_qslb[li_i];
		li_i++
		FETCH cur_bddzxx Into :ls_xz[li_i], :ls_qslb[li_i],:ld_ylfze[li_i],:ld_jjzfze[li_i],:ld_grzhzfze[li_i],:ld_xjzfje[li_i];
	LOOP
	// 5.关闭游标
	CLOSE cur_bddzxx;
	li_i = li_i -1
	FOR i = 1 To li_i
		IF IsNull(ld_ylfze[i]) THEN ld_ylfze[i] = 0
		IF IsNull(ld_jjzfze[i]) THEN ld_jjzfze[i] = 0
		IF IsNull(ld_grzhzfze[i]) THEN ld_grzhzfze[i] = 0
		IF IsNull(ld_xjzfje[i]) THEN ld_xjzfje[i] = 0
		ll_find = dw_1.Find("dzr ='"+ls_dzr+"' AND XZ='"+ls_xz[i]+ "' AND QSLB='"+ls_qslb[i]+"' and ywlx="+String(ai_ywlx),1,dw_1.RowCount())
		IF ll_find > 0 THEN
			dw_1.Object.YLFZE[ll_find] = ld_ylfze[i]
			dw_1.Object.jjzfze[ll_find] = ld_jjzfze[i]
			dw_1.Object.grzhzfze[ll_find] = ld_grzhzfze[i]
			dw_1.Object.xjzfje[ll_find] = ld_xjzfje[i]
			dw_1.Object.jybs[ll_find] = ll_jybs[i]
		ELSE
			ll_insertrow = dw_1.InsertRow(0)
			dw_1.Object.ywlx[ll_insertrow] = ai_ywlx
			dw_1.Object.dzr[ll_insertrow] = ls_dzr
			dw_1.Object.jybs[ll_insertrow] = ll_jybs[i]
			dw_1.Object.xz[ll_insertrow] = ls_xz[i]
			dw_1.Object.qslb[ll_insertrow] = ls_qslb[i]
			dw_1.Object.YLFZE[ll_insertrow] = ld_ylfze[i]
			dw_1.Object.jjzfze[ll_insertrow] = ld_jjzfze[i]
			dw_1.Object.grzhzfze[ll_insertrow] = ld_grzhzfze[i]
			dw_1.Object.xjzfje[ll_insertrow] = ld_xjzfje[i]
		END IF
		
	NEXT
ELSEIF ai_ywlx = 2 THEN
	DECLARE cur_yddzxx CURSOR FOR //异地对账
		SELECT jlxh,cbdxzqh,GRBH,NVL(YLFZE,0),NVL(jjzfze,0),JSSJ,jslsh,jzid,NVL(GRXJZC,0)
		From JKXT.ZHYB_JSMX Where JSSJ >= :ldt_begin And JSSJ < :ldt_end And ZTBZ > 0 And JSLSH Is Not Null And substr(CBDXZQH,1,4) <> :is_cbdxzhq;
	// 3.打开游标
	OPEN cur_yddzxx;
	IF sqlca.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
		CLOSE cur_yddzxx;
		RETURN
	END IF
	// 4.移动游标，获取数据。
	li_i = 1
	FETCH cur_yddzxx Into :ll_jlxh[li_i],:ls_cbdxzqh[li_i], :ls_rybh[li_i],:ld_ylfze[li_i],:ld_jjzfze[li_i],:ldt_jssj[li_i],:ls_jslsh[li_i],:ls_jzid[li_i],:ld_GRXJZC[li_i];
	DO WHILE sqlca.SQLCode = 0
		li_i++
		FETCH cur_yddzxx Into :ll_jlxh[li_i],:ls_cbdxzqh[li_i], :ls_rybh[li_i],:ld_ylfze[li_i],:ld_jjzfze[li_i],:ldt_jssj[li_i],:ls_jslsh[li_i],:ls_jzid[li_i],:ld_GRXJZC[li_i];
	LOOP
	// 5.关闭游标
	CLOSE cur_yddzxx;
	li_i = li_i -1
	FOR i = 1 To li_i
		IF IsNull(ld_ylfze[i]) THEN ld_ylfze[i] = 0
		IF IsNull(ld_jjzfze[i]) THEN ld_jjzfze[i] = 0
		ll_find = dw_1.Find("dzr ='"+ls_dzr+"' AND cbdybqh='"+ls_cbdxzqh[i]+ "' AND rybh='"+ls_rybh[i]+"' and jslsh = '"+ls_jslsh[i]+"'",1,dw_1.RowCount())
		IF ll_find > 0 THEN
			
		ELSE
			ll_insertrow = dw_1.InsertRow(0)
			dw_1.Object.dzr[ll_insertrow] = ls_dzr
			dw_1.Object.cbdybqh[ll_insertrow] = ls_cbdxzqh[i]
			dw_1.Object.rybh[ll_insertrow] = ls_rybh[i]
			dw_1.Object.jzjssj[ll_insertrow] = ldt_jssj[i]
			dw_1.Object.YLFZE[ll_insertrow] = ld_ylfze[i]
			dw_1.Object.jbjgzfze[ll_insertrow] = ld_ylfze[i]-ld_GRXJZC[i]
			dw_1.Object.JSLSH[ll_insertrow] = ls_jslsh[i]
			dw_1.Object.jlxh[ll_insertrow] = ll_jlxh[i]
			dw_1.Object.jzid[ll_insertrow] = ls_jzid[i]
			dw_1.Object.ywlx[ll_insertrow] = 2
		END IF
	NEXT
END IF




end subroutine

public subroutine wf_delrep (datetime adt_begin, datetime adt_end);u_datastore luds_del
luds_del = Create u_datastore
luds_del.DataObject = 'd_jslsh_zhdel'
luds_del.SetTransObject(SQLCA)
luds_del.Retrieve(adt_begin, adt_end)

Long ll_rowcount,ll_zyh,ll_cur
String ls_brbm,ls_jsjylsh,ls_mxzdh,ls_jylsh
ll_rowcount = luds_del.RowCount()
IF ll_rowcount > 0 THEN
	ls_brbm = luds_del.Object.brbm[1]
	ll_zyh = luds_del.Object.zyh[1]
	ls_jsjylsh = luds_del.Object.jslsh[1]
	ls_mxzdh = luds_del.Object.jzid[1]
	
	FOR ll_cur = 2 To ll_rowcount
		IF ll_zyh = 0 THEN
			IF ls_brbm = luds_del.Object.brbm[ll_cur] And ls_jsjylsh = luds_del.Object.jslsh[ll_cur] THEN
				luds_del.Object.ztbz[ll_cur] = -8
			ELSE
				ls_brbm = luds_del.Object.brbm[ll_cur]
				ls_jsjylsh = luds_del.Object.jslsh[ll_cur]
				ls_mxzdh = luds_del.Object.jzid[ll_cur]
				ll_zyh = luds_del.Object.zyh[ll_cur]
				CONTINUE
			END IF
		ELSE
			IF ll_zyh = luds_del.Object.zyh[ll_cur] And ls_jsjylsh = luds_del.Object.jslsh[ll_cur] THEN
				luds_del.Object.ztbz[ll_cur] = -8
			ELSE
				ls_brbm = luds_del.Object.brbm[ll_cur]
				ls_jsjylsh = luds_del.Object.jslsh[ll_cur]
				ls_mxzdh = luds_del.Object.jzid[ll_cur]
				ll_zyh = luds_del.Object.zyh[ll_cur]
				CONTINUE
			END IF
		END IF
	NEXT
END IF

gf_begin_transaction(SQLCA)
IF luds_del.Update( ) = 1 THEN
	gf_commit_transaction(SQLCA)
	luds_del.SetFilter( "ztbz = -8")
	luds_del.Filter( )
	ll_rowcount = luds_del.RowCount()
	FOR ll_cur = 1 To ll_rowcount
		ls_jylsh = luds_del.Object.jylsh[ll_cur]
		ls_jsjylsh = luds_del.Object.jslsh[ll_cur]
		ls_mxzdh = luds_del.Object.jzid[ll_cur]
		UPDATE jkxt.zhyb_jsmx_kz Set ztbz = -8 Where jslsh = :ls_jsjylsh and jzid = :ls_mxzdh And jylsh = :ls_jylsh;
		COMMIT Using SQLCA;
	NEXT
ELSE
	gf_rollback_transaction(SQLCA)
	MessageBox('提示','del失败')
END IF

IF IsValid(luds_del) THEN Destroy luds_del

end subroutine

public function string wf_replacestr (string as_str, string as_find, string as_replace);/*******************************************************************************
[功能] 对as_str 用as_replace 替换所有的as_find
将一个字符串指定字符串替换为另一个字符串
*******************************************************************************/

Long		ll_pos ,ll_len

IF as_str = '' Or IsNull(as_str)Or	as_find = as_replace THEN RETURN as_str

ll_len = Lenw(as_replace)
ll_pos = 0
DO
	IF ll_pos + ll_len = 0 Or ll_pos = 0 THEN
		ll_pos = Posw(as_str , as_find, 1 )
	ELSE
		ll_pos = Posw(as_str , as_find, ll_pos + ll_len )
	END IF
	IF ll_pos > 0 THEN
		as_str = Replacew(as_str,ll_pos,Lenw(as_find),as_replace)
	END IF
	
LOOP WHILE ll_pos > 0
RETURN as_str


end function

public function integer wf_ybtk ();String ls_return,ls_cbd,ls_jsjylsh,ls_grbh,ls_ywlx,ls_brbm,ls_knxx
Integer li_ret 
Long ll_count,ll_cur
//Dec{2} ld_ylfyze
DEC{0} ldc_zyh
DateTime ldt_jssj
str_zhyl_jsxx Lstr_zhyl_jsxx,Lstr_zhyl_jsxx_N
li_ret = 0
ll_count = tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.RowCount()
//ll_count = 2
gf_waiting('正在退款，请稍后......',1)
FOR ll_cur = 1 To ll_count
	//判断改誅AT*
噬昵牒藕徒崴憬灰琢魉�号是否为�

	gf_waiting('退款进行时......',(ll_cur*100/ll_count))
	ls_grbh = tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.Object.grbh[ll_cur]
	ldt_jssj = tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.Object.jssj[ll_cur]
	ls_cbd = tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.Object.cbdxzqh[ll_cur]
	ls_jsjylsh = tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.Object.jslsh[ll_cur]
//	ld_ylfyze = tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.Object.ylfze[ll_cur]
	ls_ywlx = tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.Object.ywlx[ll_cur]
	ls_brbm= tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.Object.brbm[ll_cur]
	ldc_zyh = tab_1.tab_gzxx.dw_gzxx.Object.zyh[ll_cur]
//	ls_cbdybqh = istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.cbdxzqhdm
//	ls_jzid = astr_zhyl_jsxx.JZID
//	ls_grbh = istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.GRBH
	iu_zhyl_his.istr_yb_grjbxx_zhyl.cbdxzqhdm = ls_cbd
	IF Time(ldt_jssj) > Time(23:55:00) THEN
		IF MessageBox('提示',ls_jsjylsh + '的交易时间'+String(ldt_jssj)+'可能存在跨天，是否继续退款操作！',question!,yesno!,2) = 2 THEN
			RETURN -1
		END IF
	END IF
	ls_knxx = ''
	iu_zhyl_his.ii_zymz = 0
	IF ls_ywlx = 'ZY' OR ls_ywlx = 'ZYMZ'  THEN
		IF ls_ywlx = 'ZYMZ' THEN
			iu_zhyl_his.ii_zymz = 1
	   END IF
		select knxx into :ls_knxx from bqxt.zy_brry where zyh = :ldc_zyh;
	ELSE		
		ls_ywlx = 'MZ'
		select jzkh into :ls_knxx from mzxt.mz_brda where brbm = :ls_brbm;
	END IF
	if ls_knxx > ' ' then
		if iu_zhyl_his.uf_zhcx( ls_knxx, ls_return) < 0 then			
			MessageBox('提示','第'+string(ll_cur)+'zhcx失败:kh' + ls_knxx + '  错误：' + ls_return  )
			continue
		end if
	end if
	Lstr_zhyl_jsxx = Lstr_zhyl_jsxx_N
	li_ret = iu_zhyl_his.uf_tfcl( ls_ywlx, ls_jsjylsh, 'YBDZTK', ldt_jssj, Lstr_zhyl_jsxx,ls_return)
	//	li_ret = iu_zhyl_his.uf_jyzf(ldt_jssj,ls_ywlx,ls_grbh,ls_jsjylsh,ls_return)
	IF li_ret < 0 THEN
		MessageBox('提示','退款失败'+ls_return)
		gf_waiting('退款失败',-1)
		RETURN -1
	END IF
	
NEXT
MessageBox('提示','退款成功')
gf_waiting('退款成功......',-1)
return 1





end function

			if ll_find>0 then 
			else
				ll_insert = tab_1.tab_dzxx.dw_dzxx.insertrow(0)
				tab_1.tab_dzxx.dw_dzxx.object.dzr[ll_insert]=Left(ls_dzr,8)
				tab_1.tab_dzxx.dw_dzxx.object.rybh[ll_insert]='1'
				tab_1.tab_dzxx.dw_dzxx.object.JZJSSJ[ll_insert]=gf_server_date()
			end if
		else
			ll_insert = tab_1.tab_dzxx.dw_dzxx.insertrow(0)
			tab_1.tab_dzxx.dw_dzxx.object.dzr[ll_insert]=Left(ls_dzr,8)
			tab_1.tab_dzxx.dw_dzxx.object.rybh[ll_insert]='1'
			tab_1.tab_dzxx.dw_dzxx.object.JZJSSJ[ll_insert]=gf_server_date()
		end if
	end if
	IF tab_1.tab_dzxx.dw_dzxx.Update( ) = 1 THEN
		gf_commit_transaction(sqlca)
	else
		gf_rollback_transaction(sqlca)
		gf_waiting('汇总数据出错，请重试......',-1)
		dw_1.Reset( )
		dw_1.InsertRow(1)
		MessageBox('提示','汇总数据出错，请重试!')
		SetNull(is_dzr)
		RETURN
	end if
	//---------------------
ELSE
	gf_rollback_transaction(sqlca)
	gf_waiting('汇总数据出错，请重试......',-1)
	dw_1.Reset( )
	dw_1.InsertRow(1)
	MessageBox('提示','汇总数据出错，请重试!')
	SetNull(is_dzr)
	RETURN
END IF
gf_waiting('统计数据完成......',-1)





end event

global type gf_mxnr from function_object
end type

forward prototypes
global subroutine gf_mxnr (string as_path, string as_txt, ref string as_filename)
end prototypes

global subroutine gf_mxnr (string as_path, string as_txt, ref string as_filename);String ls_filename
Long ll_fileno
if not FileExists ( as_path ) then
	CreateDirectory ( as_path )
end if
ls_filename =as_path + '\'+ String(Today(),'yyyymmdd')+'.txt'// as_path + '\log\log.txt'
as_filename=String(Today(),'yyyymmdd')+'.txt'
ll_fileno = FileOpen(ls_filename,LineMode!,Write!,LockReadWrite!,Append!)
IF ll_fileno < 0 Then Return 
FileWrite(ll_fileno,String(DateTime(Today(),Now()),'yyyy.mm.dd hh:mm:ss:fff') + '~t' + as_txt)
FileClose(ll_fileno)
end subroutine

public function integer wf_load_jdmx (ref string as_error);IF is_ybjk = 'syd' THEN
	st_1.Text = '医保结算明细(JKXT.SYDYB_JSMX)'
ELSEIF is_ybjk = 'ep' THEN
	st_1.Text = '医保结算明细(JKXT.PYYB_JSMX)'
ELSEIF is_ybjk = 'wd' THEN
	st_1.Text = '医保结算明细(JKXT.YB_JSMX)'
ELSEIF is_ybjk = 'tzsyd' THEN
	st_1.Text = '医保结算明细(JKXT.TZYB_JSMX_SYD)'
ELSEIF is_ybjk = 'lb' THEN
	st_1.Text = '医保结算明细(JKXT.LSYB_JSMX)'
ELSEIF is_ybjk = 'tzsbd' THEN
	st_1.Text = '医保结算明细(JKXT.TZYB_JSMX_SBD)'
ELSEIF is_ybjk = 'zhyb' THEN
	st_1.Text = '医保结算明细(JKXT.ZHYB_JSMX)'	
END IF
dw_ybjsmx.setfilter("")
dw_ybjsmx.FILter( )
CHOOSE CASE ii_bplx
	CASE 1 //预存不平
		dw_ybjsmx.Visible = False
		rb_1.visible = False
		rb_2.visible = False
		rb_3.visible = False
		rb_4.visible = False
		st_1.Text = "门诊账户交易明细(MZXT.H_MZ_ZHJYMX)"
		dw_zhjymx.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_zhjymx'
		dw_zhjymx.SetTransObject( sqlca )
		dw_zhjymx.Retrieve( is_brbm, idt_begin, idt_end )
		
		dw_fpzffs.SetTransObject( sqlca )
		dw_fpzffs.Retrieve( is_brbm, idt_begin, idt_end )
		
		st_2.Text = "门诊交易明细(MZXT.MZ_FPK)"
		dw_mxdz.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_fpkdz'
		dw_mxdz.SetTransObject( sqlca )
		dw_mxdz.Retrieve( is_brbm, idt_begin, idt_end )
	CASE 2 //预存挂号不平
		dw_ybjsmx.Visible = False
		rb_1.visible = False
		rb_2.visible = False
		rb_3.visible = False
		rb_4.visible = False
		st_1.Text = "门诊账户交易明细(MZXT.H_MZ_ZHJYMX)"
		dw_zhjymx.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_zhjymx_gh'
		dw_zhjymx.SetTransObject( sqlca )
		dw_zhjymx.Retrieve( is_brbm, idt_begin, idt_end )
		
		st_2.Text = "门诊挂号明细(MZXT.MZ_GHXX)"
		dw_mxdz.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_ghxxdz'
		dw_mxdz.SetTransObject( sqlca )
		dw_mxdz.Retrieve( is_brbm, idt_begin, idt_end )
	CASE 31 //基金支付不平（门诊）
		IF is_ybjk = 'ep' THEN
			dw_ybjsmx.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_jsmx_pymz'
		ELSEIF is_ybjk = 'syd' THEN
			dw_ybjsmx.DataObject = 'd_syd_jsmx_mz'
		ELSEIF is_ybjk = 'tzsbd' THEN
			dw_ybjsmx.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_jsmx_tzsbd_mz'
		ELSEIF is_ybjk = 'tzsyd' THEN
			dw_ybjsmx.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_jsmx_tzsydmz'
		ELSEIF is_ybjk = 'lb' THEN
			dw_ybjsmx.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_jsmx_lsmz'
		ELSEIF is_ybjk = 'zhyb' THEN
			dw_ybjsmx.DataObject = 'd_zhyb_jsmx_mz'
		ELSE
			dw_ybjsmx.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_jsmx_mz'
		END IF
		dw_ybjsmx.SetTransObject( sqlca )
		dw_ybjsmx.Retrieve( is_brbm, idt_begin, idt_end )
		dw_mxdz.SetTransObject( sqlca )
	CASE 32 //基金支付不平（住院）
		IF is_ybjk = 'ep' THEN
			dw_ybjsmx.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_jsmx_pyzy'
		ELSEIF is_ybjk = 'syd' THEN
			dw_ybjsmx.DataObject = 'd_syd_jsmx_zy'
		ELSEIF is_ybjk = 'tzsbd' THEN
			dw_ybjsmx.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_jsmx_tzsbdzy'	
		ELSEIF is_ybjk = 'tzsyd' THEN
			dw_ybjsmx.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_jsmx_tzsydzy'
		ELSEIF is_ybjk = 'lb' THEN
			dw_ybjsmx.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_jsmx_lszy'
		ELSEIF is_ybjk = 'zhyb' THEN
			dw_ybjsmx.DataObject = 'd_zhyb_jsmx_zy'	
		ELSE
			dw_ybjsmx.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_jsmx_zy'
		END IF
		dw_ybjsmx.SetTransObject( sqlca )
		dw_ybjsmx.Retrieve( il_zyh )
		dw_mxdz.SetTransObject( sqlca )
	CASE 4,7,41 //门诊收稤AT*

		
		IF is_ybjk = 'ep' THEN
			dw_ybjsmx.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_jsmx_pymz'
		ELSEIF is_ybjk = 'syd' THEN
			dw_ybjsmx.DataObject = 'd_syd_jsmx_mz'
		ELSEIF is_ybjk = 'tzsyd' THEN
			dw_ybjsmx.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_jsmx_tzsydmz'
		ELSEIF is_ybjk = 'lb' THEN
			dw_ybjsmx.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_jsmx_lsmz'
		ELSEIF is_ybjk = 'tzsbd' THEN
			dw_ybjsmx.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_jsmx_tzsbd_mz'
		ELSEIF is_ybjk = 'zhyb' THEN
			dw_ybjsmx.DataObject = 'd_zhyb_jsmx_mz'	
		ELSE
			dw_ybjsmx.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_jsmx_mz'
		END IF
		dw_ybjsmx.SetTransObject( sqlca )
		dw_ybjsmx.Retrieve( is_brbm, idt_begin, idt_end )
		st_2.Text = "门诊交易明细(MZXT.MZ_FPK)"
		dw_mxdz.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_fpkdz'
		dw_mxdz.SetTransObject( sqlca )
		dw_mxdz.Retrieve( is_brbm, idt_begin, idt_end )
		
		if ii_bplx = 4 or  ii_bplx = 41 then
			dw_ybjsmx.setfilter("YWLX = 'SF'")
			dw_ybjsmx.FILter( )
			cb_gzcl.event clicked( )
			cb_save.event clicked( )
			if ii_bplx = 41 then cb_exit.event clicked( )
		end if
	CASE 5,8,51 //门诊挂号不平
		
		IF is_ybjk = 'ep' THEN
			dw_ybjsmx.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_jsmx_pymz'
		ELSEIF is_ybjk = 'syd' THEN
			dw_ybjsmx.DataObject = 'd_syd_jsmx_mz'
		ELSEIF is_ybjk = 'tzsyd' THEN
			dw_ybjsmx.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_jsmx_tzsydmz'
		ELSEIF is_ybjk = 'lb' THEN
			dw_ybjsmx.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_jsmx_lsmz'
		ELSEIF is_ybjk = 'tzsbd' THEN
			dw_ybjsmx.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_jsmx_tzsbd_mz'
		ELSEIF is_ybjk = 'zhyb' THEN
			dw_ybjsmx.DataObject = 'd_zhyb_jsmx_mz'	
		ELSE
			dw_ybjsmx.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_jsmx_mz'
		END IF
		dw_ybjsmx.SetTransObject( sqlca )	
		dw_ybjsmx.Retrieve( is_brbm, idt_begin, idt_end )
		st_2.Text = "门诊挂号明细(MZXT.MZ_GHXX)"
		dw_mxdz.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_ghxxdz'
		dw_mxdz.SetTransObject( sqlca )
		dw_mxdz.Retrieve( is_brbm, idt_begin, idt_end )
		if ii_bplx = 5 or  ii_bplx = 51 then
			dw_ybjsmx.setfilter("YWLX = 'GH'")
			dw_ybjsmx.FILter( )
			cb_gzcl.event clicked( )
			cb_save.event clicked( )
			if ii_bplx = 51 then cb_exit.event clicked( )
		end if
	CASE 6,9 //住院不平
		IF il_zyh <= 0 Or IsNull(il_zyh) THEN
			IF IsNull(il_zyh) THEN il_zyh = 0
			as_error = '传入住院号有误ZYH' + String(il_zyh)
			RETURN -1
		END IF
		IF is_ybjk = 'ep' THEN
			dw_ybjsmx.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_jsmx_pyzy'
		ELSEIF is_ybjk = 'syd' THEN
			dw_ybjsmx.DataObject = 'd_syd_jsmx_zy'
		ELSEIF is_ybjk = 'tzsyd' THEN
			dw_ybjsmx.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_jsmx_tzsydzy'
		ELSEIF is_ybjk = 'lb' THEN
			dw_ybjsmx.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_jsmx_lszy'
		ELSEIF is_ybjk = 'tzsbd' THEN
			dw_ybjsmx.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_jsmx_tzsbdzy'			
		ELSEIF is_ybjk = 'zhyb' THEN
			dw_ybjsmx.DataObject = 'd_zhyb_jsmx_zy'		
		ELSE
			dw_ybjsmx.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_jsmx_zy'
		END IF
		dw_ybjsmx.SetTransObject( sqlca )
		dw_ybjsmx.Retrieve( il_zyh )
		if ii_bplx = 6 then
			dw_ybjsmx.setfilter("YWLX = 'ZY'")
			dw_ybjsmx.FILter( )
		end if
		st_2.Text = "住院结算明细(BQXT.ZY_ZYJS)"
		dw_mxdz.DataObject = 'd_sbdz_zyjsdz'
		dw_mxdz.SetTransObject( sqlca )
		dw_mxdz.Retrieve( il_zyh )
END CHOOSE

RETURN 1



end function

public subroutine wf_get_sql ();String ls_sql, ls_sql1, ls_sql2, ls_sql3, ls_sql4, ls_sql5
Integer li_pos1, li_pos2, li_pos3

//JKXT.YB_JSMX的SQL语句
IF ii_bplx = 32 Or ii_bplx = 6 THEN
	ls_sql = dw_ybjsmx.Object.DataWindow.Table.SELECT
	li_pos1 = Pos(ls_sql, ":an_zyh")
	ls_sql = Replace(ls_sql, li_pos1, 7, String(il_zyh))
ELSEIF ii_bplx = 31 Or ii_bplx = 4 Or ii_bplx = 5 or ii_bplx = 41 Or ii_bplx = 51 THEN
	ls_sql = dw_ybjsmx.Object.DataWindow.Table.SELECT
	li_pos1 = Pos(ls_sql, ":as_brbm")
	ls_sql = Replace(ls_sql, li_pos1, 8, "'" + is_brbm + "'")
	li_pos2 = Pos(ls_sql, ":adt_begin")
	ls_sql = Replace(ls_sql, li_pos2, 10, gf_dtinsql(idt_begin))
	li_pos3 = Pos(ls_sql, ":adt_end")
	ls_sql = Replace(ls_sql, li_pos3, 8, gf_dtinsql(idt_end))
END IF

//MZXT.MZ_FPK的SQL语句
IF ii_bplx = 1 Or ii_bplx = 4 or ii_bplx = 41 THEN
	ls_sql1 = dw_mxdz.Object.DataWindow.Table.SELECT
	li_pos1 = Pos(ls_sql1, ":as_brbm")
	ls_sql1 = Replace(ls_sql1, li_pos1, 8, "'" + is_brbm + "'")
	li_pos2 = Pos(ls_sql1, ":adt_begin")
	ls_sql1 = Replace(ls_sql1, li_pos2, 10, gf_dtinsql(idt_begin))
	li_pos3 = Pos(ls_sql1, ":adt_end")
	ls_sql1 = Replace(ls_sql1, li_pos3, 8, gf_dtinsql(idt_end))
END IF

//MZXT.MZ_GHXX的SQL语句
IF ii_bplx = 2 Or ii_bplx = 5 or ii_bplx = 51 THEN
	ls_sql2 = dw_mxdz.Object.DataWindow.Table.SELECT
	li_pos1 = Pos(ls_sql2, ":as_brbm")
	ls_sql2 = Replace(ls_sql2, li_pos1, 8, "'" + is_brbm + "'")
	li_pos2 = Pos(ls_sql2, ":adt_begin")
	ls_sql2 = Replace(ls_sql2, li_pos2, 10, gf_dtinsql(idt_begin))
	li_pos3 = Pos(ls_sql2, ":adt_end")
	ls_sql2 = Replace(ls_sql2, li_pos3, 8, gf_dtinsql(idt_end))
END IF

//BQXT.ZY_ZYJS的SQL语句
IF ii_bplx = 6 THEN
	ls_sql3 = dw_mxdz.Object.DataWindow.Table.SELECT
	li_pos1 = Pos(ls_sql3, ":an_zyh")
	ls_sql3 = Replace(ls_sql3, li_pos1, 7, String(il_zyh))
END IF

//MZXT.H_MZ_ZHJYMX的SQL语句
IF ii_bplx = 1 Or ii_bplx = 2 THEN
	ls_sql4 = dw_zhjymx.Object.DataWindow.Table.SELECT
	li_pos1 = Pos(ls_sql4, ":as_brbm")
	ls_sql4 = Replace(ls_sql4, li_pos1, 8, "'" + is_brbm + "'")
	li_pos2 = Pos(ls_sql4, ":adt_begin")
	ls_sql4 = Replace(ls_sql4, li_pos2, 10, gf_dtinsql(idt_begin))
	li_pos3 = Pos(ls_sql4, ":adt_end")
	ls_sql4 = Replace(ls_sql4, li_pos3, 8, gf_dtinsql(idt_end))
END IF

//MZXT.H_FP_ZFFS的SQL语句
IF ii_bplx = 1 Or ii_bplx = 2 THEN
	ls_sql5 = dw_fpzffs.Object.DataWindow.Table.SELECT
	li_pos1 = Pos(ls_sql5, ":as_brbm")
	ls_sql5 = Replace(ls_sql5, li_pos1, 8, "'" + is_brbm + "'")
	li_pos2 = Pos(ls_sql5, ":adt_begin")
	ls_sql5 = Replace(ls_sql5, li_pos2, 10, gf_dtinsql(idt_begin))
	li_pos3 = Pos(ls_sql5, ":adt_end")
	ls_sql5 = Replace(ls_sql5, li_pos3, 8, gf_dtinsql(idt_end))
END IF

IF ls_sql <> "" And Not IsNull(ls_sql) THEN
	IF is_sql <> "" And Not IsNull(is_sql) THEN
		is_sql = is_sql + ls_sql + ";~n"
	ELSE
		is_sql = "~n" + ls_sql + ";~n"
	END IF
END IF

IF ls_sql1 <> "" And Not IsNull(ls_sql1) THEN
	IF is_sql <> "" And Not IsNull(is_sql) THEN
		is_sql = is_sql + ls_sql1 + ";~n"
	ELSE
		is_sql = "~n" + ls_sql1 + ";~n"
	END IF
END IF

IF ls_sql2 <> "" And Not IsNull(ls_sql2) THEN
	IF is_sql <> "" And Not IsNull(is_sql) THEN
		is_sql = is_sql + ls_sql2 + ";~n"
	ELSE
		is_sql = "~n" + ls_sql2 + ";~n"
	END IF
END IF

IF ls_sql3 <> "" And Not IsNull(ls_sql3) THEN
	IF is_sql <> "" And Not IsNull(is_sql) THEN
		is_sql = is_sql + ls_sql3 + ";~n"
	ELSE
		is_sql = "~n" + ls_sql3 + ";~n"
	END IF
END IF

IF ls_sql4 <> "" And Not IsNull(ls_sql4) THEN
	IF is_sql <> "" And Not IsNull(is_sql) THEN
		is_sql = is_sql + ls_sql4 + ";~n"
	ELSE
		is_sql = "~n" + ls_sql4 + ";~n"
	END IF
END IF

IF ls_sql5 <> "" And Not IsNull(ls_sql5) THEN
	IF is_sql <> "" And Not IsNull(is_sql) THEN
		is_sql = is_sql + ls_sql5 + ";~n"
	ELSE
		is_sql = "~n" + ls_sql5 + ";~n"
	END IF
END IF


end subroutine

public subroutine wf_write_log ();IF is_sql = "" Or IsNull(is_sql) THEN
	wf_get_sql()
END IF

FileWrite(li_FileNum,"// " + String(Today(),"yyyy.mm.dd") + " " + String(Now(),"hh:mm:ss") + is_xgjl + is_sql )
FileClose(li_FileNum)
RETURN

end subroutine

public function integer wf_bjy (ref string as_error);String ls_brbm,ls_ksbm,ls_ysbm,ls_ywlx_y,ls_fplsh
Dec{0} ldc_ghlsh
Dec{2} ldc_zjje,ldc_jzje,ldc_yhje,ldc_yhje_t
Integer li_gfje,li_count,li_row
DateTime ldt_now,ldt_kpsj
u_datastore uds_bjy_temp
uds_bjy_temp = Create u_datastore
uds_bjy_temp.DataObject = 'd_zhybbjy_temp'
uds_bjy_temp.SetTransObject(sqlca)
li_count = uds_bjy_temp.Retrieve()
IF li_count <= 0 THEN
	IF IsValid(uds_bjy_temp) THEN Destroy uds_bjy_temp
	RETURN 0
END IF
ldt_now = gf_server_date()
ls_brbm = uds_bjy_temp.Object.brbm[1]

uo_brxx luo_brxx
u_datastore lds_yb_sfmx
IF IsValid(gu_ybjk_public) = False THEN
	gu_ybjk_public = Create u_ybjk_public
	IF gu_ybjk_public.uf_init(as_error) = False THEN
		as_error = '医保初始化失败：' + as_error
		GOTO Error
	END IF
END IF
str_brxx lstr_brxx
str_return lstr_return
luo_brxx = Create uo_brxx
string ls_jzkh
ls_jzkh = gf_inputbox('请刷卡','')
lstr_brxx.jzkh = ls_jzkh
lstr_return = luo_brxx.uf_get_brxx(lstr_brxx)
IF lstr_return.ai_return < 0 THEN
	as_error = '获取病人信息失败：' + lstr_return.as_error
	GOTO Error
END IF 

//lstr_brxx.BRBM = ls_brbm //
if ls_brbm <> lstr_brxx.BRBM then
	as_error = '病人编码不一致:' + ls_brbm + '----' + lstr_brxx.BRBM
	GOTO Error
end if
str_yb_mzsfqq_public lstr_yb_mzsfqq,lstr_yb_mzsfqq_null
Dec{2} ldc_smkzf
String ls_jylx,ls_bzdm
ldc_smkzf = 0
Dec{2} ldc_xmsl
String ls_ywlx,ls_filter
Long ll_fyxh,ll_ypcd,ll_find
Long ll_count ,ll_cur,ll_yyts,ll_spbz
Dec{0} ldc_cflsh,ldc_jzlsh
String ls_ycsl,ls_jl,ls_jsjylsh,ls_firstfplsh,ls_fplshs[],ls_fplsh_temp[],ls_fplsh_null[]
String ls_ywlsh,ls_zh,ls_spbz
Boolean lb_isyz = False
Int li_ret
Dec{2} ldc_tzje,ldc_tjzje
String ls_newfp = ''
str_yb_mzghqq_new lstr_yb_mzghqq
lds_yb_sfmx = Create u_datastore
FOR li_row = 1 To li_count
	ls_ywlx_y = uds_bjy_temp.Object.ywlx[li_row]
	ls_fplsh = uds_bjy_temp.Object.ywlsh[li_row]
	ls_jylx = uds_bjy_temp.Object.yllb[li_row]
	ls_bzdm = uds_bjy_temp.Object.bzbm[li_row]
	IF ls_ywlx_y = 'GH' THEN
		ldc_ghlsh = Dec(ls_fplsh)
		SELECT BRBM,nvl(ZJJE,0),nvl(ZJJE,0) - nvl(XJJE,0),KSBM,ysbm Into :ls_brbm,:ldc_zjje,:ldc_jzje,:ls_ksbm,:ls_ysbm From MZ_GHXX Where GHLSH = :ldc_ghlsh;
	ELSE
		SELECT grbm,GHLSH,(CASE when gfje = 1 THEN xmzje - nvl(yhje,0) ELSE xmzje END) ,jzje Into :ls_brbm,:ldc_ghlsh,:ldc_zjje,:ldc_jzje From mz_fpk Where fplsh = :ls_fplsh;
	END IF
	IF sqlca.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
		as_error = '获取发票信息失败：' + sqlca.SQLErrText
		RETURN -1
	END IF
	
	//SELECT jyjslx,smkzhzf Into :ls_jylx,:ldc_smkzf From jkxt.zhyb_jsmx Where BRBM = :ls_brbm And ywlx  = :as_ywlx And ywlsh = :as_fplsh And ztbz In (1,2,-1) Using sqlca;
	
	//SELECT yllb ,bzbm INTO  :ls_jylx, :ls_bzdm FROM JKXT.ZHYB_JSMX
	//	Where BRBM = :ls_brbm And ywlx  = :ls_ywlx And ywlsh = :ls_ywlsh  And ztbz In (1,2) Using sqlca;
	
	IF sqlca.SQLCode <> 0 THEN
		as_error = '获取医保结算信息出错:' + sqlca.SQLErrText
		GOTO Error
	END IF
	IF ls_jylx = '11' Or ls_jylx = '12' Or ls_jylx = '13' THEN
		ls_jylx = 'PT'
	ELSEIF ls_jylx = '140201' THEN
		ls_jylx = 'TSB'
		lstr_brxx.tsbxm = ls_bzdm
	ELSEIF ls_jylx = '14' THEN // ls_jylx = '140104' Or
		ls_jylx = 'MXB'
		lstr_brxx.mxbxm = ls_bzdm
	ELSEIF ls_jylx = '140401' THEN
		ls_jylx = 'HJB'
	ELSEIF ls_jylx = '51' THEN
		ls_jylx = 'SY'
	ELSE
		ls_jylx = 'PT'
	END IF
	IF ls_ywlx_y = 'GH' THEN
		lds_yb_sfmx.DataObject = 'd_gh_bjy'
		lds_yb_sfmx.SetTransObject( sqlca)
		ll_count = lds_yb_sfmx.Retrieve(ldc_ghlsh )
	ELSE
		ls_firstfplsh = ''
		ls_newfp = ''
		ls_fplshs = ls_fplsh_null
		ls_fplsh_temp = ls_fplsh_null
		ls_fplshs[1] = ls_fplsh
		ldc_tzje = 0.00
		ldc_tjzje = 0.00
		ldc_yhje_t = 0.00
		ldc_zjje = 0.00
		ldc_jzje = 0.00
		ldc_yhje = 0.00
		li_gfje = 0.00
		setnull(ldt_kpsj)
		lds_yb_sfmx.DataObject = 'd_cwsf_mz_sfmx_bjy'
		lds_yb_sfmx.SetTransObject( sqlca)
		SELECT firstfplsh Into :ls_firstfplsh From mz_tpxx Where newfplsh = :ls_fplsh And tpxh = 0;
		IF ls_firstfplsh > '' THEN			
			ls_fplshs[2] = ls_firstfplsh
			SELECT to_char(wm_concat(newfplsh)) Into :ls_newfp  From mz_tpxx Where firstfplsh = :ls_firstfplsh And tpxh = 0 And newfplsh <> :ls_fplsh;
			IF ls_newfp > ' ' THEN
				gf_splitparm(ls_newfp,ls_fplsh_temp)
				IF UpperBound(ls_fplsh_temp) > 0 THEN
					FOR ll_cur = 1 To UpperBound(ls_fplsh_temp)
						ls_fplshs[2 + ll_cur] = ls_fplsh_temp[ll_cur]
					NEXT
				END IF
			END IF
			SELECT GHLSH,xmzje,jzje,nvl(yhje,0),gfje,kpsj Into :ldc_ghlsh,:ldc_zjje,:ldc_jzje,:ldc_yhje,:li_gfje,:ldt_kpsj From mz_fpk Where fplsh = :ls_firstfplsh;
			IF li_gfje = 1 THEN
				SELECT sum(nvl(yhje,0)) Into :ldc_yhje_t From mz_fpk Where grbm = :ls_brbm And kpsj >= :ldt_kpsj  And fplsh In (SELECT fplsh From mz_tpxx Where firstfplsh = :ls_firstfplsh And tpxh = 0 );
				IF IsNull(ldc_yhje_t) THEN ldc_yhje_t = 0
			END IF
			SELECT sum(t_zje),sum(t_jzje) Into :ldc_tzje,:ldc_tjzje From mz_tpxx Where firstfplsh = :ls_firstfplsh And tpxh = 0 ;
			IF IsNull(ldc_tzje) THEN ldc_tzje = 0
			IF IsNull(ldc_tjzje) THEN ldc_tjzje = 0
			ldc_zjje = ldc_zjje - ldc_tzje - ldc_yhje_t
			ldc_jzje = ldc_jzje - ldc_tjzje
		END IF
		ldc_jzlsh = 0
		ls_ysbm = ''
		ls_ksbm = ''
		ll_count = lds_yb_sfmx.Retrieve(ls_fplshs )
		if ll_count <= 0 then 
			as_error ='明细出错' +  lds_yb_sfmx.is_error
			return -1
		end if
		//	获取对应的KSBM,YSBM,GHLSH,JZLSH GH.CBDXZQH
		SELECT GH.YSBM,GH.KSBM, JZ.JZLSH INTO :ls_ysbm,:ls_ksbm,:ldc_jzlsh
			FROM JKXT.ZHYB_MZJZXX JZ,JKXT.ZHYB_GHXX GH
			Where GH.BRBM = JZ.BRBM And GH.JZID = JZ.JZID And GH.BRBM = :ls_brbm And GH.ywlsh = :ls_fplsh;
		IF ls_ysbm = '000000' THEN
			ls_ysbm = ''
		ELSE
			SELECT ygdm Into :ls_ysbm From gy_ygdm_kz Where gjybdm = :ls_ysbm;
			//ls_ksbm = 'YB+' +ls_ksbm
		END IF
		IF ldc_jzlsh > 0  THEN
			SELECT JZKS Into :ls_ksbm From MZ_JZXX Where JZLSH = :ldc_jzlsh;
		END IF
	END IF
	
	IF ls_ywlx_y = 'SF' And ll_count > 0  THEN
		
		FOR ll_cur = 1 To ll_count
			ldc_cflsh = lds_yb_sfmx.Object.ywlsh[ll_cur]
			ls_ywlsh = String(ldc_cflsh)
			ls_zh  = String(lds_yb_sfmx.Object.mxxh[ll_cur])
			ls_filter = ''
			IF lds_yb_sfmx.Object.ywlx[ll_cur] = 'CF' THEN
				If (ldc_jzlsh <= 0 Or IsNull(ldc_jzlsh)) And ll_cur = 1 THEN
					SELECT KSBM Into :ls_ksbm From YPXT.mz_cfk Where cflsh = :ldc_cflsh;
				END IF
				SELECT ycsl,jl,yyts Into :ls_ycsl,:ls_jl,:ll_yyts From mz_cfmx Where cflsh = :ldc_cflsh And xh = :ls_zh Using sqlca;
				lds_yb_sfmx.Object.ycjl[ll_cur] = ls_ycsl
				lds_yb_sfmx.Object.sypc[ll_cur] = ls_jl
				lds_yb_sfmx.Object.yyts[ll_cur] = ll_yyts
				lds_yb_sfmx.Object.ypzh[ll_cur] = ls_zh
				IF gu_ybjk_public.uf_Get_spbz( 'CF', ls_brbm, ldc_cflsh, Dec(ls_zh), ll_spbz, as_error) < 0 THEN
					as_error = '获取spbz失败：' + as_error
					RETURN -1
				END IF
			ELSE
				If (ldc_jzlsh <= 0 Or IsNull(ldc_jzlsh)) And ll_cur = 1 THEN
					SELECT KSBM Into :ls_ksbm From MZXT.MZ_yjk1 Where YJLSH = :ldc_cflsh;
				END IF
				IF gu_ybjk_public.uf_Get_spbz( 'YJ', ls_brbm, ldc_cflsh, Dec(ls_zh), ll_spbz, as_error) < 0 THEN
					as_error = '获取spbz失败：' + as_error
					RETURN -1
				END IF
			END IF
			IF IsNull(ll_spbz) THEN ll_spbz = 0
			lds_yb_sfmx.Object.spbz[ll_cur] = ll_spbz
			ldc_xmsl = lds_yb_sfmx.Object.xmsl[ll_cur]
			ll_fyxh = lds_yb_sfmx.Object.xmlsh[ll_cur]
			ll_ypcd = lds_yb_sfmx.Object.cdlsh[ll_cur]
			ls_ywlx = lds_yb_sfmx.Object.ywlx[ll_cur]
			IF ldc_xmsl < 0 THEN
				//数量小于0 的和正的消掉
				ldc_xmsl = ldc_xmsl * -1
				ls_filter = " ywlx = '"+ls_ywlx+"' and xmlsh = "+String(ll_fyxh)+" and cdlsh = "+String(ll_ypcd) + " and xmdj = " +String(lds_yb_sfmx.Object.xmdj[ll_cur])  +" and xmsl >= " + String(ldc_xmsl)
				IF ll_spbz = 9 Or ll_spbz = 1 THEN
					ls_filter += " and spbz in (1,9) "
				ELSE
					ls_filter += " and spbz in (0,2,8) "
				END IF
				ll_find = lds_yb_sfmx.Find(ls_filter,1,ll_cur - 1)
				IF ll_find > 0 THEN
					lds_yb_sfmx.Object.xmsl[ll_find] = lds_yb_sfmx.Object.xmsl[ll_find] - ldc_xmsl
					IF lds_yb_sfmx.Object.xmsl[ll_find] = 0 THEN
						lds_yb_sfmx.DeleteRow( ll_find)
						ll_cur --
						ll_count --
					ELSE
						lds_yb_sfmx.Object.ZJJE[ll_find] = lds_yb_sfmx.Object.ZJJE[ll_find] + lds_yb_sfmx.Object.ZJJE[ll_cur]
						lds_yb_sfmx.Object.zfje[ll_find] = lds_yb_sfmx.Object.zfje[ll_find] + lds_yb_sfmx.Object.zfje[ll_cur]
						lds_yb_sfmx.Object.yhje[ll_find] = lds_yb_sfmx.Object.yhje[ll_find] + lds_yb_sfmx.Object.yhje[ll_cur]
					END IF
					lds_yb_sfmx.DeleteRow( ll_cur)
					ll_cur --
					ll_count --
				ELSE
					as_error = String(ll_find) + '找不到大于等于的该正数量的明细' +  String(lds_yb_sfmx.Object.xmmc[ll_cur])
					RETURN -1
				END IF
			END IF
		NEXT
	END IF
	IF ll_count <= 0 THEN
		as_error = '无明细' + String(ll_count)
		GOTO Error
	END IF
	IF IsNull(ldc_jzlsh) Or ldc_jzlsh = 0 THEN
		SELECT Min(JZLSH) Into :ldc_jzlsh From MZ_JZXX Where GHLSH = :ldc_ghlsh;
	END IF
	lstr_yb_mzsfqq = lstr_yb_mzsfqq_null
	lstr_yb_mzsfqq.str_yb_grjbxx = gu_ybjk_public.istr_yb_grjbxx
	//lstr_yb_mzsfqq.str_yb_zhxx = gu_ybjk_public.istr_yb_zhxx //病人账户信息
	lstr_yb_mzsfqq.ads_mzfymx = Create datastore //费用明细
	lstr_yb_mzsfqq.ads_mzfymx.DataObject = lds_yb_sfmx.DataObject
	lstr_yb_mzsfqq.ads_mzfymx.Reset()
	lds_yb_sfmx.RowsCopy(1, lds_yb_sfmx.RowCount(), Primary!, lstr_yb_mzsfqq.ads_mzfymx, 1, Primary!)
	lstr_yb_mzsfqq.ysbm = ls_ysbm
	IF ls_ywlx_y = 'SF' THEN
		lstr_yb_mzsfqq.ads_mzfymx.SetSort('xmsl D')
		lstr_yb_mzsfqq.ads_mzfymx.Sort( )
	END IF
	// //市民卡诊间结算，医保是否结算
	//SetNull(lstr_yb_mzsfqq.ybsfjs)
	//lstr_yb_mzsfqq.smkzhsfzf = '1' //0：支付  1：不支付
	//IF ldc_smkzf <> 0 THEN
	//	lstr_yb_mzsfqq.smkzhsfzf = '0' //0：支付  1：不支付 --市民卡账户是否支付
	//	lstr_yb_mzsfqq.ybsfjs = '1'
	//ELSE
	//	lstr_yb_mzsfqq.smkzhsfzf = '1'
	//	lstr_yb_mzsfqq.ybsfjs = '2'
	//END IF
	lstr_yb_mzsfqq.GHLSH = ldc_ghlsh
	lstr_yb_mzsfqq.JZLSH = ldc_jzlsh
	lstr_yb_mzsfqq.KSBM = ls_ksbm
	lstr_yb_mzsfqq.fplsh = ''
	//lstr_yb_mzsfqq.jzlsh = 
	IF ls_jylx = 'TSB' Or ls_jylx = 'MXB' THEN
		lstr_yb_mzsfqq.tsbxmdm = String(lstr_brxx.tsbxm ) //特殊病编码
		lstr_yb_mzsfqq.mxbxmdm = String(lstr_brxx.mxbxm ) //慢性病编码
	END IF
	
	IF ls_ywlx_y = 'GH' THEN
		IF gu_ybjk_public.uf_gh_jscl( lstr_brxx.BRBM, False,ls_jylx, gstr_jqxx.as_jqm, lstr_yb_mzsfqq, lstr_yb_mzghqq, as_error) < 0 THEN
			//   IF gu_ybjk_public.uf_gh_jscl( lstr_brxx.brbm, false, ls_jylx, gstr_jqxx.as_jqm, lstr_yb_mzsfqq, lstr_yb_mzghqq, as_error) < 0 THEN
			GOTO Error
		ELSEIF lstr_yb_mzsfqq.str_yb_jsxx.ylfyze + lstr_yb_mzsfqq.str_yb_jsxx.bscfyje <> ldc_zjje Or lstr_yb_mzsfqq.str_yb_jsxx.jjzfze <> ldc_jzje THEN
			as_error = '医保与发票金额不一致，医保金额：' + String(lstr_yb_mzsfqq.str_yb_jsxx.ylfyze) + '--' +String(lstr_yb_mzsfqq.str_yb_jsxx.jjzfze) + '发票金额：' + String (ldc_zjje) +'---'  + String(ldc_jzje)
			IF MessageBox('询问',as_error + '~r~n是否继续补记录'  ,question!,yesno!,2) = 2 THEN
//				as_error = '取消操作'
				GOTO Error
			END IF
//			GOTO Error
		END IF
	ELSE
		IF gu_ybjk_public.uf_mz_jscl(lstr_brxx.BRBM, 0, ls_jylx,gstr_jqxx.as_jqm,lstr_yb_mzsfqq, as_error ) < 0 THEN
			GOTO Error
		ELSE
			IF lstr_yb_mzsfqq.str_yb_jsxx.ylfyze + lstr_yb_mzsfqq.str_yb_jsxx.bscfyje <> ldc_zjje Or lstr_yb_mzsfqq.str_yb_jsxx.jjzfze <> ldc_jzje THEN
				as_error = '医保与发票金额不一致，医保金额：' + String(lstr_yb_mzsfqq.str_yb_jsxx.ylfyze) + '--' +String(lstr_yb_mzsfqq.str_yb_jsxx.jjzfze) + '发票金额：' + String (ldc_zjje) +'---'  + String(ldc_jzje)
				IF MessageBox('询问',as_error + '~r~n是否继续补记录'  ,question!,yesno!,2) = 2 THEN
					GOTO Error
				END IF
			ELSE
				IF MessageBox('询问','是否继续补记录'  ,question!,yesno!,2) = 2 THEN
					as_error = '取消操作'
					GOTO Error
				END IF				
			END IF
		END IF
	END IF
	//lstr_yb_mzsfqq.fplsh = 'A' + as_fplsh
	lstr_yb_mzsfqq.fplsh = ls_fplsh	
	lstr_yb_mzsfqq.ads_mzfymx.Reset()
	lds_yb_sfmx.RowsCopy(1, lds_yb_sfmx.RowCount(), Primary!, lstr_yb_mzsfqq.ads_mzfymx, 1, Primary!)
	lstr_yb_mzsfqq.ysbm = ls_ysbm
	IF ls_ywlx_y = 'SF' THEN
		lstr_yb_mzsfqq.ads_mzfymx.SetSort('xmsl D')
		lstr_yb_mzsfqq.ads_mzfymx.Sort( )
	END IF
	IF ls_ywlx_y = 'GH' THEN
		li_ret = gu_ybjk_public.uf_gh_jscl( lstr_brxx.BRBM, True, ls_jylx, gstr_jqxx.as_jqm, lstr_yb_mzsfqq, lstr_yb_mzghqq, as_error)
	ELSE
		IF gu_ybjk_public.uf_mz_jscl(lstr_brxx.BRBM, 1, ls_jylx,gstr_jqxx.as_jqm,lstr_yb_mzsfqq, as_error ) < 0 THEN
			GOTO Error
		END IF
		li_ret = gu_ybjk_public.uf_mz_jscl(lstr_brxx.BRBM, 2, ls_jylx,gstr_jqxx.as_jqm,lstr_yb_mzsfqq, as_error )
	END IF
	
IF li_ret < 0 THEN
		GOTO Error
	ELSE
		ls_jsjylsh = lstr_yb_mzsfqq.str_yb_jsxx.jsjylsh
		//本次结算所有的不够市民卡支付，但是如果有支付，那么回滚
		IF IsNull(lstr_yb_mzsfqq.str_yb_jsxx.smkzhzfje) THEN lstr_yb_mzsfqq.str_yb_jsxx.smkzhzfje = 0.00
		//	ldc_smkzf = ldc_smkzf + lstr_yb_mzsfqq.str_yb_jsxx.smkzhzfje
		as_error = ''
		IF ldc_smkzf = 0 And lstr_yb_mzsfqq.str_yb_jsxx.smkzhzfje <> 0 THEN
			lb_isyz = True
			as_error = '原非市民卡账户支付，但现存在市民卡账户支付:' + String(lstr_yb_mzsfqq.str_yb_jsxx.smkzhzfje)
		ELSEIF ldc_smkzf <> 0 And (lstr_yb_mzsfqq.str_yb_jsxx.smkzhzfje <> lstr_yb_mzsfqq.str_yb_jsxx.xjzfze Or ldc_smkzf <> lstr_yb_mzsfqq.str_yb_jsxx.smkzhzfje) THEN
			lb_isyz = True
			as_error = '市民卡支付不一致，原:'+String(ldc_smkzf)+'自负：'+String(lstr_yb_mzsfqq.str_yb_jsxx.xjzfze) +"市民卡："+ String(lstr_yb_mzsfqq.str_yb_jsxx.smkzhzfje)
		END IF
		IF lb_isyz THEN
			gu_ybjk_public.uf_tkqr( 'MZ', lstr_brxx.jzkh,ls_jsjylsh,ldc_zjje,gstr_jqxx.as_jqm,ldt_now,lstr_yb_mzsfqq.str_yb_jsxx,as_error)
			//		gu_ybjk_public.uf_tkqr(lstr_brxx.jzkh,ls_jsjylsh,ldc_zjje,gstr_jqxx.as_jqm,ldt_now,lstr_yb_mzsfqq.str_yb_jsxx,as_error)
			GOTO Error
		END IF
		as_error = as_error + '医保金额：' + String(lstr_yb_mzsfqq.str_yb_jsxx.ylfyze) + '--' +String(lstr_yb_mzsfqq.str_yb_jsxx.jjzfze)
	END IF
NEXT
IF IsValid(luo_brxx) THEN Destroy luo_brxx
IF IsValid(lds_yb_sfmx) THEN Destroy lds_yb_sfmx
IF IsValid(uds_bjy_temp) THEN Destroy uds_bjy_temp
RETURN 1
Error:

IF IsValid(luo_brxx) THEN Destroy luo_brxx
IF IsValid(lds_yb_sfmx) THEN Destroy lds_yb_sfmx
IF IsValid(uds_bjy_temp) THEN Destroy uds_bjy_temp
RETURN -1


end function
